title: Staff Backend Engineer - Phone Billing
description:
Job Summary Were looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of Phone Billing, one of the most critical components of HighLevels communication platform. Phone Billing sits at the intersection of product usage, infrastructure, and revenue - it is responsible for accurately metering and monetising usage across LC Phone products, including voice, messages, phone numbers, and other communication services. The scale and criticality of this system make billing correctness non-negotiable. Every communication event can have a financial implication, and a single billing error can impact revenue, customer trust, and financial reconciliation at the same time. The platform processes 100M+ events daily across 15+ services, with billing workflows that need to remain accurate and reliable despite retries, duplicate events, delayed events, provider inconsistencies, partial failures, and continuously evolving pricing models. As a Staff Engineer, youll own the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical strategy of the Phone Billing platform. Youll solve complex distributed-systems problems around usage metering, rating, charging, idempotency, reconciliation, credits, refunds, adjustments, provider cost tracking, and billing lifecycle management. Youll also drive the architectural evolution required to support significantly higher volumes without compromising financial accuracy or system performance. A key part of the role will be building billing systems that are correct by design - ensuring that every billable event is accounted for exactly once from a business perspective, even when the underlying infrastructure operates with retries, at-least-once delivery, asynchronous processing, and failures. Youll establish robust reconciliation mechanisms between HighLevels internal usage data, provider-level usage, and customer invoices, with strong observability and auditability to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies. Youll work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Finance, and other Staff Engineers to define pricing and billing architecture, while partnering across Phone, WhatsApp, CPaaS, and provider-integration teams. Youll influence technical decisions beyond a single team, establish engineering standards, identify systemic technical debt, and drive long-term improvements in reliability, cost efficiency, data architecture, and operational excellence. The broader Phone Core ecosystem includes CPaaS platform services, Trust Compliance, and phone number provisioning, giving this role significant architectural influence across the communication platform. Your primary focus, however, will be making Phone Billing a highly scalable, financially accurate, resilient, observable, and extensible platform capable of supporting the next 10x growth of HighLevels communication business. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical health of Phone Billing - proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, correctness and reliability risks, and technical debt; define and drive the roadmap to improve billing accuracy, reconciliation, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency as the platform scales to 10x its current volume. Drive 1-2 high-impact initiatives end-to-end - take ownership from problem definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, rollout, and measurement, ensuring the initiatives deliver measurable improvements to Phone Billing in areas such as accuracy, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency. Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events. Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage Lead the evolution of Revenue Growth into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses. Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar

This role plays an important part in protecting the confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of technology and data by identifying exploitable weaknesses before they cause harm, validating the effectiveness of security controls, and supporting safer delivery across our technology environment. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Security Compliance \& Governance, you’ll work closely with engineering, cloud, platform, infrastructure, architecture and security teams to embed security early in the software development lifecycle, reduce vulnerabilities reaching production, and provide evidence\-based assurance across applications, APIs, cloud environments and security controls. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys practical security testing, automation, threat emulation, vulnerability lifecycle management and working with technical teams to improve security outcomes in a complex enterprise environment. What You’ll Do
   

  

* Plan and perform authorised, risk\-based security testing across web applications, APIs, infrastructure, networks, identity services and cloud\-hosted workloads.

* Use cloud security posture management tooling to assess cloud vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, attack paths and compliance posture.
* Conduct MITRE ATT\&CK\-aligned control validation, adversary emulation and purple team activities across key security controls.
* Provide practical remediation advice to engineering and technology teams, including guidance aligned to OWASP Top 10, PCI DSS secure coding requirements and secure AI development practices.
* Automate repeatable discovery, testing, ticketing, evidence collection, reporting, remediation tracking and validation activities where practical.
* Produce evidence\-based reports, service metrics and control\-effectiveness insights to support operational, executive, audit and governance reporting. What You’ll Bring
* Experience in cybersecurity, application security, penetration testing, security engineering or DevSecOps.
* Strong knowledge of web application, API and cloud security.
* Hands\-on experience with security testing tools such as SAST, DAST and CSPM platforms.
* Understanding of secure software development and CI/CD environments.
* Experience identifying, validating and remediating security vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of security frameworks including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT\&CK, ISO 27001, NIST and PCI DSS.
* Ability to automate tasks using scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
* Ability to provide practical, risk\-based security advice to technical and business teams.
* Relevant cybersecurity qualifications, certifications or equivalent industry experience.
* A passion for emerging security technologies, automation and continuous improvement.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the job** 




  





**DivyaSree Group — AI Engineering Roles** 




 DivyaSree Group is a diversified, multi\-business organisation with operations spanning real estate development, commercial and residential assets, hospitality, co\-living, asset management, facilities and workplace services, and education through REVA University.The Group's other business verticals operate across three states, while its co\-living business has a presence across seven states.
 



  





 This multi\-business, multi\-location footprint creates a wide range of operational and customer\-centric challenges across assets, services, communities, institutions, and enterprise functions. Group\-wide Centres of Excellence (COEs) support these businesses by developing shared capabilities, platforms, standards, and specialist expertise.
 



  





 As DivyaSree continues to expand, it is investing in AI, data, automation, and digital engineering to improve decision\-making, operational efficiency, resident, guest, customer, and student experiences, asset performance, and enterprise scalability.We are expanding our multidisciplinary engineering team and hiring across AI, machine learning, data, software, analytics, automation, and digital product roles at multiple experience levels. The team will work across business units and COEs to build reusable platforms and intelligent systems that address complex, real\-world problems at scale.
 



  





**Forward Deployed Engineer — AI Initiatives** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Applications open until:** 
 end of September, or as soon as we find the right candidates, whichever comes sooner. Early submissions get reviewed first, so don't wait for the deadline.
 



  





 This is modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role. You don't belong to one business unit and could get deployed wherever in the Group there's a real problem worth solving with AI. It could be Founder's Office, Real Estate, Hospitality, Co\-living, Asset Management, Facilities, REVA University. The objective is to embed with that team, and ship something that works before you move to the next one. Some deployments last days, some last a quarter. Every one ends the same way: a working system, and a team that can run it without you.
 



  





**How deployments work** 



* Founder's Office is one discipline you may be deployed into — fast, high\-ambiguity POC work directly for the founders, days\-to\-decision, kill\-or\-scale
* Other deployments run longer and go deeper — embedding inside a business unit (e.g. Leasing, Co\-living Ops, Hospitality, REVA University, Facilities) to take something from idea to a system that's actually adopted and still running after you leave
* You're assigned based on where the Group's priorities are, not a fixed team — expect to move across disciplines multiple times a year
* Every deployment ends with a handoff: either the receiving team can operate and extend what you built, or you've written a clear, evidence\-backed brief on why it shouldn't be scaled



  





**What you'll do** 



* Sit with whichever business unit or founder you're deployed to, understand the real problem, and define a clear technical plan often before anyone else has scoped it.
* Build and ship production code, prototypes, and everything between, using whatever the problem demands: data pipelines, LLM orchestration across providers, backend services, internal tools, deployment on AWS.
* Decide, every time, whether AI/LLMs are actually the right tool for the problem and say so plainly when they aren't.
* Present your work directly to the stakeholders (founders, business unit heads, functional teams) who asked for it. You own the narrative, not just the code
* Train the team you're embedded with so what you built keeps running without you
* Contribute reusable platforms, frameworks, and standards back to the AI Initiatives COE so the next deployment moves faster than the last



  





**What makes you stand out** 



* You've used AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as your daily driver for a meaningful stretch and not something you tried once
* You orchestrate agents, not just prompt them. You build with skills, MCPs, and multi\-step automation, and it's muscle memory
* You have a public or demonstrable artifact, a shipped project, a hackathon win, a repo, something you can point to and say "I built this, end to end"
* You've shipped something into a real workflow, even an informal one, that's still running without you
* You're comfortable with zero spec and being told "just figure it out"
* You're a fast generalist. You'd rather learn lease accounting, hospitality operations, or campus administration on the fly than wait for a briefing document
* Founder mindset: you've taken something from a blank page to working, on your own hands, at least once
* Comfortable being the only technical person in a room of non\-technical stakeholders, and can explain your work in their language



  





**Who should apply** 




 This isn't limited to computer science grads or people already carrying an "AI Engineer" title. We're open to anyone, from any educational or professional background, at any stage: interns, fresh graduates, or experienced professionals from any discipline who've been wanting to make the move into AI and can show they've already started. What matters is what you've built, not what your degree or job title says.
 



  





**How to apply:** 




 The Build TrackWe're skipping the resume screen and the standard interview funnel for this role. Instead, you pick a problem statement below (or propose your own under the Open Track), build a working solution against it, and submit it. Strong submissions get called in directly for a live panel. No aptitude test, no group discussion in between.
 



  





*What to submit, to* 
***ai@divyasree.com***
*:* 



1. A public GitHub repository with your code. Include a clear README covering what it does, how to run it, and how it's set up.
2. A 5\-minute pitch video (unlisted link is fine): Lead with the problem, then your solution, then a live demo of it actually working. Spend the most time on the AI\-native part: if your project touches agents, orchestration, or LLM reasoning, that's what we want to see in action. This is optional but recommended.
3. A short written note (half a page is enough) covering: what tradeoffs you made and why, where this would break at scale or on real data, and where you did or didn't use AI and why.



  





 Send the repo link, video link, and note in a single email to
 **ai@divyasree.com** 
 , with the track name in the subject line. Feel free to also share links to anything else you've built that you'd like us to see (other repos, side projects, live products, anything that shows how you think and build)
 



  





***What we're evaluating:***



* **AI judgment:** 
 Did AI/LLMs genuinely add value here, or were they forced in because the brief mentions AI?
* **Speed\-to\-signal:** 
 How much real progress did you make in the time given, versus over\-engineering a narrow slice?
* **Failure awareness:** 
 Do you know where this breaks, and have you said so honestly?
* **Communication:** 
 Can you explain this to a non\-technical founder or business head in plain language?
* **Scope instinct:** 
 Did you pick something narrow enough to actually finish?



  





***What happens next:***




 Shortlisted submissions move to the one\-hour, hands\-on technical call described below. From there, strong candidates go straight to an offer conversation — there's no additional round.
 



  





**Problem statement** 




 Pick one, or propose your own under the Open Track. Every track uses the same submission format above (GitHub repo \+ README, 5\-minute pitch video, short note).
 



  





**Open Track** 




 Propose and build your own idea for a real problem anywhere in the Group: real estate, hospitality, co\-living, facilities, or asset management. A working prototype, plus the same note format as above.
 



  





**What the technical call looks like** 




 Shortlisted from a Build Track submission, or applying directly: the first technical call is one hour, hands\-on, and runs entirely off your screen. We'll walk through what you built, then hand you a new, live, underspecified problem and watch how you scope it and start, not whether you finish it.
 



  





**What you'll get** 



* Broad exposure: you'll work across nearly every part of a diversified Group spanning real estate, hospitality, co\-living, facilities, and education within your first year
* Real ownership from week one, wherever you're deployed: your work is load\-bearing, not a side project
* Freedom to use whatever models, agents, frameworks, and tools work best for the problem in front of you
* Direct access to founders and business unit leaders: your work is judged on impact, not process
* A growing track record of shipped, adopted systems across the group, not just POCs
* High\-variance work by design: some deployments are two\-day sprints, some become the system a whole business unit runs on



  





*DivyaSree Group is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, or any other protected characteristic.*

title: Accounts Receivable Manager
description:
**Accounts Receivable Manager** 




**Location: Bengaluru** 




**Experience: 3–5 Years** 




**Role Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Manager to manage the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable function, ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, revenue reconciliation, and effective management of outstanding receivables.
 



 The role will be responsible for maintaining healthy cash flows, monitoring AR ageing, resolving billing and reconciliation issues, and working closely with Operations, Sales, and Finance teams.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in Accounts Receivable, excellent analytical and Excel skills, working knowledge of Tally/accounting systems, and the ability to manage and review the work of an AR team in a high\-volume business environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**01 \| Accounts Receivable \& Invoicing** 




 Manage the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, including invoicing, collections, reconciliation, and reporting.
 



 Ensure accurate and timely client invoicing in coordination with Operations and Sales teams.
 



 Perform revenue reconciliation and ensure invoices are aligned with contractual and operational data.
 



 Monitor unbilled revenue and ensure timely conversion into invoices.
 



 Identify and resolve billing discrepancies, short payments, and other invoicing\-related issues.
 



 Maintain accurate customer accounts and ensure timely updating of AR records.
 



  





**02 \| Collections \& AR Ageing** 




 Drive timely collections and follow up with customers on outstanding payments.
 



 Monitor AR ageing and identify overdue and high\-risk receivables.
 



 Track collection targets and ensure timely closure of outstanding balances.
 



 Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve payment blockers and customer disputes.
 



 Prepare regular ageing reports and highlight critical overdue accounts to management.
 



 Support initiatives to improve DSO and overall working capital efficiency.
 



  





**03 \| Reconciliation \& Accounting** 




 Perform customer ledger reconciliation and balance confirmations.
 



 Reconcile receipts, invoices, credit notes, debit notes, and outstanding balances.
 



 Investigate and resolve differences between customer statements and internal books.
 



 Ensure accurate accounting of collections and receivables.
 



 Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities related to Accounts Receivable.
 



 Maintain proper documentation and records for audit requirements.
 



  





**04 \| MIS \& Reporting** 




 Prepare and maintain regular AR reports, ageing reports, collection reports, and outstanding dashboards.
 



 Provide management with insights on receivables, collections, overdue accounts, and ageing trends.
 



 Track key AR metrics and identify areas for process improvement.
 



 Support internal and external audits by providing required AR\-related data and documentation.
 



 Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial reports and MIS.
 



  





**05 \| Team Management** 




 Manage and review the day\-to\-day work of the Accounts Receivable team.
 



 Allocate responsibilities and monitor team productivity and performance.
 



 Review reconciliations, ageing reports, collections, and other AR activities completed by the team.
 



 Guide team members on resolving complex reconciliation and collection issues.
 



 Ensure adherence to defined processes, controls, and timelines.
 



 Identify process gaps and implement improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy.
 



  





**06 \| Cross\-functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with Operations and Sales teams to ensure accurate billing and timely collections.
 



 Coordinate with business teams to resolve invoice disputes and customer queries.
 



 Partner with Finance and Accounting teams on revenue reconciliation, month\-end closing, and audit requirements.
 



 Act as a finance partner to business teams on receivables\-related matters.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Experience \& Qualification** 




 3–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable / Order\-to\-Cash / Finance \& Accounting.
 



 CA Qualified or CA Semi\-Qualified candidates are preferred.
 



 Strong hands\-on experience in invoicing, collections, AR ageing, reconciliation, and receivables management.
 



 Experience managing or reviewing the work of an AR team.
 



 Strong exposure to month\-end closing, MIS, audit support, and customer reconciliation.
 



 Experience working in a high\-volume transaction environment is preferred.
 



 Experience in staffing, manpower services, workforce management, or similar businesses will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, reconciliation, and data analysis.
 



 Working knowledge of Tally or other accounting/ERP systems.
 



 Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes and accounting principles.
 



 Ability to work with large volumes of financial and transactional data.
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 Behavioral Competencies
 



 Strong ownership and attention to detail.
 



 Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 Ability to follow up effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 Strong problem\-solving and reconciliation skills.
 



 Ability to manage priorities and work within tight deadlines.
 



 Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and high\-volume environment.
 



 Ability to independently identify issues and drive them to closure.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 



 Timely and accurate client invoicing
 



 Improvement in collections and reduction in overdue receivables
 



 Effective management of AR ageing
 



 Reduction in reconciliation and billing discrepancies
 



 Timely closure of customer outstanding balances
 



 Accurate and timely month\-end AR reporting
 



 Improved visibility of unbilled and overdue revenue
 



 Strong team productivity and process adherence

title: Subops BAU Engineer
description:
**Job Description: SubOps BAU Engineer / Analyst** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The SubOps BAU Engineer is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Subscription Platform (SOPS). This includes monitoring, incident resolution, batch job management, minor enhancements, and coordination across integrated systems to ensure uninterrupted subscription lifecycle operations for digital and print products.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Production Support \& Monitoring** 



* Perform daily health checks across SOPS platform components
* Monitor batch alerts (e.g., Google Cloud payload errors, failed payment notifications) and triage/resolve per established runbooks
* Track and resolve P3/P4 incidents within defined SLAs
* Monitor subscription reconciliation dashboards and escalate discrepancies



**2\. Batch Processing \& Job Management** 



* Oversee and troubleshoot \~40\+ batch jobs including payment processing, DTI imports, earned revenue reports, demographic conversions, context space flushes, and file transfers
* Manage batch scheduling, re\-runs, and failure recovery across AWS Lambda, ECS clusters, and legacy JBOSS\-based batch services
* Coordinate nightly print fulfilment data flows between different systems



**3\. Incident Management \& Troubleshooting** 



* Investigate and resolve issues across the integration chain
* Diagnose API failures
* Coordinate with middleware teams (Boomi, WebMethods, Axway) for integration\-related issues
* Manage operational tasks including unresolved payment processing and offer/campaign configuration



**4\. Minor Enhancements \& Configuration Changes** 



* Implement minor code changes, configuration updates, and field\-level modifications
* Support product/offer setup for pricing, promotions, campaign configuration
* Execute user access changes, permission set updates, and profile modifications
* Perform data loads (single objects, ≤5,000 records) as requested by business teams



**5\. Release \& Deployment Support** 



* Support BAU releases
* Coordinate with CloudOps for Rundeck\-based deployments to AWS environments
* Participate in warranty support (2 weeks post\-implementation) for new releases
* Maintain and update release notes and deployment documentation



**6\. Coordination \& Communication** 



* Raise and track ServiceNow (SNOW) change requests for production changes
* Provide operational handover documentation for new features transitioning from project to BAU
* Participate in BAU prioritisation forums and sprint planning for recurring BAU stories



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 7\+ years of experience in application support / BAU operations for
 **enterprise subscription or eCommerce platforms . Experience in any other subscription management systems**
* Strong experience with
 **Java\-based enterprise applications and AWS cloud services**
* **Hands\-on experience with SQL (MS SQL Server and/or Oracle) for data investigation and reporting**
* **Familiarity with REST API troubleshooting and middleware integration patterns**
* Experience with ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management processes

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap”—the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments—kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, and homes—to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading robotics labs use to train their foundation models.

* Own complex platform initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, and operation.

 Perks
   

  

* Free snacks
* Health Insurance
* Personal Insurance
* Flexible Hours
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Broadband Reimbursement


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada.  Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.

title: Vector DB Engineer
description:
Role Purpose
 



 Deliver the natural\-language query capability over the Entity Graph. This role implements the vector indexing and retrieval layer that powers GraphRAG — enabling users to ask questions in plain language instead of writing graph queries — and is accountable for the accuracy, relevance and evaluation of those responses.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Vector index design \& build —** 
 design and implement the vector indexing strategy over graph projections and entity attributes, including chunking, embedding selection and index configuration.
* **Embedding pipeline —** 
 build pipelines to generate, store and refresh embeddings as entity and graph data changes.
* **GraphRAG implementation —** 
 combine vector similarity search with graph structure and multi\-hop traversal to produce grounded, context\-rich retrieval.
* **Natural\-language query enablement —** 
 implement and tune NLQ scenarios agreed with WK; support natural\-language\-to\-graph\-query translation approaches.
* **Retrieval evaluation \& tuning —** 
 define and run evaluation harnesses measuring retrieval relevance and answer quality; tune retrieval parameters against agreed scenarios.
* **Grounding \& traceability —** 
 ensure retrieved answers are attributable to source entities and edges, preserving provenance.
* **Performance \& cost management —** 
 optimise index size, query latency and compute/token cost of retrieval operations.
* **Documentation —** 
 document retrieval architecture, evaluation results, known limitations and supported query patterns.



  





 Must\-Have Qualifications
 


* 5\+ years engineering experience with 2\+ years hands\-on vector search / RAG implementation
* Demonstrable production experience building a retrieval pipeline (not prototype\-only)
* Strong Python skills and familiarity with embedding models
* Experience evaluating and tuning retrieval quality with defined metrics
* Understanding of how to ground responses and preserve source traceability



 Nice\-to\-Have
 


* Direct GraphRAG experience (graph \+ vector combined retrieval)
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric NL2GQL / Data Agent capabilities
* Exposure to graph databases and traversal concepts
* Experience managing LLM inference cost and latency at scale



 Key Deliverables Owned
 


* Vector index over graph projections
* Embedding generation and refresh pipeline
* GraphRAG retrieval capability supporting agreed NLQ scenarios
* Retrieval evaluation results and tuning documentation
* Documented supported query patterns and known limitations

title: Associate-Talent Mobility
description:
International Career Pathway Programs — Nursing \& Hospitality (Albania \| Korea \| Malta / Germany / Japan)
 



 Department : Sales \& Admissions / International Career Programs
 



 Location : Bangalore
 



 Working Days : Monday\-Saturday
 



  





 About the Role :
 



 We are hiring experienced Career Counsellors to promote and enroll candidates into our job\-oriented Career Pathway Programs in Nursing and Hospitality, leading to overseas placement in Albania, South Korea, and Malta Japan Germany. These programs combine language training (e.g., Korean/TOPIK, Maltese/English, Albanian where applicable) with skill and vocational studies, preparing candidates for guaranteed job placement in the destination country. This is a target\-driven, sales\-oriented counselling role.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities :
 



 ● Counsel prospective candidates (freshers, 12th passed, ITI/diploma holders, nursing graduates, hospitality aspirants) on career pathway programs for Albania, Korea, and Malta.
 



 ● Explain program structure clearly: language training, vocational/skill training, visa process, job guarantee terms, timelines, and costs.
 



 ● Convert inquiries into enrolments — own the full sales funnel from lead to admission (cold calls, walk\-ins, digital leads, referrals).
 



 ● Achieve monthly enrolment/revenue targets assigned by the Team Lead.
 



 ● Conduct one\-on\-one and group counselling sessions, seminars, and webinars for prospective candidates and parents.
 



 ● Follow up diligently on leads via calls, WhatsApp, and email; maintain CRM hygiene and daily activity reports.
 



 ● Guide candidates through documentation, eligibility screening, and pre\-departure formalities in coordination with the operations/visa team.
 



 ● Build and maintain relationships with candidates for referrals and repeat business.
 



 ● Stay updated on destination\-country job market demand, visa policies, and competitor offerings.
 



 ● Coordinate with marketing for lead generation campaigns, events, and education fairs.
 



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 ● 1–4 years of experience in counselling \+ sales — preferably in overseas education, immigration, recruitment, EdTech, or overseas job placement industry.
 



 ● Prior exposure to Nursing/Hospitality overseas program counselling, Korea (EPS/TOPIK), Malta, Gulf, or Europe job/visa consultancy is highly preferred.
 



 ● Strong communication, persuasion, and interpersonal skills; comfortable with target\-based, incentive\-linked roles.
 



 ● Basic understanding of visa processes, language certification requirements (TOPIK, IELTS/OET, TELC, JLPT etc.) is a plus.
 



 ● Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Office/Google Workspace.
 



 ● Bachelor's degree in any discipline (Nursing/Hospitality background is an added advantage).
 



 Compensation
 



 Fixed salary \+ attractive incentive/commission structure on enrolments (to be discussed).

title: Staff SW Engineer (6+, Golang)
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Overview**
**Job Description**
 Software Development Engineers are expert problem\-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands\-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI\-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross\-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to determine requirements for product components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solutions.
* Translate functional requirements into system designs and communicate component interactions, ensuring alignment with business needs and timelines.
* Design and develop product components, refine code plans, and lead design reviews to ensure completeness and adherence to requirements.
* Contribute to project estimation, considering delivery costs and escalating issues that may cause delays.
* Lead by example in creating, implementing, and maintaining extensible, reusable code, and drive code quality through metrics and best practices.
* Apply debugging tools to resolve moderately complex issues and identify opportunities for automation across products.
* Lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and providing feedback to team members.
* Create complex test plans, identify test gaps, and proactively address defects to minimize customer impact.
* Leverage data analysis and monitoring standards to identify patterns and defects in all environments.
* Respond to incidents during on\-call rotations, troubleshoot complex issues, and assist in incident response and resolution.
* Build, enhance, and identify new developer tools to support programs and applications.
* Proactively seek new knowledge and adapt to trends and technical solutions to improve product performance and recommend resources to other engineers.


 This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience designing and executing large\-scale portfolio migration strategies for mission\-critical financial platforms.
* Strong expertise in Golang and distributed systems processing high\-volume workloads.
* Experience building and operating data\-intensive migration pipelines with a focus on performance, resiliency, and observability.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge, KMS, and Valkey.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous processing patterns, event\-driven architectures, and large\-scale data movement.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production incidents involving distributed systems and cross\-service dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical design and execution of complex engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Experience balancing migration velocity, operational risk, and customer impact in highly regulated financial environments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage directly with clients, internal stakeholders, and engineering teams during migration planning and execution.
* Experience with payment processing, card issuing, digital banking, or other mission\-critical financial systems is highly desirable.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Principal Engineer – Geotechnical
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional person to add to our Geotechnical Team in our Bengaluru, India office. You will have at least 12\+ years’ experience in the design of foundations, slope stability, embedded retaining walls, settlement analysis, damage assessment of existing facilities and structures for various infrastructure projects, especially metro projects.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in the day\-to\-day delivery of projects working closely with and being supported by other team members, Project Managers and Directors within the UK team.
   

  

 As a specialist/expert within the UK\&IE based Geotech Team working predominantly on a range of variety of geotechnical projects across the UK world.
   

  

 At WSP, you’ll find yourself challenged in fascinating and far\-reaching ways. You’ll explore new and inspiring opportunities to make the most of your expertise, broaden your professional horizons and create exciting new possibilities for people, organisations and society in general.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Development of professionally and technically competent reports by making use of efficient working practices to provide industry leading, best value services to our clients.
* Provide support in all aspects of project delivery including financial analysis, client liaison, public and statutory body consultation, quality control, management of specialists, contractors and sub consultants.
* Coordinate and manage multidisciplinary teams working on geotechnical projects, work closely with and provide professional advice that builds relationships and raises the profile of the geotechnical division
* Effectively manage and deliver project work with robust project financial management. Has budget responsibility for the delivery of projects and services.
* Provide support in all aspects of project delivery meeting high technical standards, required quality and within allotted budget.
* Working in accordance with accepted methods and legislation (including CDM) and operate in accordance with WSP’s corporate health \& safety, environment, and quality (SHEQ) standards. Taking ownership for aspects of SHEQ management across the geotechnical team.
* Undertake own continuing professional development and showing management of others across a team, to maintain and build professional capability.
* Conduct technical peer reviews and quality checks of calculations, reports, and design deliverables prepared by others.
* Maintain professional development and contribute to technical excellence initiatives within the team.
* Key Competencies
* Mandatory Skills
* Strong UK based experience – good knowledge of the London base geology is a plus
* A sound understanding of geotechnical engineering, with a broad understanding of the underlying principles, and substantial project management experience of medium sized projects.
* Excellent report\-writing and strong client liaison skills.
* Will have significant previous experience of undertaking and managing: geotechnical desk studies; designing, procuring \& supervising Ground Investigations (GIs); checking and reviewing Ground Investigation Reports \& Geotechnical Design Reports in accordance with the requirements of Eurocode 7 : Part 1\. Client facing and able to lead at client/contractor meetings.
* Ability to use a range of geotechnical software for the design of civil engineering projects including the following: deep and shallow foundations (including pile group analysis); embedded and gravity retaining walls; earthworks/slope stability; reinforced earthworks.
* Will have proven previous metro projects experience including undertaking under ground elements design, ground movement assessment, embedded retaining systems design, Diaphragm wall designs etc
* Ground Movement Assessments to determine the impact of construction works on existing tunnels (BT, LUL, RMG), masonry tunnels (NR, City of London), masonry viaducts (NR), bored utilities (sewers / water mains)
* Building damage assessments on third party structures
* Demonstrable experience of geotechnical design together with a familiarity of design submission documentation. This includes a demonstrable understanding of the underlying principles and a knowledge of Eurocode 7 and UK annex design codes, ground investigation and construction contracts and specifications.
* Proficiency with the use of geotechnical software for the management, review and presentation of ground investigation and geotechnical data using current best practice. Must have the skills to check, critically evaluate and amend your own work, be it drawings, calculations or reports.
* General commercial awareness and an understanding of client requirements as described in contracts, including an understanding and awareness of contractual issues and risks when dealing with clients and sub\-consultants.
* Provides active contribution to technical excellence and innovation across the local geotechnical team
* Good oral communication skills also, able to provide solid support at client facing meetings and able to assist with client/contractor meetings.
* Desired Skills
* Hands on experience in using the geotechnical software like Oasys XDisp, PDisp, GeoSlope SLOPE/W, GEOSTUDIO, Repute 2\.5, WALLAP, Settle 3D, Slide 2, Plaxis 2D and Plaxis 3D.
* Knowledge in the Engineering Geology or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Chartered Engineer from a reputed professional body membership (preferably ICE, UK) or working towards chartership with substantial progress demonstrated


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in civil engineering with Geotechnical Engineering / Soil Mechanics and Foundation engineering as specialisation.
* Working towards full professional membership / chartership.


 BGV:

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: IAM Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an IAM Engineer that would welcome the opportunity to work with a company that is in the fast\-growing market of providing whole\-home solutions around security and comfort. This is a tech\-oriented company that is expanding and growing and in need of an accomplished Engineer that loves to work as a team to solve complex technical problem.
   

  

 This Engineer will provide the expertise, and design services for Microsoft AD, Azure AD, single sign\-on (SSO), virtual directory services (VDS), multi\-factor authentication (MFA), identity governance \& administration (IGA), public key infrastructure (PKI), and identity federation for the enterprise. Work closely with IT and business partners to ensure identity and access solutions meet or exceed security policies and regulatory compliance requirements. This role will provide technical leadership, subject matter expertise, and direction on complex projects in the corporate IAM space at the highest levels of the organization.
   

  

**JOB DUTIES:**
* Partners with Enterprise Architecture to develop strategies and standards for IAM solutions.
* Serve as the technical subject matter expert, thought leader, and one of the key decision makers for IAM as it relates to infrastructure integration, cloud security, network, and other platform related security efforts.
* Defines and documents the proposed, high\-level solution, including the use of Commercial Off the Shelf (COTS) packages to create solutions.
* Analyzes technical risks and advises on risk mitigation strategies.
* Responsible for the technical content (architecture and design), integrity, and quality of proposed solutions.
* Defines and documents the actions needed to close architecture gaps in support of business objectives.
* Responsible for the technical content (architecture and design), integrity, and quality of solution.
* Identifies new technologies and development tools as required.
* Analyzes available assets (frameworks, reference architectures, etc.) to bridge the gap between the as\-is architecture and the to\-be architecture.
* Participates in the design, implementation and integration of Active Directory services in support of Azure, AWS, Sailpoint, PingFederate, and Office 365\.
* Ensure that all IAM functionality and integrations across the enterprise conform to security standards.


**YOU MUST HAVE:**
* Ability to work in team environment on assigned tasks and multiple large projects.
* 10\+ years of technical IT infrastructure work experience.
* 8\+ years of IAM administration and design experience that includes most of the following: AD, IGA, SSO, VDS, MFA, PKI, SAML.
* Entry/Mid\-level Azure / AWS technical knowledge.
* Proven track record operating in a lead technical role in large enterprise with multiple IAM services environments: AD services, LDAP, interfaces with HR software, MFA, scripting, replication, certificates, performance, troubleshooting, monitoring, disaster recovery, security \& administration…


**WE VALUE:**
* Working knowledge of hybrid infrastructure technologies (ESXi, VMware Cloud, server, network, storage, load balancing clustering, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise infrastructure (including cloud) security principles, policies, and compliance.
* Hands on experience building large scale application deployments, standard three tier web application.
* Operating systems experience – Windows Server, RHEL, CentOS.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professional verbally and written.
* Experience working directly with customers in a consultative capacity.
* Motivated and calm under pressure.
* Relevant certifications: CIST, CIAM, CISSP, Cloud Solution Architect


**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Health Insurance Coverage
* Education Assistance
* Maternity \& Paternity Leave
* Menstrual Wellness Benefit
* Bereavement Leave


**About Us**
 ADI is a leading global distributor and solutions provider of security, AV, and smart living technologies, helping professionals deliver smarter, safer, and more connected experiences for homes and businesses around the world. Through trusted brands, exclusive solutions, and strong industry partnerships, ADI supports more than 110,000 customers across residential and commercial markets globally. From security and video surveillance to networking, audio, automation, fire, and connected technologies, ADI offers a broad portfolio of products, services, and software designed to support the evolving needs of integrators, installers, and technology professionals. title: Senior Technology Operations Analyst / Voice & CCaaS Specialist
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled Voice \& Contact Center Technology Specialist to manage, support, and optimize enterprise IT Service Desk voice platforms and contact center technologies. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in IVR administration, call routing, queue management, workforce capacity planning, and Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, specifically Five9\. This role will be responsible for ensuring efficient call delivery, enhancing customer experience, driving voice automation initiatives, and supporting next\-generation AI\-enabled voice solutions. This aligns with internal requirements around IVR operations, skill\-based routing, queue management, and Five9 administration
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Voice Platform \& Call Routing Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end Service Desk call routing architecture.
* Design, maintain, and optimize call flows, routing logic, and queue strategies.
* Configure and manage skill\-based routing models.
* Analyze call distribution patterns and improve routing efficiency.
* Troubleshoot call routing issues and queue performance bottlenecks.
* Manage inbound and outbound call flows across multiple support channels.



  





**IVR Administration \& Automation** 



* Design, build, and maintain IVR menus and call treatment flows.
* Develop and manage IVR prompts, announcements, and voice recordings.
* Optimize self\-service capabilities and call containment strategies.
* Implement intent\-based routing and voice automation use cases.
* Partner with AI/Conversational teams to integrate IVA, chatbot, and voice bot capabilities.



**Queue \& Capacity Management** 



* Monitor queue health, staffing alignment, and service levels.
* Analyze call volumes, abandon rates, hold times, and occupancy metrics.
* Recommend staffing and routing improvements based on forecasted demand.
* Work closely with Workforce Management (WFM) teams to optimize customer experience.



**Five9 \& CCaaS Administration** 



* Administer and support Five9 contact center platform.
* Configure campaigns, skills, queues, routing rules, and agent profiles.
* Manage integrations between Five9, ServiceNow, telephony, and reporting systems.
* Ensure platform stability, resiliency, and operational performance.
* Support CCaaS migration, transformation, and optimization initiatives.



**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Generate operational reports and dashboards.
* Analyze:
* Call volumes
* Talk time
* Hold time
* Queue performance
* Transfer rates
* Abandonment rates
* Service Levels
* IVR containment rates
* Provide actionable insights to leadership.



**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with Service Desk Operations, Product Owners, Engineering Teams, and Vendors.
* Support technology upgrades, migrations, and platform enhancements.
* Participate in incident management and problem management activities.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Deep understanding of:
* IVR architecture
* ACD routing
* Skill\-based routing
* Queue management
* Workforce optimization concepts
* Contact center operations



  





**Hands\-on Experience** 



* Five9 CCaaS Administration
* Call Routing \& Queue Management
* IVR Design \& Configuration
* Voice Recording Management
* Voice Automation Solutions
* Conversational AI Platforms
* Intent Mapping \& Call Steering
* Voice Analytics \& Reporting



**Telephony \& Contact Center Technologies** 



* Five9
* Genesys (Preferred)
* IVA / Conversational AI Platforms
* SIP \& Voice Infrastructure Concepts
* ServiceNow Integration
* Workforce Management Tools



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* AI\-powered voice automation solutions
* Voice Biometrics / Authentication platforms
* Google Conversational AI / Gemini / Flash 3\.5
* Cloud Contact Center transformations
* Service Desk environments supporting large\-scale enterprises



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting enterprise contact center and voice technologies.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Five9 administration experience.
* Experience managing large\-scale Service Desk voice operations.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 



* Five9 Administrator Certification
* CCaaS Certifications
* ITIL Foundation / ITIL 4
* Genesys Certifications
* ServiceNow Fundamentals

title: Senior Engineer, Systems Infrastructure
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior Systems Infrastructure Engineer** 
 to manage and optimize enterprise infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments. The role focuses on
 **operational stability, VMware and Windows infrastructure, capacity management, automation, patching, compliance, monitoring, and technical leadership** 
 .
   

  

 The engineer will work closely with architects, operations, security, and other technology teams while providing technical guidance and mentorship to team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Operations**
* Manage Incidents, Tasks, Problems, and Change Requests in alignment with ITIL processes.
* Lead technical activities during Major Incident Management (MIM) calls and support timely service recovery.
* Ensure SLA adherence and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Provide technical troubleshooting, escalation support, and mentorship to team members.


**VMware \& Windows Infrastructure**
* Manage and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail environments.
* Perform virtualization administration, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Plan and execute P2V and V2V migrations.
* Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022 environments.
* Support server provisioning, lifecycle management, performance optimization, and decommissioning.


**Capacity \& Performance Management**
* Monitor infrastructure utilization across compute, memory, storage, virtualization, and cloud resources.
* Identify capacity constraints and performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Forecast capacity requirements and work with architects on scaling and infrastructure planning.
* Maintain capacity dashboards, performance metrics, and leadership reports.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Support infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Work with architects on cloud implementation, migration, optimization, governance, security, and reliability.
* Support hybrid cloud and on\-premises infrastructure environments.


**Automation \& Optimization**
* Automate repetitive operational activities using PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting technologies.
* Automate provisioning, health checks, monitoring, patching, compliance validation, and reporting.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices where appropriate.
* Drive continuous service improvement and reduce manual operational effort.


**Patch Management \& Compliance**
* Plan and execute Windows Server patching across enterprise environments.
* Maintain patch compliance, vulnerability, exception, and remediation dashboards.
* Automate patch deployment, validation, and compliance reporting.
* Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit requirements.


**Monitoring, Backup \& Recovery**
* Support enterprise monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability platforms.
* Maintain dashboards for infrastructure availability, health, performance, and capacity.
* Support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high\-availability solutions.
* Participate in disaster recovery testing and remediation activities.


**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead or contribute to infrastructure migrations, upgrades, technology refreshes, and transformation initiatives.
* Work with architects and technical teams on infrastructure standards and operational improvements.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and act as a technical escalation point.
* Conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions and maintain strong technical documentation.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering or systems infrastructure.
* Strong hands\-on experience with VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail.
* Advanced administration experience with Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022\.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Strong understanding of capacity planning, performance monitoring, forecasting, and infrastructure optimization.
* Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation practices.
* Strong experience with ITIL\-based Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Experience with P2V and V2V migrations.
* Strong knowledge of patch management, compliance reporting, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience leading complex infrastructure activities and mentoring technical team members.
* Ability to work independently and effectively with distributed global teams.


**Work Conditions**
* Ability to work early IST shifts starting from 6:00 AM onwards to provide coverage for APAC business hours as per business requirements.
* Flexibility to support critical maintenance windows, Major Incidents, and infrastructure changes outside regular working hours.
* Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation supporting 24x7 enterprise operations.

title: MS Exchange Administrator
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**MS Exchange Administrator**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.
   

  

 The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.
   

  

 This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.


**Technical skills to include:**
* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.


**What We Look For**
* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Technical Analyst - MECM, Intune
description:
**Life on the team** 




  




* A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a technical role within Computacenter’s dynamic and rapidly expanding Digital Infrastructure group. You will join a global organisation delivering services across more than 70 countries.
* You will work with experienced infrastructure and workplace specialists, supporting a large, complex and business\-critical Microsoft endpoint management environment from our Computacenter office in Bangalore.
* This role is primarily focused on BAU and project services, with ownership of the MECM platform and tooling, while supporting the customer’s phased transition towards Co\-Management and Microsoft Intune.
* You will have exposure to enterprise\-scale endpoint engineering, platform transformation, automation and modern management technologies.



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* Own, administer, maintain and continuously improve the enterprise Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) platform and all associated tooling.
* Manage the full MECM infrastructure, including Central Administration Site where applicable, primary and secondary sites, management points, distribution points, software update points, reporting services points, service connection points, boundaries, boundary groups, collections and client settings.

* Develop PowerShell automation, health checks, operational dashboards and reports to improve platform reliability, deployment success, compliance and support efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, support procedures, build standards, patching runbooks, operating models and knowledge articles.
* Work closely with security, infrastructure, network, application packaging, service management and workplace teams to deliver stable services and planned platform transformation.
* Provide technical mentorship, contribute to service improvements and lead assigned platform projects and changes.



  





**What You’ll Need** 




  




* Experience: Minimum 7\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting large enterprise endpoint management environments, with strong recent experience in MECM/SCCM platform engineering and L3 operations.
* MECM Platform Expertise: Deep hands\-on knowledge of MECM current branch architecture, installation, configuration, site systems, hierarchy design, upgrades, hotfixes, backup/recovery, monitoring, performance and troubleshooting.
* Operating System Deployment: Strong experience with Windows 10/11 build engineering, task sequences, boot images, PXE, drivers, BIOS/firmware, USMT and operating system deployment troubleshooting.
* Patch Management: Advanced experience with WSUS/SUP, Automatic Deployment Rules, deployment rings, maintenance windows, servicing, compliance reporting and remediation across enterprise estates.
* Software Management: Strong experience with MECM applications, packages, collections, requirements, detection methods, dependencies, supersedence, content distribution and deployment troubleshooting.
* MECM Infrastructure: Strong knowledge of management points, distribution points, software update points, reporting services, boundaries, boundary groups, discovery methods, client installation and client health.
* Database and Reporting: Working knowledge of SQL Server, MECM database maintenance, SSRS reporting and SQL/WQL queries for operational analysis and compliance reporting.
* Troubleshooting: Proven ability to analyse MECM server and client logs, WMI, IIS, SQL, replication and content distribution issues and to lead complex root cause investigations.
* Co\-Management: Strong experience implementing and supporting MECM and Intune Co\-Management, tenant attach, Cloud Management Gateway and workload transition strategies.
* Intune: Practical hands\-on experience with Intune configuration profiles, compliance, application deployment, Windows Update for Business, Autopilot and endpoint security. Intune is important for the migration roadmap, but MECM depth is essential for the immediate role.
* Cloud and Security: Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure services, certificates/PKI, Defender for Endpoint integration and enterprise endpoint security controls.
* Scripting and Automation: Strong PowerShell skills for MECM administration, automation, data collection, remediation, reporting and troubleshooting.
* Change and Service Management: Experience working within structured ITIL processes for incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability and configuration management.
* Communication and Ownership: Strong written and verbal communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of a critical platform.
* Preferred: Relevant Microsoft certifications and experience delivering a phased transition from MECM\-led management to Co\-Management and Intune.



  





**About us** 



* With over 20,000 employees across the globe, we work at the heart of digitisation, advising organisations on IT strategy, implementing appropriate technology, and helping customers source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure in more than 70 countries.
