title: Specialist, Software Engineer - Verification and Validation
description:
**About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance)**
 Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety\-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS\-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle.
   

  

**Job Title: Software V\&V Engineer – Surveillance**
**Position Summary:** 
 As a Software V\&V Engineer, you will execute hands\-on software verification and validation activities in compliance with DO\-178C objectives for safety\-critical avionics surveillance systems. Acron Aviation is seeking detail\-oriented, technically rigorous V\&V engineers who can execute and document software verification activities and contribute to airworthiness certification on our TCAS, Transponder, and Integrated Surveillance Platform programs. The applicant will work as a key individual contributor within the Software V\&V team, collaborating with Systems Engineering, Software Development, and Program Management to ensure verification coverage, requirements traceability, and compliance with applicable DO\-178C DAL B and C requirements.
   

  

 As an individual contributor, the Software V\&V Engineer is responsible for hands\-on execution and documentation of software verification activities within assigned programs, ensuring DO\-178C compliance and collaborating with Software Development Leads and Project Leads on test integration, schedule, and certification readiness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Accountable for DO\-178C software verification and validation activities for Surveillance development projects, including test planning, procedure development, execution, and results documentation; coordinates with US based Acron software engineers as required
* Partner with Software Development Leads, Systems Engineering, and Project Leads to define verification strategies, manage test dependencies, and meet program verification milestones
* Plan, develop, and execute Software Verification Cases and Procedures (SVCPs) in accordance with DO\-178C DAL\-appropriate objectives, ensuring requirements\-based test coverage and traceability to software requirements
* Track and communicate software verification status, open Problem Reports (PRs), and structural coverage metrics (e.g., decision, statement coverage) to project stakeholders
* Author and peer\-review Software Verification Results (SVRs), Problem Report dispositions, test reports, and associated DO\-178C lifecycle data artifacts
* Perform structural coverage analysis and requirements\-based test traceability to satisfy DAL\-appropriate DO\-178C objectives; identify, document, and disposition coverage gaps through additional tests or analyses
* Support DER/ACO coordination activities and contribute to Software Accomplishment Summary (SAS), Software Configuration Index (SCI), and other certification artifacts required for FAA/EASA approval


**Required Qualifications**
* BS Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent fields required
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience executing DO\-178B/C software verification activities in a safety\-critical avionics or aerospace environment
* Demonstrated experience developing, reviewing, and executing requirements\-based software test cases and procedures
* Practical knowledge of DO\-178C software verification objectives, software plans, and lifecycle data (e.g., SVCP, SVR, SAS, SCI)
* Direct experience with DO\-178B/C software verification activities is REQUIRED (not solely development experience)
* Experience developing with C programming language is required
* Knowledge of engineering design standards for commercial aviation industry
* Good written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and team\-working skills required
* Action oriented, results driven, high energy, self\-starter, innovative with new approaches to design work, influential with peers and demonstrate critical thinking skills to drive to root cause


**Preferred Additional Skills**
* Experience with Real Time Operating Systems such as Green Hills, VxWorks or CentOS
* Experience with C\+\+, Python, Visual Basic, Pascal
* Linux
* Experience with Configuration Management and Change Control Tools (such as Git, Bitbucket, ClearCase, Subversion, ClearQuest)
* Experience with Requirement Management tools such as DOORS
* Experience with Agile software development lifecycle
* Experience with emerging AI tools, including prompt engineering and introducing these concepts into existing rigorous safety critical software development environments
* Experience with DevOps concepts and implementations, especially with Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing aspects
* Experience with Jenkins is a plus
* Experience with software test automation tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA Testbed, Cantata, or equivalent structural coverage analysis tools
* Experience with Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) or Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) test environments for embedded avionics software
* Familiarity with DO\-178C Annex A objectives (Tables A\-7 through A\-9\) and software verification independence requirements
* Experience performing and interpreting structural coverage analysis results
* Experience with test traceability tools linking software requirements to test cases and results (e.g., DOORS, Polarion, Jama)
* Familiarity with formal software test review and approval processes in a DO\-178C certification context

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




**Talent Acquisition Manager** 



* Location: Bengaluru / PAN India
* Function: Human Resources – Talent Acquisition
* Experience: 6 \- 10 years
* Reporting To: HR Head



  





 HomeLane is looking for a results\-driven Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale talent acquisition across the organization. This role will own the end\-to\-end recruitment strategy, execution, governance, analytics, and team performance for PAN\-India hiring. The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader and hands\-on TA professional who thrives in a highgrowth, high\-volume environment. You will partner closely with business and functional leaders to translate workforce plans into effective hiring strategies, build a high\-performing recruitment team, and use data to continuously improve hiring outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who can balance strategic thinking with execution and bring strong rigor to recruitment metrics, stakeholder management, process governance, and candidate experience.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Talent Acquisition Strategy \& Workforce Planning
 



  




* Own and drive the end\-to\-end talent acquisition strategy across business and functional verticals.
* Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to understand workforce plans, hiring priorities, critical roles, and timelines.
* Translate business requirements into scalable hiring plans and recruitment models.
* Build effective strategies for both volume hiring and leadership/specialist hiring.
* Anticipate talent\-market challenges, hiring risks, and capacity requirements, and proactively recommend solutions.
* Ensure recruitment priorities remain aligned with business growth and organizational objectives.



  





 2\. Team Leadership \& Recruitment Governance
 



  




* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing TA team managing PAN\-India recruitment.
* Define and monitor recruiter\-wise KPIs, SLAs, productivity metrics, and quality benchmarks.
* Establish a strong performance\-management and review cadence across the recruitment team.
* Coach recruiters on sourcing, stakeholder management, assessment, closure, and candidate engagement.
* Build team capability through structured training, knowledge sharing, and continuous feedback.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and data\-driven decision\-making.



  





 3\. Data, MIS \& Recruitment Analytics
 



  




* Own recruitment dashboards and MIS reporting for leadership and business stakeholders.
* Leverage strong Excel and analytical capabilities to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities.
* Track and analyze key TA metrics including:
* 
* Time\-to\-hire / Time\-to\-fill
* Cost\-per\-hire
* Source effectiveness and channel ROI
* Recruiter productivity
* Hiring funnel conversion
* Offer\-to\-join ratio
* Candidate drop\-offs
* Hiring plan vs. actuals
* Attrition and replacement hiring trends
* 
* Convert recruitment data into actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Present concise, decision\-oriented reports to senior stakeholders.



  





 4\. Stakeholder Management
 



  




* Act as a strategic TA partner to business heads, functional leaders, HRBPs, and hiring managers.
* Establish clear expectations around job requirements, hiring timelines, interview processes, and closure priorities.
* Drive regular hiring reviews and ensure timely resolution of recruitment bottlenecks.
* Influence stakeholders using market intelligence, hiring data, and talent availability insights.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders while maintaining recruitment discipline and governance.



  





 5\. Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
 



  




* Review and continuously improve recruitment processes to enhance speed, quality, efficiency, and candidate experience.
* Identify bottlenecks across the hiring funnel and implement data\-backed corrective actions.
* Drive standardization of recruitment processes, interview practices, documentation, and governance.
* Leverage ATS, recruitment technology, automation, and analytics tools to improve TA efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment policies, compliance requirements, and employer\-branding guidelines.



  





 6\. Employer Brand \& Candidate Experience
 



  




* Champion a consistent and differentiated candidate experience across the recruitment journey.
* Partner with HR and business teams to strengthen HomeLane’s employer proposition.
* Identify opportunities to improve candidate engagement, communication, and offer\-to\-join conversion.
* Ensure recruitment teams consistently represent the organization's culture and values.



  





**Key Success Metrics** 




  





 Success in this role will be measured through:
 



  




* Achievement of hiring plans within agreed timelines
* Reduction in time\-to\-hire and hiring bottlenecks
* Improvement in offer\-to\-join ratios
* Recruiter productivity and team performance
* Quality and effectiveness of hiring sources
* Cost optimization across recruitment channels
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction
* Strong candidate experience
* Compliance with TA processes and governance
* Successful scaling of recruitment capability in line with business growth



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or a related discipline.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong experience in volume, lateral, and leadership hiring.
* Proven experience managing and developing a high\-performing recruitment team.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end talent acquisition and hiring funnels.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate recruitment data into business decisions.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment MIS.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and execution skills.

title: Sr. Associate - AI and Data Engineer
description:
Senior AI and Data Engineer
   

  

 Want to be a part of Asia Pacific \& Japan’s (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
   

  

 AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose \- to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers \- the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
   

  

 Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
   

  

 Come join the A\-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
   

  

**A Snapshot**
 As a Senior AI and Data Engineer at AirTrunk, you will help design, build, and operate the intelligent data and AI systems that power our next\-generation data and AI platforms. You’ll work at the intersection of data engineering, AI engineering, DevOps, and agentic automation, developing and deploying robust solutions that drive operational efficiency, sustainability, and intelligent decision\-making across our data centre and business ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a full\-stack, DevOps\-oriented environment and is passionate about shaping production\-grade AI systems and modern data foundations that directly enable smarter, faster, and more efficient business outcomes. You will help build both the data platform capabilities and intelligent applications that underpin AirTrunk’s AI and Data Platform.
   

  

**Your Day to Day**
**AI Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI and ML solutions that enhance AirTrunk’s operations, from energy optimisation and predictive maintenance to intelligent automation.
* Engineer agentic AI systems including multi\-agent architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) that enable adaptive, autonomous solutions.
* Integrate emerging LLM and generative AI technologies (e.g. Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) into enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Champion design standards and reusable patterns for AI components, tooling, and frameworks that ensure reliability, scalability, and security.


**Data Engineering \& Platform Foundations**
* Design, build, and optimise robust batch and streaming data pipelines that support analytics, operational workloads, and AI use cases.
* Develop and maintain curated, high\-quality data models and datasets that enable trusted reporting, data products, and AI solutions.
* Collaborate closely with platform engineers and data teams to integrate AI services into the broader AI \& Data Platform ecosystem (Databricks, dbt, Kafka, Azure Event Hubs / Event Grid).
* Improve data quality, lineage, observability, and discoverability through strong engineering standards, testing, and metadata practices.


**MLOps, DataOps \& Platform Integration**
* Implement end\-to\-end MLOps pipelines including training, deployment, monitoring, and model lifecycle management across applications like Azure and Databricks.
* Standardise and automate CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML workloads using Git, Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Implement robust observability and validation frameworks to ensure performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI models and agents as well as the resilience and supportability of data pipelines.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of AirTrunk’s AI \& Data Platform, enabling scalable experimentation, production delivery, and platform adoption.


**Responsible AI \& Innovation**
* Embed Responsible AI practices through governance, ethics, and compliance with data privacy standards.
* Experiment with emerging agentic AI technologies to extend platform intelligence and observability while maintaining transparency and trust.
* Apply sound data governance, security, and privacy practices to data engineering and AI workflows alike.
* Contribute to platform data classification and PII management practices, ensuring sensitive data is handled appropriately across structured and unstructured workloads.


**Collaboration \& Mentorship**
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with AI, Data and the broader technology team to deliver integrated, production\-ready solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of quality, learning, and operational excellence.
* Actively contribute to AirTrunk’s Data \& AI community of practice by sharing knowledge, reusable components, and engineering improvements.


**Requirements**
* 5 to 7 years’ experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or software engineering, with proven delivery of production\-grade data and AI solutions in cloud environments.
* Demonstrated ability to architect scalable, high\-performance, and secure data and AI solutions that meet enterprise standards.
* Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining robust batch and streaming data pipelines, with hands\-on knowledge of modern data engineering patterns and practices.
* Experience developing and maintaining curated data models and datasets, with familiarity in medallion architecture, lakehouse concepts, and transformation frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure and Databricks preferred, and proficiency with data pipeline and streaming technologies including dbt, Kafka, and Azure Event Hubs.
* Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in SQL and experience using JavaScript or Shell in engineering workflows.
* Experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions, including LLM\-based applications, intelligent automation, or agentic systems using platforms and tools such as OpenAI, Databricks, Anthropic, and LangChain.
* Strong understanding of MLOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD, testing, monitoring, orchestration, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform).
* Experience implementing observability, validation, and quality controls across both data pipelines and AI systems to ensure reliability, accuracy, and supportability in production.
* Familiarity with real\-time and event\-driven architectures, vector databases, and data storage patterns spanning relational, NoSQL, and analytical platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, and security practices, with the ability to embed Responsible AI and sound data management principles into engineering workflows.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across platform, data, AI, and business teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* A growth mindset with the ability to mentor others, contribute reusable engineering patterns, and help mature AirTrunk’s AI and Data engineering capability.


**The AirTrunk Culture**
 Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast\-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
   

  

 The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
   

  

 Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Role: Snowflake Data Engineer
 



 Hybrid \- 3 days
 



 Budget: 1\.6 LPM
 



 Location: Bangalore
 



 Exp: 6\+ Years
 



  





  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Snowflake Data Engineer / Migration Lead to drive an enterprise\-scale Oracle Database to Snowflake migration. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience designing and executing Oracle\-to\-Snowflake migrations and strong expertise in Snowflake, Oracle SQL/PLSQL, Apache Airflow, Parquet, and modern data engineering.
 



 This role will be responsible for migrating not only data, but also database logic, business rules, and data pipelines, while ensuring data quality, performance, scalability, and a smooth production transition.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead the end\-to\-end Oracle\-to\-Snowflake migration, including assessment, architecture, development, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
 



 Analyze Oracle schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, and dependencies and translate them into Snowflake.
 



 Design and implement scalable Snowflake data models, ELT pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and transformations.
 



 Convert Oracle SQL/PLSQL and database logic into optimized Snowflake SQL and modern cloud data patterns.
 



 Develop production\-grade Apache Airflow DAGs for data ingestion, transformation, scheduling, dependencies, monitoring, and error handling.
 



 Design efficient Parquet\-based data pipelines, including extraction, staging, loading, partitioning, compression, and schema evolution.
 



 Evaluate and implement Snowflake Hybrid Tables for appropriate transactional/operational workloads.
 



 Identify, document, and migrate business rules embedded in Oracle PL/SQL, ETL processes, database objects, and application logic.
 



 Determine appropriate implementation of business rules using
 



 Snowflake SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow, or a Business Rules Engine (BRE).
 



 Build automated data reconciliation, validation, and business\-rule regression testing between Oracle and Snowflake.
 



 Perform Snowflake query, warehouse, pipeline, and data\-load performance optimization.
 



 Collaborate with architects, DBAs, application teams, business analysts, QA, and data engineering teams.
 



 Support production cutover, troubleshooting, and post\-migration stabilization.
 



 Required Qualifications \& Skills
 



 6\+ years of overall database/data engineering experience.
 



 3\+ years of hands\-on Snowflake experience.
 



 Proven experience delivering enterprise\-scale Oracle\-to\-Snowflake migrations in production.
 



 Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL expertise, including stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, views, and complex database logic.
 



 Strong Snowflake SQL, architecture, data modeling, and ELT experience.
 



 Hands\-on Apache Airflow experience developing and operating production DAGs.
 



 Strong experience with Parquet and cloud object storage such as AWS S3, Azure Data Lake, or GCP.
 



 Experience with Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Snowpipe/COPY INTO, stages, and performance optimization.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Snowflake Hybrid Tables is strongly preferred.
 



 Experience with large\-volume data migration, incremental loads, CDC, reconciliation, and migration testing.
 



 Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
 



 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
 



 SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer certification.
 



 SnowPro Core certification.
 



 Experience with a Business Rules Engine (BRE) or decision/rules\-management platform.
 



 Experience migrating and modernizing business rules from Oracle/PLSQL.
 



 Experience integrating BRE with Snowflake and Airflow.
 



 Python and DBT experience.
 



 Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, AWS DMS, Fivetran, Qlik Replicate, Informatica, or similar tools.
 



 Experience with CI/CD, Git, and cloud data platforms.
 



 Snowflake security and governance experience

 As an AI \& Data Engineer at AirTrunk, you will contribute to the design, build, and operation of the data and AI systems that power our next\-generation platforms. **Requirements**

* Understanding of software engineering best practices including version control (Git), testing, and code quality.

* Awareness of data quality, governance, and security considerations in building data and AI solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.


**The AirTrunk Culture**
 Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast\-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

**We are looking for Senior Simulation Engineer – Rolling Stock**
 As a Senior Simulation Engineer in the Rolling Stock domain, you will take ownership of the end\-to\-end simulation development lifecycle — from requirements analysis to HiL bench deployment and validation. You will serve as a technical authority for simulation model development, integration, and testing of Train Control and Management Systems (TCMS) and associated Rolling Stock subsystems.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by**
* Demonstrating a deep understanding of the Rolling Stock business, including the architecture of Rolling Stock platforms such as Metro and Locomotives, and driving simulation strategy aligned with project goals.
* Possessing good knowledge of Rolling Stock subsystems and TCMS functionality, interfaces and system\-level behaviour.
* Ensuring adherence to the V\-cycle (V\-model) methodology throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements analysis through verification, validation, and deployment.
* Analyzing and interpreting the requirements of each subsystem functionality as documented, understanding complex interfaces, and translating them into simulation specifications.
* Reading and interpreting electrical schematics relevant to Rolling Stock subsystems and ensuring accuracy in simulation model representation.
* Developing simulation models of subsystems from requirements using NI LabVIEW. Where project requirements dictate, develop models using MATLAB \& Simulink.
* Independently verifying simulation models developed for subsystems, integration of multiple simulation models, and ensuring system\-level coherence and signal integrity.
* Integrating developed simulation models and performing signal mapping in NI VeriStand, ensuring seamless communication between models and real\-time targets.
* Working on communication protocols including MVB, RS232, CAN, Ethernet, and TRDP.
* Managing test benches comprising NI Instruments (PXI platforms and associated hardware), Duagon Instruments.
* Developing advanced User Interfaces in LabVIEW that reflect Rolling Stock subsystems for operator interaction, monitoring, and diagnostics.
* Deployment of simulation models on HiL benches, executing complex test scenarios, analyzing results, and ensuring test coverage.
* Demonstrating expert understanding of HiL (Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop) and SiL (Software\-in\-the\-Loop) testing methodologies and driving continuous improvement in testing processes.
* Troubleshooting efforts on HiL test benches, diagnosing hardware, software, and interface\-related issues, and implementing corrective actions.
* Conducting training sessions for customers, team members, and service colleagues.


**Desired Skills**
* Successfully completed a technical degree in computer science, electrical engineering, railway engineering or a related subject.
* Education: Bachelor's degree (B. Tech / B.E.) in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience: 8\+ years of relevant experience in simulation engineering, with hands\-on experience in working with test bench, HiL/SiL testing.
* Expert\-level proficiency in NI LabVIEW development (simulation model development, UI development, system integration, and debugging).
* Extensive hands\-on experience working with NI Products, specifically PXI instruments, real\-time controllers, and associated hardware.
* Strong experience with communication protocols such as MVB, RS232, CAN, Ethernet, and TRDP.
* Deep understanding and proven experience with the V\-model development lifecycle and requirement engineering.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin\-based AI startup building an autonomous AI\-powered supply chain automation platform. Backed by Lakestar, Leo Capital, and leading angels with $12M raised in January 2026, we're eliminating manual, inbox\-driven workflows in enterprise supply\-chain operations \- automating Sales Order processing, Purchase Order lifecycle management, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable. We integrate with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and Salesforce, serving companies like a $16B food retailer and an $8\.2B resources company.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**Backend Ownership** 



  

  
* Own the backend end\-to\-end: service architecture, API design, reliability posture, and long\-term technical direction.
  
* Be the person who knows how everything fits together \- and who other engineers come to when they're not sure where something belongs.
  
* Set the bar on code quality, service boundaries, and shared abstractions across the engineering team.
  
* Make foundational decisions with conviction, document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.
  


  


**Python Services \& Production Systems** 



  

  
* Design for failure: retries, timeouts, graceful degradation, and recovery paths built in from the start.
  
* Write code that is easy to operate \- observable, testable, and straightforward to debug at 2am.
  
* Understand the runtime, not just the framework. Know when the problem is the code, the config, or the infrastructure.
  


  


**Workflow Engineering \& Temporal** 



  

  
* Design and build durable workflows using Temporal \- long\-running processes, async coordination, saga patterns.
  
* Own workflow observability: know when a workflow is stuck, degraded, or silently wrong before a customer notices.
  
* Think carefully about idempotency, failure modes, and replay semantics — not just the happy path.
  
* Evolve workflows without breaking running instances; manage versioning with intention.
  


  


**Reliability \& Systems Thinking** 



  

  
* Detect regressions before they become incidents; build the tooling to catch them early.
  
* Own the operational posture of the services you build: alerting, runbooks, on\-call readiness.
  
* Identify structural debt before it compounds; propose refactors that are thoughtful, not just correct.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* **Experience:** 
 6\+ years building and operating backend systems in Python, with clear ownership of production services \- not just feature delivery.
  
* **Python depth:** 
 Non\-negotiable. You make deliberate choices about async vs. sync, framework selection, and performance tradeoffs. You know the language well enough to have opinions.
  
* **Temporal or equivalent:** 
 You've used Temporal (or a comparable workflow engine) in production. You understand durable execution, not just task queues.
  
* **Reliability instinct:** 
 Idempotency, retries, and observability are part of how you design, not afterthoughts.
  
* **End\-to\-end ownership:** 
 You're comfortable being the person who holds the full backend picture. You identify what's broken or missing before you're asked, and you don't leave the system worse than you found it.
  
* **A real spike:** 
 We're a strong team with broad coverage. What we're hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we're currently underinvested in. That might be workflow systems, data infrastructure, AI\-native backend patterns, or deep domain expertise. We don't know exactly what shape it takes \- but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

 Role Summary
 



  





  





 We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is a builder, not just a backend developer. The ideal candidate will bring strong engineering fundamentals, move with pace, question decisions constructively, and understand why something should be built before deciding how to build it. Backend will be the primary focus, but boundaries are not rigid. The role requires working across areas when needed, collaborating cross\-functionally, and picking up problems outside the immediate area when the product requires it. The candidate should have hands\-on experience with Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, production experience with Spring/Spring Boot or Node.js, and a strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, production\-grade system design, SQL and NoSQL databases, and cloud platforms.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Key Responsibilities
* Build with ownership — take problems from idea and design through production, not just from ticket to code.
* Think from first principles — question assumptions, understand trade\-offs, and make deliberate engineering choices.

* Design for tomorrow — think about scalability, extensibility, reliability and maintainability without over\-engineering for imaginary scale.
* Understand distributed systems, including service boundaries, communication patterns, failure handling, and when a microservice actually needs to exist.
* Think deliberately about tenancy, data isolation, partitioning and access patterns.
* Own performance through query optimisation, API performance, caching, concurrency and identifying bottlenecks.
* Think product, not tickets — understand the expected outcome and challenge a solution when there is a better way to achieve it.
* Move with pace — make informed decisions, ship, measure and iterate.
* Be cross\-functional when needed. The problem matters more than where the boundary of the role happens to be.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Required Qualifications
* 3–5 years of software engineering experience with strong backend engineering fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience building production systems using Spring/Spring Boot or Node.js.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems and production\-grade system design.
* Experience with SQL databases, including schema design, indexing and query optimisation.
* Good understanding of NoSQL concepts, including partitioning, consistency, access patterns and data modelling.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform — AWS, GCP or equivalent.
* Ability to reason about scale, reliability, performance, maintainability and cost while making technical decisions.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Preferred Technical Skills
* Java / Spring / Spring Boot
* JavaScript / TypeScript / Node.js
* API development
* Distributed systems
* Production\-grade system design
* SQL database design, indexing and query optimisation
* NoSQL concepts including partitioning, consistency, access patterns and data modelling
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or equivalent
* Caching and concurrency
* Performance and bottleneck identification
* Understanding of service boundaries, communication patterns and failure handling
* Understanding of tenancy and data isolation



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Functional Competencies
* Strong backend engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to think from first principles and make deliberate technical choices.
* Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability and cost.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to understand the expected product outcome and challenge solutions constructively.
* Strong ownership from problem definition and design through production.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and functional boundaries.
* Ability to make informed decisions, ship, measure and iterate.
* Strong engineering judgement and willingness to question assumptions.

* We expect you to use AI effectively to build faster and better — for exploration, coding, debugging, testing, reviewing and understanding unfamiliar systems.
* But we’re not looking for a prompt hero.
* You should understand what you’re shipping, validate what AI produces, question its assumptions and own the engineering decisions behind it.

* Demonstrate strong backend engineering fundamentals and take end\-to\-end ownership of problems.
* Build simple, maintainable and scalable systems without unnecessary complexity.
* Make sound engineering decisions across APIs, distributed systems, databases, performance and cloud.

* Simple over clever. Outcomes

title: Staff Engineer- ML Infra
description:
**About Us** 




 ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt Ltd) is India's largest homegrown social media company and the only local player to achieve profitability in the industry, with 200\+ million Monthly Monetizable Users across all its platforms.
 



 Founded in 2015, ShareChat has social media brands such as the ShareChat App and Moj App and micro drama app QuickTV under its portfolio. QuickTV, the newest addition to ShareChat's family of apps, crossed the 10 million downloads mark within 3 months of launch and currently has 60Mn MAUs across the network viewing the vertical episodic content.
 



 Today, the ShareChat network maintains a whopping 1,000 Cr ARR and is India's leading social media platform servicing users across the country in 15 regional languages. This growth has led to a 28% YoY revenue growth in the July\-Sept (2025\-26\) quarter and increased it by more than 60% in the Oct\-Dec quarter.
 



 What does the team do?
 



 Serving recommendations to 200\+ million users entails developing large\-scale personalization and recommendation models that understand user needs and preferences in real\-time, while also helping creators grow their audiences on our platforms.
 



 Underpinning all of this is a horizontal AI Infrastructure team that owns the systems every product surface depends on — training pipelines, inference infrastructure, and data pipelines spanning feed and ads. This is where you come in.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* **Distributed training at recommender scale.** 
 Our models are embedding\-heavy — ID vocabularies in the 10⁷–10⁸ range, sharded across workers and churning constantly. That makes training a different problem from most deep learning: embedding placement and sharding strategy, eviction, multi\-host data\-parallel throughput, and holding cost per experiment down across \~35 models in daily training. We run on TensorFlow today and are moving to the PyTorch ecosystem.
* **Inference optimization across hardware and runtimes.** 
 Serving is the largest line in our infrastructure cost. We run TensorFlow Serving and OpenVINO today, across CPU and GPU; testing further runtimes — ONNX Runtime, Triton, TensorRT — is on the roadmap. The work is measurement\-driven: find where cost and latency actually go, then move them.
* **Expand the GPU serving path.** 
 We run a GPU/CPU hybrid deployment today, but only for a subset of models. Extending it — and making it the obvious choice wherever it wins on cost or unlocks models CPU can't serve — is open work.
* **Orchestration and observability for dozens of training pipelines** 
 across feed and ads, running on Flyte and Kubernetes.
* **Work horizontally** 
 across feed and ads, and raise the ceiling around you through design review and pairing.



  





**Who you are** 



* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience — we care about the depth of what you've built more than the count. Fast progressors are very much welcome.
* **Depth in at least one of: distributed training, model serving and inference optimization, or ML platform / MLOps — with working knowledge of the others.** 
 We're looking for T\-shaped, not a tour of all three.
* You've
 **owned or substantially rebuilt** 
 a piece of production ML infrastructure, not only operated one someone else built. For example: changed how a training job was parallelized, moved a model between serving runtimes and measured the result, built eval and release gating for a model fleet, or debugged a distributed training failure to root cause.
* Comfortable in framework internals — PyTorch, TensorFlow, TorchRec, TF Serving / ONNX Runtime / Triton / OpenVINO — not only their APIs.
* You reason about performance from measurement: profiles, utilization, where the time actually goes.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — distributed systems, system design, building for scale and reliability.
* Comfortable as a senior individual contributor, owning complex problems end to end with minimal hand\-holding.
* **We welcome candidates from software engineering, ML engineering, and ML platform backgrounds.** 
 We care what you've built, not which track you sat on.



  





**Where Will You Be?** 




 Bangalore (Hybrid)
 



  





**What's In It For You?** 




 At ShareChat, our values — Ownership, Speed, User Empathy, Integrity, and First Principles — are at the core of our ways of working. We believe in hiring top talent and grooming future leaders by providing a flexible environment to aid growth and development.
 



 Our Elite Benefits Suite:
 


* Wealth \& Security: ESOPs and comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Lifestyle: Hybrid working culture, Gym allowance, and Zomato coupons.
* Family Support: Monthly childcare allowance for women employees.
* And many more…

* Strong attention to detail, precision and cross\-functional communication skills.


 To provide Cobot Cell and AMR design engineering support, including 2D/3D layout development, mechanical system and fixture design, component integration, and the creation of manufacturing\-ready drawings with accurate GD\&T callouts, datum schemes, and tolerance allocations in accordance with ASME Y14\.5 standards.

title: Specialist, Procurement Controlling
description:
*At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.*



**Job Description**

 Konecranes Procurement Controlling enables professional measurement, analysis and reporting for the Procurement Function and Konecranes’ global spend. The team develops processes and practices that strengthen transparency, support decision\-making and maintain an effective financial control environment across approximately EUR 2 billion of annual procurement spend across all Business Areas and Group Functions.
   

  





 We are looking for a proactive and self\-motivated Procurement Analyst to turn external market signals and internal procurement data into forward\-looking insights. The primary ownership of this role is Konecranes’ inflation pressure simulation and the related market intelligence service for strategic decisions, helping the organization understand how cost drivers may affect Konecranes direct and indirect external spend.
   

  





 You will combine structured analysis with active stakeholder engagement across businesses, regions and purchasing categories. In addition, you will own the governance of supplier payment\-term decrease requests and contribute to Procurement Controlling priorities, savings validation, spend reporting and the continued development of Sievo.
   

  





 This role is a strong fit for someone who is curious about global markets, confident working with complex data and able to translate analysis into clear, actionable messages for procurement and business stakeholders. The location is in Chennai, India. The role is hybrid and involves approximately 15% business travel.
   

  





**Your key responsibilities**



* **Own the global inflation pressure simulation:** 
 Lead the outlook prepared for Annual Planning purposes as well as quarterly three\-month updates throughout the year, including impact analysis against the original annual forecast, across direct and indirect procurement spend.
* **Deliver procurement market intelligence:** 
 Monitor relevant direct and indirect material commodities such as labour, energy, logistics, steel, copper and other cost drivers; use AI\-enabled research to scale insight collection across market research, internal experts, external service providers and supplier\-facing stakeholders; and translate external market movements into quantified procurement\-spend impacts.
* **Maintain the simulation methodology and data model:** 
 Extract historical category spend, maintain the category\-to\-commodity correlation matrix, develop scenarios and ensure assumptions, calculation logic and outcomes are transparent and documented.
* **Analyse, communicate and document results:** 
 Use complementary sources such as Purchase Price Variance and PIR analyses to challenge outcomes, explain key drivers and delay effects, and provide concise updates, presentations and decision support to relevant stakeholders.
* **Maintain reporting and enable users:** 
 Own the functional maintenance and content of the inflation Power BI report and related Procurement House documentation and provide practical user guidance and training.
* **Govern supplier payment\-term decrease requests:** 
 Validate requests through spend and business rationale reviews, apply defined thresholds and approval routes, coordinate execution support where applicable and safeguard alignment with policy, working\-capital objectives and cost control.
* **Contribute to Procurement Controlling priorities:** 
 Support agreed strategic deliverables, the global savings validation process, harmonised reporting and the standardisation and productisation of recurring analyses and reports.
* **Develop procurement analytics capabilities:** 
 Support continuous improvement of Sievo and selected modules as a super user, strengthen data quality and adoption, provide stakeholder training, and further develop standards, guidelines and policies within the responsibility area.
* Awareness of ISO 14001 \& 45001 standard


**Qualifications**

**What You Should Bring**




  

  





**Educational Qualification \- Graduation/Post graduation in** 
 business, procurement, supply chain management, finance, economics, data analytics or a comparable field.
   

  





**Experience\- 8\-10 Years**



* Relevant experience in procurement analytics, market intelligence, procurement controlling, business controlling or a similar analytical role in an international environment.
* A strong analytical mindset and the ability to build and explain forecasts, scenarios, spend\-based models and impact analyses.
* Understanding procurement economics and the way commodities, supplier, contract and timing effects can influence cost development and business performance.
* A proactive, structured and accountable way of working, with the curiosity to investigate signals, challenge assumptions and improve established approaches


**Additional Information**

 Skills \& Knowledge
   

  




* Strong research and analytical capability for monitoring and interpretation of global commodities, macroeconomic indicators, markets and cost trends.
* Ability to summarize complex topics into clear conclusions, recommendations and executive\-ready communication
* Confident stakeholder management and collaboration skills across functions, business areas, regions, Category Managers, Supplier Managers and Category Specialists
* Advanced data\-handling skills; practical Power BI experience is expected, while experience with Sievo, SAP or comparable procurement and ERP platforms is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.
* A service\-oriented, collaborative mindset and willingness to travel internationally when required.



**Why join us?**




*We are a global company with history dating back to 1910 \- with future looking attitude that has brought us here today. Now together, we are shaping the next generation of material handling for smarter and safer world.*




*We believe in creating a workplace that is built on trust, flexibility, friendliness and inclusivity towards each other and culture with open communication and low hierarchy. We are a strong expert organisation where you are able to use modern tools and technologies \- while embracing agile methodologies and continuous learning and development.*




**What we offer?**



* *Competitive Salary.*
* *Work\-Life balance.*
* *Innovative and dynamic working environment.*
* *Support of an excellent Team.*
* *Possibility to work in leading crane building company with leading technology.*



**Interested?**
  

 If this role sparked your interest, please submit your application as soonest, on our career site. Please note that position will be filled when we find a suitable person. For any additional query feel free to write at \- harshita.agrahari@konecranes.com
   

  





  

  

****Konecranes moves what matters***
*. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000\+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.
   

  

  

  

 Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination.**

title: Head- Fund Raising & Investor Relations
description:
**About the Company** 




 Vantrock is an Operator Led \- Real assets platform. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks if the first strategy across the full chain — first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space — vertical industries, where our expertise transfers; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



  





 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO — three institutional platforms built from zero, the fourth now on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close — ₹2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the distribution channel — India’s first domestic warehousing AIF, and India’s largest industrial real estate exit. Delivered across the founder’s three prior platforms. We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 MULTIPLE PRODUCT lines — INVIT, REIT, Yielding, Industrial parks, Logictic \& Warehousing, Office, Plotted Sales, Land Fund, Pre\-leased, Private Credit — through a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment via CIV and co\-investment PMS and other routes. Seeded means the operator puts assets in place before the fund launches, so 50–60% of the pipeline is typically identified and de\-risked on day one. No blind\-pool vehicle is ever raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment, and larger co\-investment tickets.
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS: Own the capital\-formation mandate end to end — strategy, channel architecture, the team, the investor franchise and the number. The single point of accountability for whether the first strategy closes on size and on time, and whether the next ones have a channel waiting.
 



  





 A builder’s seat, not a steward’s — but not a cold start. The platform brings an existing investor base, sponsor and anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the AIF and product channel from two prior funds; this team will be welcomed. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the zonal network. If you have only ever run an established distribution machine, this is not your seat.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  




* Strategy across national and regional distributors, IFA/MFD networks, DSAs, RIAs, family offices and wealth platforms — split by channel and quarter.
* Empanelment at the national distributors and wealth platforms that decide whether an RM may sell Vantrock at all — product heads, product committees — opened and closed personally.
* The second tier, built early: regional wealth firms, multi\-family offices, RIAs and large IFAs — they convert faster and often carry a first raise while the big platforms are in committee.
* The commercial construct, with the CIO: ticket, class structure, hurdle, distribution economics, direct plan, co\-investment routes — and what each does to saleability.
* The zonal team: recruited, led; targets, cadence and attribution rules set before anyone joins. Stay in the field yourself.
* The investor narrative — why Vantrock, why real assets, why an operator\-manager, why now — consistent everywhere; anchor and large family\-office conversations led personally. After the close, investor relations: reporting quality, capital\-account transparency, the investor day.
* Governance in the channel: every communication and figure approved before it leaves the building; empanelment register and suitability evidence maintained.



  





  





 THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT: You are the platform’s voice in the channel and the market. Accompany distributors and their RMs to clients and pitch the fund yourself — co\-selling beside the partner. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits nationally, and speak at them — and at trade shows, expos and industry forums. Be present on LinkedIn as a named voice of the platform. Approved material only; no return promises, ever.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 


* 15\+ years in financial services, at least eight in alternatives, PMS or fund distribution leadership on the manufacturer’s side — an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. B2B throughout: through distributors and platforms, not to your own clients.
* Personal accountability for third\-party capital raised through the channel across at least two launches — products, vintages and channel mix named without hedging.
* A national empanelment record: you have taken a product through the product committees of multiple national distributors or large wealth platforms, and can name who signed off.
* Led a distributed team of four or more senior people who each carried a number.
* Product\-head\-level relationships at the national distributors and at least three top\-ten wealth platforms.



  





**Required Skills** 



* B2B distribution leadership experience in financial services, specifically in alternatives, PMS or fund distribution on the manufacturer’s side.
* Proven track record of raising third\-party capital through distributor channels across multiple launches.
* Experience securing national empanelments with major distributors and wealth platforms.
* Ability to lead and manage a distributed senior team with individual targets.
* Strong relationships with product heads at national distributors and top wealth platforms.
* Fluent AI use, with judgment to check it — tested at interview for every hire.

title: Fresher – Statutory Audit
description:
Key Responsibilities

 documentation while maintaining professional communication.

 (SAs), Companies Act, and CNK’s audit methodology.

 ● Mandatory Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) completed. (Freshly qualified CAs
   

 are eligible; candidates awaiting results are not eligible).
   

 ● Experience: Fresher (0 years post\-qualification experience).
   

 ● Preferred Articleship Exposure: Statutory audits, Ind AS, Internal Financial Controls
   

 (IFC), consolidation, financial statement preparation/review, or corporate audits
   

 (manufacturing, banking, NBFC, or financial services).

 numerical and logical reasoning, basic knowledge of Standards on Auditing, and strong

title: Physical Therapist
description:
**Occupational Therapist – Fogelsville, PA**
 FOX Rehabilitation is growing in
 **Fogelsville, PA** 
 and we’re looking for passionate, licensed Occupational Therapists who want to deliver exceptional one\-on\-one care to older adults right where they live. Whether treating in private residences or within Senior Living Communities, you’ll help patients improve mobility, independence, and quality of life through our signature Geriatric House Calls™ model.
   

  

 This opportunity is ideal for Occupational Therapists who value autonomy, flexibility, and truly meaningful patient outcomes, while enjoying the freedom to create and manage your own treatment schedule and build strong, lasting patient relationships.
   

  

 FOX clinicians may also incorporate telehealth and other forms of virtual care into their schedules, allowing for greater flexibility, improved continuity of care, and the ability to support more patients.
   

  

 If you're searching for a high\-impact OT role that allows you to positively impact the lives of the communities we serve, FOX is the right fit for you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide one\-on\-one Occupational therapy to older adults wherever they call home (Private residences, Senior Living Communities, Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care)
* Perform evaluations, develop individualized plans of care, and deliver evidence\-based treatment
* Deliver therapy sessions that support patient wellness, longevity, mobility, and functional independence
* Document effectively within FOX’s EMR system in accordance with regulatory standards
* Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team of PTs, OTs, SLPs, and Fitness Specialists
* Educate patients, caregivers, and senior living staff to promote safety, function, and aging in place
* Provide telehealth / virtual care when appropriate to extend access and flexibility


**Why Join FOX Rehabilitation?**
 FOX Rehabilitation is a clinician\-operated practice rooted in meaningful relationships, evidence\-based care, and a mission to abolish ageism. You’ll be supported by leaders who understand clinical work, because they’ve lived it.
   

  

**Why Clinicians Love Working With FOX**
* A one\-on\-one care model that allows you to truly connect with each patient
* Opportunities to practice in both in\-home and senior living community settings
* Optional telehealth / virtual care components that expand flexibility and access
* The ability to create, control, and adjust your own treatment schedule
* A collaborative, interdisciplinary environment (PT, OT, SLP, Fitness Specialists)
* Work within a community\-based practice that supports independence, wellness, and longevity
* A culture that invests in your growth and values clinician\-driven decision\-making


**Employment Types Available**
 FOX offers multiple pathways to match your lifestyle and career goals:
   

  

* Full\-time Occupational Therapist – In\-Home \& Senior Living Care (salaried with benefits)
* Part\-time Occupational Therapist – In\-Home \& Senior Living Care (salaried with benefits eligibility based on minimum hours requirement)
* PRN / FOX Flex Occupational Therapist – Home \& Community Visits (pay per unit compensation)
* New Graduates eligible for FOX’s nationally recognized Emerging Professionals Mentor Program


**Ways to Earn More with FOX**
 Beyond base compensation, our clinicians have real opportunities to develop professionally and increase their income:
   

  

* Refer a friend — earn employee referral bonuses for growing our clinical team
* Refer a patient — wellness referral incentives for connecting patients to continued care with a FOX Fitness Specialist
* Teach the next generation — earn more while you shape the future serving as a Clinical Instructor
* Mentor rising talent — guide new grads and emerging professionals as they launch their careers
* Manage more patients — earn additional pay by supervising PTA/OTAs and expanding the care you're able to provide
* Go above and beyond — earn additional pay for patient care above bi\-weekly quota
* Share your expertise — get compensated for writing blog articles or creating viral social content


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 FOX offers competitive compensation based on experience and employment type. Benefits for eligible roles include:
   

  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Unlimited continuing education access
* Professional certification reimbursement
* Clinical and nonclinical career advancement pathways
* Access to advanced technology and tools (including virtual care resources)
* Supportive, clinician driven culture


**Qualifications**
* Valid Occupational Therapy license in the state(s) of practice, or eligibility to obtain
* Degree from an accredited Occupational Therapy program
* Basic computer and EMR proficiency
* Current CPR certification


**Physical Requirements**
 FOX clinicians must be able to meet the physical demands of in\-home and community\-based care, including:
   

  

* Exerting medium physical effort, including lifting 25–50 lbs occasionally, 10–25 lbs frequently, and up to 10 lbs constantly
* Performing CPR
* Providing moderate to maximum assistance with patient transfers and bed mobility
* Repositioning patients, standing/walking for extended periods, climbing stairs, and performing therapeutic activities
* Driving to patient homes and senior living communities as part of the Geriatric House Calls™ model
* Wearing PPE when required


**Apply Today**
 Join FOX Rehabilitation as a Occupational Therapist providing in\-home, senior living, and virtual care to older adults across
 **LOCATION, STATE** 
 , and surrounding communities. You’ll help people improve mobility, stay independent, and live stronger, longer lives.
   

  

**Contact FOX Now!**
 Kelly Schlindwein, Senior Clinical Talent Acquisition Specialist
   

  

 kelly.schlindwein@foxrehab.org
   

  

 856\-816\-1034
   

  

 You can also text FOX to 609\-853\-5114 to learn more!
   

  

 FOX Rehabilitation is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Integration Engineer – IICS & Boomi
description:
**Integration Engineer – IICS \& Boomi** 




  





**Full Time \| Chennai** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Integration Engineer to join the data team on a strategic account with an enterprise manufacturing client, working alongside our Data Architect and the wider engineering, integration, and BI team. This is a permanent, full\-lifecycle role: you will design, build, maintain, and optimize integration services on the client's Boomi and IICS platforms, working within their established enterprise architecture and governance standards.
 



 A major current initiative is consolidating a legacy Talend estate into Boomi and IICS. You will help rebuild and rationalize those services onto the right target platform \- reliably, with proven output parity \- and contribute technical tool\-fit input to the assessment framework that decides the best target (Boomi vs IICS) for each service. But the role extends well beyond migration: as the estate consolidates, you own the ongoing health of the integration landscape \- new service design, enhancements, production support, and performance and cost optimization.
 



 The core skill is depth in the target platforms \- Boomi and IICS. Talend familiarity is a strong accelerator for the consolidation work, but not a prerequisite: you'll be reading Talend to understand intent, not building new Talend.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Design \& Build:** 




  





 · Design and implement integration services on Boomi and/or IICS, following the client's
 



 architecture standards and integration patterns.
 



 · Build integration flows, mappings, orchestrations, connectors, error handling, and scheduling.
 



 · Enhance and extend existing services as business needs evolve.
 



 · Own solution design decisions and communicate their trade\-offs to technical and business
 



 audiences.
 



  





**Migration \& Consolidation (current initiative):** 




 · Rebuild legacy Talend integration services on Boomi and/or IICS.
 



 · Reverse\-engineer existing Talend jobs to establish their true behavior \- business logic,
 



 transformations, edge cases, and data handling \- not just their surface intent.
 



 · Partner with the team's existing Talend knowledge holder to validate understanding of legacy
 



 services.
 



 · Define and run parity / reconciliation testing to prove each rebuilt service matches its legacy
 



 output; resolve source\-to\-target discrepancies.
 



 · Contribute technical tool\-fit input to the Boomi\-vs\-IICS assessment framework.
 



  





**Maintenance \& Optimization:** 




 · Provide ongoing production support for built integration services \- monitoring, troubleshooting,
 



 and resolving issues.
 



 · Optimize services for performance, reliability, and cost / consumption efficiency.
 



 · Perform root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
 



 · Maintain a prioritized backlog of improvements and technical debt.
 



  





**Collaboration \& Delivery:** 




 · Work within the client's enterprise architecture, governance, and security standards.
 



 · Coordinate with the Data Architect, platform, security, and business teams.
 



 · Maintain clear documentation of services, designs, and support procedures.
 



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 




 · Demonstrated depth as an integration / ETL engineer across the full lifecycle \- design, build,
 



 and ongoing maintenance (we are flexible on total years \- see note above).
 



 · Working knowledge of both Boomi and IICS, with genuine working knowledge of the other \- or
 



 a strong track record of ramping quickly onto an adjacent iPaaS platform.
 



 · Strong integration fundamentals: mappings, transformations, orchestration, connectors, APIs,
 



 error handling, and scheduling.
 



 · Experience maintaining and optimizing integration services in production \- performance,
 



 reliability, and cost / consumption.
 



 · Proven ability to reverse\-engineer undocumented or lightly\-documented integration jobs and
 



 rebuild them faithfully.
 



 · Discipline around validation \- reconciliation and parity testing to confirm rebuilt services match
 



 legacy behavior.
 



 · Strong SQL.
 



 · Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and
 



 governance framework.
 



 · Clear communicator \- able to explain technical decisions to both technical and business
 



 audiences.
 



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




 · Talend experience \- even at a read / maintenance level \- to accelerate reverse\-engineering of
 



 the legacy estate.

title: Asset Engineer- Asset performance Management
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. **About This Role**
 Dow is looking for
 **Asset Engineer** 
 to be located in
 **Chennai, India** 
 .
   

  

 The Asset Management Professional provides global support for master data management activities on SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) and Materials Management (MM) through the Maintenance Technology Center.
   

  

 The engineer possesses strong expertise in Maintenance and Materials Master Data Management (MDM), including data creation, cleansing, classification, verification, validation, standardization, and enrichment activities. Demonstrates proficiency in managing ERP/CMMS master data in compliance with SAP PM and MM module standards, along with a solid understanding of global customer MDM practices and industry best practices.
   

  

 This role should demonstrate strong accountability and commitment to delivering high\-quality work while adhering to project schedules and timelines, be capable of developing and effectively populating the required deliverables with accuracy and completeness, and possess expanded conceptual and practical knowledge within their job discipline and continuously broadens their capabilities to handle increasing responsibilities and complex assignments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**PLANT MAINTENANCE (SAP\-PM) MANAGEMENT**
* Master equipment list (MEL)/ asset register preparation \& Physical asset verification, mark\-up and As Built of P\&ID
* Develop functional location (FLOC) \& Develop Bill of Materials (BOM) for equipment.
* Review Recommendation of new spares from vendor documents and spare parts inter\-changeability record (SPIR)
* PM Plan, maintenance item, task list, task list group \& interpret and incorporate FMEA outputs with PM plan.
* PM spares against task list operations \& Maintenance of Work\-Pack preparation against work orders


**MATERIALS MANAGEMENT (SAP\-MM) MANAGEMENT**
* Material creation in SAP MM using transaction codes \& Cleansing, standardization, enrichment and de\-duping.

* Classification of materials based on noun and modifier (Class) concept with suitable attributes (Characteristic)
* Class, Characteristic master template creation and standardize \& Classify materials as OEM, general and consumable spares.
* Review SPIR/SPDF with all related documents and establish operational spares for new projects \& experienced in MRO spares criticality analysis.
* Define/ recommend stock and non\-stock spares for different types of equipment.
* Inventory Optimization, define ROP/ MAX and ability to identify the equipment for no BOM linked materials.
* Perform Material Replenishment study for routine spares.


**Additional Support**
* Creates Equipment Reliability Strategies based upon Top Opportunity List, Critical Equipment List, and identified plant/business needs.
* Validates ERS implementation and closes gaps to improve/sustain reliability improvement.
* Evaluates effectiveness of individual aspects of the PPM program by showing quantitatively the impact of failures and Predictive Preventive Maintenance (PPM).
* Optimizes PPM activities, on an on\-going basis, to support overall productivity improvements.
* Identifies and resolve Top Reliability Opportunities and decrease equipment failure losses in order to meet the site Product Supply Reliability improvement goals for the given year.
* Develops and maintains, as requested, a model that identifies the unit operations, equipment, process, etc. that identifies the value of opportunities for improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree only in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5 to 10 years of working experience in Chemical/ Petrochemical plants plus reliability, maintenance, manufacturing or related experience required.


**Your Skills**
* Strong technical expertise in plant asset management, reliability, maintenance or related.
* Collaborative communication to work efficiently with different stakeholders across different regions.
* Proactive problem solving to manage challenges, problems and provide the right solutions.

**About The Role**
 TTEC is scaling its Automation \& AI portfolio to move beyond manual, ticket\-by\-ticket process work toward an agentic framework that can right\-source work across business units. **What You'll Do**
* Design and implement multi\-agent workflows using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), including agent orchestration, tool routing, and memory/context management
* Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose internal systems (Jira, SharePoint, ServiceNow, internal APIs, etc.) as discoverable tools that agents can call at runtime
* Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, and safety — both pre\- and post\-deployment
* Design, build, and optimize conversational and task\-based agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, integrating with Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) and enterprise data sources
* Apply strong prompt engineering practices — structured prompting, few\-shot design, guardrails, and iterative evaluation — to improve agent reliability and reduce hallucination/drift
* Architect and deploy agentic solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, IAM) with attention to scalability, cost, and security
* Partner with business unit stakeholders to identify manual, repeatable processes suitable for agent\-based automation, translating business requirements into technical agent designs
* Collaborate with the Automation \& AI team on reusable patterns, shared tooling, and governance standards (security review readiness, access control, data handling)
* Contribute to internal enablement — documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so the broader team can build and extend agentic solutions
* Monitor deployed agents in production, iterating based on performance data, user feedback, and evaluation results


**Required**
**What You'll Bring**
* Hands\-on experience building with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or comparable agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI)
* Practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building or consuming MCP servers/tools
* Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation\-driven prompt iteration
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio for building and deploying enterprise agents/bots
* Working knowledge of GCP services relevant to AI workloads (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions/Run, IAM, logging/monitoring)
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Python (preferred), API design, version control

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build core pieces of this semantic layer: ontology models, canonical entity schemas, and the SPARQL/Jena\-based services that expose them, while mentoring Software Engineers and partnering closely with the Team Leader and architecture stakeholders.

title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
**Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management**
 The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity \& Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm – 11pm IST.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Identity \& Access Management**
* Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services.
* Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes.
* Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access\-related issues.
* Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols.
* Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications.
* Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms.
* Support role\-based access control and group\-based access management.


**Identity Security \& Governance**
* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls.
* Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation\-of\-duties controls.
* Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues.
* Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable.
* Assist with investigation and remediation of identity\-related security events.
* Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements.


**PKI \& Certificate Management**
