**Email:** 
 careers@manastuspace.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Application Firmware Engineer Role Summary We are seeking a skilled Application Firmware Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in RTOS\-based, 32\-bit microcontroller systems. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in real\-time system design, mission/state machine logic, telemetry and command handling, and firmware verification — building on top of the driver interfaces the Platform Firmware Engineer exposes. Experience in aerospace, defence, avionics, or other mission\-critical electronics domains will be highly valued.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Design and implement Super loop and RTOS\-based application firmware: task scheduling, inter\-task communication, timers, interrupts, mutexes, queues, and memory management.
* Develop application\-level firmware, mission logic, and state\-machine behavior on top of the driver layer.
* Implement real\-time data acquisition pipelines: sensor read, engineering\-unit conversion, calibration, and filtering.
* Implement telemetry packetization, CRC framing, and command decode/validate/execute/reply flows.
* Implement fault detection and fault management logic, including safe\-state transitions and event logging.
* Perform firmware integration and system\-level debugging at the application/mission\-logic level.
* Review schematics and hardware designs from a mission\-logic and data\-flow perspective.
* Support design verification activities from an application\-behavior perspective.
* Prepare firmware design documents, test procedures, debug reports, and release notes.
* Participate in unit testing, integration testing, and firmware release management and version control.
* Collaborate with the low\-level Firmware Engineer, hardware, FPGA teams.



**Qualifications** 



* Role Overview
* Department Engineering / Embedded Systems / Avionics \& Defence Electronics
* Employment Type Full\-time
* Experience 6 \- 15 Years of relevant embedded firmware experience
* Qualification B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech — Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Instrumentation, Computer Science or related discipline
* Domain Preference Aerospace, Defence, Avionics, Space, or Mission\-Critical Systems



**Required Skills** 



* Core programming \- strong proficiency in Embedded C , Python or VB.NET knowledge is an advantage.
* Solid understanding of RTOS\-based firmware development, with working knowledge of the underlying MCU architecture (memory map, interrupts, timers) the application runs on.
* Experience designing application logic that consumes a driver interface rather than accessing registers directly.
* Supported MCU Platforms
* Application\-level familiarity with ARM Cortex\-M series (STM32, NXP, Microchip SAM / PIC32\)
* Renesas, Infineon, or other equivalent 32\-bit MCU platforms, as consumed through the platform team's BSP
* RTOS Concepts
* Task/thread creation, priorities, and scheduling
* Semaphores, mutexes, queues, and mailboxes
* Software/hardware timers and ISR\-to\-task communication
* Stack and heap management; memory safety
* Communication Protocols
* Application\-level framing and command/telemetry design over UART, SPI, I²C, CAN / CAN\-FD
* RS\-232, RS\-485, Ethernet, USB — protocol\-level packet design and validation
* Debugging \& Tooling
* JTAG, SWD, breakpoints, watchpoints, memory views, and trace tools for application\-level debugging.
* Working knowledge of IDEs/toolchains: STM32CubeIDE, MPLAB X, Code ,GCC, Eclipse.
* Source control: Git.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets to understand the data available from the driver layer.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior experience in mission\-critical embedded systems.
* Familiarity with MISRA C, MIL\-STD requirements, or RTCA qualification processes.
* Experience with firmware upgrade mechanisms, CRC verification, watchdog strategy, and fail\-safe design at the application/state\-machine level.
* Knowledge of high\-reliability and fault\-tolerant embedded design practices.
* Real\-time data acquisition, control systems, sensor interfacing, or actuator control experience.
* Python, VB, or scripting skills for test automation and utility development.
* Exposure to static analysis tools, unit testing frameworks, and CI for embedded firmware.
* Tools \& Technologies
* Programming: Embedded C (primary), C\+\+ (preferred), Python scripting
* RTOS: FreeRTOS. JD — Application Firmware Engineer
* Debug Tools: JTAG, SWD, ST\-Link.
* Lab Instruments: DSO, Logic Analyzer, Protocol Analyzer, Multimeter, Function Generator.
* Protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN / CAN\-FD, Ethernet, USB, RS\-232, RS\-485\.
* Version Control: Git.
* Documentation: Design documents, test procedures, traceability docs, technical reports
* Key Competencies
* Embedded System Design
* Strong Firmware Fundamentals
* Hardware\-Software Integration
* Hands\-on Debugging \& Problem\-Solving
* Documentation \& Process Discipline
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Quality, Reliability \& Safety Focus
* Documentation of source Code.

 Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML engineering, production AI systems, model integration/deployment, and the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-powered applications.

**Preferred / Good to Have:** 



* Experience with classical ML techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering, ensemble methods, and model evaluation.
* Practical experience with deep learning architectures such as CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, transformers, vision transformers, and transfer learning.
* Experience with training and fine\-tuning models, hyperparameter optimization, experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and reproducible ML workflows.



  





**What would you be expected to do:** 



* Experience deploying and managing AI inference workloads on Linux VMs, GPU VMs, cloud infrastructure, or on\-premise servers.
* Familiarity with inference runtimes and optimization stacks such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, vLLM, LiteRT/LiteRT\-LM, or similar technologies.
* Experience with multimodal AI, vision\-language models, speech/audio AI, or AI systems integrated with hardware products.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD, Docker, observability, and production infrastructure for AI workloads.
* Experience with C\+\+, CUDA, GPU profiling, or hardware\-aware optimization is an added advantage.



  





**What would you be expected to do:** 



* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions that balance model quality, latency, scalability, reliability, infrastructure cost, and user experience.
* Integrate, fine\-tune, evaluate, and deploy LLMs and Generative AI models for use cases such as conversational AI, summarization, entity extraction, classification, reasoning, text generation, and AI agents.
* Work with Computer Vision and multimodal AI systems, including image understanding, visual\-language models, embeddings, classification, detection, and other perception workloads where applicable.
* Build and maintain REST APIs and model\-serving services using FastAPI and related serving frameworks, with proper validation, documentation, logging, and observability.
* Create reproducible AI pipelines covering data preparation, experimentation, evaluation, model integration, deployment, and production validation.
* Evaluate AI systems using relevant quality and performance metrics, test edge cases, analyze failure modes, and establish reliable validation and benchmarking processes.
* Design prompt engineering strategies, RAG pipelines, guardrails, tool calling, and safety mechanisms for production Generative AI and agentic AI systems.
* Build and maintain AI observability and monitoring to track model quality, latency, resource utilization, failures, drift, anomalies, and out\-of\-distribution inputs.
* Optimize AI inference for low latency and high throughput using techniques such as quantization, batching, caching, efficient model serving, GPU optimization, and hardware\-aware deployment.
* Deploy and operate AI workloads on Linux\-based VMs and cloud/on\-premise GPU infrastructure; manage runtime dependencies, containers, model artifacts, services, logs, and production troubleshooting.

title: Sponsorship Sales Manager
description:
India worships one sport. Every kid here can talk about a cover drive before they learn alphabet. But somewhere past the boundary ropes, a new arena is filling up cages instead of pitches, fighters instead of batsmen and it is growing faster than most people in the room realise.
 





 Having spent close to two decades inside this sport, as India's only UFC panellist on Sony, I have witnessed MMA go from a niche YouTube search to genuine obsession for a generation that grew up on octagon highlights. Superhuman Sportz exists to give that obsession a real home \- India's first structured combat sports IP, built fighter\-first, from Amateur to Pro.
 




  





**We have run the events. We have filled the galleries. Now we need someone who can walk into a boardroom and make a brand believe what a packed arena can offer.** 




  





**THE ROLE** 





 You will be the person who turns
 
***“never heard of it”***

 into a signed sponsorship deal. That means two very different conversations, often in the same week \- getting a foot in the door with a brand executive and then discussing with CMO or Founder to sign the sponsorship contract with us.
 




  





**WHAT'S EXPECTED FROM YOU** 



* Open doors at the ground level : build real relationships with brand marketing teams who can get you into the room.
* Close the deal with CMOs and founders directly : this isn't a role that hands off the hard conversation to someone senior.
* Figure out which brands actually belong here : sports \& fitness, energy \& nutrition, auto \& two\-wheelers, fintech and lifestyle and go after them with intent, not a spray\-and\-pray list.
* Own the pipeline end to end : from first cold outreach to a signed contract supported by founders.
* Build the sponsorship playbook as you go : work closely with the founders to shape packages that make maximises category ROI.



  





**EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 3\-7 years in sponsorship sales, media sales or brand partnerships. Prior exposure in revenue generation in Media, Sports industry would be useful
* A real track record of closing deals at the CMO/founder level, not just managing accounts someone else opened.
* Comfortable moving between a first cold conversation and a boardroom negotiation, often in the same deal cycle.
* Startup instincts \- lean team, fast calls, no big brand name to lean on yet. You build the credibility as you go.



  





  





**THE SKILLS THAT ACTUALLY MATTER HERE** 



* Storytelling that makes a CXO see themselves inside an emerging sports that hasn't been told yet. This sport won't sell off a template.
* Out\-of\-the\-box thinking \-  the standard logo and banner pitch doesn't work in a category brands haven't budgeted for. You will have to invent the ask.
* Sharp category instinct \- knowing exactly why a brand fits before you ever pick up the phone.
* A high tolerance for “no” \- you are not selling an established property, you are building category belief one conversation at a time.



  





**WHERE** 





 Mumbai preferred. Open to Delhi and Bangalore for the right person.
 




  





***If you ever watched a room turn from skeptical to sold and you want to do that for a sport that's about to explode in this country , let's talk.***

 Senior AI Full\-Stack Engineer
   

  

 Build production AI for the future of financial markets.

Collaborating directly with an experienced US\-based engineering team, you will build advanced LLM applications, real\-time data integrations and intelligent products that solve genuine problems across financial markets. * Build greenfield AI products rather than maintain legacy applications.
* Solve genuine challenges across trading, risk and portfolio management.
* Own the journey from business problem and prototype through to production.
* Work across React, Python, AWS, LLMs, agentic workflows and real\-time data.
* Influence product direction, architecture and measurable business outcomes.

* Partner with product and business stakeholders to understand complex Financial Services challenges and define clear outcomes.

* Build secure, scalable backend services that integrate with LLMs, agentic workflows and enterprise data.
* Transform AI prototypes into reliable production products by addressing security, performance, scalability and supportability.
* Own automated testing, CI/CD, observability and deployment using Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Advise teams on where AI can create measurable value and develop reusable engineering patterns for production\-ready AI products.
* Mentor engineers and communicate technical recommendations clearly to business and engineering stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced product engineer who combines technical depth with commercial awareness and a genuine interest in Financial Services.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production\-grade applications.
* Strong full\-stack engineering experience across frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure.
* Recent hands\-on development experience with Python and React, or a comparable modern frontend framework.
* Experience designing APIs and building secure, scalable backend services.
* Strong hands\-on AWS experience, including building and operating cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated testing and observability.
* Experience taking prototypes or early\-stage products through to secure, scalable production.
* Strong product judgement and the ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.
* Experience within Financial Services, fintech, capital markets, banking or another regulated environment.
* A genuine interest in trading, investment management, digital assets and cryptocurrency.
* Confidence communicating architecture, trade\-offs and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.


 Technology environment
   

  

 React \| Python \| FastAPI \| AWS \| Amazon Bedrock \| SageMaker \| AgentCore \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| Docker \| PostgreSQL \| Databricks \| Redis \| REST APIs \| Server\-Sent Events \| WebSockets \| LLMs \| Agentic workflows
   

  

 You do not need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering fundamentals, relevant technical depth and the judgement to choose the right solution for the business problem.
   

  

**Valuable Additional Experience**

* Authentication and authorisation using OAuth2, OIDC, SSO or RBAC.

 Why Version 1?
   

  

 At Version 1, you will deepen your expertise within our Financial Services practice while building sophisticated AI products for a global organisation operating across trading, investment management and digital assets.

title: Senior Production Designer – Set Design & Fabrication
description:
**The Job:** 




  





 To look into the creative visualization, design, production and fabrication of sets and spatial experiences across corporate events, weddings, award shows, festivals, exhibitions, fashion shows and 70 EMG Intellectual Properties.
 



 The role requires a strong combination of
 **creative design sensibility and hands\-on production expertise** 
 , with ownership from the initial brief and concept development through design detailing, fabrication, workshop supervision and final on\-ground execution.
 



  





**Work Experience** 




 6\+ years of experience in set design, event design, spatial design, production, fabrication or experiential design, preferably within the Events, Weddings, Entertainment, Exhibitions or Live Entertainment industry.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Creative Direction \& Set Design
 


* Develop set concepts, décor themes, installations and experiential elements while maintaining design consistency across the project.
* Ensure designs are aesthetically strong, practical and suitable for fabrication and execution.
* Present and communicate design concepts clearly to internal teams, clients and external partners.



 2\. Design Development \& Technical Detailing
 


* Convert creative concepts into detailed and executable set designs.
* Support in supervising 3D models, layouts, elevations, working drawings and production drawings.
* Ensure designs account for dimensions, structural requirements, materials, fabrication methods, installation and dismantling.
* Work closely with production and fabrication teams to identify practical solutions and resolve design\-related challenges.
* Ensure design intent is maintained throughout the production process.



 3\. Production \& Fabrication
 


* Take ownership of the complete set production and fabrication process from design handover to final execution.
* Work closely with fabricators, contractors, vendors and production partners to execute designs accurately.
* Identify appropriate materials, finishes, construction methods and fabrication techniques.
* Evaluate fabrication feasibility, timelines, material availability and associated costs.
* Conduct regular workshop visits and monitor fabrication progress.
* Ensure fabricated elements meet the required design, finish, quality and safety standards.
* Identify potential production challenges in advance and provide practical design or fabrication solutions.



 4\. Budgeting \& Cost Management
 


* Prepare and manage budgets related to set design, fabrication, décor and production.
* Develop estimates for materials, manpower, fabrication, transportation, installation and dismantling.
* Work with vendors to negotiate costs and identify cost\-effective alternatives without compromising design quality.
* Monitor production costs and ensure projects remain within approved budgets.



 5\. Vendor \& Resource Management
 


* Build and maintain a strong network of fabricators, contractors, material suppliers and production vendors.
* Identify and engage new vendors based on project requirements.
* Stay updated on the latest materials, fabrication techniques, finishes, technology and production inventory available in the market.
* Evaluate vendor capabilities, quality, timelines and commercial viability.
* Manage external resources and ensure timely delivery of production requirements.



 6\. Workshop \& On\-Ground Execution
 


* Supervise fabrication and installation at workshops and event sites.
* Ensure the final execution accurately reflects the approved design and creative intent.
* Conduct quality checks at key stages of fabrication and installation.
* Coordinate with production, project management, creative, client servicing and other internal teams for smooth execution.
* Resolve on\-ground design and fabrication challenges quickly and effectively.
* Ensure all set elements are completed within timelines and are ready for event operations.



  





 Desired Skills
 


* Set Design \& Creative Direction
* Spatial \& Experiential Design
* Production \& Fabrication
* Materials \& Fabrication Knowledge
* Budgeting \& Cost Management
* Vendor \& Contractor Management
* Workshop \& On\-Site Execution
* Project Management

 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

 The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front\-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post\-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end\-to\-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work.  Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. title: Agentic AI Engineer — Data & Analytics
description:
**Agentic AI Engineer — Data \& Analytics** 




**5\-12 yrs of exp** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are building a portfolio of AI agents and reusable accelerators that transform how enterprises run their data, analytics, and supply chain operations. As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will design and build production\-grade AI agents — systems that reason over enterprise data, invoke tools and APIs, and execute multi\-step analytical workflows with appropriate guardrails. This is a software engineering role first and a GenAI role second: you will ship code that runs in client production environments, not notebooks that run\-in demos.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Design and build LLM\-powered agents for data and analytics use cases: data quality triage, pipeline diagnostics, analytics copilots, document intelligence, and domain\-specific decision agents etc.
* Implement agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent — and know when to use none of them.
* Build robust tool/function\-calling layers over enterprise systems: SQL engines, REST APIs, data catalogs, ERP/planning systems, and vector stores.
* Design and implement retrieval architectures (RAG, hybrid search, GraphRAG, semantic caching) with measured retrieval quality, not assumed quality.
* Build evaluation harnesses: golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, regression suites for prompts and agent behavior; treat evals as Continuous Integration, not as an afterthought.
* Implement guardrails and safety controls: input/output validation, PII handling, cost and latency budgets, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for consequential actions.
* Productionize agents: containerization, CI/CD, observability (tracing every agent step), versioning of prompts and models, rollback strategies.
* Collaborate with developers and solution architects to ensure agents consume governed, well\-modeled data — not raw chaos.
* Presents demos; handles technical Q\&A



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Strong software engineering foundation in Python (typing, testing, packaging, async); working proficiency in SQL.
* Hands\-on experience building LLM applications beyond prototypes: at least one system with real users, real failure modes, and real iteration.
* Practical understanding of LLM behavior: context management, structured outputs, tool calling, prompt versioning, token/cost economics.
* Experience with at least one vector database or hybrid retrieval stack (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search) and the trade\-offs between them.
* Experience deploying services to at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP); comfort with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to reason about non\-determinism: designing systems that fail gracefully and are testable despite probabilistic components.
* Sound judgment on when a problem warrants an agentic solution versus a deterministic one, with clear rationale for the choice.



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with agent evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, LangSmith/Langfuse or equivalent).
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building tool integrations for AI systems.
* Knowledge graph or semantic layer experience.
* Domain exposure to supply chain, manufacturing, or enterprise operations data.
* Contributions to open source, technical writing, or internal accelerator/IP development.

title: Director, Data & AI Platform Engineering
description:
**Director, Data \& AI Platform Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Remote, India
   

  





**About SailPoint:** 
  
   

  





 SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less. 
 



 Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time, matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud\-oriented, modern enterprise. 
 



**About the role:** 




 As the Director of Data and AI Platform Engineering, you will lead the strategic vision, design, and execution of SailPoint’s high\-performance enterprise data and artificial intelligence platforms in Pune. You will spend your days driving technical excellence, scaling our distributed systems, and empowering engineering teams to build data\-intensive and machine learning\-driven applications with ease. In this role, you will oversee both the Data and AI Platform teams, guiding team members in both technical and professional growth. You will lead a powerhouse of engineering talent working with a sophisticated modern tech stack that includes Apache Flink, Apache Spark, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, dbt, Airflow, and OpenSearch, alongside state\-of\-the\-art AI/ML engineering tools across multi\-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure). You will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural design and day\-to\-day delivery, ensuring our user\-facing products have robust full\-text search capabilities, data governance, high\-volume streaming, and scalable AI infrastructure.
 



**About the team:** 




 The SailPoint Data and AI Platform teams in Pune are the foundational engines powering our core Identity Security Cloud, the Identity Graph, and various analytics and machine learning\-driven products and services across SailPoint. We deliver cutting\-edge, reliable, and user\-friendly infrastructure for data ingestion, storage, processing, interaction, and machine learning model lifecycle management. Our teams provide a fully managed Lakehouse solution powered by Snowflake and Apache Flink, custom AI/ML model\-serving platforms, a Service and Data Catalog, and various custom\-built services to manage data and models at massive scale. We support key products and organizations across SailPoint, including Identity Security Cloud, Non\-Employee Risk Management, Machine Identity Security, Agent Identity Security, Data Access Security, and Cloud Infrastructure and Entitlement Management.
   

  





**Responsibilities** 
  :
 



**Team Leadership:** 
  
 


* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers specializing in Flink, Spark, Snowflake, Iceberg, Airflow and related technologies
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement inline with SailPoint’s 4\-Is cultural framework
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, promoting their professional growth
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and identify opportunities for training and development
* Manage team workload, prioritize projects, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions



**Technical Strategy and Execution:** 
  
 


* Define and execute the technical roadmap for our data platform, aligning with SailPoint's overall data strategy
* Drive innovation in data processing techniques, exploring new technologies and approaches to improve performance, scalability, and efficiency
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of robust and scalable data pipelines using Flink / Spark, dbt, Airflow and Snowflake / Iceberg
* Ensure the reliability, availability, and security of our data processing infrastructure
* Collaborate with other engineering teams to integrate our data processing technologies with other SailPoint systems and services



**Stakeholder Management:** 
  
 


* Partner with data scientists, data engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand their data processing needs and requirements
* Communicate technical concepts and solutions effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Advocate for best practices in data processing and engineering; Manage expectations and ensure alignment across different teams



**Engineering Thought Leadership:** 
  
 


* Know and evangelize what excellence looks like when it comes to high volume data processing
* Represent SailPoint data platform innovations at external conferences
* Deliver presentations and write blog posts highlighting SailPoint’s leadership in big data processing



**Minimum Qualifications** 
  
 


* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 12\+ years of software development experience, with a focus on data processing or machine learning systems at scale
* 8\+ years of engineering people management experience—leading, mentoring, and growing teams, with 3\+ years of experience managing engineering managers
* Deep expertise in open\-source data technologies like Apache Flink, Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, and OpenSearch
* Hands\-on experience with data processing and AI languages such as Java / Scala and Python
* Deep understanding of data pipeline and ML system performance, including partitioning, parallelism, serialization, scaling, and storage formats
* Strong knowledge of modern infrastructure including containers, orchestration, cloud computing (AWS / GCP / Azure), information retrieval, and distributed systems
* Experience supporting high\-volume, low\-latency systems in highly regulated environments
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field of study



**What Success Looks Like in the Role**




**Within the first 30 days you will:** 




 Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your test and development environment. Go through the product specific trainings to understand the product features. Work with the buddy to understand specific team processes.
   

  





**By 90 days:** 




 Get deeper understanding of the specific functional area that you are part of. Seek to deeply understand business problems. Proactively collaborate on, discuss, debate and refine ideas, problem statements with different (sometimes many) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, and other stakeholders to define test requirements, resolve issues, and ensure proper integration of testing processes.
   

  





**By 6 months:** 




 Occasionally serve as a debugging expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner. Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to produce a prioritized team roadmap.
   

  





**By 1 year:** 




 Scale the enterprise data platform architecture to support a 50% increase in data ingestion volume while maintaining strict low\-latency standards.
 



 Establish SailPoint's big data engineering thought leadership by presenting at an external industry conference or publishing a technical blog post detailing our data platform innovations.
 



 Successfully execute the annual strategic technical roadmap, aligning data platform capabilities with SailPoint's long\-term business goals.
   

  





**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:** 
  
   

  





 Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting\-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever\-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.  
   

  





 Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2\-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified).
   

  





 We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:  
 


* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health\-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* Private equity at certain levels

title: Lead Data Architect
description:
**About Calfus:** 









 At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting\-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start\-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high\-impact tasks. None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we're actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in\-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.
 



  





 As one of the fastest\-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high\-energy, driven individuals.
 



  





 To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!
 



  





**About the role:** 




 As a Senior Data Architect, you will lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise\-grade data architectures that serve as the foundation for organizational analytics and AI\-driven decision\-making. You will architect cloud\-native data platforms using modern medallion architectures, design semantic data models, and establish data governance frameworks that scale across complex enterprise ecosystems. This is a highly technical, hands\-on leadership role that demands deep expertise in data modeling, cloud platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure), and the ability to mentor engineering teams while driving strategic data architecture initiatives.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




**Data Architecture \& Modeling:** 



* Architect enterprise data platforms using medallion (bronze\-silver\-gold) layering strategies for scalable, maintainable analytics ecosystems.
* Design and implement semantic data models that enable self\-service analytics, reduce complexity, and improve business alignment.
* Lead dimensional, relational, and analytical schema design for complex multi\-source data environments.
* Own foundational data architecture strategies that balance performance, scalability, cost, and usability.



  





**Cloud Data Platform Engineering:** 



* Design and implement cloud\-native data architectures on Snowflake, Databricks, or Azure cloud ecosystems.
* Architect ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks for high\-volume, multi\-source enterprise data ecosystems.
* Establish reusable data frameworks, platform abstractions, and architectural best practices to drive long\-term scalability.
* Lead performance tuning, cost optimization, and capacity planning across cloud data platforms.



  





**Data Modeling \& Governance:** 



* Design and govern metadata, data catalogs, and semantic layers to enable discoverability and trustworthiness.
* Implement comprehensive data quality frameworks, validations, and observability practices.
* Establish data governance policies, lineage tracking, and compliance standards across the platform.



  





**Technical Hands\-On Leadership:** 



* Write complex SQL, Python, and data transformation code alongside your team—not just provide direction.
* Lead greenfield data architecture initiatives from conceptualization through production deployment.
* Design and optimize database schemas, indexing strategies, and query execution plans for analytical workloads.
* Mentor and develop junior data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.



  





**Stakeholder \& Client Collaboration:** 



* Partner with BI teams to enable semantic modeling and self\-service analytics on Power BI or Tableau.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable data architecture solutions.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives and communicate technical architecture decisions to executive stakeholders.
* Support data visualization teams with optimized data structures and APIs for reporting and dashboarding.



  





**On your first day, we'll expect you to have:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* **8–12 years of hands\-on experience designing and architecting enterprise data solutions** 
 , with deep expertise in:
* Data warehouse and lakehouse architecture design
* Medallion architecture implementation (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers)
* Semantic data modeling and dimensional design
* Cloud\-native data platform development
* Proven track record of owning large\-scale data architecture initiatives from inception through production deployment.
* **Expert\-level proficiency with Snowflake or Databricks** 
 —candidates with expertise in both will be strongly preferred.
* Advanced SQL expertise with experience across modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Redshift).
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data tools (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, cloud object storage).
* Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, data manipulation, and framework development.
* Deep understanding of data serialization formats (Parquet, JSON, CSV, Delta Lake formats).
* Demonstrated ability to design scalable data platforms that handle complex enterprise analytics at petabyte scale.
* Leadership experience mentoring data engineering teams or leading technical workstreams.



  





**We'd be super excited if you have:** 



* Snowflake or Databricks architect certifications
* Experience designing and implementing semantic layers (e.g., dbt, Semantic Layer frameworks)
* Azure SDK or cloud\-native development experience
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, data integration patterns, and ETL orchestration tools
* Prior experience architecting data solutions for AI/ML pipelines
* Exposure to data governance and metadata management tools
* Experience with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure\-as\-code for data platforms



  





**Please note:** 
 This role is heavily focused on data architecture, semantic modeling, platform engineering, and strategic data platform development. Candidates whose experience is primarily centered around BI tool development, maintenance of existing warehouses, or routine data operations may not be the best fit. We're looking for architects who design and build platforms from the ground up.
 



  





**Benefits:** 




 At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.
 



 Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
 



 We believe diversity drives innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone—regardless of background, identity, or experience—has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Lead to join our Corporate Finance Technology (CFT) team. This role is responsible for providing first\-line functional support for Oracle Fusion cloud ERP application, managing stakeholder expectations, and supervising a team of support analysts. The ideal candidate will possess strong domain knowledge, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to lead and coordinate support operations effectively.
   

  

 As a Lead in Oracle Fusion Support, your responsibilities will include:
   

  

**Functional Support \& Issue Resolution**
* Provide expert\-level support across Oracle Finance Cloud modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Cash Management, Transaction Tax, Intercompany, and BPM Approvals.
* Understanding of self\-service procurement, approval workflows, Contract module, RFQ, receipt processing, Supplier management, etc will be an added advantage
* Troubleshoot complex issues across the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Record to Report (R2R) lifecycle.
* Good to have technical understanding of BIP, OTBI, OIC, VBCS, etc
* Analyse and resolve ServiceNow tickets, adhering to SLAs.
* Address functional issues through configuration changes and educating users on tool capabilities.
* Support version upgrades and lead service reviews with vendor.


**Business Engagement and Change Process**
* Support the end user training sessions on Oracle Fusion new processes and functions.
* Promote awareness of audit and compliance principles in daily operations of the team.
* Evaluate new requirements by coordinating with business stakeholders and manage and co\-ordinate the implementation lifecycle.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business users regarding Oracle Fusion\-related queries and issues.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely updates on issue resolution.
* Participate in change management discussions and impact assessments for new business requirements.


**Team Leadership \& Supervision**
* Allocate and supervise work across team members, ensuring balanced workloads and timely resolution of support tickets.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance team culture.
* Monitor team performance against SLAs and drive continuous improvement in support processes.


 This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a high\-performing support team, work on mission\-critical financial systems, and engage with stakeholders across the enterprise. If you are passionate about Oracle Fusion, enjoy solving complex functional challenges, and thrive in a leadership role, we invite you to be part of our transformation journey.
   

  

**Key Stakeholder Management**
**Internal**
* UK Finance Accounting
* UK Finance Actuarial
* UK Corporate Functions technology


**External**
* Software Suppliers
* External Consultants


**Knowledge, Skills, Experience \& Educational Qualification**
**Required Knowledge \& Skills**
* Expertise in Oracle Fusion: In\-depth understanding of Oracle Fusion Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Record\-to\-Report (R2R) processes.
* ERP Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in Finance ERP application support, maintenance, or implementation.
* Configuration Proficiency: Strong practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion configurations.


**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills**
* Team Leadership: Proven experience in managing teams, including task allocation and performance supervision.
* Domain Exposure: Background in captive organizations within the banking, insurance, or financial services sectors.
* Innovation \& Technology: Exposure to AI enablement within Oracle Fusion modules.
* Stakeholder Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree: In any discipline, preferably in Finance or IT.
* Postgraduate Qualification: Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent certifications.
* Professional Certifications:
+ Oracle certifications in P2P or R2R modules.
+ Additional credentials such as CBAP, PMP, or certifications in Business Transformation or Finance Functional domains are a plus.


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

**So, what’s the role all about?**
 The Professional Services Engineer is a customer\-facing, billable role responsible for delivering specialized expertise and solutions for NiCE products and services. This includes implementing, configuring, and optimizing AI\-driven applications, such as Co\-pilot, knowledge assistants, and other CXone digital solutions, for enterprise contact centers. The position combines technical and business responsibilities, requiring engagement with clients to understand their needs, Implement, provide consultative support, and deliver cutting\-edge solutions.
   

  

**How will you make an impact?**
- Technical Implementation:

- Implement \& provide technical consulting around areas such as AI ,NLU,CRM integrations, API’s, ACD, IVR, ASR and other contact center features and applications.

- Provide technical configuration and, in some cases, light programming as required (JavaScript, HTML/CSS for UI tweaks).

- Provide development, and enhancement, as well as management and coordination of changes to existing applications

- Understand Structuring knowledge repositories hierarchies, categorization, and knowledge mapping for intuitive navigation

- Understand SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and LDAP/Kerberos; experienced with IAM platforms like Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, and OneLogin.

- Project Management:

* Collaborate with Project Managers to design and oversee end\-to\-end project rollouts.
* At times act as the Project Manager for your own project.
* Manage system lifecycle development, change control processes, and risk analysis for enterprise solutions.
* Ensure seamless project execution through inter\-departmental coordination and clear communication.


- Business Consulting:

* Provide subject matter expertise on NiCE CXone digital products and AI solutions during client consultations.
* Conduct business analysis to assess user needs, design tailored solutions and provide industry guidance.
* Regular interaction with client teams to understand pain points, present solutions, and align on progress
* Promote the use of AI tools to enhance decision\-making and operational efficiency across business units.
* Leadership and Customer Handling:
* Once trained, mentor and lead project teams, sharing expertise and fostering a collaborative environment.
* Develop documentation and processes for emerging digital products from R\&D teams.
* Regularly interact with client teams to understand needs, address pain points, and align on deliverables.
* Work closely with SMEs, admins, and business leads; share updates and drive KM adoption.
* Translate technical concepts into business terms; manage expectations and clarify scope.


**Have you got what it takes?**
* Bachelor’s degree in technical (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering) or business field (e.g., Marketing, MIS) or equivalent work experience.
* 2\+ years of professional experience, with 1\+ years in digital channels or AI software applications preferred.
* Proven expertise in:
+ Technical configuration and if required programming of AI and contact center technologies.
+ CRM integrations, APIs, and other ecosystem technologies.
+ Best practices for contact center operations and KPIs.

* Familiarity with:
+ Generative AI models, NLU techniques, and automation principles.
+ Industry trends and emerging technologies in AI and digital customer engagement.

* Desired personal traits:
+ Analytical and inquisitive mindset.
+ Team\-oriented with strong interpersonal skills.
+ Early adopter of innovative technologies.
+ Strong sense of accountability and ownership.
+ Professional communication, behavior and demeanor.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
   

  

**Enjoy NiCE\-FLEX!**
 At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
   

  

**Requisition ID: 11476
   

  

 Reporting into:** 
 Tech Manager
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor
   

  

**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

description:
**Job Summary** 









 We are seeking a Firmware Engineer to support the design, development, and implementation of embedded firmware for inflight entertainment (IFE) audio systems and peripherals on commercial aircraft.
 



  





 This role is highly hands\-on and will focus on low\-level embedded development, real\-time system behavior, and integration with audio, control, and communication interfaces. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in embedded C/C\+\+, microcontroller\-based systems, and hardware bring\-up.
 



  





 You will work closely with electrical, acoustic, and mechanical teams. You will also interface with external manufacturing partners, to develop robust, production\-ready firmware from concept through deployment.
 



  





**Location** 




 Pune, India – Occasional travel may be required.
 



  





**Summary of Role Responsibilities** 








* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for microcontroller\-based systems
* Develop IC drivers and HAL API for low\-level interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, etc.)
* Implement real\-time control and communication systems
* Support audio\-related firmware features including codec interfacing, DSP integration, and control logic
* Bring up new hardware platforms and support board\-level debugging
* Work closely with hardware teams to validate schematics, PCB layouts, and system architecture
* Develop and maintain firmware architecture, documentation, and coding standards
* Debug and resolve system\-level issues across hardware and firmware boundaries
* Develop test tools and scripts to support validation and production testing
* Support integration with higher\-level systems and external interfaces

* Provide ongoing support to manufacturing to troubleshoot firmware\-related production issues and improve reliability and yield
* Generate technical documentation including requirements, specifications, and test reports
* Support qualification documentation and testing including environmental and EMI/EMC testing
* Undertake code reviews for merges, updates, fixes developed by other team members
* Manage source control, artifact versioning and configuration of both in\-development and production firmware
* Work with technical staff from third\-party vendors to develop drivers, test SDKs, and implement APIs for ICs



  





**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 








* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Minimum five (5\) years of relevant industry experience
* Strong experience in embedded C/C\+\+ development
* Experience working with microcontrollers (e.g., STM32 or similar)
* Experience with hardware interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, ADC, etc.)
* Experience with debugging tools (JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers)
* Familiarity with real\-time systems and embedded architectures
* Ability to read schematics and work closely with hardware teams
* Ability to do basic electronics calculations (work with voltages, currents and basic electronic components)
* Hands\-on, self\-motivated, and able to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with internal teams and external manufacturing partners



  





**Desired Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 








* Experience with audio systems, codecs, and digital audio interfaces (I2S, PDM, TDM)
* Familiarity with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) or bare\-metal development
* Experience with USB , ethernet or other communication systems in an embedded context
* Experience with bootloaders, firmware update mechanisms, and version control
* Familiarity with Python or scripting for test and automation
* Experience with DSP concepts or integration with audio processing pipelines
* Knowledge of aerospace standards such as DO\-254, DO\-178, or DO\-160
* Experience with EMI/EMC and environmental testing
* Product development experience from concept through production



  





**Educational Requirements** 




  




* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field



  





**Supervisory Responsibilities** 




  




* None



  





**Physical Requirements** 




 Must be able to remain in a stationary position for the majority of the workday. Must be able to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc. Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery (i.e., a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer). Must be able to communicate with other intra\-company personnel. May be exposed to manufacturing conditions. Must hold drivers license.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
**Role – CHANNEL SALES HEAD** 




**Company:** 
 Joy N Crew Vacations LLP
 



**Location:** 
 Pune \| Work from Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Preferred Experience:** 
 8–12 years in Travel \& Tourism, including at least 3 years managing channel sales or B2B sales teams
 



**Industry:** 
 Travel \& Tourism experience is mandatory
 



**Compensation: Up to** 
**9 LPA** 




**Role Overview** 




 Joy N Crew Vacations LLP is looking for an experienced
 **Channel Sales Head** 
 to build, expand, and manage its travel agent and distribution partner network.
 



 The position will own revenue growth through travel agents, tour operators, travel consultants, and other approved business partners. The ideal candidate will bring strong travel trade relationships, proven partner acquisition skills, and experience converting a channel network into consistent, profitable bookings.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Channel Strategy and Business Growth** 



* Develop and execute the channel sales strategy for domestic and international holiday products.
* Set monthly, quarterly, and annual targets for channel revenue, profitability, partner acquisition, and activation.
* Identify priority markets and territories based on travel demand and business potential.
* Build a balanced partner portfolio to reduce dependence on a small number of agents.
* Develop territory\-wise growth plans and review performance with management.



**2\. Travel Agent and Partner Acquisition** 



* Identify, approach, and onboard travel agents, tour operators, independent travel consultants, and relevant distribution partners.
* Build relationships with agency owners and key decision\-makers.
* Evaluate prospective partners for market reach, customer profile, business potential, and commercial suitability.
* Coordinate partner documentation, agreements, and onboarding with the relevant internal teams.
* Maintain a qualified pipeline of prospective partners and ensure timely follow\-up.



**3\. Partner Activation and Relationship Management** 



* Convert newly onboarded partners into active booking partners through structured engagement.
* Conduct regular partner meetings, product presentations, and business reviews.
* Communicate package updates, group departure schedules, availability, and promotional offers.
* Identify reasons for partner inactivity and execute reactivation plans.
* Strengthen retention through responsive service, transparent communication, and reliable booking support.



**4\. Channel Revenue and Commercial Management** 



* Own sales targets and gross margins generated through the partner network.
* Coordinate approved partner pricing, commissions, incentives, and commercial terms.
* Maintain discount discipline and ensure special commitments receive appropriate approval.
* Monitor partner payment schedules and coordinate outstanding collections with Finance.
* Ensure credit arrangements remain within approved terms and limits.
* Track booking cancellations and commercial disputes, coordinating timely resolution.



**5\. Product Promotion and Trade Engagement** 



* Work with Products and Operations to create competitive, saleable travel offerings for the channel.
* Equip partners with accurate itineraries, quotations, sales material, inclusions, exclusions, and booking conditions.
* Organise partner training sessions, webinars, destination presentations, and sales meetings.
* Represent the company at relevant travel trade events, exhibitions, and networking forums.
* Share market intelligence on competitor pricing, destination trends, and partner requirements.
* Recommend joint promotions based on expected business returns.



**6\. Team Leadership and Sales Discipline** 



* Lead and develop the channel sales and B2B business development team.
* Assign territories, partner portfolios, and individual targets.
* Establish clear expectations for partner visits, acquisition, activation, follow\-ups, and bookings.
* Coach team members on travel trade selling, negotiation, and relationship management.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and address gaps through focused action plans.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of channel sales team members.



**7\. Booking Coordination and Partner Experience** 



* Establish clear ownership for partner enquiries, quotations, booking confirmations, and escalations.
* Work closely with Operations, Ticketing, Visa, CRM, and Finance to support smooth execution.
* Ensure commitments made to partners match confirmed availability and service capabilities.
* Resolve channel conflicts, account ownership issues, and pricing concerns within company guidelines.
* Use partner feedback to improve response times, booking processes, and service quality.



**8\. Reporting and Sales Analytics** 



* Maintain accurate partner records, opportunities, and follow\-ups in the CRM.
* Track partner productivity, repeat bookings, territory performance, and sales pipeline.
* Present sales forecasts, commercial risks, and growth opportunities to management.
* Distinguish between registered partners and active, revenue\-generating partners when reporting network growth.



**Candidate Requirements** 




**Mandatory** 



* Relevant channel sales or B2B sales experience within Travel \& Tourism.
* Proven experience building and managing a productive travel agent or tour operator network.
* Strong understanding of domestic and international holiday packages, customised travel, and group departures.
* Demonstrated achievement of channel revenue and partner development targets.
* Experience managing a sales team and reviewing territory\-wise performance.
* Knowledge of travel trade pricing, commissions, margins, payment terms, and booking processes.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, relationship management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, Excel, and sales reporting.
* Willingness to work from Pune and travel regularly for partner meetings and business development.



**Preferred** 



* Established travel trade relationships in Maharashtra and other relevant Indian markets.
* Experience expanding into new territories and activating underperforming partner networks.
* Experience selling outbound holidays and fixed group departures through agents.
* Graduate qualification; an MBA or qualification in Travel \& Tourism will be an advantage.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Channel revenue and gross margin achievement.
* Number of qualified partners onboarded.
* Partner activation rate and time to first booking.
* Number of active, revenue\-generating partners.
* Revenue and booking productivity per active partner.
* Repeat business and partner retention.
* Territory\-wise growth and pipeline conversion.
* Collection performance and overdue outstanding amounts.
* Team target achievement.
* Partner enquiry response and escalation resolution times.



**First 90\-Day Priorities** 



* Review the existing partner network, channel revenue, and territory potential.
* Prepare a territory\-wise acquisition and activation plan.
* Implement partner segmentation, CRM discipline, and regular business reviews.
* Launch focused onboarding, training, and reactivation initiatives.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline and deliver against agreed initial targets.



**How to Apply** 




 Share your updated CV with:
 


* Total and relevant Travel \& Tourism experience.
* Current company and designation.
* Territories and partner networks managed.
* Number of active partners handled.
* Team size managed.
* Recent channel sales targets and achievements.
* Current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.
* Current location and willingness to work from Pune.



**Only candidates with relevant Travel \& Tourism channel sales experience will be considered.**

description:

 A brand \& growth consultancy aimed at helping consumer brands with promise to meet their growth potential \& the right consumers, with an ROI\-first mindset. We are advisors, friends, idea boards and guides to the brands we work with.

 World peace, and weather that’s always perfect. Oh and, also, a rockstar teammate!

 1 – Research, research, reference, reference. Immerse yourself in industry, category, consumer, competitors and culture. Be the voice of the consumer and bring insights, refs, trends and ideas to the table.
 



 2 – Help build the brand. Collaborate on brand strategy, positioning, identity, tone of voice and content systems, and work with design teams to bring them to life.
 



 3 – Own content end\-to\-end. Develop and manage content across social, ads, website, email and other consumer touchpoints \- from ideation and copy through to execution and publishing.
 



 4 – Own social. Build content calendars, spot trends and opportunities, develop social\-first content, manage community and keep the brand culturally relevant.
 



 5 – Be hands\-on with making. Be comfortable shooting, editing, Canva\-ing, working with creators/UGC and generally figuring out how to turn an idea into an asset without needing a village every time.
 



 6 – Bring the same energy to The Build Inc. Support our consulting work through consumer research, references, brand thinking, content and creative ideas, pitches and generally being a strong idea \+ problem\-solving partner.
 



  





*Education, experience \& aptitude* 




 1 – 1\-2 years working in fields related to consumer goods and / or communications (ideally
 *and* 
 )
 



 2 – If you’re a fresher, we’re open but would really be looking for some extra enthu
 



 3 – Super super exceptional communication skills – both verbal and visual
 



 4 – Creativity, out of the box thinking and an ability to problem solve independently
 



 5 – Like people and be able to work well with them – both internally \& externally
 



 6 – A general openness to learning new skills and trying things outside your comfort zone
 



 7 – Ideally, know your way around excel, word, powerpoint, canva et al
 



 8 – Basic video shooting / editing skills — reels\-style content especially, to enable end\-to\-end ownership
 



 9 – Comfort with AI for image / video generation and smart speed enablement
 



  





**What you should be prepared for** 




*Pivots:* 
 In a business that’s only a little more than a year old, expect for things to evolve. This could be your role, the business model, or the kind of clients we work with. As long as we keep communication open and flowing in both directions, we don’t see this to be a problem!
 



  





*Genuine effort:* 
 We’re not people that do things halfway, and a lack of sincerity is a pet peeve. If you’re in, be all in and do your best at any task you take up. It’s cool if you don’t know how to do something but give it a go and the rest, we’ll figure out together.
 



  





*Multi\-hatting:* 
 You’ll be expected to don different hats depending on the day and task at hand. Do not expect to have a unidimensional POV on everything you do here. The plus side? Well\-rounded learning, at a pretty fast pace! We’re a small team so if you’re interested in doing more things and doing them differently, we’re interested in having you do them too.
 



  






 The office is based in Vikhroli. The position will be hybrid and flexible WFH, but we’d want to see each other at least 2\-3 times a week, if not more. Expect some amount of intra\-city travel for shoots, events, vendor visits et al, in addition to meeting in office.

title: Senior Cloud HPC Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
The Opportunity: Can You Build and Command a Cloud Supercomputer?
   

  

 Want to run one of the largest high\-performance computing grids in the financial industry? Are you driven by the challenge of orchestrating trillions of calculations across thousands of cloud cores to price the firm's entire trading book in minutes, not ours? Do you want to build the massive\-scale "valuation engine" that powers Citi's next\-generation risk platform?
   

  

 Citi is seeking a visionary Cloud HPC Engineer to lead the development and operation of our global pricing grid. This is the engine room of our risk system. You will be responsible for deploying, scaling, and optimizing the computational factory that runs our most complex pricing models at an unprecedented scale on public cloud platforms like AWS and GCP.
   

  

 Your Role and Impact:
   

  

 As the lead for the Pricing Engine, you are the master of massive\-scale computation. You will take the sophisticated pricing models developed by our top quants and operationalize them on a colossal grid. Your primary mission is to ensure that millions of trades can be re\-valued against thousands of historical market scenarios with extreme speed, efficiency, and rock\-solid stability.
   

  

 Your impact is at the core of our risk valuation capability. You will architect the system that answers the most fundamental question in risk: "What is it worth, right now, under this scenario?" The performance and reliability of the platform you build will directly determine the firm's ability to manage risk and meet its most critical regulatory obligations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Architect, build, and manage a massive\-scale, distributed compute grid on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) for running financial pricing models.
* Design and implement the orchestration layer responsible for distributing millions of pricing tasks efficiently across hundreds of thousands of CPU/GPU cores.
* Deploy, manage, and version control a diverse library of quantitative pricing models, ensuring they run optimally in a distributed environment.
* Obsessively monitor and optimize the performance, cost, and resource utilization of the cloud grid, driving continuous efficiency improvements.
* Collaborate with quantitative development teams to seamlessly integrate new and updated pricing models into the production grid.
* Engineer the data logistics to ensure that the correct market data, trade data, and model configurations are available for every calculation at runtime.
* Ensure the pricing engine is highly available, resilient, and capable of meeting stringent recovery time objectives.


 What We're Looking For:
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional experience with a proven track record of designing, building, and running applications on massive\-scale compute grids.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud provider (AWS or GCP), including their batch processing, container, and serverless offerings.
* Deep expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong programming skills in languages common to high\-performance computing, such as C\+\+ and Python.
* Prior experience in a similar role within the financial industry (e.g., running large\-scale Monte Carlo simulations, VaR calculations, or XVA pricing grids) is highly desirable.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* A strong background in distributed systems, performance tuning, and infrastructure\-as\-code principles.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues in a high\-pressure, large\-scale environment.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with quantitative research, trading, and risk management teams.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
