**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 12 to 20 years (5\+ years in People Management / Engineering Leadership)
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Enterprise B2B SaaS / Global Commerce / Supply Chain Technology
   

  

**Seniority** 
 : Mid to Senior
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global B2B SaaS company powering commerce for brands, retailers, logistics companies and enterprises. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Order Experience Management (OXM) platform Engineering. This role requires a blend of Node.js, Java and AWS expertise,
 **AI\-led engineering practices** 
 , and a sharp focus on system reliability, security, and cost.
   

  

 Anchanto OXM is a mission\-critical e\-commerce operations platform, not a peripheral or support system. Our customers rely on it to realize 100% of their revenue on a daily basis. The platform is used by 300\+ customers brands, retailers, and logistics providers, processes 150M\+ orders annually, and serves thousands of users across operations teams in 12 countries including France, UK, Singapore, Malaysia and UAE. Core functionality includes order orchestration, inventory visibility, marketplace and D2C integrations, fulfilment workflows, and real\-time operational insights.
   

  

**What Will Your Day Look Like?**
* Drive AI\-led engineering execution: Identify opportunities to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging using tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Cursor; set adoption targets and measure impact on productivity.
* Evolve event\-driven, distributed system architectures: Ensure scalability, fault tolerance, and multi\-tenant isolation across AWS (SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis).
* Balance feature delivery, system performance, security, and compute and storage related hyper\-scaler costs.
* Monitor SLOs, latency, and system health; lead incident response and Root Cause Analysis to eliminate recurring issues.
* Grow people: Mentor engineers and tech leads, run 1:1s, drive performance reviews, build career ladders, and retain top talent. You will conduct technical interviews, calibrate levelling, and build a strong engineering bench.
* Partner across business units and countries: Work with Product, Customer Success, and Leadership to translate requirements into scalable systems and measurable outcomes for customers and partners across ecosystem.
* Raise the bar on engineering productivity, DORA metrics, and team execution discipline.
* On day\-to\-day technical execution, while owning overall engineering outcomes.


**Skills And Experience Needed For This Job**
* Strong hands\-on experience: In Node.js backend systems at scale, with a solid grasp of asynchronous processing and high\-throughput architectures.
* Experience building: Distributed, event\-driven systems on AWS, ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Event Bridge, Aurora/PostgreSQL, S3, API Gateway, Redis/Elastic\-Cache, CloudWatch.
* System design depth: Scale multi\-tenant architecture, idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure handling.
* Track record: Designing and operating systems with high availability (99\.9%\+) and low latency (sub\-200ms P95\).
* Observability and reliability engineering: Metrics, logs, traces (Open Telemetry/Datadog), SLO/SLI, incident management, on\-call discipline.
* CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code: GitHub Actions / CodePipeline, Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Testing discipline: J\-unit tests, integration, contract, and load testing as part of the engineering bar.
* Proven track record: Improving engineering productivity, DORA metrics, and execution discipline.


 How you will build at Anchanto
   

  

* This role sets the tempo for how Anchanto builds. You will define what "good" looks like in an AI\-native engineering org, set the standards the team operates by, and make Anchanto one of the fastest\-building engineering teams in enterprise SaaS.
* You will make Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot the default toolkit across the SDLC, drive adoption, set productivity expectations, and track measurable gains in cycle time, throughput, and code quality.
* You will move the team from ticket\-driven to spec\-driven work, so AI produces the first draft of code, tests, and docs. Engineers, tech leads, and architects then focus on what compounds value: system design, scalability, security, and technical judgment.
* Every hour AI gives back will flow into new functionality, incremental innovation, and faster time\-to\-market, translating productivity gains directly into shipped capabilities that widen Anchanto's lead with enterprise customers.
* You will ship AI\-powered capabilities inside OXM, including intelligent order routing, anomaly detection, demand forecasting, conversational operations, and agentic workflows, at the reliability, security, and cost standards our enterprise customers require.
* Experience operating enterprise systems under SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls, with awareness of GDPR, PII handling, and regional data residency (critical for 12\-country operations).
* Familiarity with secure SDLC practices threat modelling, SAST/DAST, dependency and secret scanning, OWASP Top 10\.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

- Reliability: ≥ 99\.9% uptime for owned services.

 Performance: \< 200ms P95 latency for critical APIs.
 - Predictability: ≥ 85–90% release predictability (planned vs actual).

- Quality: reduction in P1/P2 incidents and MTTR; improving DORA metrics quarter over quarter.

- Scale: systems scaling to high order volumes across multiple regions without cost blowouts.

- People: strong engagement, low regrettable attrition, and a visible growth path for engineers.

 Leadership \& Ownership traits you must have
   

  

* Own delivery, quality, reliability, and cost of assigned product areas end\-to\-end.
* Build and manage teams of 10–20 engineers; drive hiring, onboarding, performance, and retention.
* Mentor engineers and tech leads; build career ladders and a strong internal bench.
* Maintain accountability and ownership within the team; make technical trade\-off calls.
* Partner with Product, Customer Success, and senior stakeholders on roadmap execution.


 Behaviours / Personal Qualities
   

  

* Outcome Ownership: owns delivery, quality, and production outcomes end\-to\-end; ensures results are achieved.
* High Accountability: takes responsibility for failures and drives closure with clear actions, owners, and timelines.
* Execution Discipline: maintains follow\-through on commitments; tracks planned vs actual and corrects deviations early.
* Systems Thinking: considers scale, failure scenarios, dependencies, and impact on performance, reliability, and cost.
* Raising the Bar: sets high standards for code, design, and team performance; actively improves team capability.

description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know our Team:**
 The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front\-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post\-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end\-to\-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go\-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.
   

  

 The Impact You’ll Make
   

  

* Lead full\-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross\-platform environments.
* Own complex end\-to\-end systems: Take responsibility for building, integrating, and maintaining both frontend and backend components, including the critical Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer.
* Mentor and guide high\-performing teams: Provide technical leadership, drive engineering excellence, and support the growth of your peers.
* Drive technical decisions: Influence architecture and best practices across multiple squads, ensuring scalable, reliable, and high\-quality solutions.
* Collaborate with Product and Design: Work closely with cross\-functional partners to deliver cohesive, user\-centered features and experiments that directly impact business outcomes.

* Proven experience leading end\-to\-end architecture on high\-traffic, high\-availability platforms, ideally with exposure to cross\-platform or migration projects (e.g., native to WebView).
* BFF (Backend for Frontend) experience is a must: You have designed, built, or maintained BFF layers (language flexible—C\#, Kotlin, Java, etc.) that bridge frontend and backend systems.
* Track record of technical mentorship, cross\-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong API and middleware skills: Ability to design and implement APIs and backend services tailored for frontend needs.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Scala or other JVM languages.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, and modern DevOps practices.
* Prior work on large\-scale migration or cross\-platform initiatives.
* Android and/or iOS native development experience

**Women's Hormonal Health**

  Full\-time
 



  





**About Us** 
  Nutritionist Misha Services is a women's hormonal health coaching brand helping women manage PCOS naturally through our No\-Pill PCOS Reversal Method. Every client is supported by a multi\-specialist team (dietitian, doctor, yoga coach, mental health coach, and accountability coach), always working alongside their doctor, never instead of them.

  PCOS affects far more than the body. Many of our clients deal with stress, low confidence, body image concerns, emotional eating, and frustration after years of trying to feel better. * Conduct one\-on\-one and group video coaching sessions with programme clients

* Guide clients through practical tools such as journaling, mindfulness, habit\-building, and stress\-management techniques
* Work closely with our dietitians, doctor, yoga coach, and accountability coaches to support each client holistically
* Track client progress and maintain session notes and records on time
* Recognise when a client needs clinical support and refer them to a qualified therapist or psychiatrist
* Contribute to workshops, content, and resources on mental wellbeing and PCOS



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or a related field
* 0–2 years of experience in counselling, coaching, or mental wellness support (freshers with relevant internships are welcome)
* A warm, non\-judgemental approach and excellent listening skills
* Clear understanding of the boundary between coaching and clinical therapy
* Strong commitment to client confidentiality and ethical practice
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi
* A laptop with a working webcam, a quiet private workspace, and a stable internet connection



  





**What We Offer** 



* Salary: ₹15,000/month
* Fully remote work
* Hands\-on experience in a collaborative, multi\-specialist women's health team
* Opportunity to make a real difference in women's health and wellbeing
* Growth opportunities as the brand expands

title: Hospital Appointment Setter
description:
**Position Title:** 
 Hospital Founder Appointment Setter
 **(IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY)** 




**Department:** 
 Business Development
 



**Work Mode:** 
 On\-Field
 



**Reporting To:** 
 BDE
 



**Monthly Target:** 
 100 Qualified Appointments
 



**Role Objective** 
 The Hospital Founder Appointment Setter is responsible for prospecting, approaching, and securing qualified meetings with C\-suite healthcare leadership—including Hospital Founders, Owners, Directors, CEOs, and MDs. This on\-field role focuses exclusively on building initial rapport, securing meeting commitments, and coordinating a smooth handover to the Business Development Executive (BDE).
 



**Compensation \& Incentives** 



* **Base Salary:** 
 ₹30,000 / month
* **Performance Incentives:** 
 Tiered cash bonuses based directly on verified qualified appointments and completed BDE handovers.
* **Total Earning Potential:** 
 Strong performers who exceed meeting targets can significantly boost their monthly compensation through performance payouts by an additional
 
 ₹
 
 10000/month.



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Hospital Prospecting:** 
 Conduct active field visits to hospitals across assigned territories to map decision\-makers.
* **Appointment Scheduling:** 
 Pitch VAIFX at an introductory level, identify basic needs, and lock in meeting dates aligned with BDE schedules.
* **On\-Site Coordination:** 
 Accompany the BDE to scheduled meetings, introduce the BDE to hospital leaders, and brief both parties to initiate discussion.
* **Field Target Management:** 
 Maintain an active daily outreach log to meet individual monthly volume and quality metrics.



**Step\-by\-Step Daily Workflow** 



1. Identify target hospitals within the assigned territory.
2. Conduct on\-field hospital visits.
3. Establish contact with Founders, Owners, Directors, or MDs.
4. Introduce VAIFX and gauge interest/requirements.
5. Secure a confirmed appointment slot.
6. Confirm schedule details with the assigned BDE.
7. Arrive at the hospital alongside the BDE on the appointment date.
8. Introduce the BDE to the decision\-maker and set context.
9. Ensure the meeting starts smoothly (Handover complete).



**What Defines a Qualified Appointment?** 




 An appointment counts toward monthly KPIs when:
 


* Scheduled directly with an authorized senior management decision\-maker.
* The hospital shows genuine marketing or business development potential.
* Date, time, and location are confirmed and communicated to the BDE in advance.
* The Setter is physically present to facilitate the in\-person BDE introduction.



**Sales Boundaries (Zero Closing Required)** 
 Your responsibility ends once the meeting begins and the BDE takes over. You are
 **not** 
 responsible for sales closing. The BDE manages:
 


* Detailed solutions presentations
* Requirement analyses \& custom proposals
* Commercial pricing \& contract negotiations
* Lead follow\-ups \& final agreement execution



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* **Monthly Benchmark:** 
 100 Qualified Appointments / month.
* **Weekly Benchmark:** 
 \~25 Qualified Appointments / week.
* **Daily Benchmark:** 
 \~4–5 Qualified Appointments / day.
* *Focus:* 
 High decision\-maker quality and meeting show\-rates take priority over sheer volume.



**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications** 



* Strong interpersonal, pitch, and convincing skills.
* Highly presentable with confidence engaging C\-level healthcare executives.
* Comfortable with full\-time, active field outreach.
* **Preferred Experience:** 
 Prior field sales or appointment\-setting experience in Healthcare, Pharma, Medical Equipment, B2B Sales, or Insurance.
* **Career Growth Path** 
 Appointment Setter ➔ Senior Appointment Setter ➔ BDE ➔ Senior BDE ➔ BDM ➔ Sales Manager.

**Company Description** 
 Win in Life Academy is the country’s first and leading institute that offers training delivered directly by industrial faculty, creating real\-world simulations to prepare learners for professional success. The academy acts as a bridge between freshers, aspiring professionals, and industries, helping individuals start, upgrade, and scale their careers. The role also requires close collaboration with the academy’s faculty and industry partners to ensure training remains current and relevant.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong expertise as a Technical Trainer with experience in Technical Training for mechanical domains.
* Demonstrated ability in Training \& Development, including designing and delivering structured training programs.
* Effective Communication and Training skills to explain complex mechanical concepts clearly and engage diverse learners.
* Solid mechanical engineering or related technical background, with hands\-on industrial or workshop experience.
* Ability to create and revise training materials, practical exercises, and assessments aligned with industry needs.
* Experience working with entry\-level learners or fresh graduates, with a focus on employability and skill\-building.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; relevant certifications in training or pedagogy are an advantage.
* Strong mentoring attitude, patience, and commitment to supporting learners through to successful placement.

description:
**About VHAI** 




  





 Voluntary Health Association of India (VHAI) is a federation of 24 State Voluntary Health Associations, linking over 4,000 health and development organizations and grassroots\-level community health programmes. For over five decades, VHAI has been pursuing its vision of 
 **“Making Health and Development a Reality for the People of India”** 
  by advocating people\-centred policies, promoting dynamic health planning, and supporting participatory development initiatives at National and State level.
 



 The position of 
 **Senior Program Officer/Consultant** 
**– Resource Mobilisation**

The incumbent will be responsible for developing and implementing resource mobilisation strategies, identifying and engaging potential donors and partners, leading proposal development, strengthening donor relationships and supporting the organisation in securing resources from institutional donors, foundations, trusts, CSR partners and other funding sources.

 ·        
 **Educational Qualification:** 
  Postgraduate degree in Public Health/Social Work/ Social Sciences/Management/Rural Development/Corporate Social Responsibility or related disciplines.
 



 ·

  At least
 **7\-10 years of relevant experience** 
  in resource mobilisation, fundraising, grant management, proposal development, institutional partnerships or related areas within the public health, development or non\-profit sector.
 



 ·

  Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing resource mobilisation strategies and identifying new and non\-traditional funding opportunities from institutional donors, trusts, foundations, CSR initiatives, corporates and philanthropic organisations.
 



 ·

  Experience in donor mapping, maintaining donor intelligence, analysing donor priorities and funding trends and proactively developing relationships with prospective and existing donors.

 ·

  Ability to lead and coordinate proposal development processes, work collaboratively with programme teams, ensure quality and timely submission of proposals and incorporate donor feedback effectively.
 



 ·        
 **Partnership Development:** 
  Demonstrated ability to build and manage strategic relationships with government agencies, institutional donors, foundations, trusts, CSR partners, corporates, civil society organisations and other stakeholders to support resource mobilisation.
 



 ·        
 **Partnership Agreements:** 
  Experience in supporting or managing the formalisation and operationalisation of partnerships, including MoUs, funding agreements, project documents and related arrangements.
 



 ·        
 **Communication \& Negotiation:** 
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal, presentation, analytical and negotiation abilities.
 



 ·        
 **Analytical \& Strategic Thinking:** 
  Strong understanding of donor requirements, funding trends, programme logic and the ability to translate organisational priorities into compelling funding propositions.
 



 ·        
 **Team Coordination:** 
  Ability to lead and coordinate complex proposal development processes and work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
 



 ·        
 **Flexibility:** 
  Willingness to travel to states as required. The candidate should be self\-motivated, self\-driven and capable of working independently while effectively leading diverse teams and multi\-stakeholder initiatives.

 ·        Strategic and entrepreneurial approach to resource mobilisation and partnership development.
 



 ·        Strong relationship\-building, interpersonal and negotiation skills.
 



 ·        Self\-motivated, result\-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
 



 ·        High standards of integrity, professionalism and commitment to VHAI’s mission and values.

title: NDR Calling
description:
**Role Objective** 




 The NDR Associate will be responsible for managing
 **Non\-Delivery Report (NDR) shipments end\-to\-end** 
 , closely monitoring courier performance, driving timely corrective actions, coordinating customer closures with Customer Support, and ensuring that no avoidable delivery leakage is accepted.
 



 The role is expected to maximize successful deliveries, reduce RTO, and ensure accountability across courier partners and internal teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Monitor NDR shipments
 **multiple times during the day** 
 across all courier partners and ensure every actionable shipment is attended within defined TAT.
* Aggressively track
 **courier\-wise NDR performance, ageing, reattempts, delivery conversion, and RTO movement** 
 and immediately highlight any deterioration.
* Ensure
 **no courier\-performance leakage is left unattended** 
 . Every missed attempt, delayed reattempt, incorrect status, or operational gap must be identified, questioned, and closed with the courier partner.
* Maintain strict follow\-up with courier SPOCs for
 **reattempts, address corrections, customer callbacks, escalations, and ageing NDR cases** 
 until final closure.
* Challenge and escalate cases involving
 **fake delivery attempts, false customer\-unavailable remarks, premature RTO movement, incorrect NDR remarks, or shipments closed without appropriate attempts** 
 .
* Push courier partners for immediate corrective actions whenever performance drops below agreed benchmarks or SLAs.
* Track commitments provided by courier partners and ensure actions are completed within committed timelines.
* Escalate repeated non\-compliance, delayed actions, or unresolved cases to the Logistics Lead with supporting shipment\-level data.
* Maintain a daily
 **courier\-wise NDR performance tracker/scorecard** 
 covering conversion, reattempt success, ageing, RTO, fake attempts, and pending actions.
* Identify courier partners, hubs, pincodes, or delivery centers consistently showing poor performance and initiate corrective action.
* Ensure every courier escalation has a
 **clear owner, committed action, closure date, and verified outcome** 
 .
* Do not consider a case closed merely because an escalation has been raised; closure means the required action has actually been completed.
* Coordinate closely with the Customer Support team for cases requiring
 **customer confirmation, address correction, alternate contact details, delivery preference, refusal validation, or reattempt confirmation** 
 .
* Share clear and timely shipment\-level feedback with Customer Support for all cases requiring customer intervention.
* Ensure Customer Support closes pending customer\-side actions within agreed TAT and shares actionable remarks back with the Logistics/NDR team.
* Track cases where Customer Support delays or incomplete customer closures are contributing to NDR ageing or RTO.
* Contact customers directly wherever required through calls, WhatsApp, SMS, or available communication channels.
* Verify and correct customer information such as
 **address, landmark, phone number, preferred delivery date, and availability** 
 .
* Update customer responses and requested actions accurately on the relevant NDR/courier platform.
* Prioritize
 **high\-value, prepaid, repeat\-NDR, high\-risk, and ageing shipments** 
 to minimize revenue loss.



  





**Skills Required** 



* Strong ownership and follow\-up mindset.
* Ability to
 **firmly drive courier and internal teams toward closure** 
 .
* Good verbal and written communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Comfortable coordinating with customers, Customer Support teams, and courier partners.
* Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to analyze operational data and identify performance deterioration.
* Strong attention to detail and shipment\-level tracking capability.
* Ability to handle a high volume of NDR cases, follow\-ups, and escalations.
* Basic understanding of ecommerce logistics, NDR, RTO, and last\-mile delivery operations preferred.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Graduate / Undergraduate with relevant operational experience.
* **1–2 years of experience** 
 in ecommerce logistics, NDR operations, customer support, telecalling, or courier operations preferred.
* Experience with D2C brands, ecommerce companies, courier partners, or logistics aggregators will be an advantage.

title: MS Exchange Administrator
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**MS Exchange Administrator**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.
   

  

 The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.
   

  

 This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.


**Technical skills to include:**
* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.


**What We Look For**
* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sales & Business Development Intern
description:
Modelens is looking for a proactive, driven and entrepreneurial person to join our sales team and help bring new business to the company.
   

  

 This is a pure sales and business development role where your primary responsibility will be to identify potential clients, reach out to them, pitch Modelens, build relationships and convert opportunities into paying business.
   

  

 You’ll work across online and offline sales, with clear targets and performance\-linked profit sharing.
   

  

**ROLE DETAILS**
 Role: Sales \& Business Development Intern
   

 Duration: 3 months
   

 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid
   

 Eligibility: Current college students \& freshers
   

  

**ABOUT MODELENS**
 Modelens is a creative production platform that connects brands with models, creators, photographers and other creative professionals through curated talent and end\-to\-end production.
   

  

 We help brands discover the right talent and get their creative work executed end\-to\-end as per their requirements, budget and timelines.
   

  

 As an early\-stage, founder\-led business, every new client directly contributes to our growth. Our sales team plays a key role in making that happen.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**
* Identify potential B2B clients, brands, agencies and businesses for Modelens.
* Reach out to prospects through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, calls, networking and offline meetings.
* Initiate conversations and understand potential clients' requirements.
* Pitch Modelens and communicate our services and value proposition effectively.
* Schedule and participate in client meetings and sales conversations.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and move opportunities towards closure.
* Convert leads into paying Modelens clients.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline from lead → conversation → meeting → proposal → negotiation → closure.
* Research new industries, businesses and potential customer segments.
* Work towards defined weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Track outreach, meetings, leads, conversions and revenue generated.
* Experiment with different approaches to improve lead generation and conversion.
* Work directly with the Founder on high\-value prospects and sales opportunities.


**TARGETS \& PERFORMANCE**
 This is a target\-driven role. You will work towards measurable goals around:
   

* Prospects reached
* Conversations initiated
* Meetings booked
* Qualified leads generated
* Clients acquired
* Revenue generated


 Performance will be evaluated based on actual business outcomes and conversions, not simply the number of messages or calls made.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
* Currently pursuing college or a recent graduate.
* Genuinely interested in sales, business development, startups and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable with cold outreach, calls, networking, pitching and rejection.
* Confident communicating with business owners, founders and decision\-makers.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative without waiting for instructions.
* Target\-oriented and motivated by results.
* Persistent with follow\-ups and comfortable chasing opportunities.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Curious, resourceful and quick to learn.
* Able to work independently in an early\-stage startup environment.
* More focused on generating business than simply completing tasks.


**PERKS \& OPPORTUNITIES**
* Direct access and mentorship from the Founder.
* Hands\-on experience in B2B sales and client acquisition.
* Exposure to the creative production and startup ecosystem.
* Ownership of the complete sales cycle.
* Performance\-linked profit sharing on successful business generated.
* Internship certificate.
* Performance recognition / recommendation for strong performers.
* Modelens goodies and other team perks.
* Opportunity to continue with Modelens based on performance and business requirements.


**THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…**
 You see a brand and immediately think, “How can we get them as a Modelens client?”
   

  

 You enjoy talking to people, finding opportunities, pitching ideas, following up and closing deals and generating revenue. You’re comfortable hearing “no,” learning from it and trying again.
   

  

 If you want a conventional internship where you’re simply assigned tasks, this may not be the role for you.
   

  

 If you want to actually learn sales by selling, work directly with a Founder and see your efforts translate into clients and revenue, you’ll fit right in.

title: Data Scientist II-2
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Data Scientist II\-2
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
   

  

 Mastercard has over 2 billion payment cards issued by 25,000\+ banks across 190\+ countries and territories, amassing over 10 petabytes of data. Millions of transactions are flowing to Mastercard in real\-time providing an ideal environment to apply and leverage AI at scale. The AI team is responsible for building and deploying innovative AI solutions for all divisions within Mastercard securing a competitive advantage. Our objectives include achieving operational efficiency, improving customer experience, and ensuring robust value propositions of our core products (Credit, Debit, Prepaid) and services (recommendation engine, anti\-money laundering, fraud risk management, cybersecurity)
   

  

**Role**
* Gather relevant information to define the business problem
* Creative thinker capable of linking AI methodologies to identified business challenges
* Develop AI/ML applications leveraging the latest industry and academic advancements
* Ability to work cross\-functionally, and across borders drawing on a broader team of colleagues to effectively execute the AI agenda


**All About You**
 :
   

  

* Demonstrated passion for AI competing in sponsored challenges such as Kaggle
* Previous experience with or exposure to:
* Deep Learning algorithm techniques, open source tools and technologies, statistical tools, and programming environments such as Python, R, and SQL
* 
* Big Data platforms such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, GPU Clusters for deep learning
* Classical Machine Learning Algorithms like Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Clustering (K\-means,
* Hierarchical and Self\-organizing Maps), TSNE, PCA, Bayesian models, Time Series ARIMA/ARMA,
* Recommender Systems \- Collaborative Filtering, FPMC, FISM, Fossil
* Deep Learning algorithm techniques like Random Forest, GBM, KNN, SVM, Bayesian, Text Mining techniques, Multilayer Perceptron, Neural Networks – Feedforward, CNN, LSTM’s GRU’s is a plus.
* Optimization techniques – Activity regularization (L1 and L2\), Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta concepts; Cost
* Functions in Neural Nets – Contrastive Loss, Hinge Loss, Binary Cross entropy, Categorical Cross entropy; developed applications in KRR, NLP, Speech and Image processing
* Deep Learning frameworks for Production Systems like Tensorflow, Keras (for RPD and neural net architecture evaluation), PyTorch and Xgboost, Caffe, and Theono is a plus
* Concentration in Computer Science


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Research, Product and Strategy Associate
description:
**Research, Product Strategy Associate**
**Location:** 
 Delhi (In\-office, 5 days/week)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 B.Tech / Engineering (2\-4 years) OR MBA (02 years)
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building an AI\-native product for the legal industry and are looking for a Research, Product Strategy Associate to work directly with the founders across product, research, market intelligence, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional role with a strong focus
 **on understanding and improving the product** 
 . You will research markets and competitors, study how AI and software products work, analyses user and industry needs, and translate your findings into product ideas, strategic recommendations, and structured execution plans.
   

  

 The role is ideal for someone who enjoys diving into unfamiliar subjects, understanding how products and businesses work, experimenting with technology, and turning large amounts of information into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Work closely with the founders on product research, product strategy, feature exploration, and new initiatives.
* Study our product and related workflows to identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, potential features, and new use cases.
* Research AI, legal\-tech, SaaS, and software products to understand their features, workflows, UX, capabilities, positioning, and use cases.
* Conduct research across markets, companies, products, competitors, customers, and emerging technologies.
* Analyze competing AI and legal\-tech products across their business models, customers, pricing, funding, features, and market positioning.
* Build structured research databases, competitor matrices, market maps, feature comparisons, and product analyses.
* Speak to or study potential users and customers to better understand their workflows, pain points, behaviors, and requirements.
* Convert research and user insights into product recommendations, feature ideas, strategic briefs, and actionable next steps.
* Analyze information to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and strategic insights.
* Experiment extensively with AI tools and emerging technologies to understand how they can be incorporated into the product.
* Create clear presentations, spreadsheets, documents, product notes, and strategic briefs.
* Support the founders on high\-priority projects across product, strategy, market intelligence, and business initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* Tech / Engineering graduates with 24 years of experience, or MBA graduates with 02 years of experience.
* Strong interest in product, technology, AI, software, and business strategy.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand software products deeply including their features, workflows, user experience, and underlying use cases.
* Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms , and comfortable using AI extensively in everyday work.
* Ability to independently explore and learn unfamiliar industries, technologies, and products quickly.
* Strong written English and the ability to structure and communicate complex information clearly.
* Comfortable working extensively with spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and research tools.
* Curious, detail\-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of open\-ended assignments.
* Comfortably operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may evolve as the product and company grow.


**Who This Role Is Best Suited For**
 You are a strong fit for this role if you naturally enjoy:
   

  

* Exploring new AI software products to understand how they work.
* Comparing different products and analyzing why one product performs better than another.
* Breaking down ambiguous problems and designing research approaches to solve them.
* Identifying product improvements, feature gaps, and better user workflows.
* Using AI tools to research, write, prototype, and solve problems faster.
* Turning scattered information into clear, structured insights.


**Growth Progression**
 As the company grows, this role can evolve into broader ownership across
 **product management, product strategy, business strategy, market intelligence, growth, and other high\-priority initiatives,** 
 depending on the individuals strengths and interests.
   

  

 The role offers significant exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building and the opportunity to work closely with the founders on decisions that directly shape the product and company.

title: RF Radar Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior RF Radar Engineer** 




**Company: Omnipresent Robot Technologies Pvt. Ltd.** 




**Location: Noida \| Type: Full\-Time** 




  





**About Us:** 




 Omnipresent Robot Tech Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative startup pushing the boundaries of robotics, drones, and space tech. We recently contributed to ISRO’s Chandrayaan\-3 mission by developing the perception and navigation module for the Pragyaan rover. Currently, we are developing innovative satellite and drone\-based solutions for defence and commercial applications. Join our dynamic team and grow your career!
 



**Position Title: Senior RF Radar Engineer** 




**Role Overview:** 




 The Senior RF Radar Engineer will lead the technical design and verification of radio frequency (RF) radar systems for spaceborne Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite sensors. This role involves system architecture development, hardware design, RF circuit analysis, antenna and payload integration, performance modeling, and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and optimise advanced RF radar systems and subsystems for SAR satellite payloads (with emphasis on X\-band or higher frequencies).
* Perform system\-level architecture planning, specification definition, and link budget analysis for SAR payload.
* Lead antenna design, simulation, and integration for phased array systems, considering beamforming, polarization, and pointing requirements.
* Develop and validate radar signal processing algorithms for SAR imaging, calibration, and image quality assurance.
* Conduct hardware and software integration, system testing, troubleshooting, and verification of all radar\-related electronics.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory RF emissions, spectrum allocation, and electromagnetic compatibility standards.
* Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to ensure payload performance and system interoperability.
* Prepare technical documentation, reports, and contribute to test plans and reviews for satellite missions.
* Support technology transfer (ToT), vendor assessment, and liaison with external research or industrial partners.
* Support the clean room operations for sensor integration.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Master's or PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Physics, or related field; substantial experience in RF or radar system design (minimum 5 years preferred).
* Demonstrated expertise with SAR, radar imaging, and RF payloads (preferably in satellite or aerospace context).
* Hands\-on experience with RF simulation tools, modeling software (such as Dassault CST, Ansys HFSS, Keysight pathwave ADS, COMSOL Multiphysics, etc), and signal processing platforms.
* Strong grounding in analog and digital RF circuit design, antenna engineering, and phased array technologies.
* Proficiency with system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and calibration of radar payload hardware/software including Digital, RF and transmitter modules.
* Knowledge of regulatory standards and documentation (ITU, EMC, MIL\-STD, etc.).
* Strong written and verbal communication; adept at technical reporting and collaboration.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Experience with interferometric SAR (InSAR) and advanced radar processing algorithms.
* Familiarity with embedded processing, FPGA/DSP platforms, and satellite bus integration.
* Project management or team leadership in an engineering/space systems context.
* Industry certifications in RF engineering or satellite communications (e.g., ISTQB, IAM, etc.).
* Experience with technology transfer, external collaboration, and vendor liaison processes.

description:

 We are seeking a
 **CAD Engineer specializing in Digital Verification**

* Monitor and optimize infrastructure usage (compute farms, LSF environments) to ensure efficient job execution and resource utilization
* Analyze DV flow issues and performance bottlenecks, and provide improvements or recommendations for optimization
* Partner with DV, RTL design, and system teams to resolve cross\-functional issues impacting verification flows
* Provide methodology guidance, user support, and training to verification engineers on tools and flows
* Maintain and contribute to documentation, best practices, and support guidelines for verification flows


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering
* 12\+ years of experience in Digital Verification / CAD / Engineering Support\-related roles
* Strong understanding of digital verification flow (simulation, regression, coverage, debug)
* Hands\-on experience with System Verilog and UVM (for debugging/support perspective)
* Having experience in System tools like Matlab, Coside will be an added advantage
* Proficiency in scripting/programming (Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar)
* Experience in Linux\-based environments
* Experience with EDA tools (VCS, Xcelium, Verdi, vManager, etc.)
* Exposure to regression environments, CI/CD systems, and compute farm usage
* Familiarity with AI/ML\-based DV tools (e.g., Cadence Verisium AI) is a plus
* Basic understanding of SoC/ASIC architecture and RTL design concepts


**Required Interpersonal Skills**
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across teams
* Proven ability to collaborate with design, verification, IT and infrastructure teams
* Experience working in multi\-cultural global environments and coordinating with globally distributed teams


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Exposure to AI\-assisted verification workflows / LLM\-based tools and AI Agents development.
* Experience with cloud\-based or distributed regression environments
* Interest in automating repetitive support workflows across DV flows using scripting or AI\-based approaches

**Job Description**
 To support WSP Australia’s Strategic Asset Management team from India by contributing to advisory projects across transport, energy, mining, water, facilities and social infrastructure. The role supports clients from strategy through implementation by analysing asset information, developing practical recommendations and producing high\-quality client\-ready outputs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support strategic asset management and advisory projects from strategy and policy development through business cases and implementation support.
* Interrogate asset data, identify trends and insights, and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations.
* Contribute to asset management, business management, asset maintenance and asset management systems assignments.
* Prepare clear, client\-ready reports, presentations and data outputs tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Work with project teams and specialists across Australia, India and global locations to deliver agreed project outcomes.
* Engage with clients, understand their requirements and support tailored service delivery that strengthens client relationships.
* Manage assigned priorities, timelines and deliverables with attention to quality and detail.
* Contribute to efficient asset management and best\-practice approaches that improve asset performance, sustainability and long\-term value.
* Share knowledge, collaborate with colleagues and support the learning and development of others.
* Maintain a commitment to continuous professional development and relevant asset management certification.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in a relevant field.
* Certification in Asset Management, or an equivalent qualification, is desirable; willingness to obtain certification is acceptable.


 Experience, skills and organisational knowledge:
   

  

* 3 to 5 years of experience in strategic asset management, business management, asset maintenance, asset management systems or a related advisory role.
* Strong analytical capability and attention to detail, with experience interrogating asset data and identifying trends and insights.
* Ability to convert analysis into clear, practical recommendations for clients and project teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing and presentation of data for the intended audience.
* Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships through effective communication and tailored service delivery.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented approach, with a willingness to learn from and mentor others.
* Sound organisational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Commitment to continuous learning, professional development and building an industry profile.
* Experience or exposure across transport, energy, mining, water, facilities, social infrastructure or cultural institutions is advantageous.
* Ability to work effectively with national and international project teams and industry specialists.


 BGV:
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 With approximately
 **4,000 talented people** 
 across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru \& Mumbai offices) in India and more than
 **73,000 globally** 
 , in 550
 **offices across 40 countries** 
 , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
   

  

**Inclusivity and Diversity**
 WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength \- Our People \-feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
   

  

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
   

  

**With us, you can.
   

  

 Apply today.**

title: Meta Ads Operations Executive
description:
**Dominators Business Tribe · Greater Noida West · On\-site · Full\-time** 




  




 About the role
 
 Dominators Business Tribe helps Indian working professionals build and scale digital product businesses. As part of our flagship DBT Accelerator programme, we build and run Meta ad campaigns for our students — real businesses, with real budgets.
 



 We're hiring the person who will run those campaigns.
 



 This is an operations role, not a creative strategy role. You'll work from a documented system with AI\-assisted reporting that handles the heavy analysis. Your job is to execute it accurately across many accounts, make the calls it surfaces, and keep our students informed.
 



**Freshers are welcome.** 
 If you've run even one Meta campaign and you're precise, organised and curious, we will train you on everything else.
 



  




 What you'll do
 
**Daily** 
 — Review the automated performance report across all active accounts. Act on what it flags: pause what isn't working, scale what is, escalate what's broken. Around 30–45 minutes of focused decision\-making.
 



**Weekly** 
 — Send each student a clear performance update. Join the Wednesday coaching call to stay aligned with what our students are learning.
 



**For every new student** 
 — Set up access to their ad account, verify the pixel is firing correctly, build the campaign to our naming convention, and launch it. Around two hours per account.
 



**Always** 
 — Flag problems early. An account heading for trouble at ₹3,000 spent is a conversation; at ₹30,000 it's a refund.
 



 You'll begin with 10–25 accounts and grow as we do, and you'll join our 10:15 AM daily team huddle.
 



  




 What we're looking for
 
**Essential** 



* Basic hands\-on exposure to Meta Ads Manager — a personal campaign, an internship, a college project or a small business all count
* Clear written English; you'll send client updates every week
* Genuinely organised. Managing 25 accounts is a systems problem before it's a marketing problem
* Trustworthy with other people's accounts and budgets
* Comfortable following a documented process — and speaking up when the process is wrong



  





**Good to have** 



* Familiarity with Business Manager, Events Manager or pixel setup
* Exposure to landing pages, checkout tools or funnels
* Interest in digital products, coaching or info\-product businesses
* Comfort using AI tools in daily work



  





**Not required** 
 — a design background, agency experience, or large\-budget campaigns. Ours start at ₹300/day.
 



  




 What we offer
 * **₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 
 , negotiable based on experience
* Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, on\-site at Greater Noida West
* Structured training on a documented system, with AI tooling that removes the grunt work
* Ownership of a core delivery function with direct access to the founder
* Real campaigns, real budgets, real revenue outcomes — you'll learn more in six months here than in two years of theory

title: HR Manager – Ecommerce & Appliances
description:
Moonstruck Appliances is hiring an HR Manager to build strong teams and take ownership of recruitment and day\-to\-day people management.
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced HR professional who has worked in ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies and understands how to hire, develop and retain people in a fast\-moving business.
 



  





 Location: Bawana, Delhi \| Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 • Recruitment from start to finish: work with the founders and department heads on hiring plans, write clear job descriptions, source candidates, screen profiles, coordinate practical assessments and interviews, manage offers and follow through until joining.
 



 • Ecommerce and appliance hiring: recruit marketplace managers and executives, Amazon/Flipkart specialists, advertising and performance\-marketing staff, catalogue teams, designers, customer\-support staff and operations employees. Coordinate warehouse, production and service hiring as business needs require.
 



 • Team building and leadership: lead the recruitment/HR function, establish clear responsibilities and reporting lines with department heads, coach managers and help teams work together effectively.
 



 • Performance management: help managers set measurable goals, run probation and performance reviews, identify training needs and follow up on agreed improvement plans.
 



 • Onboarding and retention: create structured induction and 30/60/90\-day onboarding plans, improve joining and early\-tenure retention, conduct employee check\-ins and exit interviews, and address recurring reasons for attrition.
 



 • People operations: maintain accurate employee records, attendance and leave processes; coordinate payroll inputs with accounts; document HR policies, employee concerns and resolutions with confidentiality and fair treatment.
 



 • Hiring and HR reporting: maintain a weekly dashboard of vacancies, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joiners, time to fill, offer acceptance, early retention, headcount and pending performance reviews.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • Proven HR and recruitment experience within ecommerce, D2C, home\-appliance or consumer\-durables companies.
 



 • A record of independently closing specialist and managerial roles, with examples of the roles hired, hiring volume, turnaround time and retention results.
 



 • Experience managing employee relations, onboarding, performance reviews and manager coordination, alongside recruitment.
 



 • Ability to lead recruiters or HR staff, set priorities, follow up consistently and hold teams accountable for agreed actions.
 



 • Familiarity with ecommerce roles and workflows, including Amazon/Flipkart operations, marketplace advertising, catalogue management, customer support and fulfilment.
 



 • Practical sourcing experience using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and recruitment partners; confidence using Excel/Google Sheets and an applicant or HR tracking system.
 



 • Clear communication, sound judgement and the ability to handle sensitive employee matters professionally.
 



 • Availability for full\-time, on\-site work in Bawana, Delhi.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



  





 Priority roles filled with suitable candidates, stronger offer\-to\-joining conversion and early retention, reliable onboarding, timely performance reviews, and managers who follow clear people\-management processes.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a short note covering:
 



 • The ecommerce or appliance companies you have worked with and your responsibilities.
 



 • The main roles you have hired for, approximate hiring volume and measurable outcomes.
 



 • The size of the HR/recruitment team you have led and the employee headcount you have supported.
 



 • Your notice period, expected compensation and availability to work on\-site in Bawana.

description:
**Job Description – Manager – Finance \& Accounting** 




**Location:** 
 Metropolitan, Kolkata
 



**Position:** 
 Manager – Finance \& Accounting
 



**CTC:** 
 Up to 9 LPA(Based on Experience)
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Function:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
 



**Industry Preference:** 
 Retail / Apparel / E\-commerce / FMCG / Consumer Business
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager – Finance \& Accounting** 
 to manage day\-to\-day financial and accounting operations with primary ownership of
 **Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), reconciliations, month\-end closure, MIS, and financial reporting** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on accounting experience, good analytical skills, and the ability to independently manage finance operations while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders, vendors, customers, and auditors.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounts Receivable (AR)** 



* Manage end\-to\-end AR operations including invoicing, collections, customer reconciliations, and ageing analysis.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and ensure timely follow\-up and collection.
* Identify and resolve reconciliation issues, credit notes, debit notes, and customer ledger discrepancies.
* Track receivables and provide regular updates to management.



**Accounts Payable (AP)** 



* Oversee vendor invoice processing, verification, accounting, and payment cycles.
* Ensure timely vendor payments while maintaining appropriate documentation and approvals.
* Perform vendor ledger reconciliation and resolve outstanding discrepancies.
* Monitor payable ageing and support effective working\-capital management.



**Accounting \& Financial Operations** 



* Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions and maintenance of books of accounts.
* Drive monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, and other accounting schedules.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and internal financial controls.



**MIS \& Reporting** 



* Prepare periodic MIS reports and financial dashboards for management review.
* Provide analysis on revenue, receivables, payables, expenses, cash flow, and working capital.
* Highlight key financial variances, trends, and areas requiring management attention.
* Support management with data\-driven financial insights for decision\-making.



**Cash Flow \& Working Capital** 



* Monitor daily/weekly cash flow requirements and fund utilization.
* Support working\-capital planning and ensure efficient utilization of available funds.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders for payment planning and cash\-flow requirements.



**Audit, Compliance \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate with internal and external auditors for timely completion of audits.
* Ensure availability and accuracy of supporting documents, schedules, and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with internal teams such as Commercial, Sales, Procurement, Operations, and HR for finance\-related matters.
* Support statutory and regulatory compliance activities as required.



**Budgeting \& Financial Planning** 



* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Track actuals against budgets and assist in variance analysis.
* Provide relevant financial data and analysis to support business planning.



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong knowledge of
 **Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Accounting, and Reconciliation** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **month\-end closing and financial reporting** 
 .
* Strong Excel skills and proficiency in accounting/ERP systems.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong understanding of cash flow and working\-capital management.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deadlines independently.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.



**Qualification** 



* **CA Inter / CMA / M.Com / B.Com** 
 or equivalent qualification.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Finance \& Accounting.
* Candidates from
 **Retail, Apparel, E\-commerce, FMCG, or other fast\-paced consumer businesses** 
 will be preferred.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* A hands\-on finance professional who can independently manage core accounting operations.
* Strong ownership of AR/AP and financial closure.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and growing business environment.
* Strong MIS and analytical orientation with a practical approach to problem\-solving.

**Role Overview**
 This engineer will build and extend the Python services behind AI features endpoints, data access, ingestion and retrieval jobs, and the integration points to foundation model APIs and will also implement the front\-end surfaces for a new AI Playground that ACD engineering will develop for rapid prototyping and experimentation, before implementing it in customer\-facing UI.
   

  

 The work is majority backend; the front\-end capability matters because it means features get delivered whole rather than handed across a seam. This is a delivery role on a small team, working to patterns set by the AI Engineering Lead and senior backend engineer rather than defining architecture. The expectation is steady, tested, production\-ready output with growing independence over the engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain Python API endpoints and service logic (FastAPI or equivalent) backing AI features, following established patterns for request validation, streaming responses, timeouts, retries, and structured error handling.
* Implement the front\-end features in Angular or React streaming and incremental response rendering, loading and partial\-failure states, and responsive layouts for the AI Playground and customer\-facing UI.
* Write and maintain SQL against relational stores, Python against other NoSQL or object data stores.
* Write automated tests as a normal part of delivery: unit and API tests on the back end, fixture\-based tests for model\-dependent paths, and contributions to regression suites running in CI.
* Add logging, metrics, and tracing to the services and jobs owned so failures and performance regressions are visible without a customer report.
* Fix defects on owned features through to root cause, including issues surfaced in production.
* Collaborate with the AI Engineering Lead, Senior Backend Engineer, Product, and UX in a distributed team, using written updates and asynchronous communication as the default.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience delivering production backend services and web application user interfaces.
* Strong Python for production backend work: REST API development, async basics, testing, and debugging in a real codebase not scripting or notebook\-only experience.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or an equivalent Python API framework.
* Working proficiency in a modern front\-end framework Angular or React sufficient to build and modify feature\-level UI independently.
* Angular is preferred, as it is used in ACD's existing platform.
* Comfort with TypeScript/JavaScript and browser fundamentals including async behavior and debugging.
* Solid SQL and relational data modeling: joins, indexing basics, schema changes, and migrations.
* Experience with Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong written English and the ability to work effectively with a US\-based team.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong Python backend development with REST APIs and FastAPI/Flask/Django.
* Hands\-on Angular or React with JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Strong SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and API integration.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, and production support.


**Desired Attributes**
* Exposure to AI/LLM features, model APIs, RAG/retrieval, or streaming interfaces.
* Knowledge of Azure, Docker, and cloud deployment.
* Experience with background jobs/queues such as Celery.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, ownership, and ability to work with distributed/US\-based teams.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI or LLM\-backed features calling model APIs, prompt handling, retrieval\-backed search, or streaming and conversational interfaces.
* Vector databases or embedding\-based retrieval.
* Azure cloud services, Docker, or exposure to cloud deployment workflows.
* Background job and queue processing (Celery, or equivalent).
* C\# and .NET familiarity, which are core to ACD's existing product platform.
* Accessibility (WCAG) and front\-end performance work.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling in day\-to\-day work.


**Interview Process**
* 2 rounds of discussion.
