title: Insurance Agent
company: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited
description:
**Company Description** 
 ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited is one of India’s leading private sector life insurance providers, offering solutions to help customers secure their families and achieve long\-term financial goals. The company delivers a broad portfolio of products, including term plans, wealth plans, child education plans, and retirement plans that support every life stage. Its focus on customer commitment, innovation, and strong values has earned numerous industry awards and recognition. Flagship offerings such as the iProtect Smart Life Cover Plan have been celebrated for product innovation, reinforcing the company’s notable position in the life insurance industry. Team members join a trusted brand with a strong reputation and a customer\-centric culture.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Insurance Agent role is a full\-time hybrid position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of on\-site client interactions and some work\-from\-home flexibility. In this role, the Insurance Agent will identify prospective clients, explain life insurance and financial protection solutions, and recommend suitable plans aligned with customer needs and life goals. Daily responsibilities include conducting customer meetings, performing basic financial needs assessments, preparing proposals, and assisting clients throughout the application and policy issuance process. The Insurance Agent will maintain ongoing relationships with policyholders, provide policy servicing and support, and ensure timely follow\-up for renewals and additional coverage opportunities. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, adhering to regulatory and company guidelines, and meeting assigned sales and service targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Insurance Sales and Insurance, with the ability to present and explain life insurance products clearly and ethically.
* Candidates should possess skills in Insurance Brokerage and Finance, including basic financial planning knowledge and understanding of risk and protection needs.
* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills, with a focus on relationship building, responsiveness, and problem\-solving for policyholders.
* Relevant experience in life insurance, banking, financial services, or telesales is beneficial.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, proficiency in English and local languages, and comfort with digital tools and CRM systems are preferred.
* Ability to work toward sales targets, manage time effectively in a hybrid work environment, and comply with regulatory and company standards is required.
* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline is preferred; appropriate licensing or certification as per insurance regulations may be required or supported by the company.

title: Senior Barista
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nature’s Cafe is a welcoming café located inside Harinalaya and in Baguihati Kolkata, serving guests daily from 10:30 AM to 6:30 PM and 1PM to 11PM respectively. The café focuses on providing a relaxed and warm environment where visitors can enjoy quality beverages and delicious food options. Team members are encouraged to deliver attentive service and contribute to a clean, comfortable space for guests. Working at Nature’s Cafe offers the opportunity to engage with a diverse mix of customers in a vibrant local setting. The café values reliability, respect, and a positive attitude in all staff members. Nature’s Café is now growing and is expanding to Salt Lake, for which a vibrant team of passionate hospitality personnels are required.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Barista role based at Nature’s Cafe in Kolkata. The Barista will prepare and serve a variety of hot and cold coffee, manual brews, beverages, teas, and other café drinks according to established recipes and standards. Daily tasks include preparing beverages, maintaining a clean and organized workstation, and ensuring equipment is properly used and cared for. The role involves greeting guests, taking orders, processing payments, and providing responsive, friendly customer service throughout each shift. The Barista will also support opening and closing duties for the barista station, restock supplies, follow hygiene and safety guidelines, and work collaboratively with the café team.
 


**Qualifications**




* Candidates should possess barista and coffee preparation skills, including familiarity with espresso machines and manual brewing methods.
* Candidates should possess customer service and interpersonal skills to engage courteously with guests and build positive customer relationships.
* Candidates should possess clear communication skills for taking orders, explaining menu items, and coordinating with team members, proving oneself to be a team player.
* Candidates should possess basic food preparation skills and an understanding of food safety and hygiene practices.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include prior café or restaurant experience, ability to stand for extended periods, basic math skills for handling cash and POS systems, flexibility to work weekends and holidays, and a commitment to punctuality and teamwork.
* Compensation: Salary \+ Health Benefits \+ Fooding \& Accomodation

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
**About the role:** 





 Zeltis works on communicating the Government of West Bengal’s schemes, initiatives, events and priority messages to the people of the State through simple, accessible video and graphic content.
 





 We are looking for a
 
**Senior Copywriter** 

 who can anchor the written word in that process. The job is to take policy; often dense, technical and written for administrators and turn it into language that a farmer in Purulia, a student in Siliguri and a homemaker in Howrah can easily understand. This is not advertising for its own sake; it is public communication and it carries the weight and responsibility of the Government’s voice.
 





 The role is suited to someone who reads and analyzes the news out of genuine interest, who can tell the difference between a claim and a fact and who can write a line that lands without ever overstating or understating what the Government has actually said. 
 





 At Zeltis, we are looking for someone who brings curiosity, clarity and editorial judgement to every piece of content they write.
 




**Experience:** 

 3 to 5 years minimum prior experience as a content writer in governance, political, journalistic, research\-driven or critical/analytical environments. Candidates from newsrooms, policy institutions, think tanks, research organisations, editorial desks or long\-form publications will be strongly preferred, as the role demands accuracy and depth alongside creative flair.
 




**Key responsibilities:** 



* Translate scheme documents, policy notes, press releases and departmental briefs into clear, simple, people\-facing copy in Bengali and English.
* Write scripts (explainers, reels, testimonials, event films), voice\-over copy, graphic and creative copy, campaign taglines and punchlines.
* Produce copy that reads natively, with the idiom, rhythm and cultural texture appropriate to each, rather than a literal rendering of the other.
* Proactively ideate content and campaigns; identify communication opportunities before they are assigned and propose the narrative angle for them.
* Manage narrative consistently across campaigns and ensure the Government's initiatives are communicated positively, accurately and in a single coherent voice.
* Brief and work alongside the design, motion and video teams; ensure copy and visual treatment work together rather than in parallel.
* Deliver rapid\-response copy during announcements, events, launches and time\-sensitive situations.
* Act as the final quality check on outgoing copy to ensure factual accuracy, official nomenclature, scheme names, figures, spellings, grammar and tone.
* Guide and review the work of junior copywriters and maintain the unit's style and terminology standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality on all unreleased communication, data and internal material.



**Essential skills and requirements:** 



* **Genuine understanding and interest in governance and policy:** 

 Demonstrable understanding of, knowledge of, or serious interest in governance, public policy and welfare delivery. Follows news \- State, local and National as a daily habit and can hold an informed conversation about the same.
* **Understands the sensitivity of government communication:** 

 Understands that government communication is not just another brand of communication. Appreciates the protocols, the factual discipline, the political and administrative sensitivities involved and the lines that must not be crossed. Exercises judgement about what can be said, how and when.
* **Simplification for the layman:** 

 Proven ability to convert technical, administrative and policy language into simple, everyday terms; copy that connects with a general audience across literacy levels, age groups and districts, without diluting or misrepresenting the facts.
* **Language command:** 

 Fluency in Bengali and English, publication\-standard writing, with the ability to write original copy. Hindi proficiency is optional but desirable.
* **Keen eye for detail and error identification:** 

 Catches factual slips, wrong figures, wrong scheme names, grammatical and typographical errors and inconsistencies in tone before anything goes out. A single error in government communication carries a disproportionate cost.
* **Creative writing and punchline ideation:** 

 Can produce memorable, sharp, quotable lines and headlines; slogans, hooks, taglines, captions that travel well on social platforms.
* **Proactive ideation and narrative management:** 

 Brings ideas to the table unprompted. Thinks in terms of campaigns and arcs, not one\-off posts and can shape a sustained positive narrative around the Government's work.
* **Availability and work commitment:** 

 Government work is unpredictable and often urgent. The role requires genuine willingness and enthusiasm to work beyond designated hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays, when the situation demands.



**Good to have:** 



* Ad copywriting experience: Experience in writing campaign copy, print, OOH, digital and film.
* Agency experience: Familiarity with client servicing, brief\-taking, deadline culture and working within a creative team.
* Creative writing credentials: Published work, long\-form storytelling, literary or scripting background.
* Working knowledge of social media platform policies: Community guidelines, content restrictions and compliance requirements across Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube and WhatsApp.
* Understanding of platform algorithms: What drives reach, retention and engagement and how copy choices affect distribution.



  





**Remuneration: I** 

 ndustry standard, commensurate with experience, portfolio and interview performance
 




***This is an on\-site role and the candidate must travel to and work from the office***




  





***Applicants are requested to apply at***
*hr@zeltis.co.in* 
***along with submission of any one assignments mentioned below (Pick any one):***



1. *There is a lot of negative publicity surrounding Annapurna Yojana owing to the delay in payments. Even though the reason is logical administratively speaking, common people do not understand that. Hence, your task is to prepare a one\-minute content script for a video that will be published through Government or Department page; positively promoting the Annapurna Yojana which is not misleading \[in Bengali]*
2. *Write a video script on PM Surya Ghar Yojana with the intention of urging people to apply for the scheme through listing out its benefits. Common people find it boring to look through the pages of scheme documents, guidelines and websites; hence write the script in a manner like it appeals to the layman with the lucrative side of the scheme; without any half information or misinformation \[in Bengali]*

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint ISC Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on\-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Freelance Sound Designer – Audio Drama Series
description:
**ABOUT THE PROJECT** 




 Archivium Audio Stories is a premium, independent, self\-funded audio drama series. Our mission is to produce gripping, modern language adaptations of timeless public domain novels and short stories from around the world. We focus on psychological tension, gothic atmospheres, and intense storytelling. We focus on various genres including psychological tension, gothic atmospheres, and intense storytelling.
 



 Our initial launch lineup includes:
 



 • Julius Caesar (Shakespeare's intense political thriller)
 



 • The Signal\-Man (Charles Dickens' classic ghost story)
 



 • Hell Screen (Ryūnosuke Akutagawa's descent into artistic madness)
 



 • The Kreutzer Sonata (Leo Tolstoy's dark psychological drama)
 



 • Die Spinne / The Spider (Hanns Heinz Ewers' hypnotic horror)
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking a talented, creative Freelance Sound Designer \& Audio Editor based in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area. The ideal candidate must have a deep, inherent understanding of the Sunday Suspense audio drama format—specifically its cinematic pacing, heavy atmospheric world\-building, and dynamic use of background scores and Foley to drive psychological tension.
 



  





 As this is a self\-funded independent venture, this role is perfect for final\-year film/media students, recent graduates (e.g., SRFTI, St. Xavier's, JU), or independent freelance audio engineers looking to work on world\-class literary material and build a powerhouse portfolio.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* **Atmospheric Soundscapes** 
 : Build deep, immersive ambient backgrounds (from the stormy nights of ancient Rome to claustrophobic train tunnels).



  




* **Foley \& Sound Effects** 
 : Source, edit, and layer visceral sound effects to match the script's action and psychological dread.



  




* **Music \& Leitmotif Integration** 
 : Select, edit, or compose repeating musical themes that heighten emotional and dramatic stakes.



  




* **Dialogue Editing \& Mixing** 
 : Clean up recorded voice tracks, balance levels, and execute the final master mix.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* Natively familiar with the narrative structure and sonic signature of Sunday Suspense or similar cinematic audio dramas.



  




* Access to your own Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) setup (Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Reaper, Premiere, etc.).



  




* Ability to take total creative ownership of a script and translate it into a world\-class auditory experience.



  




* Strong communication skills to collaborate directly with the creator (no deep technical jargon required!)



  





**Project Type** 
 : Freelance / Contract (Per\-Episode Basis)
 



**Budget** 
 : Competitive stipend per completed episode (to be discussed based on experience/portfolio).
 



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Please apply directly via LinkedIn.
 



  





**Crucial** 
 : Please include a link to your portfolio, showreel, or any previous narrative audio work/mixes you have done.

 The Human Resources Assistant will support the HR department and management team across our convenience store chain by handling critical administrative functions, recruitment, payroll processing, and accounting software management. This role is essential to ensuring smooth HR operations, compliance with labor regulations, and efficient financial management of our stores.
 



 Primary Responsibilities
 



 Recruitment \& Application Management:
 


* Review and screen job applications for accuracy and completeness
* Coordinate with store managers to understand staffing needs and job requirements
* Prepare applicant tracking reports and recommendation summaries
* Communicate with candidates regarding application status and next steps
* Maintain organized applicant files and documentation



 Payroll Administration:
 


* Process bi\-weekly payroll for all employees across multiple store locations
* Verify timesheets and hours worked; identify and resolve discrepancies
* Calculate deductions, withholdings, and tax compliance requirements
* Coordinate payroll tax filings and unemployment insurance processing
* Generate and distribute pay stubs and payroll reports
* Maintain accurate payroll records and employee compensation files



 Sage 100 Accounting Software Management:
 


* Enter and reconcile payroll data in Sage 100
* Process vendor payments and accounts payable transactions
* Generate financial reports and reconciliation statements
* Maintain chart of accounts and account classifications
* Troubleshoot system issues and ensure data integrity
* Create regular backups and ensure system compliance



 HR Documentation \& Compliance:
 


* Prepare and process employment contracts, offer letters, and termination documents
* Maintain employee files with required documentation and certifications
* Track and ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations
* Assist with new hire orientation and onboarding procedures
* Prepare HR reports and employee census information
* Manage employee records database and ensure confidentiality



 Secondary Responsibilities (Convenience Store Chain Specific)
 


* Assist with employee benefits administration and enrollment
* Coordinate with franchise/store managers on scheduling and staffing matters
* Track employee certifications (Food Handler, Alcohol Service, etc.)
* Support expense tracking and cost analysis across store locations
* Assist with store inventory and supply ordering documentation
* Help prepare financial reconciliation reports for store managers
* Respond to employee inquiries regarding HR policies and procedures
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive employee and financial information
* Assist with audit preparation and documentation requests
* Support special projects as requested by HR Manager or ownership



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelors in Finance or Accounting; equivalent work experience in HR or accounting
* Proven experience with Sage 100 accounting software (2\+ years preferred)
* Proficiency with payroll processing and payroll software platforms
* Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws and tax regulations
* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numerical data
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task and work in a fast\-paced environment



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Bachelors degree or higher in Human Resources, Accounting, or Business Administration
* HR certification (PHR, SHRM\-CP) or accounting certification
* Experience in retail or convenience store operations
* Familiarity with Quickbooks, Sage 100
* Previous experience with multi\-location business management
* Knowledge of point\-of\-sale (POS) systems



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Attention to Detail \& Accuracy
* Data Entry \& Database Management
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Customer Service \& Interpersonal Skills
* Time Management \& Organization
* Technical Proficiency \& Software Troubleshooting
* Discretion \& Confidentiality
* Initiative \& Adaptability



 Physical Requirements
 



 While this is primarily an office\-based role, the candidate must be able to:
 


* Sit for extended periods at a desk and computer workstation
* Perform repetitive hand and finger motions (typing, data entry)
* Lift and carry documents and files weighing up to 20 pounds
* Communicate effectively by phone, email, and in person



 Work Environment
 



 This position operates in a professional office setting. The employee will work with confidential information and must maintain professionalism when interacting with employees, managers, and external vendors. Flexibility may be required to accommodate business needs and seasonal demands.
 



  





 Compensation \& Benefits
 



 Salary: 80,000 – 1 Lakh Rupees Per Month
 



 Benefits May Include:
 


* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Days, Holidays)



  





 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
 



 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our company policy is to recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 



 This job description is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employer reserves the right to modify, add, or remove responsibilities and requirements as business needs change. This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and should not be construed as a contract of employment.

title: Quality Control Engineer
description:
**About the Job** 




  





**Company Description** 




 Protouch is India’s leading beauty\-tech brand, redefining personal care with luxurious, high\-performance, technology\-driven devices. From hair care to skincare, we create professional\-grade tools designed to deliver a premium, salon\-like experience at home. Guided by innovation and science\-backed solutions, Protouch is committed to making beauty routines smarter, safer, and effortlessly elevated. Learn more at
 **www.protouchskin.com** 
**.** 




  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad for a
 **QC Engineer** 
 . The role involves ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of Protouch products across different stages of manufacturing and operations. Daily responsibilities include conducting quality inspections, monitoring product and process quality, identifying defects or deviations, maintaining QC documentation, and coordinating with production, warehouse, R\&D/NPD, and other teams to resolve quality\-related issues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct quality inspections and testing of raw materials, components, packaging materials, in\-process products, and finished products.
* Ensure products meet defined quality specifications, standards, and internal quality parameters.
* Monitor quality at different stages of the manufacturing, assembly, and packaging processes.
* Identify, document, and report defects, deviations, and non\-conformities.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for quality issues and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Maintain QC records, inspection reports, test reports, checklists, and other quality\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with Production, R\&D/NPD, Warehouse, and Operations teams to identify and resolve quality concerns.
* Conduct regular inspections of production and packaging processes to ensure compliance with approved SOPs and quality standards.
* Support the development, implementation, and improvement of quality control procedures and SOPs.
* Monitor rejected or non\-conforming materials/products and ensure proper segregation and documentation.
* Assist in handling product quality complaints and support investigation and resolution.
* Participate in internal quality audits and ensure necessary corrective actions are implemented.
* Monitor recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements to reduce defects, wastage, and customer complaints.
* Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and compliance throughout the quality control process.


- 


**Qualification** 



* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Assembly, FMCG, Consumer Electronics, Cosmetics, Beauty \& Personal Care, or a related industry.
* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Control processes, inspection procedures, and quality documentation.
* Good understanding of ISO standards, GMP, SOPs, and quality management practices.
* Knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and non\-conformance management.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Good attention to detail with a quality\-focused approach.
* Good communication and coordination skills with the ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic reporting/documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple quality requirements and meet timelines.
* Experience in beauty, skincare, personal care, consumer electronics, D2C, or product\-based companies will be preferred.
* Knowledge of product testing, inspection tools, and quality audit processes will be an added advantage.



**Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:** 
**hr@protouchskin.com**

title: Scriptwriter(Short Form)
description:
**We’re Hiring: Short\-Form Educational Scriptwriter** 




  





 I’m looking for a very strong scriptwriter to work on my personal brand at Konvo Media.
 



 The goal is simple:
 



  





 Create educational short\-form videos that people actually want to watch till the end.
 



  





**The content will revolve around topics such as:** 



* India and its development
* Global issues
* Business and economics
* Society and culture
* Geopolitics
* Interesting problems India faces
* Ideas that can help people understand the world better
* Most videos will be under 60 seconds.



  





 So we’re not looking for someone who can just “write well.”
 



 We’re looking for someone who understands attention.
 



  





 Someone who can take a complicated topic and turn it into:
 



  





**A strong hook → curiosity → simple explanation → tension/story → memorable payoff.** 




  





 You should understand how to make an educational video feel interesting without making it clickbait or dumbing it down.
 



  





**What matters to us** 




 You should ideally have a proven track record of writing high\-performing educational content for creators, personal brands, media companies, or similar channels.
 



  





**You should understand:** 



* Short\-form storytelling
* High\-retention hooks
* Curiosity gaps
* Simplifying complex ideas
* Research and fact\-finding
* Pacing
* Writing in a natural spoken voice
* Why someone would share a video
* Why someone would stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds



  





 Your degree doesn't matter.
 



 Your years of experience don't matter nearly as much as your work.
 



  





 If you've written educational videos that have generated serious views, that's what we want to see.
 



  





**This is NOT for:** 



* Generic brand copywriters.
* Ad\-copy specialists.
* Writers who only write captions.
* People whose entire process is asking AI to generate a script and lightly rewriting it.



  





 We're looking for someone who can think, research, find the angle, and tell the story.
 



  





**Role: Short\-Form Educational Scriptwriter** 




**Company: Konvo Media Private Limited** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




**Focus: Personal Brand \+ Educational Content** 




  





**To apply, send:** 



1. Your best 3–5 scripts/videos you've worked on
2. The views those videos generated, wherever possible

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Build the Future of Generative AI with goML** 




 At goML, we’re building the next generation of Machine Learning platforms and Generative AI services that solve real\-world enterprise problems. We work at the intersection of cutting\-edge research and production\-grade engineering—turning ideas into scalable, impactful AI systems.
 



 We’re looking for a AI / Machine Learning Engineer to join our core team of young hustlers. In this role, you’ll design, build, and productionize GenAI systems—from model training and fine\-tuning to deployment and monitoring. If you’re excited about shaping how AI is built, scaled, and delivered, this is the place for you.
 



  





**Why You? Why Now?** 




 Generative AI is moving fast—from experimentation to enterprise adoption. We need engineers who can bridge research and production, build reliable ML pipelines, and turn GenAI breakthroughs into real business outcomes. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys ownership, experimentation, and solving complex problems end to end.
 



  





**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)** 




  





 First 30 Days: Foundation \& Immersion
 


* Understand goML’s ML and GenAI platforms, use cases, and architecture
* Get familiar with existing training, inference, and deployment pipelines
* Study current approaches to RAG, LLM fine\-tuning, and model evaluation
* Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to understand business problems



  





 First 60 Days: Build \& Experiment
 


* Design and develop Generative AI solutions using techniques like RAG, transformers, and LLM\-based architectures
* Fine\-tune pre\-trained LLMs for domain\-specific and task\-specific use cases
* Build and maintain data pipelines for training and inference workflows
* Apply strong software engineering practices to ML and GenAI pipelines
* Evaluate, analyze, and benchmark model performance and quality
* Develop and deploy proof\-of\-concept GenAI systems



  





 First 180 Days: Ownership \& Scale
 


* Own end\-to\-end ML/GenAI pipelines—from training to production deployment
* Implement model optimization and compression techniques where applicable
* Productionize ML and GenAI research for real\-world enterprise use cases
* Monitor deployed models and continuously improve performance and reliability
* Stay current with advancements in Generative AI and apply them thoughtfully
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to solve challenging business problems at scale



  





**What You Bring (Qualifications \& Skills)** 




 Must\-Have
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, or related domains
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Hands\-on experience with RAG and LLM\-based architectures
* Experience building data pipelines, deploying ML/GenAI models, and maintaining them in production
* Solid understanding of ML/GenAI evaluation techniques
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and Linux\-based systems
* Experience working with cloud platforms, especially AWS ML/GenAI services



  





 Nice\-to\-Have
 


* Exposure to model compression and optimization techniques
* Experience with popular ML/GenAI frameworks and tools
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and monitoring systems
* Experience working in fast\-paced startup environments



  





 Who You Are
 


* A strong problem\-solver with a research\-driven yet pragmatic mindset
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively
* Methodical, detail\-oriented, and thoughtful in planning and execution
* A clear communicator who can explain complex ideas simply



  





 Why Work With Us?
 


* Be part of a core team building next\-gen ML \& GenAI platforms
* Work on real enterprise problems, not just experiments
* High ownership, rapid learning, and strong growth opportunities
* Remote\-first, with opportunities for in\-person collaboration
* A culture built around curiosity, hustle, and impact

title: Junior resident in orthopaedics
description:
**Company Description** 
 Rohini Hospital is an emerging healthcare facility serving the Cherpu area, focused on delivering attentive and personalized patient care. The hospital offers overnight services and a fully equipped emergency wing with updated medical technology. Each department is supported by specialized doctors, enabling comprehensive and coordinated treatment. The campus includes ambient parking facilities, contributing to a comfortable and accessible experience for patients, visitors, and staff. Rohini Hospital is committed to continuous improvement in clinical standards and service quality.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Junior Resident in Orthopaedics will provide inpatient and outpatient care under the supervision of senior orthopaedic consultants, including history\-taking, physical examination, and formulation of preliminary management plans. Daily responsibilities include assisting in orthopaedic surgeries and procedures, monitoring post\-operative patients, writing progress notes, and ensuring accurate documentation of clinical findings. The role also involves participating in ward rounds, coordinating with nursing and allied health teams, responding to emergency orthopaedic cases, and supporting pre\- and post\-operative counselling. The Junior Resident is expected to engage in clinical meetings, case discussions, and ongoing learning to enhance orthopaedic knowledge and skills. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based at Rohini Hospital in Thrissur.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Recognized MBBS degree with successful completion of internship; registration with the appropriate medical council.
* Foundational clinical skills in history\-taking, physical examination, differential diagnosis, and formulation of basic treatment plans.
* Basic orthopaedic knowledge, including common fractures, joint disorders, trauma management, and post\-operative care.
* Competence in routine clinical procedures (e.g., IV line insertion, wound care, splinting, and assisting in minor and major orthopaedic procedures).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with patients, families, and multidisciplinary care teams.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure clinical environments, prioritize tasks, and respond promptly to emergencies.
* Commitment to ethical medical practice, patient safety, and adherence to hospital protocols and infection control standards.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts, including nights and weekends, and to participate in continuous professional development.
* Previous exposure or training in orthopaedics through postings or electives is an advantage.

 Own a major product area. Lead the engineering. Stay deeply involved in the code.
 
 Script Assist is looking for a hands\-on
 **Lead Software Engineer** 
 with deep production experience in
 **Node.js, TypeScript and React** 
 to take technical ownership of a substantial part of our platform.
 



 We are particularly interested in engineers who have built and evolved
 **large, complex, multi\-tenant B2B SaaS products** 
 with:
 


* Multiple interconnected product modules
* Customer\-specific configurations
* Complex workflows and state transitions
* Roles and permissions
* Large integration surfaces
* APIs and webhooks
* Significant production data
* Different customer behaviours and requirements
* Years of accumulated product complexity



 This is not simply a senior developer position.
 



 We need someone who can
 **own an area technically** 
 , make important engineering decisions, maintain very high standards across the code written by others, mentor engineers and remain capable of personally solving the hardest technical problems.
 



 You may currently be a:
 


* Lead Software Engineer
* Lead Full Stack Engineer
* Technical Lead
* Tech Lead
* Senior Software Engineer
* Senior Full Stack Engineer
* Hands\-on Staff Engineer
* Full Stack Technical Lead



 Your current title matters less than the level at which you already operate.
   




 About Script Assist
 
 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the software and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform connects:
 


* Clinics
* Pharmacies
* Prescribers
* Patients
* Operational teams
* External technology providers



 and supports tens of thousands of structured clinical and pharmacy transactions every month.
 



 The platform includes complex functionality across:
 


* Clinical workflows
* Prescribing
* Medication management
* Pharmacy operations
* Inventory
* Dispensing
* Payments
* Subscriptions
* Fulfilment
* Communications
* Reporting
* Permissions
* Integrations
* Customer\-specific configuration
* Operational automation



 Healthcare experience is
 **not required** 
 .
 



 What matters is that you have already built sophisticated software products where many features, workflows, integrations and customer configurations interact with each other.
   




 The engineering problem
 
 Script Assist is not a simple CRUD application.
 



 Different customers may use the same underlying platform in different ways.
 



 A new feature can interact with:
 


* Existing workflows
* Different user roles
* Tenant\-specific configuration
* External integrations
* Payment states
* Operational processes
* Existing customer data
* Historical product decisions



 We need engineers who understand how to extend a mature shared product without creating an unmaintainable collection of exceptions.
 



 You should be comfortable thinking about questions such as:
 


* How should customer\-specific behaviour be represented?
* Should this be configuration or code?
* How should workflows be versioned?
* What happens to processes already in progress?
* How do we prevent duplicate actions when events retry?
* How do we maintain data integrity across several systems?
* How do we change one module without breaking another?
* How do we make increasingly complicated software easier—not harder—to maintain?


 🔧 What you will ownTechnical ownership
 
 You will take responsibility for a substantial product domain.
 



 That will include:
 


* Technical design
* Backend services
* Data models
* React applications
* APIs
* Integrations
* Testing strategy
* Deployment
* Production behaviour
* Technical debt
* Reliability



 You should become the person who can say:
 


**“I understand this area end\-to\-end and I am responsible for its technical quality.”** 
 Hands\-on engineering
 
 You will remain deeply involved in implementation.
 



 You will:
 


* Write production
 **Node.js / TypeScript** 
 backend code
* Build and review
 **React / TypeScript** 
 applications
* Design APIs and service contracts
* Work directly with databases
* Debug difficult production behaviour
* Refactor problematic areas
* Implement technically difficult functionality
* Review and improve existing architecture



 This is not an architecture\-only role.
 


 Technical leadership
 
 You will:
 


* Lead design discussions
* Break large engineering problems into sensible pieces
* Review important pull requests
* Maintain high coding standards
* Challenge poor abstractions
* Identify hidden dependencies
* Mentor engineers
* Improve testing and release discipline
* Establish reusable patterns
* Help engineers make better technical decisions



 The goal is
 **not** 
 for you to personally write every difficult piece of code.
 



 The goal is for the engineering around you to become better because you are there.
   




 The SaaS experience we care about
 
 We want engineers who have genuinely worked on
 **shared multi\-tenant software products** 
 .
 



 Relevant experience may include:
 


 Multi\-tenancy
 * Tenant isolation
* Tenant\-aware data models
* Customer configuration
* Entitlements
* Feature flags
* Organisation structures
* Multi\-company / multi\-entity architecture


 Complex workflows
 * Workflow engines
* Rules engines
* Approval processes
* State machines
* Status transitions
* Long\-running processes
* Workflow configuration
* Exception handling


 Permissions and governance
 * RBAC
* Roles and permissions
* Organisational hierarchies
* Audit trails
* Access control


 Integrations
 * REST APIs
* GraphQL
* Webhooks
* External services
* Background jobs
* Message queues
* Event\-driven systems
* Third\-party integration failures


 Production complexity
 * Idempotency
* Retries
* Concurrency
* Reconciliation
* Transactions
* Data migrations
* Backward compatibility
* Incident investigation
* Observability
* Safe releases



 You do not need every item above.
 



 You do need evidence that you have already worked inside a genuinely complex shared software product.
   




 Essential technical experience
 
 You should have substantial recent experience with:
 


* **Node.js**
* **TypeScript**
* **React / React.js**
* Backend service development
* API design
* Database design
* Production software
* Automated testing
* Git
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Cloud\-deployed systems



 Experience with the following is particularly useful:
 


* NestJS
* Express
* Fastify
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis
* GraphQL
* Kafka
* RabbitMQ
* SQS or other queues
* Kubernetes
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Observability and monitoring



 We do
 **not** 
 require one particular database or cloud provider.
 


 Important
 
 Your
 **Node.js experience must include real backend business logic and production services** 
 .
 



 Node used only for:
 


* Front\-end tooling
* SSR
* Build systems
* Very thin BFF layers



 will not be enough by itself.
   




 Relevant backgrounds
 
 We are particularly interested in engineers from mature
 **B2B SaaS and enterprise software product companies** 
 .
 



 Relevant environments may include teams at:
 


* Freshworks
* Okta / Auth0
* Blue Yonder / JDA Software
* LeadSquared
* Diligent
* Postman
* Other enterprise SaaS, workflow, CRM, identity, automation or operational\-software companies



 These companies are examples, not requirements.
 



 We care about what
 **you personally built and owned** 
 , not simply the logo on your CV.
   




 How we expect you to lead
 
 We want somebody who:
 


* Is obsessive about code quality
* Reviews other engineers’ work carefully
* Understands architectural consequences
* Spots complexity before it becomes technical debt
* Can challenge Product constructively
* Makes pragmatic trade\-offs
* Writes difficult code when necessary
* Helps others solve difficult problems
* Does not create dependency on themselves
* Takes responsibility for production outcomes



 Strong written and spoken English is important.
   




 Experience
 
 We expect most strong candidates will have approximately
 **8–14\+ years of software engineering experience** 
 .
 



 But years alone are not the deciding factor.
 



 An exceptional engineer with fewer years but substantial ownership can be more interesting than someone with a longer but narrower career.
   




 📈 Why join Script Assist?
 
 This is an opportunity to move from being one senior engineer inside a very large organisation to
 **owning a meaningful part of an entire product platform** 
 .
 



 You will have genuine influence over:
 


* Architecture
* Product behaviour
* Code quality
* Engineering standards
* Production reliability
* Technical strategy
* How other engineers work



 You will remain hands\-on.
 



 But your impact should increasingly come not only from the code you write yourself, but from the quality of the entire area you lead.

**Description:**
 The AI Lab is the engineering core of our Risk Modeling Solutions (RMS) team, focused on integrating Gen AI solutions into our risk management framework. The team is responsible for building and deploying practical, high\-impact applications that combine deep quantitative analysis with cutting\-edge AI. These solutions enhance analytical decision\-making, automate complex reporting, and create significant operational efficiencies for the business.
   

  

**The responsibility includes but not limited to the following activities:**
* Architect Agentic Systems: Design and lead the implementation of complex, multi\-agent AI workflows capable of advanced reasoning, planning, and autonomous execution using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, and Google ADK.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
**Who are we?** 




 We at Epikindifi (Epik) are building a zero\-code platform that lets businesses build their own apps through a simple, intuitive interface. We're disruptive, hardworking, highly adaptable, and constantly evolving.
 



  





**Who would you be?** 




 You're a full\-stack engineer who lives in the MEAN stack and owns features from the Angular front end through to Node.js services and the data layer. You enjoy encoding real business logic in clean code, and you're not afraid to reach for new technologies when they're the right fit.
 



  





**What you get to do in this role** 




  




* Build and maintain internet\-scale applications and services to a high standard of engineering excellence, across the full stack.
* Own features end\-to\-end: scoping, technical design, implementation across front end and back end, testing, and production rollout.
* Independently deliver new integration frameworks, or extend existing ones, to implement features of medium to high complexity.
* Partner with Project Managers across the org on project and release planning.
* Deliver high\-quality, well\-written code that others can quickly understand, support, and maintain.
* Write automated test cases that plug into our Continuous Integration (CI) pipeline.
 
 Work within a Lean\-Agile / Scrum framework to ship features to production predictably.
* Build effective relationships with product management, technical teams, systems operations, and service and support.
* Present and communicate complex ideas and features clearly to a broad audience.



  





**What you should have** 



* 3–5 years in software development, with a minimum of 3\+ years on the MEAN stack.
* Deep understanding of JavaScript, and hands\-on experience with TypeScript.
* Strong command of Node.js and its ecosystem, including Express (or similar frameworks).
* Solid experience with Angular (recent versions) and modern front\-end JavaScript.
* Deep understanding of HTML, CSS, and SCSS.
* Confident with asynchronous programming and how to apply it pragmatically.
* Production experience with MongoDB and MySQL, including data modelling and schema design that maps cleanly to business processes.
* Deep understanding of MongoDB and query optimization.
* Working knowledge of caching mechanisms (Redis).
* **Experience with message queues — ideally RabbitMQ** 
 — and event\-driven patterns (publish/subscribe, work queues, retries, dead\-letter, idempotency).
* Ability to model and apply authorization and permission control across users, systems, and services.
* Ability to serve different data sources and databases to different client platforms (mobile vs desktop) with optimal output.
* Familiarity with building scalable Node.js applications.
* Strong testing discipline — unit and integration — integrated into CI.
* Comfort with Docker and containerized deployment; exposure to a cloud platform (Azure/AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Fluent with Git\-based workflows (GitLab).



  





**Nice to have** 



* Working experience with Web Components.
* Working experience with React.
* GraphQL.
* **Experience building no\-code / low\-code platforms** 
 or highly configurable, metadata\-driven systems — a strong plus given Epik's zero\-code product.
* Prior work on developer platforms or complex web applications.



  





**What you get** 




 Competitive compensation, generous benefits, and a collaborative, inclusive environment. Individuals strong on aptitude and attitude will get to grow their careers working on advanced technology alongside talented developers, and help shape a product from an early stage.

title: Full stack Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer skilled in building scalable web applications using React / Next.js on the frontend
   

  

 and Python frameworks (Django and FastAPI) on the backend. You’ll work closely with product, design, and DevOps teams
   

  

 to deliver reliable, high\-performing applications hosted on AWS, backed by PostgreSQL and Snowflake. We value
   

  

 developers who leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate delivery
   

  

 and maintain code quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

* Build secure, scalable RESTful and async APIs; integrate with third\-party services as needed.

 workflows.

title: Staff Software Engineer – Full Stack | Node.js, TypeScript, React | Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS
description:
📍
 **Remote – India** 




**💰 ₹25–50 LPA total CTC, depending on experience and scope** 




**🕒 Full\-time** 




  





**Staff Engineer \| Node.js \| TypeScript \| React \| Multi\-Tenant SaaS \| Software Architecture \| Technical Leadership**



 Shape the architecture. Control the quality. Stay hands\-on.
 
 Script Assist is looking for a hands\-on
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 with deep production experience in
 **Node.js, TypeScript and React** 
 to help shape the architecture and technical direction of a complex multi\-tenant healthcare SaaS platform.
 



 We are looking for someone who has already worked on a substantial
 **enterprise B2B SaaS product** 
 and understands what happens as that product becomes large:
 


* More modules
* More integrations
* More customer configuration
* More workflow variation
* More roles and permissions
* More historical data
* More dependencies
* More engineers
* More opportunities for seemingly small changes to have unexpected consequences



 You may currently be a:
 


* Staff Software Engineer
* Staff Engineer
* Staff Full Stack Engineer
* Lead Software Engineer
* Principal\-level IC
* Senior Technical Lead
* Experienced Senior Software Engineer already operating beyond your formal title



 This is
 **not** 
 an Engineering Manager position.
 



 It is also not an architect role where you stop working in production code.
 



 You will remain technically hands\-on while influencing the quality and direction of engineering well beyond your own implementation work.
   




 About Script Assist
 
 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the technology and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 



 It supports substantial functionality across:
 


* Clinical workflows
* Prescribing
* Medication management
* Pharmacy workflows
* Inventory
* Dispensing
* Payments
* Subscriptions
* Fulfilment
* Communications
* Reporting
* Permissions
* Customer configuration
* Third\-party integrations



 The difficult engineering problem is not any one of these features.
 



 It is
 **how they interact** 
 .
 



 A workflow may behave differently depending on:
 


* Customer
* Clinical service
* User role
* Pharmacy
* Medication
* Configuration
* Integration
* Payment status
* Previous actions
* Operational exceptions



 The product therefore needs engineers who can understand local implementation details while simultaneously protecting the coherence of the wider platform.
   




 🧭 Your role
 
 You will take deep technical ownership of a substantial part of Script Assist while helping establish engineering patterns that scale beyond it.
 



 You will move comfortably between:
 


* Architecture
* Product behaviour
* Node.js services
* React applications
* Databases
* Integrations
* Code review
* Production incidents
* Mentoring
* Technical strategy



 You should be able to understand the hardest parts of the codebase without becoming the only person capable of changing them.
   




 Architecture and system design
 
 You will:
 


* Define domain and module boundaries
* Design backend services and APIs
* Define data ownership
* Review database models
* Design integration patterns
* Establish appropriate shared abstractions
* Improve configuration architecture
* Challenge unnecessary coupling
* Reduce fragile customer\-specific behaviour
* Lead important technical migrations
* Help simplify accumulated complexity



 You should understand when to introduce:
 


* Configuration
* Shared services
* Events
* Queues
* Transactions
* APIs
* Feature flags
* Migration layers



 and equally importantly, when
 **not** 
 to introduce them.
   




 Hands\-on engineering
 
 You will remain capable of personally implementing difficult production changes.
 



 That includes:
 


* **Node.js / TypeScript backend development**
* **React / TypeScript frontend development**
* **API design**
* **Database work**
* **Integration development**
* **Debugging**
* **Performance investigation**
* **Refactoring**
* **Testing**
* **Production incident investigation**



 You should still enjoy working directly with code.
   




 Multi\-tenant SaaS complexity
 
 The strongest candidates will have experience with products where many customers share the same platform while behaving differently.
 



 Relevant problems include:
 


 Tenant architecture
 * Tenant isolation
* Tenant\-aware data models
* Customer\-specific configuration
* Organisations and sub\-organisations
* Entitlements
* Feature flags


 Workflow complexity
 * Workflow engines
* State machines
* Rules engines
* Configurable business logic
* Approval flows
* Long\-running workflows
* Versioned workflows
* Exception handling


 Permissions
 * RBAC
* User roles
* Organisation\-level access
* Fine\-grained permissions
* Auditability


 Integrations
 * REST APIs
* GraphQL
* Webhooks
* Public APIs
* External systems
* Background jobs
* Asynchronous processing
* Event\-driven architecture


 Distributed\-system behaviour
 * Idempotency
* Retries
* Partial failures
* Transactions
* Outbox patterns
* Queues
* Dead\-letter handling
* Concurrency
* Reconciliation
* Correlation IDs


 Product evolution
 * Schema changes
* Data migrations
* Backward compatibility
* Safe rollouts
* Feature flags
* Progressive migrations
* Production monitoring
* Incident recovery



 You do not need to have implemented every specific pattern.
 



 We care about whether you have
 **actually solved these kinds of problems** 
 .
   




 Technical leadership
 
 A Staff Engineer at Script Assist should improve the work of other engineers.
 



 You will:
 


* Lead important design reviews
* Review difficult code
* Challenge poor technical decisions
* Establish engineering patterns
* Mentor Senior and mid\-level engineers
* Help engineers decompose complex problems
* Document major technical decisions
* Improve testing strategy
* Improve observability
* Help identify technical debt worth solving
* Resolve architectural disagreements
* Work with Product on technical trade\-offs
* Raise the quality of engineering across your area



 We do not want someone who responds to every difficult problem by saying:
 


 “I'll just build it myself.”
 
 You should be capable of solving the hardest problems while making the people around you increasingly capable of solving them too.
   




 Production ownership
 
 You will take responsibility beyond merge and deployment.
 



 You should care about:
 


* What happened in production
* Whether customers are seeing unexpected behaviour
* Performance
* Errors
* Failed integrations
* Operational recovery
* Logging
* Monitoring
* Reconciliation
* Incident prevention



 A major production incident should result not merely in a patch, but in a better system afterwards.
   




 Essential technical background
 
 We need substantial recent production experience with:
 


* **Node.js**
* **TypeScript**
* **React / React.js**
* **Backend systems**
* **API design**
* **Databases**
* **Distributed applications**
* **Automated testing**
* **Git**
* **Docker**
* **CI/CD**
* **Cloud environments**
* **Production observability**



 Particularly relevant:
 


* NestJS
* Express
* Fastify
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis
* GraphQL
* Kafka
* RabbitMQ
* SQS
* Kubernetes
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Integration testing
* Event\-driven systems



 One particular database, message broker or cloud provider is
 **not** 
 mandatory.
 


 Node.js requirement
 
 We need genuine
 **backend Node.js ownership** 
 .
 



 Experience limited to:
 


* Front\-end build tooling
* Server\-side rendering
* Simple proxy services
* Thin BFF layers



 is insufficient unless you also have substantial Node.js backend experience elsewhere.
   




 Relevant product backgrounds
 
 The most interesting candidates will often come from mature enterprise SaaS products involving:
 


* Workflow management
* Automation
* CRM
* Identity
* Permissions
* Governance
* APIs
* Developer platforms
* Operational systems
* Enterprise configuration



 Potentially relevant engineering environments include:
 


* Okta / Auth0
* Blue Yonder / JDA Software
* Freshworks
* Diligent
* Postman
* LeadSquared
* Comparable enterprise SaaS businesses



 These are examples only.
 



 We assess
 **your actual product ownership** 
 , not your employer's brand.
   




 How you should think
 
 We are interested in engineers who ask questions such as:
 


* What is the real domain boundary here?
* Is this customer\-specific or product behaviour?
* Should this become configuration?
* What happens to existing tenants?
* What happens to workflows already underway?
* What happens if the event arrives twice?
* How do we recover from partial failure?
* How do we prove this migration is safe?
* How will another engineer understand this in two years?
* How do we make this simpler rather than merely making it work?



 That style of reasoning matters enormously.
   




 Communication and judgement
 
 You will work directly with senior Product and Engineering colleagues across the UK and India.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Explain difficult technical concepts clearly
* Challenge assumptions constructively
* Defend technical decisions with evidence
* Understand commercial/product constraints
* Avoid overengineering
* Make pragmatic trade\-offs
* Communicate clearly in written English
* Mentor without patronising or micromanaging


 Experience
 
 We expect strong candidates will typically have approximately
 **8–14\+ years of software engineering experience** 
 .
 



 However, Staff\-level scope matters more than calendar years.
 



 You do not necessarily need to hold a Staff title today.
 



 A Lead or exceptional Senior engineer who is already:
 


* Leading architecture
* Influencing several engineers
* Reviewing critical work
* Owning production behaviour
* Taking responsibility beyond individual features



 can absolutely be relevant.
   




 📈 Why join Script Assist?
 
 At a very large organisation, a Staff Engineer may own one layer or one subsystem of a much bigger machine.
 



 At Script Assist, you can have meaningful influence across a significant part of the product.
 



 You will help determine:
 


* How major areas are designed
* How the platform handles customer variation
* How engineers structure new functionality
* How code quality is maintained
* How technical debt is reduced
* How production issues are prevented
* How engineering scales as the company grows



 You will remain hands\-on.
 



 But the objective is not simply to become the person who can write the most difficult code.
 


* The objective is to make a substantial part of the platform — and the engineers responsible for it —
 **better because of your technical leadership** 
 .

title: Software Engineer-Full Stack Software Engineer (Java + Angular)
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Software Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise web applications. The ideal candidate will have strong backend expertise in Java and Spring Boot, paired with robust front\-end development skills using Angular. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams in an Agile environment to deliver high\-quality, high\-performance software solutions.**

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**

* Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Exposure to integrating AI capabilities (such as OpenAI/LLMs) into enterprise applications.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
* Backend: 3–6 years of strong hands\-on experience with Core Java (Java 8 or higher), OOP concepts, Collections, and Multithreading. Extensive experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security).

* Architecture: Deep understanding of microservices architecture and web service integration (REST/JSON).
* Version Control \& Tools: Strong proficiency with Git (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket) and build tools like Maven or Gradle.
* Methodology: Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 Under 10%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 None
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 Yes
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. title: Senior Software Engineer (3 - 6 years of experience in Java full-stack development, Angular / React, GenAI)
description:

 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of our development team to help design, enhance and build our HR platform in an agile development environment, you will work independently with minimal insight to develop software that conforms to Visa’s high standards. As part of this self\-driven team, you will have total ownership of the solutions we provide for our HR customers making availability, performance, security, and reliability critical to our success. You will work with colleagues, who will support and challenge you daily. You will play part of multiple teams tasked with multiple projects.  2\+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5\+ years of relevant work experience
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience of building innovative and scalable products.
* You understand the trade\-offs of speed vs quality on technical decisions and look at problems from different angles.

* Extensive experience working with Java, Node.js and JavaScript
* Experience with Generative AI:
* Understanding of transformers, GANs, VAEs, and other generative architectures.
* Application of NLP, multimodal AI, and AI\-powered developer tools in production systems.
* Practical exposure to prompt engineering and tooling orchestration for AI agents in enterprise environments, ensuring reproducibility and compliance.
* Experience with cloud\-native DevOps:
* AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code

title: Lead  Software Engineer(Python/AWS/SQL)
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Roles at Lead IC level solve complex problems and guide others through code, design, and architecture. Scope includes
   

  

 owning technical direction and architecture in a defined area, mentoring peers, and raising quality through reuse and hands\-on
   

  

 support. The impact is consistent, high\-quality solutions that reduce duplication and accelerate team delivery.
   

  

 \#\# ROLE SUMMARY
   

  

 Are you a software developer who loves building software that actually gets used?
   

  

 Join us at FTSE Russell! We're building a team of engineers who care about software craftsmanship, clean code, and shipping things that matter. As a Software Engineer, you'll build the services, libraries, and applications that power the indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide.
   

  

 We work primarily in Python, so that's our preference — but we care far more about whether you can genuinely build software than about which language you built it in. If your track record is in Java, C\#, C, C\+\+, Scala, Go, or Rust and you're keen to work in Python, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers pick up a new language quickly; strong engineering judgement takes years.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on software development role. You'll spend your days designing, coding, testing, and shipping — in a modern AWS environment, alongside engineers who review each other's code, pair when it helps, and take real ownership of what they build. The systems you work on handle serious volumes of financial data, so there's a rich data dimension to the problems — but the craft we're hiring for is software engineering.
   

  

 If you've built real software and want to keep building, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 \#\# WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
   

  

 We're building the next\-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell — and we want you to help build it:
   

  

 Looking for 10\+yrs of experience in writing production code, primarily in Python — services, APIs, libraries, and command\-line tools that are modular, well\-tested, and built to be maintained by others
   

  

* Designing and building software components end to end, from breaking down a problem through to deployment and support in production
* Applying modern software engineering practices every day: version control, trunk\-based development, CI/CD, code review, refactoring, and automated testing (unit, integration, contract)
* Taking ownership of features and systems — you debug your own problems, fix them properly, and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver
* Designing data models and integrations across relational databases (Aurora PostgreSQL) and object storage, thinking carefully about schema design, evolution, and backwards compatibility
* Building software that processes data at scale on AWS — Lambda, S3, containerised services, and where appropriate the AWS data stack (Glue, EMR Serverless)
* Building observability in from the start — structured logging, metrics, tracing, and meaningful alerting, so that we know how our software behaves in production
* Contributing to design and architecture discussions, and to our shared engineering standards
* Working directly with product and business teams to turn requirements into working software
* Learning the financial indices domain and sharing what you learn with the team


 \#\# WHAT YOU'LL BRING
   

  

 Essential — this is the bar:
   

  

* You have built and shipped real software. Not scripts and notebooks — applications, services, or libraries that other people depended on, that you maintained and evolved over time
* Python is our preference, but not a hard gate. Either you already write strong production Python, or you have that depth in another serious general\-purpose language — Java, C\#, C, C\+\+, Scala, Go, or Rust — and are genuinely motivated to work in Python here. We'll give you the time and support to get fluent
* You write clean, maintainable, testable, extensible code. In Python that means type hints, linters and formatters (ruff, mypy, black), and a genuine testing habit with pytest; we'd expect the equivalent discipline in whatever language you've come from
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — modular design, sensible abstractions, dependency management, packaging, error handling, and knowing when \*not\* to add a layer
* You are hands\-on and want to stay hands\-on. You enjoy being in the code
* Practical experience with Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD
* Strong experience with relational databases (e.g. Aurora PostgreSQL) — schema design, query writing, and understanding what happens under the hood
* Working knowledge of a cloud platform, ideally AWS (S3, Lambda, containers, IAM basics)
* You're comfortable with data\-shaped problems — batch processing, ETL, schema evolution — or you're keen to learn them
* You enjoy the business context and working closely with stakeholders rather than at arm's length
* You work well in Agile teams and value collaboration over solo heroics


 \#\# NICE TO HAVES
   

  

 Great if you bring these, but we'll happily teach you:
   

  

* Apache Spark / PySpark or other large\-scale distributed processing
* Big data experience — working with datasets and workloads that don't fit on one machine
* Additional languages used in data\-intensive software — Scala, Java, C\+\+, Go, or Rust — particularly where you've used them for performance\-sensitive or high\-throughput work
* Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar open table formats, and lakehouse architecture
* Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable data platforms
* CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK)
* Data quality frameworks like Great Expectations or Deequ
* Curiosity about financial markets, index data, or investment analytics
* Experience in finance domain (investment banking, asset/portfolio management) or in any product company


 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to build software that matters, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Career Stage:**
 Manager
   

  

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
   

  

 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
 **Integrity, Partnership** 
 ,
 **Excellence** 
 and
 **Change** 
 underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
   

  

 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
   

  

 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
