title: AWS Migration Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Consultant / Migration Engineer (Cloud – AWS) 
 



**Job Summary:** 
  
   

 Ensono’s Cloud Consultancy team is expanding to meet increasing client demand for complex, high\-value cloud transformation projects, ranging from traditional lift\-and\-shift migrations to advanced platform modernization (VM to PaaS or serverless). We are seeking Consultants to join our AWS team, delivering thought leadership and high\-quality solutions for enterprise clients leveraging AWS public cloud. 
 



 We are looking for an
 **AWS Migration Engineer / Consultant** 
 to support the design, implementation, and migration of workloads to AWS cloud environments. You will work closely with senior architects, clients, and delivery teams to execute migration projects, deploy AWS services, implement automation, and ensure smooth transitions from on‑premises to cloud. This role is ideal for someone with hands\-on AWS experience who is growing toward senior cloud Consultant or architecture responsibilities. 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



**Migration \& Deployment** 
  
 


* Support migration projects involving servers, applications, and databases from on‑premises or private cloud to AWS.


* Participate in assessment, discovery, planning, cutover, and post‑migration optimization.


* Execute re\-hosting and re\-platforming activities using AWS migration tools (Application Migration Service, DMS, Migration Hub, App2Container).


* Deploy, configure, and validate AWS services and infrastructure components.



**Cloud Engineering \& Automation** 
  
 


* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.


* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for IaC and application deployments.


* Support creation and maintenance of reusable Terraform modules and automation scripts.


* Assist in enforcing quality and security checks (tflint, Checkov, tfsec).



**Operational Support \& Troubleshooting** 
  
 


* Assist in integration, testing, and troubleshooting of AWS workloads.


* Monitor environments using CloudWatch, X\-Ray, Config, and related tools.


* Support optimization efforts for cost, performance, and security.



**Documentation \& Collaboration** 
  
 


* Prepare technical documentation, runbooks, and migration playbooks.


* Participate in client workshops and provide technical inputs when required.


* Collaborate with global delivery teams and follow established cloud best practices.


* Engage in internal learning, certifications, and capability\-building initiatives.



  
 



**Technical Requirements** 
  
 



**Cloud \& AWS Knowledge** 
  
 


* Working experience with core AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS basics).


* Understanding of AWS multi\-account management, Organizations, and Control Tower (preferred).



**Migration Tools \& Methods** 
  
 


* Familiarity with at least one AWS migration tool:


* Application Migration Service


* Database Migration Service (DMS)


* Migration Hub


* App2Container


* Understanding of migration approaches (re\-host, re\-platform, refactor basics).



**Infrastructure as Code \& Automation** 
  
 


* Hands\-on experience with Terraform or CloudFormation.


* Basic knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins).


* Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.



**Containers \& Modernization (Nice to Have)** 
  
 


* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), or AWS serverless services like Lambda.


* Monitoring, Security \& Governance


* Understanding of AWS monitoring and security tools (CloudWatch, Config, GuardDuty).


* Awareness of IAM best practices and least privilege principles.



  
 



**Non\-Technical Requirements** 
  
 


* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.


* Good communication skills with the ability to interact with clients and team members.


* Self\-driven, eager to learn, and capable of working collaboratively in global teams.


* Organized and able to handle multiple tasks in fast\-paced environments.


* High integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.



**Industry Qualifications:** 
  
 


* 5\+ years in technology consulting leadership roles.


* 4\+ years in AWS technology planning and implementation, with a track record of leading large\-scale AWS projects.


* Bachelor’s Degree (BE) in a related field required; Master’s Degree preferred.



  
 



**Certifications:** 
  
 


* AWS Solutions Architect –Professional


* AWS DevOps Engineer – Associate / Professional


* HashiCorp Terraform Associate

 Cloud platform engineering
   

  

 AI/ML systems and MLOps
   

  

 Data engineering and analytics
   

  

 IoT and device\-facing platforms

 Communicate platform strategy, delivery progress, ROI, and risk transparently to senior leadership.

 This role has enterprise\-wide impact across CSW and Lenovo’s broader product ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Outcomes Include**

**The Senior Manager Leads a Senior Leadership Bench, Including**

 AI Systems Architect
   

  

 Delivery Manager
   

  

 The role carries full accountability for organizational design, talent strategy, engineering excellence, and delivery execution across a rapidly growing global team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**

 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud platforms, or distributed systems, with senior leadership responsibility

 Proven experience delivering global, fault\-tolerant platforms (e.g., 300M\+ events/day, 99\.9% uptime)
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of AI/ML Systems, Including**

 Mastermindnetwork is the hiring organization for this Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation opportunity. The available company brief does not include additional information about its industry, operating scale, culture, products, customers, milestones, or market position, so no unsupported claims have been added. This role is defined around enterprise finance transformation ownership across Record to Report, Order to Cash, and Procure to Pay. The successful leader will connect finance process redesign, ERP implementation, technology decisions, and measurable business outcomes. The position is based in Delhi or Hyderabad and requires working from the office. Candidates should bring substantial experience leading complex transformation programs, preferably from a consulting background, with mandatory end\-to\-end implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise resource planning platform. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory for consideration. The role is intended for an operator who can combine executive stakeholder leadership with practical techno\-functional delivery depth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the finance transformation agenda across R2R, O2C, and P2P, converting business priorities into scalable process, technology, and operating\-model outcomes. Lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation programs across discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization. Act as the senior techno\-functional bridge between finance leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, system integrators, and executive sponsors. Establish governance, architecture alignment, delivery controls, and benefits tracking across the portfolio. The role requires practical hands\-on understanding rather than advisory\-only exposure, with the ability to challenge designs, resolve complex dependencies, and make implementation decisions. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory, while consulting experience is preferred. Success will be measured through adoption, process standardization, controls, reporting quality, cycle\-time improvement, and sustained business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the integrated transformation roadmap across R2R, O2C, and P2P, aligning process, data, controls, and ERP decisions with enterprise finance outcomes and measurable value realization.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP, Oracle, or comparable ERP implementation delivery from requirements and solution design through testing, cutover, stabilization, and post\-go\-live performance improvement.
* Govern system integrators, functional workstreams, and senior stakeholders through structured decision forums, risk controls, dependency management, and transparent executive reporting.
* Translate finance operating\-model requirements into practical techno\-functional solutions, challenging process designs and configuration choices that create standardization, control, scalability, and user adoption.
* Build transformation benefits tracking across close, collections, payables, working capital, compliance, reporting quality, and process cycle times to demonstrate sustained business impact.
* Apply FMCG or CPG project experience to address high\-volume, multi\-entity, customer, supplier, inventory, and commercial finance complexities within transformation programs.
* Lead change adoption across finance and business teams by establishing ownership, capability building, communication, and operating discipline required for new processes and systems.
* Resolve cross\-tower issues decisively, balancing business continuity, implementation timelines, risk exposure, architecture integrity, and long\-term maintainability.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Mandatory hands\-on, end\-to\-end implementation experience with SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise ERP platform, covering design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Strong techno\-functional command of R2R, O2C, and P2P processes, including controls, master data, integrations, reporting, close, collections, procurement, and payables outcomes.
* Proven transformation governance capability across system integrators, cross\-functional teams, executive stakeholders, delivery risks, dependencies, benefits, and adoption measures.
* Mandatory experience delivering FMCG or CPG\-related transformation projects involving complex, high\-volume, multi\-entity finance and commercial operating environments.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, communication, and executive influencing skills, with the ability to convert ambiguity into implementable decisions and measurable outcomes.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience managing global or multi\-country ERP transformation programs with common templates, localization requirements, shared services, and complex integration landscapes.
* Exposure to finance data, analytics, automation, controls, process mining, or adjacent technologies that improve transparency, decision quality, and operational performance.
* Experience leading post\-go\-live optimization, value realization, and continuous improvement beyond initial implementation delivery.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 15–23 years of experience in finance transformation, ERP delivery, enterprise technology, consulting, or related leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex programs and business outcomes.
* Mandatory end\-to\-end ERP implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform, combining executive\-level leadership with sufficient hands\-on techno\-functional depth to guide critical design and delivery decisions.
* Mandatory FMCG or CPG project experience, including an understanding of high\-volume transactions, multi\-entity operations, commercial finance interfaces, supply\-chain dependencies, and the control environment required for scalable transformation.
* A consulting background is preferred, particularly experience advising senior finance and business leaders while also driving implementation execution, issue resolution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable value realization.
* B.Tech or another technical educational background, supported by strong understanding of finance processes across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
* An outcome\-led leadership style that creates accountability across internal teams, system integrators, business owners, and technology partners while maintaining delivery momentum and implementation quality.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a high\-impact enterprise finance transformation mandate spanning R2R, O2C, and P2P, with direct influence over process, technology, governance, and measurable business outcomes.
* Shape ERP\-led operating\-model change from strategy through implementation and value realization, working at the intersection of finance, technology, and business leadership.
* Bring consulting expertise and FMCG or CPG transformation experience into a senior role where practical delivery judgment and sustained adoption matter as much as strategic vision.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A Vice President\-level mandate with broad ownership of finance transformation across the core R2R, O2C, and P2P towers.
* The opportunity to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation and measurable operating improvement from either the Delhi or Hyderabad office, with a CTC range of ₹50–75 LPA.

description:
**Description**
**Software Engineering SMTS, Identity \& Access Management**
**About The Team**
 The Salesforce Enterprise Security Engineering team builds and operates highly scalable, fault\-tolerant, distributed systems that deliver cloud\-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across our Enterprise network, public cloud infrastructure, and internal data centers. We provide the core building blocks for identity lifecycle, governance, authentication, authorization and privileged access management that protect customer trust and empower every Salesforce engineer to operate securely, regardless of environment.
   

  

 We are seeking a full\-stack software engineer with a track record of building modern, secure services and applications following the Software Development Life Cycle and best security development practices. You'll work across the IAM domain, so a solid understanding of identity concepts in the authentication, authorization, and identity governance space is important for this role.
   

  

**About The Position**
 This is a hands\-on software engineering role with a focus on the IAM domain. You will design and build end\-to\-end capabilities from backend services and APIs to the user\-facing experiences that power identity lifecycle (human/non\-human), access requests, provisioning, entitlement/role management, access certifications, and policy\-driven access decisions at enterprise scale.
   

  

 You will secure the emerging agentic enterprise by designing controls for AI agents and autonomous workloads, including agent identity, privilege, least privilege, just\-in\-time access, time\-bound access, separation of duties, and continuous risk\-based access decisions.
   

  

 You will also own features through the full development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. You'll partner across application owners, product management, and governance to translate identity and compliance requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions. This work is foundational to advancing Salesforce's Zero Trust architecture, enabling dynamic, real\-time access decisions based on employment status, role change, and device or user trust.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, build, and operate scalable IAM services and APIs spanning identity lifecycle, access requests, entitlement/role management and access certifications.
   

  

 Build privileged access management (PAM) capabilities — credential vaulting/rotation, session control, and secrets management and just\-in\-time (JIT) access flows that grant elevated, time\-bound entitlements and revoke them automatically.
   

  

 Model and secure non\-human/workload identities (NHI) — service accounts, agents, workloads, and machine credentials — including issuance, rotation, and lifecycle governance.
   

  

 Develop full\-stack features, backend services and modern web front\-ends that deliver intuitive self\-service and administrative experiences for IAM.
   

  

 Build and manage containerized workloads with Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); operate services in a full DevOps model (monitor, troubleshoot, continuously improve).
   

  

 Integrate across identity sources, directories, and downstream applications using SCIM, REST, and event\-driven patterns.
   

  

 Partner with governance and compliance teams to embed SoD, least\-privilege, and audit controls (SOX, NIST, SOC 2\) into the platform.
   

  

 Write clean, maintainable, secure code; participate in design and code reviews; and champion secure SDLC practices.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across security, infrastructure, product, and engineering to ensure platform integrity and trustworthiness.
   

  

 Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and enablement materials.
   

  

 Design for significant features, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical direction and continuous improvement across the platform.
   

  

**Required Skills/Experience**
 SMTS: 5\+ years of professional software development experience building distributed systems in SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS environments.
   

  

 Full\-stack development proficiency: strong backend skills in Java, Go, and/or Python, plus front\-end experience with modern frameworks (e.g., React).
   

  

 Solid understanding of the IAM domain, identity governance/lifecycle, authentication, authorization, RBAC/entitlement models, privileged access management including just\-in\-time access and common protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, LDAP).
   

  

 Experience designing and consuming REST APIs (JSON/XML, OpenAPI/Swagger) and integrating heterogeneous systems.
   

  

 Strong experience on public cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), including containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with CI/CD and source control (Git, Jenkins, or equivalent), including secure coding and defensive programming.
   

  

 Solid grasp of DevOps practices, monitoring, and ownership of production systems in high\-availability environments.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience integrating AI/agentic capabilities into IAM workflows or user experiences.
   

  

 Experience with globally distributed teams and large enterprises.
   

  

 Familiarity with commercial IAM platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, Active Directory/EntraID) as a consumer or integrator, not required as a specialty.

 Heather Grey is a global uniforms supplier to top brands in Food Service, Hospitality, and Aviation – McDonald’s, KFC and Hilton Hotels being just some examples.
 



 We’ve been in the business for over 20 years and have consistently grown from a team of 2 people to over 150 today. We’re well known amongst the clients we serve and come with some brand recognition.
 



 Our office at Peninsula Corporate Park in Lower Parel is our beating heart – with high energy, intelligent, and motivated colleagues, and a dynamic work environment with tight collaboration across domains. You have to see it to feel it!
 



  
 



**Skills and Role:** 
 You will own technology at Heather Grey – both keeping the things we already run working, and building the things we don’t have yet. We don’t have specific requirements for your background – we just need you to be hands\-on, curious about how the business actually works, and comfortable being the person everyone comes to when something breaks.

 4\.   Keep the basics solid – devices, networks, access, backups and security across our offices and partner sites
 



 5\.   Manage our vendors and budgets, and be honest about what’s worth paying for

Company Description
 
  





 Digital Divide Data (DDD) delivers AI Data Solutions with human\-in\-the\-loop for LLMs and Physical AI, specializing in AI/ML model training and annotation services. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations in robotics, autonomous driving, government, defense tech, technology, AgTech, and cultural heritage, DDD helps ensure the safety, performance, and reliability of AI applications. DDD also offers Generative AI solutions such as NLP dataset creation, prompt engineering, model output evaluation, red teaming, reinforcement learning, fine\-tuning, and rigorous quality control. 
 



 Digital Divide Data is a mission driven social enterprise with the goal of using technology and digital skills to bridge the divide between economically and socially marginalized youth and employment opportunities that lead to a sustainable and viable future. Our headquarters are in New York, and we have over 2,500 employees across delivery centers in Kenya, Cambodia, Laos, Philippines, and India. 
 



 www.digitaldividedata.com
 



  




 About the Role
 
  






 In preparation for DDD’s next phase of growth, we're looking for a hands\-on
 
**Marketing and Revenue Operations Specialist** 

 to own the systems, data, and processes connecting marketing and sales in a fast\-moving organization. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining the integrity and performance of our HubSpot and Salesforce environments, transforming complex data into reliable dashboards that inform executive decision\-making, and establishing the operational infrastructure that aligns Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success into a cohesive revenue motion.
 





 This is a hands\-on position suited to a professional who is equally effective architecting Salesforce workflows, ensuring the accuracy and cleanliness of contact data, and presenting pipeline insights to senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings a disciplined approach to data governance and a proactive mindset toward reporting, delivering dashboards that anticipate the questions stakeholders need answered.
   






 Key Responsibilities
 

  





***Marketing Operations***



* Administer, configure, and optimize both HubSpot and Salesforce, including objects, fields, workflows, automation, permissions, and integrations between the two platforms and with Linkedin Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Ads and other marketing stack.
* Own list segmentation, lead scoring, and database hygiene (deduping, enrichment, opt\-in compliance).
* Track campaign performance and report on cost\-per\-lead, conversion rates, and channel ROI.



***Revenue / Sales Operations***



* Administer the CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports across the full funnel\- lead\-to\-close, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, conversion rates, and revenue attribution for reps, managers, and executives.
* Own lead routing and the MQL\-to\-SQL handoff process between marketing and sales.
* Support basic forecasting, pipeline reviews, and deal tracking for the sales team.



***Reporting \& Analytics***



* Build and maintain dashboards covering funnel metrics, pipeline health, and marketing\-sourced revenue.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting to leadership on marketing and sales performance.



***Process \& Tools***



* Document processes and playbooks as the team scales.
* Evaluate and recommend new tools as budgets allow, keeping the stack lean and cost\-effective.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and solutions team on shared definitions and SLAs.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 

  




* 8\-10 years of experience spanning marketing operations and/or sales/revenue operations, ideally in a B2B SaaS, IT services, or startup environment.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in both
 
**HubSpot and Salesforce** 

 \- not just using them, but configuring, administering, and connecting them. Salesforce Administrator
* Proven track record of building dashboards and reports that drive decisions, including comfort with Salesforce reports/dashboards, HubSpot reporting, and ideally a BI tool (Looker Studio)
* Strong data management skills: you know how to model data cleanly, keep it clean, and diagnose why a number looks wrong.
* Solid grasp of the revenue funnel and GTM motions, how leads become pipeline and pipeline becomes revenue.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate raw data into clear, actionable narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good communication skills to work directly with founders/leadership in a smaller, less hierarchical setup.
* Master's degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

title: Lead Software Architect
description:
Lead software Architect
 



 Wualt (primary), with architectural oversight of Nexus
 



 Full\-time · Chennai, India (Hybrid)
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



 Wualt is a personal\-safety platform. Someone wearing a smart ring, or simply carrying their phone, can raise an SOS and get help quickly, with their live location and audio shared to trusted guardians and a staffed response centre, and AI that helps flag genuine distress. It spans mobile apps, web consoles, and cloud back\-end services.
 



  





 We are looking for a Lead Technical Architect to own the architecture of Wualt as our current architect transitions out. This is a hands\-on leadership role, and Wualt is your primary focus. To start, you will be a team of one: you will pick up the existing codebase and take it through to deployment across all of Wualt's apps and web apps yourself, and build a team around you over time. You will also provide architectural oversight of Nexus, our apparel manufacturing platform, at a guidance level rather than day to day. We want a genuine polyglot who sets the technical direction, keeps the product secure and scalable, and raises the bar on engineering and product quality.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • Wualt's architecture, end to end: the mobile apps, the web consoles, the back\-end services and APIs, and the cloud infrastructure underneath.
 



 • The system\-level decisions: technology choices, service boundaries, data flows, and build\-versus\-buy calls. You own the trade\-offs and you document them.
 



 • Real\-time reliability for safety\-critical flows. When someone raises an alarm, the live experience has to be fast and it cannot drop. You design for that.
 



 • Architecture for scale, so the product stays fast and dependable as usage grows.
 



 • Security and privacy as a first\-class concern: airtight security in every layer, and data handling architected to comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).
 



 • The quality of the front\-end experience across mobile and web, in partnership with design. Fast, polished, and a genuine pleasure to use.
 



 • A pragmatic use of AI tooling to build faster and build more, while keeping full ownership of the architecture and engineering judgment. AI accelerates the work. It does not make the decisions.
 



 • AI and ML in the product. We use AI and ML capabilities, and you own integrating them into the platform reliably and securely.
 



 • The team, over time. To start you are the team, hands\-on across the whole platform. As we grow, you build and lead a lean engineering team: design and code reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.
 



 • A clean handover from the outgoing architect, with full ownership of Wualt within 30 days of joining
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • A clear track record of shipping enterprise\-grade applications and products to production, at scale.
 



 • Strong across our core technologies: React Native for mobile, React for web, and Python and Django on the back end, on AWS.
 



 • A genuine polyglot. You move comfortably between languages and frameworks, choose the right tool rather than forcing one stack, and can give sound architectural guidance on systems built in stacks other than your primary one.
 



 • Real\-time, event\-driven systems. Experience building live, low\-latency features (for example WebSockets or streaming media) that stay reliable under load.
 



 • Strong database design experience across relational and NoSQL stores, for example PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
 



 • Hands\-on experience architecting for data protection and privacy, including the DPDPA, or comparable regimes such as the GDPR.
 



 • A security\-first mindset, with real experience designing secure systems: authentication and authorization, encryption, secrets management, and threat modeling.
 



 • A strong product and front\-end sensibility. You care how the software looks and feels, not only how it runs.
 



 • A base\-level understanding of AI and ML systems. We use AI and ML in the product and you will integrate it into the platform, so you need to be comfortable working with models and ML services, even if you are not an ML researcher.
 



 • Fluency with AI\-assisted development, and the maturity to treat it as an accelerant to your own architectural reasoning rather than a substitute for it.
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Wearables, IoT, or BLE and connected\-device experience, and data\-intensive or machine\-learning\-backed products.
 



 • Enterprise or ERP domain experience across manufacturing, supply chain, or procurement, useful for the Nexus oversight side.
 



 • Cloud and DevOps depth: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability.
 



 • Experience as the senior\-most engineer on a platform, or leading a small team.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 • First 30 days: a full context transfer from the outgoing architect, and a documented map of Wualt, its risks, and the near\-term priorities, plus a lighter read on Nexus.
 



 • By 60 days: a prioritized architecture and security roadmap for Wualt with the highest\-risk gaps already closing, and a working oversight rhythm for Nexus.
 



 • By 90 days: you are the clear technical owner of Wualt, decisions move quickly, the team is shipping against your roadmap, and Nexus is guided at the right altitude.

title: Principal Agentic Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
   

  

 The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world\-class technology capabilities and platforms.
   

  

 Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 You own the agentic resolution platform end to end — both the cloud\-native substrate it runs on and the intelligent agents that run on top of it. From Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability through agent runtime, LLM patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries, you write the production code, design the architecture, and set the engineering bar that lets automation deflect routine operational work before it ever reaches a human.
   

  

 This is a senior individual\-contributor role that is both strategic and deeply hands\-on. You ship production platform services and agentic capabilities, make the build\-vs\-buy calls on tooling and model access, and partner with the senior architect on the patterns that scale. Success is measured by rising deflection, sustained toil reduction, platform availability and developer velocity, and the ability to scale agentic intelligence through systems and people — not individual effort.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Agentic resolution platform — intake to action
* Architect the agentic resolution platform end to end: intake, classification, action execution, verification, and human\-in\-the\-loop fallback.
* Build the agent runtime and orchestration layer: agent state and memory, tool integration, multi\-agent coordination patterns, and confidence\-thresholded handoffs to humans.
* Define agent\-decision observability, audit\-ready posture, and the data contracts that let the platform consume durable fixes from upstream engineering teams.
* LLM application patterns, knowledge, and evaluation rigor
* Design production LLM patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, multi\-model routing, and hybrid retrieval over the knowledge corpus.
* Own the knowledge\-base strategy as a compounding deflection lever — every resolved incident becomes training data and structured retrieval input for future automation.
* Establish evaluation and guardrail frameworks for non\-deterministic systems: automated evals, quality scoring, drift detection, and feedback loops that compound agent quality over time.
* Cloud\-native platform — build and operate
* Architect and operate Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale for container and serverless workloads supporting agentic and LLM inference traffic patterns.
* Write production platform services and internal tooling (Python or Go) that automate provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows — not just infrastructure configuration.
* Define and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) integrated with a major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI), with secrets management and audit\-ready posture for regulated environments.
* CI/CD, observability, and developer experience
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines tuned for agentic and AI workloads: model and agent versioning, canary rollouts, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Own the observability stack (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry plus enterprise tooling) and instrument platform health, agent\-decision telemetry, and model\-inference metrics.
* Establish SLOs, SLIs, and reliability standards for both platform and agentic system health; design self\-service patterns and golden\-path templates that accelerate delivery.
* Cross\-team partnership, security, and talent development
* Partner with the Reliability Engineering team on which production patterns become agent\-assisted automations, and with senior architects on the patterns that scale.
* Own security posture: network policies, pod security, secrets rotation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Set the engineering bar through code quality standards, architectural reviews, and role modeling; mentor senior engineers in agentic AI, LLM application patterns, and platform engineering. Influence engineering leaders to adopt automation\-friendly patterns at the source, not just downstream.


**How You Will Succeed**
* Be recognized as the senior technical authority for agentic platform engineering in your area.
* Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements: rising deflection rates, reduced toil, fewer recurring incidents, faster resolution, platform uptime, and deployment velocity.
* Ship production platform services and agentic capabilities that tangibly move the deflection and developer\-experience numbers.
* Scale agentic intelligence through systems, standards, and people — not individual heroics.


**Required**
**What you should bring**
* 10\+ years of progressive technology experience with substantial hands\-on architecture and delivery of automation, AIOps, agentic systems, or cloud\-native platforms at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ownership of measurable deflection or operational\-toil\-reduction outcomes in a production environment — with the numbers to show it.
* Deep technical fluency in agentic system design: agent runtimes, multi\-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory and state management. Practical experience with at least one major framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP).
* Production experience with LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi\-model routing.
* Deep cloud\-native background: Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale, container workloads, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and at least one major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI).
* Proven ability to build and ship production platform services and tooling — not just configure infrastructure. Expert\-level Python (async, packaging, performance) for production services; Go also welcome.
* Strong CI/CD engineering experience for AI and agentic workloads: model and agent deployment, versioning, canary/blue\-green strategies, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Observability for AI systems: metrics, logs, traces, and agent\-decision telemetry using Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry, plus at least one enterprise stack (Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace).
* Demonstrated rigor in evaluation and guardrails for non\-deterministic systems — automated evals, drift detection, human\-in\-the\-loop verification, and feedback loops.
* Strong security engineering foundation: network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in regulated environments.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate technical strategy for senior business and technology leadership.


*This is a hybrid role spanning agentic AI, LLM patterns, cloud\-native platform, and developer tooling. We expect strong depth in 2–3 of these areas with the breadth and judgment to learn adjacent domains. Not every tool listed is required.*
**Preferred**
* Working knowledge of operational ML: anomaly detection, event correlation, alert\-noise reduction, and model/agent monitoring in production.
* Experience with AI observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, custom telemetry pipelines).
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow integration patterns and chat\-based intake platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams).
* Experience with vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures.
* Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP), self\-service provisioning, or platform\-as\-a\-product tooling.
* Backend development skills beyond infrastructure tooling: REST/gRPC API design, database design, message queues, distributed systems patterns.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code, automated compliance checks, or shift\-left security tooling.
* AWS cloud platform fluency, including EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, and cost\-optimization tooling.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost governance.
* Experience operating in highly regulated industries (life sciences, financial services, healthcare).
* Prior experience standing up a new engineering capability from a small founding team.
* Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal dashboards and developer portals.


**Leadership expectations**
* Acts with enterprise\-first mindset, beyond individual products or teams.
* Drives accountability, clarity, and engineering rigor across the team.
* Builds trust through consistency, technical depth, and follow\-through.
* Raises the capability of the organization, not just personal output.
* Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org\-chart authority.


**Additional Information**
 Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non\-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non\-standard hours where applicable.
   

  

 This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering — Application Platform
description:
**Overview**
**Manager, Platform Engineering — Application Platform**
 📍
 **Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India 🏢
 **Work Arrangement:** 
 Hybrid – 2 days per week in the office
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 to lead our Application Platform team in Hyderabad — a newly formed team and a deliberate expansion of what our platform organization offers.
   

  

 Hyland runs an internal Kubernetes platform that product teams deploy onto, across AWS and Azure. Two teams own it. One keeps the platform running.
 **This team builds the interfaces product teams actually use** 
 — self\-service provisioning of cloud resources, GitOps\-based delivery and promotion, environment and tenancy management, and cloud\-agnostic abstractions that behave the same way on either cloud. When a product team needs a queue, a bucket, an environment, or a path to production, they get it from this team's work — not from a ticket.
   

  

 Some capabilities are already in motion, some already have users — but much of what this team will own is still to be defined and built.
 **You'd be shaping it early** 
 , with real room to influence the direction rather than inherit it.
   

  

 Success looks like product teams choosing the paved road over building their own, new services reaching production faster, developers who'd recommend the platform to a peer, and reliable operation of the services your team owns. If you think of other engineers as your customers and thrive at the intersection of technical leadership and platform strategy — we'd love to connect.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of platform engineers across multiple time zones — owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development to build a high\-performing, accountable team.
* Own the direction of a self\-service provisioning capability that lets product teams declare the cloud resources they need through a Kubernetes\-native API, with security, tagging, and cost guardrails applied by default.
* Own the delivery and promotion capabilities product teams use to reach production — including GitOps\-based deployment, environment progression, approval and traceability controls, and progressive delivery patterns for teams running clusters outside the central platform.
* Drive a set of workload abstractions that behave consistently across AWS and Azure, so a team productive on one cloud is equally productive on the other without reinventing their workflow.
* Treat adoption as a first\-class outcome — define what good looks like, instrument it, reduce the time it takes a team to get from nothing to running in production, and retire work that isn't earning its keep.
* Run what you build — your team carries on\-call for the services it owns and is accountable for reliability, security posture, and compliance obligations; partner with runtime infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering to maintain a single coherent path onto the platform.


**Technology Tools**
* Kubernetes \& Container Orchestration
* Cloud Platforms: AWS \& Azure
* Kubernetes\-Native Resource Provisioning \& Custom Resource APIs
* GitOps \& Continuous Delivery Tooling
* Infrastructure as Code \& Policy as Code
* Cloud\-Agnostic Workload Abstractions (Serverless Runtimes, Event\-Driven Autoscaling, Service Invocation)
* Cloud Cost Visibility \& Attribution
* Secrets Management \& Workload Identity
* Monitoring, Logging \& Observability


**Role Essentials**
* 5\+ years leading engineering teams — including teams delivering platform, infrastructure, or developer\-facing products — with a Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent experience; production Kubernetes depth with enough hands\-on fluency to review your team's work credibly and make sound architectural decisions.
* Demonstrated experience building self\-service capabilities or internal APIs that other engineering teams consumed — with evidence of the measurable adoption that followed; product instincts applied internally, prioritizing against outcomes rather than requests and saying no to work that won't move adoption.
* Strong hands\-on fluency with infrastructure as code and cloud\-native services on both AWS and Azure; experience operating under security and compliance obligations such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001\.
* Experience leading a distributed engineering team across multiple time zones — including asynchronous collaboration, shared on\-call responsibilities, and accountability for managing to a budget.
* Comfortable negotiating priorities, standards, and interfaces with peer managers; excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with working knowledge of Agile or Scrum delivery practices.


**What We'd Like to See**
* Built self\-service capabilities that measurably reduced how often product teams needed to ask the platform team for anything — freeing both sides to move faster.
* Designed an API or abstraction that outlived the first use case it was built for — and successfully migrated consumers off a deprecated interface without stalling their roadmaps.
* Made a platform behave consistently across two clouds and turned developer experience from an opinion into something measured, tracked, and continuously improved.
* Grown engineers into senior or lead roles through intentional coaching, structured feedback, and deliberate career development investment.
* Background in enterprise software or another environment with real security scrutiny — where reliability, compliance, and customer trust are non\-negotiable and built into how you operate.

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
   

  

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM\-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API\-driven, and agent\-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go\-to\-market offerings, and practice\-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior\-level cloud and security credentials.


**How You’ll Grow**
 At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn.  Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. title: Senior Technical Lead (Product Releases & Engineering)
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Company Name: Incepteo
   

  

 Industry: Information Technology \& Services
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.
   

  

 The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.
   

  

 This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 You will coordinate releases across Development → Test / QA → UAT → Production → Monitoring.
   

  

  

* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies
* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks
* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes
* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations
* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution


 The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.
   

  

 Engineering Team Coordination
   

  

  

* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations
* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early
* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments
* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification


 The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
   

  

 Engineering Maturity \& Quality
   

  

 You will help strengthen:
   

  

  

* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning
* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing
* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis
* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices


 You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.
   

  

 Hands\-On Technical Capability
   

  

 Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.
   

  

 You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.
   

  

 Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.
   

  

 Production \& Incident Management
   

  

  

* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes
* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes
* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed


 We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.
   

  

 Experience We Are Looking For
   

  

 Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:
   

  

  

* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments
* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting
* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation
* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices
* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement


 We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.
   

  

 Leadership Maturity
   

  

  

* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes
* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate
* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated
* Communication – explains technical issues clearly
* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents
* Constructive leadership – guides developers without micromanaging
* Quality mindset – balances speed with reliability
* Continuous improvement – strengthens processes after every release


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

  

* More predictable and controlled releases with clear ownership and readiness criteria
* Better engineering coordination with earlier visibility of blockers and dependencies
* Stronger GitHub, PR, code\-review, testing and CI/CD discipline and more reliable Google Cloud operations
* Fewer release\-related defects and last\-minute integration issues, with faster Production incident resolution
* Improved engineering maturity and reduced dependency on individual heroics


**In one sentence: Your responsibility is to turn multiple developers, features and code changes into one coordinated engineering team delivering stable, high\-quality SaaS releases consistently for the Stratpilot venture, using strong GitHub practices and reliable Google Cloud delivery and operations.**
**About The Company**
 About Incepteo Labs Incepteo Labs Private Limited is a dynamic and fast\-growing startup venture builder creating innovative technology products and businesses. This role offers the opportunity to work in a high\-energy environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where engineer

title: Technical Delivery Manager - Data Engineering - RDT Pharma Medicines
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**The Technical Data Delivery Manager will own the delivery of data solutions across the Pharma Commercial ecosystem — including Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Managed Markets, Patient Services, and Commercial Analytics. This role acts as the critical link between commercial business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely data across the full commercial data lifecycle — from data acquisition and integration through to reporting and insights.**
****Key Responsibilities****
****Data Delivery \& Program Management****
* Own delivery of data pipelines, integrations, and platforms supporting Commercial functions: Sales (call activity, targeting, alignments), Marketing (campaign/digital engagement), Market Access (payer/formulary data), and Patient Services (hub/specialty pharmacy data)
* Manage data ingestion from third\-party sources: IQVIA, Symphony Health/Komodo, Veeva, Definitive Healthcare, claims data (medical/pharmacy), specialty pharmacy, and distributor data
* Lead sprint planning, release cycles, UAT, and production go\-lives in partnership with data engineering, IT, and business teams
* Manage timelines for recurring commercial data cycles (e.g., monthly/weekly sales data refreshes, incentive compensation cycles, alignment updates)
* Manage key projects and programs


****Business \& Technical Liaison****
* Translate requirements from Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Marketing, and Market Access teams into technical specifications
* Serve as SME on commercial data domains: sales force effectiveness (SFE), CRM (Veeva/Salesforce), MDM (customer/HCP/HCO data), incentive compensation, segmentation \& targeting, and syndicated data
* Partner with Compliance/Legal/Privacy on data usage governance (HIPAA, state privacy laws, data licensing terms with vendors like IQVIA/Veeva)


****Data Quality \& Governance****
* Define and monitor KPIs for data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness across commercial data feeds
* Establish reconciliation and exception\-handling processes (e.g., HCP/HCO matching, territory alignment discrepancies, sales data anomalies)
* Drive root\-cause analysis for data issues impacting compensation, targeting, or reporting accuracy


****Team \& Vendor Leadership****
* Manage data analysts/engineers and/or third\-party vendors and system integrators
* Own vendor relationships with commercial data providers (IQVIA, Veeva, Symphony/Komodo, Definitive Healthcare, etc.)


****Continuous Improvement****
* Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes and improve delivery speed/scalability
* Support data governance initiatives across the commercial data landscape

**Job Summary**
* The Principal Security Engineer is the bank's most senior technical authority for network\-security and firewall architecture, setting the target\-state design, standards and engineering direction for the Check Point and Palo Alto estate across production, DMZ, DR and cloud.
* Operating as a hands\-on design leader rather than a people manager, the role owns architecture decisions, complex programme delivery (migrations, refreshes, segmentation), threat\-prevention strategy, automation, and the highest level of incident and problem escalation — driving resilience, security posture and regulatory assurance for business\-critical and customer\-facing banking services.
* The role influences across teams and vendors and mentors senior and L3 engineers.


**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Architecture \& Technical Strategy
+ Own the target\-state architecture and technical roadmap for the firewall and network\-security estate (Check Point and Palo Alto), aligned to Enterprise Architecture and Information Security strategy.
+ Define and enforce security design standards, reference architectures, hardening baselines and rule\-lifecycle governance across the bank.
+ Lead network segmentation and Zero\-Trust / micro\-segmentation strategy, DMZ and east\-west security design, and secure connectivity for cloud and hybrid environments.
+ Provide design authority and technical sign\-off on high\-impact changes, new solutions and HLD/LLD across the security estate

* Deep Platform Engineering — Check Point \& Palo Alto
+ Act as the deepest technical escalation and design authority on Check Point (Gaia, MDS/Provider\-1, ClusterXL, VSX, Maestro hyperscale) and Palo Alto (PAN\-OS, Panorama, App\-ID/User\-ID/Content\-ID, Threat Prevention, WildFire, GlobalProtect).
+ Design and validate high\-scale, highly\-available firewall deployments, including capacity, throughput and interface/uplink planning to eliminate single points of failure and chokepoints.
+ Set threat\-prevention, IPS and SSL\-decryption strategy and tuning standards for a banking threat profile.
+ Lead complex platform migrations, refreshes and major version upgrades end\-to\-end, with robust rollback and minimal business impact.

* Automation \& Engineering Excellence
+ Drive automation of policy, configuration and change (Check Point Management API, Palo Alto AS3/XML API, Ansible/Python) to improve consistency, speed and auditability.
+ Establish infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration\-standardisation practices for the security estate.
+ Champion observability, config backup/compliance (SolarWinds NCM) and continuous posture monitoring.

* Governance, Risk \& Assurance
+ Serve as senior technical lead for audits and regulatory engagements (SAMA / CBUAE, PCI\-DSS); own remediation strategy and evidence for network\-security findings.
+ Partner with Information Security (ISG), Risk and Enterprise Architecture on security posture, standards and technology selection.
+ Lead root\-cause analysis and problem management for major (P1\) security incidents and define preventive controls.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentoring
+ Mentor and uplift senior, L3 and L2 engineers; set engineering standards and review complex designs and changes.
+ Represent the bank in senior technical engagements with OEMs/vendors (Check Point, Palo Alto, F5\) and influence product roadmaps and support outcomes.

* Required Skills \& Experience

title: Senior Security Consultant – Cisco ISE with AWS Cloud Architecture
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 AWS Cloud Architect responsible for designing, building, and owning the complete AWS foundation for Gruve's Cisco ISE\-as\-a\-Service (ISEaaS) multi\-tenant managed service, with 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and network security environments. Owns the AWS Organization and multi\-account landing zone, tenant network architecture, security guardrails, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cloud cost management. This is a hands\-on build role: the successful candidate will personally author Terraform modules and design the account structure that every customer tenant is provisioned from, while applying reliability engineering practices to reduce operational toil. Working knowledge of Cisco ISE, RADIUS, and enterprise network security concepts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement multi\-account AWS Organization structure, including Organizational Units (OUs), management account separation, and consolidated billing.
* Design and enforce Service Control Policies (SCPs) and organization\-level guardrails for tenant isolation and compliance.
* Design tenant network architecture: VPC, multi\-AZ subnet design, route tables, VPC endpoints, NAT, DNS (Route 53 private zones including PTR records), and IP address management (IPAM).
* Implement AWS Transit Gateway hub\-and\-spoke connectivity with per\-tenant route tables, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and Direct Connect.
* Implement AWS security services: IAM and IAM Identity Center (SSO), KMS customer\-managed keys, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Own cloud cost management and FinOps: per\-tenant cost attribution, tagging strategy, budget alerts, Cost Explorer and CUR\-based chargeback reporting, and cost modeling to support service pricing and margin analysis.
* Design for high availability and disaster recovery across Availability Zones and regions, including backup, restore, and recovery runbooks.
* Apply reliability engineering practices: automation\-first operations, toil reduction, failure\-mode analysis, and infrastructure observability.
* Implement policy\-as\-code and security scanning in CI/CD pipelines (Checkov, tfsec, or equivalent).
* Partner with automation and ISE engineering teams to ensure infrastructure outputs integrate cleanly with configuration management.
* Subscribe to and manage the Cisco ISE AMI listing on AWS Marketplace per Region, including EULA acceptance and AMI version/release validation before each tenant build.
* Verify and manage AWS service quotas (EC2 instance types, EIPs, VPC limits) per Region/tenant.
* Configure Network ACLs and manage Elastic IP allocation policy (use only where explicitly required; avoid public exposure of ISE by default).
* Enable VPC Flow Logs for tenant VPCs/subnets where required by security or compliance standards.
* Configure EC2 instance metadata options (IMDSv2\) and other instance\-level hardening attributes.

In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative data solutions that support our data analytics initiatives. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, ensuring our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics.

 Skills and Experience

* Strategic thinking and Enterprise\-level solution design

* You can discuss with stakeholders about their requirements and clearly communicate back your understanding of the requirements.

* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.


 Must have
   

  

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.

 Nice to have

* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.


 Knowledge

* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.


 Personality requirements
   

  

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)

* Not afraid to approach other stakeholders (customer centre specialists, local engineering, or technical support specialists)

 In return, we offer
   

  

 What we offer

* This role is ideal for you, if you wish to challenge yourself on Technological front and creating competence centre for Data Engineering and Visualization
