title: Application Testing & Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Summary:**  

  

Support the development, testing, validation, and deployment of service support applications and digital
  

solutions by coordinating with business stakeholders and development teams, performing end\-to\-end
  

functional testing, managing business requirements and master data activities, and creating training and
  

knowledge\-transfer documentation to support successful solution adoption.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

* Execute end\-to\-end functional, integration, regression and user acceptance testing for capabilities

developed under the program.
  

* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, expected results, test data and evidence; record defects with clear

reproduction steps, business impact and supporting screenshots.
  

* Validate business workflows across customer contact, case or service request handling, back\-office

processing, integration, notifications, reporting and user access, as applicable.
  

* Coordinate with service operations, contact center, back\-office, product, regional and IT stakeholders

to clarify requirements, obtain test data and resolve open questions.
  

* Maintain requirements, test status, defect logs, decision logs, action trackers and traceability between

business requirements, developed features and test outcomes.
  

* Perform master data cleansing, validation, maintenance and updates across relevant applications and

tools, ensuring accuracy, consistency, completeness and alignment with approved business rules.
  

* Participate in demonstrations, sprint or release reviews, solution walkthroughs and readiness

discussions; communicate risks, dependencies and unresolved defects promptly.
  

* Prepare and maintain user guides, process documents, standard operating procedures, quick\-reference

guides, FAQs, release notes and knowledge\-transfer materials.
  

* Support training preparation and delivery for business users, super users and support teams, including

demonstrations and post\-training clarification.
  

* Assist with go\-live readiness, cutover validation, user readiness, hypercare tracking and postimplementation issue analysis.
* Identify recurring process gaps, data\-quality issues and improvement opportunities using structured

analysis and user feedback.
  

* Follow applicable information security, data privacy, access\-control, documentation and changegovernance requirements.

Systems \& Domain Exposure
  

* Good working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Redwood user

experience and other Oracle applications is preferred.
  

* Exposure to Genesys Cloud, contact center platforms, CRM or service\-management applications,

workflow tools and back\-office processes is desirable.
  

* Awareness of Agentic AI, conversational AI, automation, workflow orchestration and digital\-assistant

use cases is an advantage.
  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Teams; experience with

reporting or visualization tools is preferred.
  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

* Timely completion of assigned test cycles with complete and reusable test evidence.
* Accurate defect documentation, prioritization support and closure or retest tracking.
* Requirement and test traceability with minimal gaps between business needs and delivered

functionality.
  

* Clear, current and version\-controlled training and knowledge documents before release or handover.
* Effective stakeholder coordination, timely action closure and early escalation of blockers or quality

risks.
  

* Consistent attention to data accuracy, user experience, process controls and operational readiness.

Skills \& Competencies
  

* Strong functional testing, analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand end\-to\-end business processes and translate requirements into practical test

scenarios.
  

* Good written and verbal communication, with confidence to interact with business users, developers

and program stakeholders.
  

* High attention to detail, documentation discipline and ability to manage multiple actions and

dependencies.
  

* Strong interpersonal skills, collaboration, ownership and follow\-through.
* Ability to learn new applications and processes quickly and work in a changing program environment.

Education \& Experience
  

* Graduate in engineering, computer applications, information technology, B.Sc. Information Technology,

telecommunications, business, operations or a related discipline.
  

* Prior experience in application testing, business analysis, process documentation, operations support or

digital\-transformation programs is preferred.
  

* Experience in contact center operations, back\-office management or service operations is an added

advantage.
  

* Experience working with IT development teams, business stakeholders and third\-party partners is

desirable.
  

  

**Work Conditions \& Compliance**  

  

* Fixed\-term contract for 12 months, subject to applicable company terms and conditions.
* May require coordination across functions, locations and time zones based on program needs.
* The role may require flexibility in work schedules and extended support during critical project

deliverables, testing cycles, release activities, and business priorities.
  

* Must maintain confidentiality of business, customer, employee and system information and comply

with applicable security and privacy requirements

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
**Senior ML Engineer** 




 AI Governance \& Security · DAXA · Pune, India or US (remote\-friendly) · 5\+ years
 



 DAXA provides a data\-first security and governance platform for AI applications and agents. This is an ambitious team shipping into large, demanding enterprises.
 



  





**What you'll own** 




 •    Own the end\-to\-end ML systems that power the DAXA platform: data, training, evaluation, inference and deployment.
 



 •    Build and evolve training and fine\-tuning pipelines for small language models and encoder\-family classifiers.
 



 •    Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety and real\-world product performance.
 



 •    Architect high\-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost and reliability.
 



 •    Build data pipelines and systems for high\-quality real\-world and synthetic training data.
 



 •    Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring and continuously improving models, including on\-prem and air\-gapped customer environments.
 



 •    Advance our detection surface: sensitive\-data and entity detection, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and anomalous agent behavior.
 



 •    Partner closely with product and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.
 



 •    Make pragmatic technical trade\-offs and iterate rapidly based on real\-world performance.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




**Must have** 




 •    5\+ years hands\-on in ML/NLP, with production models you personally shipped and maintained.
 



 •    Real fine\-tuning depth on transformer encoders for both sequence and token classification.
 



 •    Strong Python; fluent in PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
 



 •    Dataset ownership: labeling schemes, curation, and synthetic data generation for long\-tail classes.
 



 •    Rigorous evaluation discipline, including managing precision/recall trade\-offs in production.
 



 •    Model compression and serving optimization (distillation, quantization, ONNX, Triton, TensorRT), including CPU\-only inference where no GPU is available.
 



 •    Taking a model from notebook to a latency\-constrained production service under a hard p95 budget.
 



**Strong plus** 




 •    AI security or adversarial ML: prompt injection, red\-teaming, evasion.
 



 •    Data governance, DLP, IAM, or privacy/compliance context (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI).
 



 •    RAG, embeddings, retrieval, or knowledge graphs.
 



 •    Multilingual NLP, or shipping and versioning models into regulated, sovereign or air\-gapped environments with no egress.
 



  





**How we work** 




 The technical bar is table stakes. These are the things that actually determine whether someone does well here.
 



 •    
 **High agency.** 
 You'll get a customer symptom rather than a spec. Find the real problem, decide, ship.
 



 •    
 **AI\-native by default.** 
 Coding agents and frontier models are a core part of how you work. We care about what you ship and how well you understand it.
 



 •    
 **Write things down.** 
 Design docs, eval writeups, decision records. We're distributed across time zones.
 



 •    
 **Talk to customers.** 
 You'll sit on calls with enterprise security teams and CISOs.
 



 •    
 **Own it to production.** 
 You build it, you ship it, you watch it in production, you fix it.
 



 •    
 **Comfort with ambiguity.** 
 Startup pace, shifting priorities, incomplete information. Strong opinions, loosely held, low ego.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 You'd be the senior ML voice in the company, setting direction on the classifier architecture rather than executing someone else's roadmap. The problem space is genuinely unsolved: governing agent behavior is being defined right now, in public, and what you build here lands in production at named enterprise accounts within weeks, not quarters.
 


* If you want to build the intelligence that makes enterprise AI trustworthy, and you want your work in front of real users fast, we'd like to talk.

**Key Responsibilities**
 Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
   

  

**Competencies**
 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

 Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Quality Assurance Metrics \- Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**

**Experience**
 Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

* Exposure to Big Data open source

Analyze and document regional complexities: cut\-off times, time zones, local holidays, settlement windows, value dating, prioritization and SLA commitments.

* Partner with Architects/Engineers to clarify integrations and non\-functional requirements: throughput, latency, resilience, observability/monitoring, auditability, security and data retention. Define exception handling and investigations: rejects/returns, recalls/cancellations, reversals, repairs workflows, retries, duplicate handling and idempotency behavior.
* Drive STP improvement by identifying root causes of repairs and exceptions, simplifying business rules, and improving data quality and validation upstream. Define and maintain artefacts: BPMN/process maps, business rules catalogues, data dictionaries, interface specifications, operating model impacts and production support handovers.
* Support Agile delivery: backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos and retrospectives; ensure items meet Definition of Ready/Done and align to outcomes. Support end\-to\-end testing and acceptance: scenario design, message/sample validation, SIT/UAT support, defect triage and sign\-off readiness.
* Support production readiness across regions: runbooks, monitoring/alerting requirements, operational training needs, service communications and post\-go\-live learnings.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to consistent BA standards, templates and reusable patterns across payments deliveries.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Strong payments domain expertise across cross\-border and domestic payments, including lifecycle events, settlement models, exceptions, investigations and reconciliation. Demonstrable experience working with multiple payment rails, with depth in SWIFT and strong exposure to domestic ACH/clearing and instant payments rails across all countries.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 20022 and SWIFT message standards (including MT/MX and CBPR\+ concepts), with practical experience in mapping, validation and enrichment requirements. Proven Senior BA capability in requirements engineering elicitation, decomposition, prioritization, documentation and traceability—able to make requirements testable and implementation\-ready.
* Strong Agile delivery experience (Scrum/Kanban): writing high\-quality user stories/acceptance criteria, supporting backlog management and iterating with stakeholders. Experience operating in multi\-country environments—comfortable managing stakeholders across cultures/time zones and handling localization and regulatory variation without losing global consistency.
* Solid understanding of payments\-grade non\-functional requirements (performance, resilience, observability, audit trails, security) and how they influence design and delivery. Strong grasp of operational processing realities: STP, repairs queues, investigations, cut\-offs, batching vs real\-time, retries/failover and production support needs.
* Awareness of key compliance and control touchpoints in payments (e.g., sanctions screening interactions, AML triggers, evidencing, retention) and ability to capture them as actionable requirements.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills—able to explain complex flows and messaging to technical and non\-technical audiences and drive decisions.
* Comfortable with common BA toolsets (e.g., JIRA/Confluence) and modelling tools (BPMN/Visio), with strong documentation discipline.
* Delivery\-focused and accountable—able to manage ambiguity, resolve gaps quickly and drive outcomes across cross\-border and domestic payment initiatives.

Strong technical expertise in SAP development for SAP MM / PUR processes in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.

Strong understanding of SAP MM purchasing and procurement processes.
  

Practical experience with purchase requisitions, purchase orders, release procedures, purchasing document processing, output management, forms, inventory\-related procurement integration and supplier\-related process touchpoints.

Strong experience in implementing enhancements, extensions, reports, forms, workflows, interfaces and custom developments in a maintainable and standard\-oriented way.
  

Sound understanding of SAP Clean Core principles and modern extensibility approaches.
  

Practical understanding of SAP ECC legacy development contexts and transition considerations toward SAP S/4HANA.
  

Experience with integration concepts, including IDocs, APIs, web services, service\-based communication, middleware and data provisioning.
  

Knowledge of SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite and related integration technologies is an advantage.
  

Good understanding of SAP Fiori and modern SAP UX concepts is an advantage.
  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
  

Ability to assess technical requirements against existing global processes, architecture principles and supportability expectations.
  

High degree of ownership, autonomy, accountability and delivery orientation.
  

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  

Ability to work effectively in international, multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
  

Strong collaboration skills when working with business stakeholders, key users, consultants and management.
  

Structured, quality\-oriented and solution\-driven working style.
  

Interest in modern SAP development approaches, automation and continuous improvement.
  

Initial experience with AI\-supported development tools is an advantage.
**We offer:**
=============

**Main purpose of the position** **(% of Time)**

* The Expert Professional SAP MM / PUR Developer is responsible for the technical design, development, enhancement, extension, and support of SAP MM and procurement\-related solutions in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* The position focuses on purchasing and procurement execution processes, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, release strategies, purchasing document processing, output management, supplier\-related process touchpoints, inventory\-related procurement integration, and adjacent SAP MM / PUR functions.
* The role acts as a senior technical counterpart to business stakeholders, key users, global process owners, internal consultants, architects, and external implementation partners. The position is responsible for analyzing incoming business requirements, assessing them against existing end\-to\-end procurement processes and technical architecture standards, and translating them into robust, scalable and sustainable technical solution concepts.
* A strong focus of the role is the implementation of maintainable, standard\-oriented, and upgrade\-stable SAP solutions in accordance with Clean Core principles and modern SAP development standards. The position contributes to the continuous improvement of existing SAP MM / PUR solutions, supports technical troubleshooting and incident resolution and ensures high\-quality delivery through testing, documentation, deployment support and knowledge transfer.
* The role requires strong hands\-on SAP development expertise, a sound understanding of procurement processes, and the ability to work effectively in an international and cross\-functional environment.

**Accountabilities** **(% of Time)**

**Technical Requirement Analysis and Solution Design**

* Analyze incoming business requirements and translate them into technically feasible solution concepts.
* Assess requirements against existing SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA processes, global templates, technical architecture standards and relevant integration points.
* Evaluate technical impacts, dependencies, implementation risks and solution alternatives.
* Define efficient, scalable, maintainable and standard\-oriented technical approaches.
* Determine, in alignment with relevant stakeholders and architects where required, whether requirements should be addressed through SAP standard functionality, extensibility concepts or custom development.
* Prepare clear technical specifications, effort estimations and implementation concepts for approved developments.
* Ensure that proposed technical solutions support end\-to\-end procurement processes and business objectives.

**SAP MM / PUR Development, Enhancements, and New Developments**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain SAP MM\-related technical solutions in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* Implement custom developments and technical extensions supporting purchasing and procurement processes.
* Develop solutions for purchase requisitions, purchase orders, release procedures, output processing, forms, reports, workflows, interfaces and related procurement functions.
* Use modern SAP development technologies, including ABAP, ABAP Objects, CDS Views, APIs, OData services, RAP\-based concepts, Fiori\-related concepts and UI5 where applicable.
* Support the technical realization of reports, interfaces, applications, program enhancements, forms, service\-based solutions and workflow\-related developments.
* Ensure that developments are performant, maintainable, scalable, upgrade\-stable and aligned with internal development and architecture principles.
* Contribute to the reusability, standardization, simplification, and continuous improvement of technical solutions across the SAP MM / PUR landscape.

**Clean Core, Architecture Compliance, and Technical Quality**

* Ensure that developments follow Clean Core principles and modern extensibility concepts, including in\-app and side\-by\-side extensions where appropriate.
* Align technical solutions with enterprise architecture standards, development guidelines, security requirements and long\-term supportability expectations.
* Review and challenge technical design options to avoid unnecessary custom complexity.
* Ensure appropriate use of SAP standard functionality before proposing custom development.
* Support the optimization of data models, technical quality, system performance, data consistency, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of technical standards and best practices in the SAP MM / PUR environment.
* Ensure that developed solutions are suitable for future SAP S/4HANA releases and transformation activities.

**Collaboration with Business, Consultants, and Management**

* Work closely with business stakeholders, key users, global process owners, and procurement teams to clarify technical needs and expected outcomes.
* Collaborate with internal SAP consultants, architects, developers, and external service providers during analysis, design, implementation and support activities.
* Provide transparent technical guidance regarding feasibility, effort, dependencies, implementation risks, and solution alternatives.
* Lead or co\-lead technical workstreams in international projects and coordinate the implementation of cross\-functional requirements.
* Support management with reliable input on technical complexity, delivery expectations and implementation risks.
* Act as a trusted senior technical counterpart in international projects, rollouts, transformations and support environments.

**Integration and Connected System Support**

* Support and develop integration scenarios between SAP MM / PUR and connected systems.
* Develop and maintain interfaces, APIs, IDocs, services, forms\-related integrations and technical data exchange mechanisms.
* Support procurement\-related end\-to\-end processes across SAP ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze and resolve interface\-related issues, data inconsistencies, technical defects, and integration failures.
* Collaborate with integration specialists, master data teams, and external partners to ensure stable and reliable data flows.
* Contribute to technical solutions involving SAP Integration Suite, SAP CPI, APIs, web services or related integration technologies where applicable.

**Testing, Incident Resolution, Documentation, and Continuous Improvement**

* Support and execute unit testing, integration testing, regression testing and technical validation activities.
* Analyze and resolve technical defects, incidents, production issues and performance problems in development, test and productive environments.
* Take responsibility for troubleshooting and support activities related to developed solutions.
* Support release, transport, deployment, hypercare and post\-go\-live stabilization activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, specifications, test evidence, operational guidance and support documentation.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and sustainable handover to application support teams.
* Drive continuous improvement of technical solutions, development practices, support processes and collaboration models.

* Business stakeholders from Procurement, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Operations and Finance

Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**

 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.

 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.

title: SolarSquare Energy - Software Development Engineer III - Backend Technologies
description:
**Role : Software Development Engineer III (SDE3\)**
**Location : Mumbai / Bangalore \| Experience : 4\+ Years**
**About SolarSquare**
 At SolarSquare we are building the Home\-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full\-stack D2C residential solar brand \- designing, installing, maintaining (after\-sales) and financing solar systems for home\-owners across India.
   

  

 In 3 years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem. That means : when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain. You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two \- still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2 \- 4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end : shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1 \- 2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own \- not a problem you delivered to.


**What We're Looking For**
* Over 4 years of professional experience in software development, specifically focused on solving large\-scale technical challenges.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Java, GO, Rust, NodeJS etc) with a focus on writing scalable, maintainable, and unit\-tested code.
* Strong command of object\-oriented design, design patterns, and the creation of intuitive class\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading, concurrency, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Deep understanding of relational databases (Postgres) and various NoSQL technologies like HBase, Elasticsearch, or Aerospike, Cassandra.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the full software development life cycle on Linux platforms.
* Proven ability to build highly scalable applications that manage complex business logic and massive datasets.
* A proactive, "go\-getter" mindset characterized by high energy and dedication to task ownership.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced startup environments with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.
* A passionate drive to tackle complex, real\-world problems through innovative engineering.
* You've made and defended technical decisions, picked up problems no one assigned, or built things people use that no one asked for.
* Strong fundamentals in your primary stack \- concurrency, data modeling, debugging across systems, performance work. We're stack\-agnostic for the right person.
* Experience designing systems with explicit attention to scale, reliability, and cost \- not just functional correctness.
* Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to monitor project outcomes and iteratively refine features based on real\-world impact.

title: Head of AI and Data
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
 
  





 Takachar is focused on transforming loose, wet, and bulky crop and forest residues into valuable, carbon\-negative bioproducts for rural communities. By deploying small\-scale, low\-cost, portable systems on tractors and pickup trucks, Takachar upgrades biomass on\-site into products such as fertilizer blends, biofuels, and chemicals without external energy inputs. This approach reduces open\-air burning, mitigates air pollution and wildfire risk, and supports environmental justice. Takachar’s mission is to enable self\-sufficient rural communities that are less dependent on unstable global supply chains for essential chemical commodities. In doing so, the company helps create localized jobs and sustainable economic opportunities in hard\-to\-access regions.
 



  




**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

  





 We run a fleet of distributed pyrolysis reactors that turn agricultural and forestry residue into biochar, and we convert that into verified carbon removal credits. Every credit we issue rests on a chain of evidence that starts at a sensor on a reactor in a village and ends in a monitoring report an auditor signs off on. This role owns that entire chain.
 



  





 You will own three areas: the data and telemetry platform, the AI and analytics work that sits on top of it, and the carbon credits function that turns it all into issued credits. You will also help our clients do the same for their own projects. The bet behind this role is that these three things are actually one problem, and that whoever holds all of it can build a data\-informed software service that is faster, cheaper, and more powerful than anyone else in biochar.
 



  





 This is a leadership role with a junior data scientist under it — and it is a hands\-on role. You will write code, read methodologies line by line, and sit in audit calls. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job.
 



  




**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
**1\. Data \& Telemetry Platform** 

 •    Own the end\-to\-end data infrastructure: from IoT telemetry on distributed reactors, field apps, forms, lab reports and APIs, through ingestion and processing, to analytics and reporting.
 



 •    Design and operate cloud\-based infrastructure for IoT telemetry, real\-time data processing, warehousing, and operational dashboards serving field teams and partners.
 



 •    Make the system
 **auditable by construction** 
 : transparent, reproducible, tamper\-evident data trails that hold up to third\-party verification, not audit trails bolted on afterwards.
 



 •    Own data governance, integrity, security and access control, including multi\-tenant access where customers see only their own sites.
 



 •    Keep it usable for the people who actually feed it — field operators, plant staff, farmers and partners with varying technical comfort.
   




**2\. AI, Analytics \& Reactor Optimization** 

 •    Build the analytics layer that turns raw reactor telemetry into operational insight: yield, conversion efficiency, process stability, anomaly and fault detection, downtime drivers.
 



 •    Apply ML and AI to reactor optimization — process parameter tuning, soft sensors, predictive maintenance, guiding operators toward better runs.
 



 •    Feed reactor data analysis back into product development, so the next generation of reactors is designed against evidence rather than intuition.
 



 •    Apply AI and automation to accelerate registry compliance workflows — from documentation to verification — with a focus on speed and accuracy over manual processes.
   




**3\. Carbon Credits Digital Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (dMRV)** 

 •    Own dMRV end to end for our projects: monitoring plans, field and lab data collection protocols, monitoring reports, verification audits carried through to issuance.
 



 •    Own compliance and listings across major voluntary carbon standards. Maintain deep knowledge of registry methodologies, submission requirements, and regulatory evolution.
 



 •    Read methodologies closely, build the documentation that satisfies them, submit it, and answer auditor questions directly.
 



 •    Hold the technical line on biochar\-specific MRV: biomass characterization, pyrolysis process monitoring, carbon content quantification, permanence tracking, and the analytical chemistry (elemental, proximate, heavy metals) that underpins it.
 



 •    Stay ahead of methodology revisions, registry rule changes, and Article 6 / voluntary\-market developments, and translate them into changes in how we build and operate.
   




**4\. dMRV Product \& Hardware Innovation** 

 •    Develop scalable MRV protocols and measurement strategies for distributed production assets in remote locations, ensuring rigor and auditability at scale.
 



 •    Build software tooling for MRV — internal and, where it makes sense, customer\-facing.
 



 •    Work with the product team on hardware and instrumentation innovation for measurement: what gets sensed, how it is verified, and how measurement error is bounded and defended.
   




**5\. Client Enablement** 

 •    Act as the senior technical voice in customer conversations alongside business development.
   




**6\. Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Decision\-Making** 

 •    Lead and grow a team spanning MRV operations, data engineering, data analysis and field engineering. Hire, set standards, and raise the technical bar.
 



 •    Sit with product development, business development and operations on decisions that determine what we build, what we can credibly claim, and what we can sell.
 




 •    Translate between worlds fluently: registry rules to engineers, sensor limitations to auditors, technical risk to leadership and buyers.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Senior professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a Senior professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.

* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4–8 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.

* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

**About this role:**

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. **About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):**

MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. This high\-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.


**Understanding The Work Environment \& Standards Across MSE:**

Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in\-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together.


At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C\-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code.


**What you will do:**

Business Development Executives will be given a territory of Midsize Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Other role highlights include:


* Build trust\-based value\-added relationships with C\-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success.
* Drive high\-quality activity to build pipeline with multi\-touch prospecting outreach and campaigns.
* Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.
* Conduct calls with C\-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities and close the business.
* Partner with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts.
* Transition new accounts to account management to ensure a fast start to new client value.
* Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory.

**What you will need:**

* 4\+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C\-Level Executives.
* Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.
* Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.
* Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates.
* Bachelor's degree desired

**What you will get:**

* Uncapped earnings potential. Our sellers' success is recognized and rewarded accordingly.
* Comprehensive onboarding. All new hires begin their time at Gartner by going through Expedition, a robust training program to help them succeed.
* Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all\-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.
* Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro\-environmental shifts occur.

\#LI\-AS14


**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

description:

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert\-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands\-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't

* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

* Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision

* Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

**Nice to Have**
* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full\-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open\-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high\-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
****Working at Atlassian****
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Your future team: Search Platform**
 The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search , knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third\-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost\-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
 As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting\-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100\+ sources. Your deep expertise in large\-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
   

  

 As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step\-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world\-class end\-to\-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
   

  

****Responsibilities:****
* Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
* Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real\-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
* Make hard architectural trade\-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity \- and own the outcomes.
* Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
* Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real\-world data \- schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
* Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
* Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data\-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
* Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.


****Qualifications****
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

****Requirements:****
* Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) \- you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.
* Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale \- including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
* Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.
* Demonstrated department\-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top\-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.
* Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.
* 12\+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.


****Benefits \& Perks****
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
****About Atlassian****
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**

Stream Perfect Global Services (SPGS) is looking for a highly skilled and hands\-on **Senior Software Developer – Python** with strong experience in **Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Video Analytics**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating and optimizing software solutions that process **live and recorded CCTV/IP camera video streams** and convert video data into actionable intelligence.

The role will involve working on **AI\-powered video analytics applications**, including object detection, people analytics, activity recognition, behavioral analysis, safety and hygiene monitoring, SOP compliance and real\-time event detection.

The candidate will work closely with our **AI/ML, Computer Vision, Product, DevOps and Software Engineering teams** to build and deploy scalable video analytics services for enterprise customers.

1\. Python Software Development

2\. Computer Vision \& Video Analytics

* Develop and integrate **Computer Vision and AI/ML algorithms** for real\-world video analytics applications.
* Process live CCTV/IP camera streams and recorded video.

* Evaluate model accuracy, false positives, false negatives and performance.

title: Senior Architect
description:
Senior Architect – Residential Construction

**Company:** Buildhood Infratech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Industry:** Residential Construction / Architecture

**About Buildhood**

Buildhood is a residential construction company specializing in **independent houses, villas, duplex homes, and multi\-storey residential buildings**. We focus on quality construction, transparent processes, professional project management, and delivering homes that combine functionality, aesthetics, and modern design.

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Architect** who can take ownership of architectural design and coordinate effectively with clients, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and site execution teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage architectural design for **independent houses, villas, duplex homes, and residential buildings**.
* Understand client requirements, lifestyle preferences, budget, and functional needs.
* Develop **concept designs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and detailed working drawings**.
* Prepare and review architectural drawings using **AutoCAD** and other relevant design software.
* Develop attractive and practical **3D designs and presentations** for client approvals.
* Coordinate architectural drawings with **structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other MEP requirements**.
* Review drawings and ensure they are practical and suitable for site execution.
* Conduct regular **site visits** to monitor architectural execution and resolve design\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Project Managers, Structural Consultants, and vendors.
* Review material selections, finishes, colours, façade elements, and other architectural details.
* Identify design conflicts and provide timely solutions during construction.
* Ensure projects follow approved drawings, design standards, and quality requirements.
* Attend client meetings and confidently present design concepts, drawings, and modifications.
* Manage design revisions based on client and project requirements.
* Support the project team from **concept design through construction and final handover**.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure timely completion of drawings and design deliverables.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Architecture (B.Arch)** from a recognized institution.
* **5–6 years of relevant experience** in residential architecture.
* Strong experience in designing **independent houses, villas, duplex homes, and premium residences**.
* Excellent knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Good working knowledge of **SketchUp / 3D visualization / rendering software**.
* Knowledge of architectural detailing and construction practices.
* Good understanding of structural and MEP coordination.
* Strong knowledge of building materials, finishes, façade design, and residential construction.
* Ability to read and interpret structural and MEP drawings.
* Good communication and client\-handling skills.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to travel to project sites across Bengaluru.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in **premium residential projects**.
* Knowledge of **Vastu principles** and ability to incorporate them into designs when required.
* Experience with **3D Max, Lumion, Enscape, V\-Ray, Revit, or similar tools**.
* Experience coordinating with contractors, consultants, and site teams.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating completed residential projects.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **premium residential projects in Bengaluru**.
* Exposure to complete projects from **design to construction and handover**.
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership of architectural projects.
* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their **updated CV and portfolio of residential projects** with us.

**Position:** Senior Architect  
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment:** Full\-Time

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

title: Principal Engineer Water & Wastewater_Plant 3D
description:
The suitable candidate for this role is a Principal BIM Engineer specializing in Plant and Piping design for Water and Wastewater projects, with a strong focus on Digital Delivery. The role involves close coordination with design engineers and digital teams across India and New Zealand, supporting project delivery through high‑quality CAD and 3D modelling outputs.


The Principal BIM Engineer will take ownership of 3D modelling, drafting, and preparation of design documentation for water supply and wastewater (sewerage and drainage) infrastructure, including treatment plants, pump stations, and associated piping networks. The role supports projects across all stages, from concept and preliminary design through to detailed design and construction documentation.


Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining Plant 3D/Piping models, Revit 3D modelling \& Civil 3D producing layouts, profiles, long\-sections, and detailed drawings, and ensuring compliance with provided standards, digital requirements and project specifications. The focus is on delivering accurate, coordinated, and construction‑ready CAD deliverables that meet client and project expectations.


  
* Deliver Plant \& Piping CAD and BIM outputs for water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pipelines, pumping stations, treatment plants, recycled water schemes, dams, and desalination facilities, in line with WSP and client standards.
* Prepare 2D and 3D deliverables using AutoCAD and Plant 3D, including GA drawings, piping layouts, isometrics, plot plans, sections, PFDs, P\&IDs, and construction‑ready drawings.
* Develop, manage, and maintain federated BIM models, undertaking clash detection, coordination, issue resolution, reporting, and data management within the Common Data Environment (Autodesk Vault).
* Produce Bills of Materials (BOMs), quantity take‑offs, schedules, and equipment lists in accordance with project and client requirements.
* Coordinate with multi‑disciplinary teams (civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and process) to deliver integrated and constructible design outcomes.
* Liaise with New Zealand / ANZ lead offices to support cross‑regional project delivery and effective communication.
* Review and check drawings and models to ensure compliance with WSP drafting standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and statutory regulations.
* Take ownership of CAD delivery for small to large projects, contributing to design reviews, coordination meetings, and technical discussions.
* Mentor and guide junior and intermediate CAD staff, promoting best practices, efficiency, and capability development.
* Apply and champion QA/QC processes, supporting audits, continuous improvement, and compliance with WSP management systems.
* Provide regular progress updates, risk identification, and workload forecasts to line management.

Required Technical and Soft Skills


* Strong experience in Plant \& Piping design for Water and Wastewater infrastructure, delivering GA drawings, layouts, isometrics, PFDs, P\&IDs, and detailed construction drawings.
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk AutoCAD and Plant 3D, with hands‑on experience in BIM coordination, clash detection, and federated model management.
* Ability to interpret engineering inputs, specifications, vendor data, and survey information, and prepare BOMs, quantity take‑offs, and schedules.
* Good understanding of CAD/Digital Delivery standards and international (NZ, Australian, UK, US) design standards.
* Experience working in multi‑disciplinary and cross‑regional project environments.
* Strong communication, coordination, and collaboration skills, with a professional approach to design reviews and stakeholder engagement.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring ability.
* High attention to detail, quality focus, and ability to manage multiple priorities within deadlines.
* Proactive, self‑driven, and solution‑oriented mindset, with willingness to adopt new technologies and develop cross‑disciplinary knowledge.
* Commitment to Health \& Safety, sustainability, and WSP Future Ready® principles.

Software Proficiencies


* Demonstrated advanced hands\-on expertise in AutoCAD Plant 3D \& BIM coordination is a critical requirement for this role.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in AutoCAD (2D), Navisworks, Revit, and Civil 3D is essential.
* Proven experience in using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and BIM 360 platforms for project delivery and collaboration. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  
* Minimum qualification of a bachelor’s degree in civil or mechanical engineering, or (B.Tech or equivalent) in a relevant engineering discipline

Experience


* 12–18 years of proven experience in water supply and wastewater utility projects.
* Experience in utilities water, wastewater, recycled water pipeline projects, including potable water supply mains (DN50–DN1200\), pumping stations, reservoirs, water sampling stations, bulk metering systems, emergency storage systems, odour control units and chemical dosing systems.
* Proven experience in AU/NZ projects is highly preferred, with additional exposure to UK, US, or Middle East projects considered an advantage.

title: Senior Engineer - Stormwater/ River Hydraulic Modelling ICM
description:
Suitable candidate for this role is an young and emerging technical leader in **Storm and River Water (Flood) Modelling.** As a Senior Engineer you will be rendering end to end Hydraulic Modelling and allied engineering services for Storm, River and Waste Water systems. The role involves coordination with design engineers and peergroups across India and New Zealand while reporting to Head of Department in India. You would be expected to act as the go\-to technical expert with proven hands\-on expertise in Autodesk Innovyze ICM. Additional expertise in TuFlow will be preferred.


  
* Apply hydraulic principles for River, Storm and Waste Water infrastructure planning, including stormwater networks, culverts, bridges as well as open channel and 2D surface flows.
* Interpret hydraulic models and outputs for infrastructure planning. Develop hydrologic models and urban hydrology for use in hydraulic modelling.
* Use Innovyze ICM and/or Tuflow software to build, update or test options/scenarios for river and/or stormwater systems. This includes model schematisation, assessment of model inputs and gap analysis, model build, validation and calibration, system performance assessment, and floodplain and hazard mapping.
* Ensure model accuracy based on available information across Model Build, Demand Analysis \& Allocation, Calibration and Masterplanning
* Be able to interpret and manipulate geospatial datasets for hydraulic modelling using ArcGIS or QGIS.
* Produce reports and presentations at high levels of professional and technical calibre suitable for presenting to clients.
* Apply sound engineering judgement and best practices to arrive at technical decisions that drive innovative, fit\-for\-purpose and value\-engineered solutions to meet project and client needs.
* Ensure that all technical risks are understood, managed, assigned to the organisation best placed to manage the risk, and that these are well communicated to the project team and/or the client.
* Ensure all assignments are completed on schedule and within budget while implementing Quality Assurance protocols.
* Support delivery of registrations of interest, pre\-qualifications, project proposals/bids, fee estimates, project work programmes and budgets.
* Work with project leadership to plan projects through proper scoping with appropriate inputs, outputs, verifications and project reviews.
* Review work carried out by junior colleagues including appropriate verification of projects and peer review work done by colleagues and team members as necessary.
* Maintain knowledge of appropriate technical standards, legislation, codes of practice and New Zealand norms to ensure compliance with applicable standards, specifications, tolerances, safety factors and project brief. Keep abreast of industry developments, trends and processes.
* Liaise and work closely with Sector leadership and peer groups across India and New Zealand; Act as a brand ambassador of GCC within WSP in India across geographies; Create opportunities to share learnings, improvements, new tools, better practices etc. with the wider water team; Develop and maintain effective networks and spheres of influence (internally and externally) with team members and key stakeholders.

Desired Skills


* Fluency in spoken and written English and able to communicate ideas and complex technical matters lucids and with laconic brevity.
* Natural and confident technical leader displaying openness, accountability, decisiveness and engagement; Client centric and passionate about service excellence who can recognise and manage commercial risks while demonstrating value to the client.
* Able to develop and promote technical innovations and out\-of\-the\-box ideas; Persuasive.
* Effective problem solver engaging sound problem solving techniques and appropriate analysis; Application of knowledge learning principles.
* Can positively impact and influence office culture with and optimistic and dynamic outlook towards opportunities; Can work collaboratively with different stakeholders and across cross\-cultural teams; Ability to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully.
* Display drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with high levels of motivation and energy; Project credibility demonstrate professionalism and inspire confidence with high emotional intelligence and self\-awareness of strengths and potential areas for development
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail; Able to perform independently and/or under minimum supervision.
* Stay calm and deliver under pressure with ability to cope with urgency, work pressures and ensure achievement of project imperatives; Resilient, comfortable with change and ambiguity.

Software Proficiencies


* Must be highly proficient in ICM software for stormwater hydraulic modelling, or Tuflow software for river hydraulic modelling.
* Highly capable of using ArcGIS or QGIS to deliver stormwater and/or river hydraulic modelling projects.
* API programming skills (especially using RubyScript), SQL and VBS scripting within MS Excel with demonstrated automation/digital innovation will be given preference.
* Good to have software proficiencies: Bentley SewerGEMS, Innovyze WSPro, ArcGIS, Civil 3D, 12D, HEC\-RAS, HY\-8, DHI MIKE and similar.

  
* Masters/Bachelors Degree in Water Resource Engineering or Environmental Engineering or similar
* Member of a professional body like CIWEM, ICE etc.; Chartered or equivalent status preferred.

Experience


* 8\+ years of experience in Hydraulic Modelling for large scale River, Storm and Waste Water Infrastructure projects; Including at least 4\+ years of hands on experience using TuFlow/Innovyze ICM.
* Past experience in AU/NZ projects is preferred; should at least have experience in overseas (UK/US/ME) projects.

description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a SDET Tech Lead to drive quality engineering initiatives across critical products and platforms. You will lead automation strategy, improve release confidence, and enable shift\-left quality practices across engineering teams. * Drive shift\-left testing practices by embedding quality gates during grooming, design, and development phases.
* Contribute to engineering quality governance through RCA discussions, defect analysis, and process improvements.


**Automation \& Framework Engineering**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile (iOS/Android), and backend systems.
* Build robust automation solutions with strong debugging, logging, retry, and resiliency capabilities.
* Drive automation adoption across functional, regression, integration, and smoke testing layers.
* Improve automation reliability, execution efficiency, and test coverage across products.
* Ensure maintainability and scalability of automation frameworks through engineering best practices.


**CI/CD \& Release Quality**
* Own automation integration into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates for deployments.
* Collaborate with DevOps and Platform teams to improve release quality and deployment confidence.
* Contribute to test environment management, test data strategies, and release validation processes.
* Monitor automation stability, flaky executions, and release quality metrics.


**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Mentor and guide SDETs on automation, coding standards, debugging, and quality engineering practices.
* Conduct framework reviews, test strategy discussions, and technical reviews across teams.
* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and product managers on quality initiatives and engineering improvements.
* Drive a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 6 \- 8 years of experience in Quality Engineering with strong automation expertise.
* Proven experience leading QE initiatives in product\-based or high\-scale engineering organizations.
* Strong programming skills in TypeScript (preferred), JavaScript, Java, or Python.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in automation frameworks and tools such as Playwright (preferred), Appium or similar technologies.

* Good understanding of databases, SQL queries, and backend validation strategies.

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Experience mentoring teams and driving quality engineering best practices across pods.


**Good To Have**
* Experience building unified automation frameworks supporting Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), and APIs.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling.
* Understanding of security testing concepts including OWASP Top 10 and secure engineering practices.
* Familiarity with Selenium 4/CDP, contract testing, or observability tools.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing tools, intelligent test execution, self\-healing automation frameworks, or GenAI\-driven QE workflows.


**What We're Looking For**
* A strong Quality Engineer who has evolved into a technical leader.
* Someone who can balance hands\-on automation with quality strategy and engineering excellence.
* A leader who drives scalable quality practices and raises the engineering bar across teams.
* A problem\-solver who thrives in fast\-paced, product\-driven environments.


**Why Join Us**
* Opportunity to build and scale quality engineering practices for high\-impact products.
* High ownership and visibility across engineering initiatives.
* Exposure to modern engineering and AI\-assisted testing practices.
