title: AI Intern
description:
AI Engineer Intern

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka / Hybrid  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate **AI Engineer Intern** to join our growing team. You will gain hands\-on experience designing, building, and testing **LLM\-powered applications and agentic AI systems** that solve real\-world problems.

This internship offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of applied AI research and software engineering, learn modern AI technologies, and contribute to practical projects under the guidance of experienced professionals.

Key Responsibilities

**LLM Integration \& Prompt Engineering**

* Assist in integrating LLM\-powered features using OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and open\-source model APIs.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for accuracy, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.
* Work with structured outputs, function calling, and tool\-use workflows.
* Explore prompt engineering techniques such as few\-shot prompting and self\-consistency.

**Agentic Pipeline Development**

* Assist in building multi\-step agentic workflows using frameworks such as **ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen**.
* Support the development of multi\-agent systems with role separation, task delegation, and coordination logic.
* Explore memory systems and persistent agent behavior.

**RAG \& Knowledge Systems**

* Assist in developing and maintaining **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines.
* Work with vector databases such as **Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector**.
* Experiment with chunking strategies, embedding models, semantic search, and re\-ranking.
* Evaluate retrieval quality and contribute to improving AI\-generated responses.

**Evaluation \& Observability**

* Assist in defining and tracking metrics for LLM output quality, latency, cost, and reliability.
* Work with evaluation tools such as **RAGAS, LangSmith, or custom evaluation frameworks**.
* Monitor AI applications and help identify issues such as hallucinations, regressions, and unreliable outputs.
* Document experiments, findings, and technical improvements.

Requirements

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field**.
* Basic understanding of **Python**, APIs, and software development.
* Familiarity with **LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI/ML concepts**.
* Understanding of basic data structures and problem\-solving.
* Eagerness to learn and work with modern AI technologies.
* Good analytical, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and contribute to a collaborative team.

Preferred Skills

* Python programming and API integration.
* Familiarity with **OpenAI or Anthropic APIs**.
* Basic knowledge of **LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or ADK**.
* Understanding of **RAG, embeddings, and vector databases**.
* Exposure to **FastAPI, async programming, or backend development**.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and software development practices.
* Interest in AI agents, automation, and intelligent applications.
* Academic projects, personal projects, GitHub repositories, or demos involving AI/ML or LLMs.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks such as **RAGAS, TruLens, or DeepEval**.
* Basic understanding of LLM security, prompt injection, and guardrails.
* Experience deploying applications on **AWS, GCP, or Azure**.
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects or published experiments.

* Exposure to real\-world RAG pipelines and intelligent applications.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
* Opportunity to learn modern AI frameworks and development practices.
* Internship certificate upon successful completion.

* Academic or personal projects involving AI, ML, NLP, or LLMs are preferred.
* Strong interest in applied AI engineering and continuous learning.

description:

**About GlobalFoundries**

GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com .


**Introduction**

The Senior Systems \& Solutions Engineer will be a hands\-on customer\-facing technical leader for the Custom Digital MCU/MPU business. The role will work with customer engineering teams to understand product architectures, identify system requirements, position GF/MIPS processor and mixed\-signal capabilities, and translate customer needs into clear product and technology roadmap inputs.


The ideal candidate combines embedded processor systems depth with customer credibility. They should be comfortable discussing real\-time control, embedded software, system partitioning, connectivity, safety/security, mixed\-signal integration, and application\-specific tradeoffs with both customer engineers and internal product/architecture teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Engage customer engineering teams to understand product systems, architecture choices, workloads, software stacks, constraints, and roadmap needs.

* Hands\-on experience with one or more of: automotive electronics, industrial automation, robotics/motor control, networking/infrastructure, e\-mobility, or Edge AI systems.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customer engineering teams and internal silicon/software/product teams.
* Experience creating technical collateral, competitive analysis, architecture recommendations, and requirements documentation.
* Comfortable working across hardware, software, safety/security, connectivity, and mixed\-signal technology domains.

description:

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18716****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/14/2026**

### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years in the trenches of high\-speed interface design, where a 50\-ohm trace matters and a poorly modeled via can sink a product launch. You know that signal integrity is not just about making the eye diagram look clean, it is about understanding what breaks at 56 Gbps and why the power delivery network you signed off on three months ago is now causing headaches in the lab. You think in transmission lines, S\-parameters, and frequency domain responses, not because you memorized the textbook but because you have debugged enough real silicon to know where theory meets reality.


You are comfortable sitting with a layout team reviewing a PCB stackup, then jumping into a SPICE deck to model crosstalk on a DDR5 interface, then explaining to a customer why their return path is the problem. You do not wait for someone to hand you a perfect model. You build it, verify it, and iterate until it matches what you see on the scope.


Research excites you, especially when it is tied to what is coming next. MRDIMM, LPDDR6, HBM4, UCIe. You want to be ahead of the curve, not chasing it. At Synopsys, you will work on the interfaces that power the next generation of AI and compute, and the work you do will show up in customer tape\-outs across the industry.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review and analyze die, package, and PCB physical layouts for signal integrity and power integrity performance on high\-speed interfaces
* Model, simulate, and verify DDR, HBM, UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet interfaces using SPICE and 3D field solvers to ensure compliance with specifications
* Drive improvements to SI/PI methodology flows, identifying bottlenecks and building automation to increase accuracy and turnaround time
* Collaborate with IP development, customer engagement, and CAD teams on cross\-functional projects tied to next\-generation interface rollouts
* Independently lead SI/PI research and development activities for emerging standards including MRDIMM, LPDDR6, HBM4, and UCIe
* Debug and resolve signal integrity and power integrity issues in customer SoC, package, and board designs across different application domains
* Script and automate simulation workflows using Python and TCL to streamline repetitive tasks and improve team productivity

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable SI/PI sign\-off for customer designs across automotive, data center, mobile, and AI applications, directly affecting tape\-out schedules and product success
* Improve the speed and accuracy of SI/PI methodology flows used by teams globally, reducing simulation turnaround time and increasing confidence in results
* Provide technical guidance to customers on next\-generation memory and interconnect IP, helping them navigate design tradeoffs before they commit to silicon
* Drive early research into emerging standards so Synopsys can deliver IP and tools ahead of industry adoption curves
* Build cross\-team collaboration between Bengaluru, North America, and APAC engineering groups, ensuring knowledge transfer and consistent methodology
* Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in high\-speed interface IP by solving hard problems that competitors have not figured out yet
* Support the development of AI\-driven SoCs by ensuring the memory and interconnect layers can actually deliver the bandwidth the architecture promises

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in signal integrity, power integrity, or high\-speed interface design
* Strong working knowledge of transmission line theory, time\-domain and frequency\-domain analysis, and S\-parameter modeling
* Proficiency with SPICE simulation tools and experience using 3D electromagnetic field solvers for layout extraction and analysis
* Practical understanding of DDR, HBM, UCIe, PCIe, or Ethernet interface architectures and their SI/PI challenges
* Solid verbal and written communication skills in English, you will work with global teams and customer\-facing engineers regularly
* Experience with Python and TCL scripting for simulation automation and data post\-processing is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a layout and immediately spot the return path discontinuity or the stub that is going to cause reflections at 10 GHz
* You are comfortable explaining a complex SI tradeoff to a customer architect in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* You do not treat simulation as a black box, if the results do not make sense, you dig into the model until you understand why
* You are organized enough to juggle multiple customer engagements and internal projects without dropping threads or missing deadlines
* You push back when a design decision does not make sense from an SI/PI perspective, and you do it with data, not opinion
* You are curious about what is coming next in the industry and you actively read specs, papers, and early drafts of emerging standards

This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Contribute to the Agentic Analytics system, an AI agent that answers business questions by generating and evaluating SQL, by reviewing agent outputs for correctness, curating golden evaluation datasets, and capturing domain business rules that improve the agent's accuracy over time.
* Develop a deep understanding of EarnIn's core business domains to evaluate whether AI\-generated answers are correct for real business questions; your domain judgment is the most valuable input to the system.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real analytics engineering context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented SQL and Python code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers and analysts across the Data team; present your work and learnings to the broader team.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Experience with SQL \- writing queries, understanding data models, working with analytical datasets; coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with Python for data work; classroom or project experience is fine.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. This is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Curiosity about how businesses work \- you want to understand why a metric is defined a certain way, not just how to query it.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset \- you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly with moderate guidance.
* Prior internship or project experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, and/or business intelligence is a plus.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or dbt in any environment (coursework, personal project, or prior role) is a plus.
* Exposure to data modeling concepts or BI tools (Tableau or similar) is a plus


\#LI\-Hybrid

description:
### **Senior Business Systems Analyst \- Procurement**


* JR\-163523
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology Enablement
* Full time

**Who are we?**


Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.  

  



A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.


A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
About the Role


Equinix is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Business Systems Analyst** to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.


You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.


The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.

  

Key Responsibilities


 Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.


 Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.


 Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.


 Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.


 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.


 Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.


 Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.


 Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.


 Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.


 Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.


 Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.


 Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.


 Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.


 Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.


 Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.


 Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.


 Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.


 Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.

  

Required Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.


 8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.


 Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.


 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.


 Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.


 Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.


 Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.


 Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.


 Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.


 Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.


 Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.


 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.


 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.


 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.


 Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.


 Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.


 Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.


 Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.


 Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.


 Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.


 Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.


 Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.


How You will find success


* Cultivate a strong sense of curiosity and a product\-focused mindset.
* Collaborate effectively with managers, cross\-functional teams, and teammates to achieve shared goals.
* Demonstrate persistence, creativity, and an unwavering drive to deliver results.
* Take pride in ownership and consistently strive for excellence in every initiative.

Job Summary
  
  

The Assistant Manager, MIS is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining and enhancing management information reports, dashboards and analytical outputs for Collections and Recoveries operations. The role supports business decision\-making through accurate, timely and standardised reporting, strong data controls, process documentation and continuous improvement across markets supported by the Centre of Excellence.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support the MIS and Collections reporting strategy by delivering reliable, scalable and standardised reporting solutions aligned to business priorities.
* Drive automation, simplification and continuous improvement of recurring reports, dashboards and data processes.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, translate them into actionable MI outputs and support data\-led decision\-making.


Business
  
* Prepare, validate and publish daily, weekly, monthly and ad hoc MIS reports for Collections and Recoveries operations.
* Provide analytical insights on portfolio performance, delinquency, allocation, roll rates, agency performance, productivity, scorecards and operational KPIs.
* Ensure business users receive timely and accurate reporting support for performance reviews, governance forums and management updates.


Processes
  
* Maintain robust end\-to\-end reporting processes, including data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, validation and publishing.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, report inventories, control checklists and Documents of Instruction to ensure continuity and audit readiness.
* Identify reporting defects, data quality issues and process gaps; coordinate with relevant teams to resolve issues and implement preventive controls.
* Use tools such as Excel, SQL, SAS, Python, Power BI and macros to automate reporting and improve efficiency where applicable.


People \& Talent
  
* Work collaboratively with country, regional and central teams to deliver reporting outcomes and resolve data/reporting queries.
* Support knowledge transfer, cross\-training and effective handover for reports and processes to build resilience within the team.
* Demonstrate accountability, attention to detail, flexibility and a continuous learning mindset while managing competing priorities.


Risk Management
  
* Maintain strong controls over data handling, report production, access, reconciliations and approvals to minimise operational and conduct risk.
* Escalate data discrepancies, reporting breaks, control gaps and compliance issues in a timely manner.
* Ensure reports are produced in line with approved definitions, business rules, governance requirements and applicable data confidentiality standards.


Governance
  
* Adhere to Group, Country, Business and Functional policies, standards and procedures relevant to MIS, data management and operational reporting.
* Maintain evidence of report controls, approvals, reconciliations and issue resolutions for governance and review purposes.
* Support internal reviews, audits and management governance meetings by providing accurate reporting inputs and documented explanations.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Collections and Recoveries Operations, Country Collections teams, Agency Management teams, Risk, Finance, Technology/Data teams, Governance and Controls teams, Regional and Group MIS stakeholders, and senior business management.


Other Responsibilities
  
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Collections and Recoveries MIS; perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; support additional reporting, analytics, remediation or transformation initiatives as required.


Skills and Experience
  
  

* Data Analysis and Interpretation
* Management Information Reporting
* SQL / SAS / Python
* Excel, VBA and Automation
* Power BI / Dashboard Development
* Data Quality, Controls and Reconciliation


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Relevant 3 to 5 yrs experience in MIS, analytics, reporting, collections operations, banking operations or financial services preferred.
* Working knowledge of data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, dashboarding and reporting controls.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**The Company**

We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


\<p\>Join PayPal’s Offensive Security team to help protect our products, applications, infrastructure, and emerging technologies. You’ll conduct hands\-on penetration testing and secure code reviews across web, mobile, APIs, cloud, infrastructure, and other environments. You’ll also validate findings from AI\-assisted code reviews and automated security tools, assessing exploitability and business impact while identifying complex vulnerabilities and business logic flaws. Working closely with engineering teams, you’ll translate findings into realistic attack scenarios and practical remediation guidance.\</p\>
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
* Independently apply security best practices to enhance and optimize systems, ensuring robust protection and efficiency, while beginning to understand and align security solutions with business objectives.
  

  
* Partner with peers and internal teams to drive security initiatives, contribute to cross\-functional projects, and at times co\-lead efforts to strengthen security posture.
  

  
* Analyze and resolve security challenges by adapting standard processes and exploring alternative approaches to address complex threats.
  

  
* Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team through informed decision\-making, with a potential impact on other teams.
  

  
* Collaborate with other engineers to gather and incorporate feedback, driving continuous improvements in security processes.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

  
* 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  

  

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


* 5\+ years of hands\-on penetration testing experience preferred, including experience managing security assessments from scoping and execution through reporting and remediation support.
* Experience conducting secure source\-code reviews and identifying complex vulnerabilities and business logic flaws.
* Knowledge of application security, cloud environments, identity flows, common attacker techniques, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Familiarity with penetration\-testing methodologies and guidance such as PTES and OWASP.
* Proficiency in a scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Perl.
* Software development experience with languages or platforms such as Java or Node.js is preferred.
* Experience assessing AI/ML systems or using AI\-assisted security analysis and automation is a plus.
* Security certifications such as OSWE, OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH are a plus.
* Strong technical writing, communication, critical\-thinking, and attention\-to\-detail skills.

**Additional Responsibilities**


* Scope and execute authorized penetration tests across web, mobile, APIs, thick\-client applications, cloud environments, and internal infrastructure.
* Review and validate potential vulnerabilities identified through AI\-assisted code reviews and automated security tooling.
* Reproduce security findings and evaluate exploitability, business impact, severity, remediation priority, and potential false positives.
* Perform secure source\-code reviews to identify complex vulnerabilities, including business logic weaknesses.
* Test authentication, authorization, session management, OAuth, OIDC, JWT, CSP, cryptography, and related application security controls.
* Evaluate AI/ML systems and apply automation to improve the efficiency and depth of security testing.
* Document vulnerabilities with clear reproduction steps, realistic attack scenarios, technical context, and actionable remediation guidance.
* Support engineering teams through remediation and closure of identified security findings.
* Assess systems against applicable security requirements, including PCI DSS.
* Conduct security research and contribute to broader Offensive Security initiatives.

PayPal

0

That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

* Partner with Security to ensure appropriate access controls, logging, least privilege, and secure configurations.

**Automation \& AI**
--------------------


A key expectation of this role is to help IT operate more efficiently through automation and AI.


This includes:


* Automating manual workflows and system administration tasks.
* Building scalable integrations between enterprise applications.
* Using AI\-assisted tools for troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and service delivery.
* Improving employee self\-service and knowledge management.
* Identifying practical AI use cases while maintaining appropriate security and governance controls.

---------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, IT Engineering, or Enterprise Applications.
* Strong experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience with identity platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Strong knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, SCIM, MFA, and access lifecycle management.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and endpoint management tools such as Intune or Jamf.

* Experience with APIs, automation platforms, and scripting such as PowerShell or Python.
* Strong troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently own technical initiatives and work across multiple teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience supporting a cloud\-first or global workforce.
* Experience with Workato, Power Automate, or similar automation platforms.
* Experience with IT asset management and SaaS administration.
* Familiarity with AWS or Azure.
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled IT workflows.
* Relevant Microsoft, Okta, Atlassian, or ITIL certifications are a plus.
  

  

**The Profile**
---------------


We are looking for someone who is technically strong, curious, pragmatic, and comfortable owning systems end to end.


This is a broad engineering role for someone who can move across identity, SaaS, endpoints, integrations, automation, and AI while keeping reliability, security, and employee experience in mind.


Own the system. Simplify the process. Automate where it makes sense. Build for scale.

At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.

**Objective / Purpose:**


Support the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement in applying operational excellence and human\-centered design to evaluate, redesign, and continuously improve the processes underpinning GPT (Global Program Team) ways of working and the broader R\&D Operational Excellence function. This role combines process design expertise with technical acumen to translate business needs into scalable, technology\-enabled solutions — automations, dashboards, and digital products — that improve insight generation, data usability, and operational efficiency. Working closely with Data, Digital \& Technology (DD\&T) and business stakeholders, the role stewards a practical, Lean\-based optimization framework and moves teams beyond static documentation toward integrated, user\-centric, digitally enabled solutions that balance enterprise standards with business flexibility.

**Accountabilities:**

**1\) Process Design \& Improvement**

* Evaluate current processes and ways of working for GPTs and R\&D Operational Excellence functions, and partner with the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement and function owners to redesign prioritized processes against strategic needs.
* Identify possible opportunities where AI, automation, or digital tooling can reduce manual effort, accelerate cycle time, or improve quality — recommending what to automate versus keep human\-in\-the\-loop, and the expected value.
* Incorporate automation, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to support self\-service and system\-generated insights that improve decision\-making and operational effectiveness.
* Reimagine static outputs (e.g., fixed dashboards) as flexible solutions that support both standardized reporting and user\-driven data exploration.

**2\) Technology \& Data Enablement**

* Collaborate with business owners, DD\&T, and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions for redesigned processes.
* Embed and optimize data within process implementations for structured, reusable inputs, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and governance.
* Identify and evaluate data sources critical to process improvement initiatives, assessing availability, accessibility, and usability.
* Hands\-on development and delivery of technical prototypes and demos to validate process improvements, demonstrate new capabilities, and drive adoption.
* Partner with DD\&T and data quality SMEs to uncover barriers to data access and establish frameworks that balance end\-user flexibility with a single source of truth.
* Maintain accessible, well\-governed process documentation — interconnected with related resources and structured for long\-term version control — so functional leads can apply Process Optimization \& Enablement methods independently.

**3\) Continuous Improvement \& Adoption**

* Lead follow\-up on prototypes to capture lessons learned and refine solutions before broader rollout, keeping a clear line of sight from design intent to adoption and outcomes.
* Support and ensure post\-implementation assessments are completed to capture value, ROI, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Represent process design work in working groups and governance forums on behalf of the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.

**4\) Cross\-Functional Enablement \& Relationships**

* Provide process design support and technical reference guides across R\&D Operational Excellence functions, in alignment with the framework set by the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.
* Partner with the Operations \& Digital Enablement Lead to train peers and line function teams, building an internal process design capability that isn't dependent on any one individual.
* Define simple leading and lagging indicators (e.g., cycle time, rework, adoption, quality) that support periodic process health reviews, and recommend the next round of improvements.
* Build effective working relationships with GPT Enablement, CAPTIVATE process leads, R\&D line function leaders, transformation program leads, and DD\&T partners to ensure designs reflect real operating constraints and surface upstream/downstream dependencies.

**Education \& Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred, with 4\-6\+ years of experience in process design, business operations, data/analytics, or digital transformation.
* Strong, hands\-on command of operational excellence and process improvement methodologies (e.g., value\-stream mapping, metric development, root\-cause analysis, RACI design, and Kaizen\-style improvement events).
* Demonstrated experience supporting end\-to\-end process redesign in matrixed organizations — from current\-state diagnosis through future\-state design, pilot, rollout, and sustainment.
* Systems\-thinking orientation, with the ability to see how a process sits inside a wider operating model and design processes that coherently accommodate upstream and downstream impacts.
* Experience with data platforms, analytics tools, or reporting environments (e.g., Power BI, data models), including a working understanding of how AI and automation can be applied to enterprise processes.
* Understanding of data governance, data standards, and data quality principles.
* Strong analytical orientation — comfortable defining simple process KPIs and using data to diagnose issues and quantify improvement.
* Able to operate across functions without direct authority and bring senior stakeholders along.
* Preferred: familiarity with cross\-functional drug development execution, GPT ways of working, and portfolio/project/resource management processes within R\&D.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin\-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human\-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end\-to\-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human\-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid\-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox\-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.


**Tasks**
---------


* Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?").
* Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce.
* Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability).
* Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere.
* Rank bugs by severity (critical vs. cosmetic) and prioritise them so the team knows what to fix first.
* Retest fixed bugs and confirm that the fixes didn't break anything else (regression testing).
* Work closely with engineering and product, answer their questions, and help reproduce issues.

**Requirements**
----------------


* A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things.
* A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them.
* The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits.
* Clear, easy\-to\-understand communication, both written and spoken.
* First experience with software testing, QA tools, or ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, Linear) is a plus, but not a must depending on focus.

Join **LevelShift** as an **AI Engineer**, where you'll design AI\-native solutions, build intelligent automation pipelines, and develop next\-generation AI applications that solve real business problems. You'll collaborate with product teams, software engineers, data professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production\-ready AI solutions that accelerate digital transformation.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


As an **AI Engineer** at **LevelShift**, you will:


* Build intelligent pipelines utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning, document generation, summarization, content extraction, and task automation.
* Design and develop autonomous AI workflows where AI agents interact with tools, APIs, memory, external systems, and other agents to solve complex business problems using Prompt Engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and planning techniques.
* Analyze and modernize existing enterprise applications, rule\-based systems, stored procedures, and legacy workflows into AI\-native solutions capable of processing structured and unstructured data.
* Develop secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications by integrating LLMs with enterprise systems, cloud platforms, databases, and business processes while following responsible AI and governance best practices.

-------------------------


* Utilize Generative AI throughout the software development lifecycle to accelerate development, automate repetitive engineering tasks, improve documentation, and enhance productivity.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools for prompt optimization, code generation, workflow automation, testing, reasoning, and intelligent knowledge retrieval.
* Work with modern AI technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks to build enterprise\-grade AI solutions.

**Your Skillset**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field with 5**\+ years** of experience in AI Engineering, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or Generative AI.

* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with a passion for learning emerging AI technologies, collaborating in Agile teams, and delivering scalable AI\-driven business solutions.

title: Staff Verification Applications Engineer
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18776 **Date posted** 09/13/2026
### **Alternate Job Titles**

* Staff Verification Applications Engineer
* Senior Applications Engineer, Simulation \& Debug
* Staff Field Applications Engineer, Verification
* Technical Applications Engineer, VCS/Verdi
* Staff Customer Solutions Engineer, Verification

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years in the verification trenches and learned that the hardest part is not running the simulation, it is making sure the customer's entire flow actually works when the design is real, the schedules are tight, and the stakes are first\-pass silicon. You know the difference between a tool that demos well and one that holds up under a million\-gate SoC with Low Power intent and Gate Level Timing checks enabled. You have debugged enough waveforms to spot the issue in minutes, not hours, and you can explain what went wrong to an engineer in Taiwan and an R\&D lead in Mountain View without losing either of them.


You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the problem, write the Tcl script that reproduces it, and work backward from there. You are comfortable sitting with a customer who is frustrated because their regression is failing and walking out with a plan that gets them unblocked by end of week. You have a point of view on what makes a verification flow robust, and you are not afraid to push back when a deployment plan skips the hard questions. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers running the most complex verification challenges in the industry, and what you solve will determine whether their tape\-out happens on time.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Drive customer deployments of VCS and Verdi simulation and debug technology, working directly with design and verification teams to integrate tools into their existing flows
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across UVM testbenches, SVA assertions, Low Power UPF flows, and Gate Level Timing simulations
* Collaborate with global R\&D and product teams to gather customer requirements, reproduce issues, and influence the product roadmap based on real deployment feedback
* Lead competitive engagements by running benchmarks, demonstrating VCS/Verdi advantages, and helping customers evaluate simulation performance and debug efficiency
* Develop and optimize automation scripts in Perl, Tcl, Python, Shell, and Make to improve customer productivity and streamline verification workflows
* Interface directly with customers, product validation teams, and R\&D to propose solutions, suggest product improvements, and close the loop on deployment challenges
* Support customers adopting AI\-driven verification productivity tools and advanced simulation features as part of their methodology evolution

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to close verification faster and hit first\-pass silicon by deploying simulation technology that actually scales to their design complexity
* Reduce time\-to\-tapeout for semiconductor companies building everything from mobile SoCs to automotive safety\-critical designs
* Shape the VCS and Verdi product roadmap by surfacing real customer pain points and competitive gaps that R\&D needs to address
* Drive adoption of advanced verification methodologies including UVM, Low Power, and Gate Level Timing simulation across global customer accounts
* Build long\-term customer relationships that turn Synopsys tools into the backbone of their verification infrastructure
* Accelerate the industry's shift toward AI\-augmented verification by helping customers integrate and adopt new productivity capabilities
* Strengthen Synopsys' competitive position in simulation and debug by winning benchmarks and proving performance in head\-to\-head evaluations

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 5\-12 years of hands\-on experience in verification or applications engineering
* Strong working knowledge of VCS simulation technology and Verdi debug platform, or equivalent simulation and waveform debug tools
* Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, SVA, and verification methodologies applied to real RTL designs
* Proven experience with Low Power UPF flows and Gate Level Timing simulations in customer or product validation environments
* Advanced scripting ability in Perl, Tcl, Python, Shell, and Make for automation and flow development
* Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, Verilog, VHDL, and UNIX/Linux environments
* Exposure to DPI, C/C\+\+, SystemC, Functional Safety, or GenAI technologies is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can explain a complex UVM sequence issue to a customer in two sentences and then write the 50\-line reproducer that proves it
* Comfortable working across time zones with customers in Asia, Europe, and the US without losing momentum on open issues
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once, keeping track of what is blocking each one and what needs to escalate to R\&D
* Self\-directed enough to own a customer deployment from kickoff through production without waiting for someone to tell you what to do next
* You ask the questions that uncover the real problem, not just the symptoms the customer described in the ticket
* Open to travel for onsite customer engagements, competitive benchmarks, and team collaboration when it moves the work forward

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Machine Learning Senior Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
description:
**ABOUT EVERNORTH:**  

Evernorth℠ exists to elevate health for all, because we believe health is the starting point for human potential and progress. As champions for affordable, predictable and simple health care,
  
we solve the problems others don’t, won’t or can’t.
  
Our innovation hub in India will allow us to work with the right talent, expand our global footprint, improve our competitive stance, and better deliver on our promises to stakeholders. We are passionate about making healthcare better by delivering world\-class solutions that make a real difference.
  
We are always looking upward. And that starts with finding the right talent to help us get there.
  
  

Were a small AI\-native RD team inside one of the largest health organizations in the country. We build products that affect real healthcare outcomes — how risk gets detected, how care decisions get made, and how clinical teams do their work. Were looking for hybrid builders who own what they build: people who decide what to build, not just how.
  
AI fluency isnt nice\-to\-have. Its how we work.
  
**A few honest things about this team:** we have access to clinical data at a scale that would take a startup year to build through partnerships, and the ability to deploy to millions of people from day one. We also sit inside an enterprise, which means some things take longer than they would at a seed\-stage company. Weve structured the team to minimize that friction — and were direct about where it still shows up.
  
  

**Position overview:**  

The Problems Were Solving
  
Turning overwhelming data into clarity. Large organizations generate more signals than any team can manually process. A leadership team responsible for a portfolio of millions needs to know which three trends demand attention this week — and why theyre happening — before manual reports would surface them. We build systems that find what matters, understand why it matters, and tell the story to the people who need to act — in near\-real\-time, not weeks later. The technical challenge is multi\-layered: anomaly detection, causal reasoning, natural language synthesis. The human challenge is harder: making AI\-generated insight compelling and trustworthy enough that people actually change what they do.
  
Clinical AI that reaches real patients. The patients who most need intervention are often invisible until theyre already in crisis. We build tools that help care teams identify who needs attentionnow — turning clinical data into prioritized, actionable signals for the people making care decisions. The data is messy, the stakes are real, and getting it wrong matters.
  
Rapid prototypes that drive real decisions. New AI opportunities surface constantly. Leadership needs to evaluate them fast — before the window closes. We run short, high\-intensity build cycles: fromwhat if we could... to a working prototype that can actually move a decision. Scoping what to build is harder than building it, and this is where product sense matters most.
  
Making the team itself faster. We build AI\-augmented workflows that compound over time — tools that reduce overhead, accelerate research, and let the team stay in flow on the hard problems. We eat our own cooking: every internal tool gets used by the people who built it before it goes anywhere else.
  
The infrastructure that makes all of it possible. Enterprise data is siloed and hard to connect to AI systems. We build the connective tissue — agent infrastructure that makes real organizational data accessible to the tools were building. This is the foundation everything else depends on.
  
How We Work
  
  

* Spec\-driven, not sprint\-driven. Write a spec, build it, ship it, demo it. No standups, no ceremonies, no two\-week batches.
* Weekly demos. Every Friday. Working software over status updates.
* High autonomy. You own workstreams, not tickets. No one tells you which file to edit.
* AI\-native every day. We use the tools everyone else is still debating. Thats not optional — its how this team operates.


What We Look For
  
Dimension
  
What It Looks Like
  
Product sense
  
Think about users first. Askswhy beforehow. Has opinions about what to build — and what not to.
  
Engineering fluency
  
Full\-stack capable. Can move from data to API to UI as the problem demands. Writes production\-quality code.
  
Design eye
  
Creates usable interfaces without a designer for every decision. Knows good UX when they see it.
  
AI nativity
  
Use AI tools as core infrastructure for daily work — coding, research, and validation. Understands where models are good and where they break.
  
Shipping velocity
  
Track record offinishing things. Ships products, not just pull requests.
  
Ownership mindset
  
Owns outcomes, not tasks. Takes initiative without being told.Thats not my job isnt in their vocabulary.
  
We want builders who aredeep in one or two areas andfluent across many — able to touch any part of the stack when the problem demands it.
  
Qualities That Matter
  
  

Quality
  
What It Looks Like
  
Craftsmanship
  
Sweats details that matter. Ignores ones that dont.
  
Pragmatism
  
Ships 80% solutions. Knowing when good enough is good enough.
  
Curiosity
  
Learning new tools and tech eagerly. Not precious about their stack.
  
Low ego
  
Celebrates team wins. Admits mistakes. Asks for help.
  
Nice
  
Genuinely kind. Not nice\-as\-performance. Non\-negotiable — small teams require trust.
  
What We Value in Candidates
  
We evaluate outputs, not inputs. What youve shipped tells us more than where youve been or what credentials you hold.
  
**Strong signals:** \- Shipped work — whether through your day job, open source, or personal projects; what you built, who used it, and what it changed \- Evidence of working across the stack: not just the frontend, not just the data layer — the whole system \- AI tool fluency in practice: you use these tools daily, you know where theyre good, and you can show us how \- Outcomes over activities: reduced X by Y% lands better thanbuilt system using Z \- Comfort with ambiguity: can navigate and make decisions without a complete spec
  
Candidates from enterprise environments, startups, and non\-traditional paths have all succeeded in roles like this one. The common thread is the quality and range of the work, not where it was done.
  
  

The Real Picture
  
This team sits inside a major health organization. That means two concrete things:
  
**What it gives you:** Clinical and claims data at a scale that would take a startup year to build through partnerships. The ability to test with real people from day one. Deep domain colleagues — clinicians, actuaries, operations and compliance experts — whose knowledge makes your products better. No fundraising cycle. No runway.
  
**What it requires:** Some decisions take longer than they would at a startup. Shipping in a clinical environment involves compliance review that doesnt exist in consumer software. Weve structured the team to minimize that overhead — and well be direct with you about where it still shows up.
  
This probably isnt the right fit if youre optimizing early\-stage equity upside or pure startup velocity. It is likely if you want to build AI products that reach real people and have the data and distribution to matter from day one.
  
Desired Skills (Indicative, Not Exhaustive)
  
  

**Experience:**  

* 10 years of experience across software engineering, product management, and AI/digital product development.
* Prior experience as a full‑stack engineer (frontend, backend, APIs, data layers, cloud‑native systems) before transitioning into product management is preferred
* Demonstrated success building and scaling AI‑enabled or data‑driven products in real‑world production environments.
* Hands‑on experience with AI experimentation, including hypothesis‑driven development, rapid prototyping, pilots/POCs, and outcome measurement.
* Practical experience designing or working with GenAI and Agentic AI systems (LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation, guardrails).
* Strong track record partnering deeply with AI, data, and engineering teams on complex system design and delivery decisions.
* Experience operating in global, matrixed environments with US‑based product and technology leaders.
* Experience in healthcare, insurance, pharmacy, or other regulated domains is preferred but not mandatory.


Behavioural
  
  

* Strong product sense and ability to operate under ambiguity.
* Ownership mindset with a track record of shipping complete products.
* Effective communicator across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of daily development workflow.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and detail oriented.


Education Requirements
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc.) from top tier institute
* Masters degree (M.E. / M.Tech / M.S.) in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Data Science is preferred from top tier institute

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep technical and operational expertise and can drive infrastructure modernization, virtualization, automation, reliability, security, and continuous improvement across data center and cloud environments.


**Why this role is important to us**

The team is responsible for the complete infrastructure lifecycle—from server build, rack\-and\-stack operations, platform engineering, and virtualization to migrations, capacity management, ongoing support, and service improvement. This role is critical to delivering reliable, secure, scalable, and compliant infrastructure services that support business growth, operational resilience, and technology transformation.


**What you will be responsible for**

As an Assistant Vice President – Infrastructure Engineering \& Virtualization Services, you will:


* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers while managing workload, priorities, performance, succession planning, and career development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, engineering discipline, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Oversee engineering, administration, and support of enterprise Windows Server, VMware, Nutanix, and physical server environments, ensuring availability, performance, security, compliance, and capacity.
* Lead incident, problem, change, and service\-improvement activities, acting as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
* Manage end\-to\-end server deployment and lifecycle activities, including rack and stack, hardware installation, operating system builds, provisioning, decommissioning, VMware ESXi installation, and Nutanix cluster deployment.
* Ensure adherence to data center standards, hardware lifecycle controls, asset tracking, capacity planning, and technology refresh requirements.
* Lead infrastructure modernization, virtualization, migration, upgrade, and cloud\-transformation initiatives across VMware, Nutanix, data center, Azure, and AWS environments.
* Drive standardization, infrastructure\-as\-code, automation, and self\-service capabilities using PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, and related engineering tools.
* Develop and maintain operational procedures, engineering standards, runbooks, dashboards, metrics, and leadership reporting.
* Collaborate with business, architecture, security, operations, vendors, and other stakeholders to coordinate upgrades, refresh programs, migrations, risk remediation, and service delivery priorities.

**What we value**

These leadership capabilities and technical skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Demonstrated people leadership, strategic thinking, technical leadership, project delivery, problem solving, and continuous\-improvement capabilities.
* Deep understanding of enterprise server hardware, virtualization architecture, operating systems, storage, networking, high availability, capacity management, and data center operations.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, NSX, HCX, Nutanix Prism Central and AHV, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
* Practical knowledge of PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, infrastructure automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, operational dashboards, and reporting.
* Excellent communication, executive reporting, vendor management, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence outcomes.
* Strong risk, security, compliance, change\-management, and operational\-governance mindset in a large enterprise environment.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of infrastructure engineering and operations experience, including at least 3 years in a people\-leadership role.
* Proven experience managing enterprise Windows Server, VMware, Nutanix, physical server, and data center environments.
* Demonstrated success leading infrastructure projects, platform migrations, modernization programs, and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Experience with Azure and/or AWS is preferred.
* ITIL, VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft, or cloud certifications are preferred.

**Additional requirements**

Ability to provide leadership coverage for critical incidents, planned infrastructure changes, migrations, and release activities outside standard business hours when required.


**Work Requirement**

* Work schedule and location will align with business and leadership requirements; flexibility may be required to support global stakeholders and critical infrastructure activities.

title: AVP Agency Management - Secured Collections
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Description**

  

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra\-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

 **We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the team.** **Job Title:** AVP – Agency Management (Secured Loans Collections) **Job Summary (Secured Loans / Mortgage\-focused)**  

* Own end\-to\-end collections and recovery for a **delinquent Secured Loans portfolio (Home Loans/Mortgages)**, driving resolution outcomes in line with **regulatory and HSBC conduct expectations**.
* Lead **agency\-managed collections**: set strategy, allocate work, govern performance, and ensure disciplined execution across delinquency stages (early, mid, late, NPA).
* Drive **NPA legal recoveries** with strong working knowledge of secured recovery frameworks and processes: **SARFAESI / DRT / Civil / NCLT**, including coordination with empanelled legal counsel.
* Act as the key liaison for **legal counsel and internal stakeholders** to manage the legal journey from identification to enforcement, ensuring documentation quality and process adherence.
* Maintain robust **risk and control** practices (conduct, reputational, operational, ISR/outsourcing governance), ensuring customer fairness and audit readiness.
* Drive vendor outcomes measured through **Money Recovery Rate (MRR), Flow Rates, Loss Rates, GCL, Provision releases/saves**, productivity and cure performance.
* Ensure adherence to **C19 \& C23 Agency Management Standards**, HSBC internal controls, and timely closure of internal/external audit and regulator findings.

 **Principal Responsibilities** **1\) Collections Performance, Agency Governance \& Legal Action (Secured Loans)**  

* Set monthly/quarterly performance targets for **Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs)** aligned to portfolio strategy and business requirements.
* Build and execute recovery strategies across buckets, including **field collections governance**, settlement frameworks (where applicable), and targeted drives for high\-risk cohorts.
* Monitor and manage DCA performance against KPIs: **MRR, roll/flow rates, GCL, recovery yield, resolution TAT**, and quality metrics (complaints, breaches, audit findings).
* Identify accounts suitable for escalation and **initiate legal action** under **SARFAESI/DRT/Civil/NCLT** in partnership with legal counsel and internal legal teams.
* Own governance of the **end\-to\-end legal journey** on NPA accounts: case hygiene, documentation readiness, hearing updates, milestone tracking, vendor/counsel management and reporting.
* Ensure all collection activity complies with **HSBC Customer Fairness Principles**, including **vulnerable customer considerations** and appropriate communication standards.
* Maintain accurate, timely updates of actions, outcomes and next steps on the **collections system**, ensuring data integrity for reporting and provisioning.
* Conduct structured performance reviews, call listening/field audits (as applicable), and provide formal feedback and corrective actions to DCAs.
* Collaborate with Risk, Operations, Branch/Distribution (if relevant), Legal, Complaints, Finance and Analytics teams to remove bottlenecks and improve recovery outcomes.

 **2\) Operational Effectiveness, Risk \& Control (First Line)**  

* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and comply with Group Compliance Policy; ensure timely implementation of internal/external audit recommendations and regulator observations.
* Ensure DCAs comply with **Information Security Risk (ISR)** requirements and outsourcing governance expectations.
* Run the business in line with relevant manuals/standards: **DIM / RG / LCM / DCA guidelines** and HSBC Customer Fairness Principles.
* Manage customer escalations within defined timelines (e.g., 24 hours) and partner with **Customer Complaints** to control upheld complaint rates within threshold.
* Monitor for potential fraud indicators and provide actionable feedback to Risk teams.
* Maintain and update outsourcing/service provider records (e.g., **Archer**), including service levels, cost governance and performance MI.
* Validate billing accuracy and approve/endorse vendor invoices per policy before payment processing.
* Conduct annual risk evaluations and financial capacity reviews of service providers; retain documentation and evidence for audit.
* Complete all **First Line of Defence (LoD)** activities on time, with clear evidence and tracking.

 **Key Skills \& Experience (make the “secured loans” requirement unmissable)**

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job Description:  

Are you interested in being part of rapidly expanding Amazon initiative to redefine how we deliver packages to Amazon customers and take your skills and career to the next level? Join the Last Mile Data Engineering Team (LMDET) to raise the bar for our delivery channels and redefines Amazon’s global Last Mile delivery network.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Last Mile Data Engineering Team is looking for a Data Engineer (DE) to play a significant role in building their large\-scale, high\-volume, high\-performance data integration and delivery services. These data solutions would be primarily used in periodic reporting, and drive business decision making while dealing efficiently with the massive scale of data available through our Data Warehouse as well as our software systems. You will be responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, evaluating, deploying, and documenting data warehouse/data lake solutions, enabling stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions. You are expected to build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. You are required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. You must be a self\-starter and be able to learn on the go. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required as you will work very closely with diverse teams. As a Data Engineer, you will be working in one of the largest cloud\-based data lakes. You should be skilled in the architecture of data warehouse solutions for the Enterprise using multiple platforms (EMR, RDBMS, Columnar, Cloud). You should have extensive experience in the design, creation, management, and business use of extremely large datasets. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions. Above all you should be passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions and drive change.  

  

About the team  

The Last Mile Data Engineering Team (LMDET) is a specialized data engineering organization focused on delivering seamless, secure, and governed access to Last Mile datasets at scale. The team designs and owns large\-scale data lake and data warehouse infrastructures, including the Last Mile Data Repository (LMDR) and Campus data platforms, housing 10,000\+ datasets across domains such as maps, geocoding, routing, and transportation. Leveraging AWS and industry\-leading big data technologies, the team builds complex ETL pipelines, near\-real\-time data ingestion systems, and reusable datasets that power analytics, business reviews, and machine learning model development. LMDET also drives innovation through Generative AI\-powered solutions for natural language querying, auto\-insight generation, geocoding orchestration, and unified workflow automation, partnering closely with business, science, product, and technology teams to enable intelligent, data\-driven decision\-making across the Last Mile organization.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of data engineering experience
* 4\+ years of SQL experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* 2\+ years of developing and operating large\-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
* Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non\-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key\-value stores, graph databases, column\-family databases)
