title: Financial Reporting Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 The candidate will be a critical member of the Finance function, owning the completeness and accuracy of the books. The role combines deep technical accounting with hands\-on regulatory compliance, audit management, and process ownership — and offers direct visibility to the Group CFO.
 



 This is a high\-accountability role, suited to a CA who has built strong technical depth in their early years and is now ready to take full charge of a business unit's financial control environment.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**1\. Books \& Period\-End Close** 



* Own the complete and accurate general ledger for assigned entities / verticals — from source transactions to trial balance.
* Drive a disciplined month\-end close process: accruals, provisions, prepayments, intercompany eliminations, and ledger scrutiny completed within defined timelines.
* Maintain a zero\-surprise posture — all material balances must be reconciled, aged items explained, and open items resolved proactively.
* Prepare entity\-level MIS packs and financial dashboards for the Financial Controller and CFO on a monthly basis.



**2\. Financial Statements \& Statutory Audit** 



* Independently prepare standalone Ind AS financial statements (Balance Sheet, P\&L, Cash Flow, Notes to Accounts) for assigned entities.
* Own the statutory audit relationship for assigned entities — manage Big 4 / category I auditor queries, drive audit closures as per audit calendar, and target zero re\-opening of closed items.
* Ensure correct application of relevant Ind AS standards: Ind AS 109 / 113 / 107 / 32 for financial instruments; Ind AS 115 for revenue; Ind AS 116 for leases; Ind AS 12 for taxes and all other relevant Ind AS applicable to the vertical.
* Support Group consolidation by providing accurate entity numbers, related\-party schedules, and elimination entries on time.



**3\. Internal Financial Controls (IFC)** 



* Design, document and operate the IFC framework for the vertical — covering financial reporting controls, transaction\-level controls, and IT\-dependent controls within Oracle Fusion.
* Maintain risk\-and\-control matrices (RCMs); ensure all key controls are periodically tested and results documented.
* Track audit observations (statutory and internal) for the vertical; own closure within committed timelines; escalate systemic gaps to the Financial Controller and Group CFO.
* Support the Group's Internal Auditor during periodic reviews — prepare schedules, respond to queries, and implement recommendations.



**4\. Regulatory \& Tax Compliance** 



* Ensure correct direct tax treatment is reflected in the books — TDS (194A / 194H / 194J / 194C / 194LD as applicable), advance tax provisioning, and deferred tax accounting (Ind AS 12\).
* Manage GST compliance for assigned entities: output tax determination, ITC eligibility, blocked credits, RCM applicability, and reconciliation of GSTR\-2B vs. books.
* Liaise with the Tax Head (HF) for Income Tax return inputs, tax audit schedules, and transfer pricing documentation where applicable.
* Support compliance with applicable sectoral regulations.



**5\. Treasury \& Asset Class Accounting** 



* Book and reconcile daily treasury trades across applicable asset classes — listed bonds, equity, F\&O, commodities, AIFs, unlisted securities, structured products.
* Apply correct Ind AS 109 classification (FVTPL / FVOCI / Amortised Cost) at instrument level; maintain documentation of business model assessment and SPPI test outcomes.
* Reconcile MTM valuations against FIMMDA / FBIL / CRISIL prices; maintain a valuation methodology note approved by the CFO and Statutory Auditor.
* Produce a daily treasury P\&L and position report for the CFO / Treasury Head; flag breaks, limit breaches, or valuation anomalies same\-day.



**6\. Process Improvement \& Automation** 



* Identify and eliminate manual, repetitive tasks in the close and reporting cycle — build Excel automation (macros, Power Query) or work with the AI Lead to deploy agent\-based solutions.
* Actively participate in Oracle Fusion enhancement initiatives; raise system gaps via the Financial Controller and own UAT for changes affecting assigned entities.
* Document all key processes in standard SOPs; ensure SOPs are version\-controlled and handed over as part of onboarding / succession.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Non\-negotiable** 



* Chartered Accountant — first attempt strongly preferred.
* Minimum 2 years post\-qualification experience in BFSI sector, preferably in multi business, multi entity set up with exposure in Prop Trading, Asset Management, Wealth Management, NBFC, broking, treasury, or Big 4 FS practice.
* Hands\-on experience in preparation of Ind AS financial statements and independent management of statutory audit — not just support / assistance.
* Solid working knowledge of Ind AS standards relevant to the vertical (Ind AS 109 / 113 / 107 / 32 for markets role and other relevant Ind AS across all roles).
* Strong command of direct and indirect tax compliance — TDS, advance tax, GST, deferred tax.
* Advanced Excel: macros (VBA), Power Query, array / dynamic formulae, pivot\-based MIS models.



**Strongly preferred** 



* Exposure to Oracle Fusion or a comparable ERP (SAP / Tally Enterprise) in a multi\-entity environment.
* Working knowledge of IFC frameworks under Companies Act 2013 / ICAI guidance.
* Familiarity with SEBI AIF / NBFC\-ML / IRDAI regulations as applicable to the vertical.
* Experience handling Big 4 statutory auditors independently.



**Behavioural attributes** 



* High ownership — treats the books as their own; does not wait to be asked.
* Process\-first mindset — documents before doing; builds for scale, not just for today.
* Automation appetite — curious about digital tools; willing to invest time learning new platforms.
* Precision under pressure — delivers accurate numbers on time even during peak close / audit cycles.
* Straight communicator — surfaces bad news early, escalates the right things, comfortable saying no when a transaction is non\-compliant.



  





**Why This Role** 




  




* Exposure to a regulated, multi\-entity financial services group spanning — breadth that is rare at this level.
* Direct line of sight to Group CFO.
* Active build\-out of AI and automation capability within Finance — early movers will shape how the function operates.

title: Marketing & Community Associate
description:
Marketing \& Community Associate

**Location:** Mumbai, India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, In\-office  
**Experience:** 0\-2 years

About SkillUpExchange

SkillUpExchange is building a new technology publishing and learning company. We work with experienced technology professionals and developers to create high\-quality technical books, courses, audiobooks, and other learning products.

We are an early\-stage company, so you will not simply execute an existing marketing plan. You will help us build our community, distribution channels, partnerships, and marketing processes from the ground up.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Marketing \& Community Associate** who enjoys researching people, starting conversations, building relationships, and learning about technology.

A significant part of this role involves identifying relevant developers and technology professionals on LinkedIn, researching their backgrounds and interests, reaching out to them with personalized messages, and developing those relationships over time.

You will also support our authors with social media content, build partnerships with technology newsletters and creators, and maintain our growing community database.

You do not need to be a software developer. You do need to be curious about technology, comfortable communicating with professionals, and willing to learn.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Technology Community Outreach**

* Identify relevant developers, engineers, technology professionals, technical leaders, and technology enthusiasts on LinkedIn.
* Research prospects and understand their interests before reaching out.
* Conduct personalized outreach and appropriate follow\-ups.
* Build genuine, long\-term relationships rather than treating outreach as one\-time communication.
* Invite relevant professionals to become early readers, community members, or participants in our learning programs.
* Build relationships with approximately 40 relevant professionals per working day.

**2\. Community \& CRM Management**

* Maintain our relationship database in Zoho Bigin.
* Track contacts, roles, companies, technology interests, conversations, responses, follow\-ups, and opportunities.
* Track early\-reader participation, learning interests, partnership opportunities, and potential future authors or instructors.
* Keep the database organized and ensure follow\-ups happen consistently.

**3\. Author \& Social Media Support**

* Work with authors to create LinkedIn content ideas and posts.
* Prepare approximately 2 posts per week for each active author.
* Coordinate content calendars and publishing schedules.
* Help authors turn their technical expertise, books, and ideas into useful social content.
* Support content creation for SkillUpExchange, AuthPlat, and the founder's LinkedIn presence.

**4\. Partnerships**

* Research technology newsletters, YouTubers, podcasts, bloggers, developer communities, educators, and online publications.
* Build prospect lists and initiate conversations with potential partners.
* Track partnerships from initial contact through to collaboration or publication.

**5\. Measure, Learn \& Improve**

* Track the journey from people identified → contacted → connected → responded → interested → engaged → community members → customers/participants.
* Analyze what outreach and distribution approaches are working.
* Help improve our processes based on results and feedback.

What We're Looking For

* Strong written and spoken English.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Curious about technology and willing to learn technical concepts.
* Comfortable researching people and understanding what they do.
* Comfortable using LinkedIn and online communities.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Persistent without being pushy.
* Comfortable working with targets and measurable goals.
* Comfortable learning AI tools, CRM software, and other new technologies.
* Self\-motivated and willing to take ownership in an early\-stage environment.

Who Can Apply?

This role can be a strong fit for:

* Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 2 years of experience.
* Candidates from engineering, computer science, technology, marketing, communications, or related backgrounds.
* People active in technology communities, college tech clubs, or online communities.
* Candidates interested in marketing, community building, developer relations, technology publishing, or technology businesses.
* People who genuinely enjoy meeting new people and starting conversations.

**You do NOT need:**

* Prior publishing experience.
* A marketing degree.
* Previous Developer Relations experience.
* To be a software developer.
* An MBA.
* Experience at a large technology company.

We care more about your curiosity, communication skills, initiative, and ability to build relationships than your degree or previous job title.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you will help build a growing network of relevant technology professionals and contribute to:

* Developer and technology professional community growth.
* Early\-reader participation for our books.
* Genuine reader reviews and feedback.
* Author and company LinkedIn visibility.
* Newsletter, creator, and community partnerships.
* Growth and quality of our CRM database.
* A repeatable process for finding and engaging the right audience for our books and learning products.

Compensation

**₹25,000/month fixed salary \+ performance bonus of up to ₹35,000 per quarter.**

Performance will be based on agreed distribution and community\-building objectives, including both results and quality of execution. Spam, irrelevant outreach, misleading communication, or attempts to manipulate reviews will not qualify as successful performance.

Work Schedule

* Monday\-Friday: Office
* 1st, 3rd and 5th Saturday: Working
* 2nd and 4th Saturday: Off
* Up to 2 WFH days per month

Why Join SkillUpExchange?

You will join at an early stage and have the opportunity to help build our technology community and distribution engine from scratch.

You will gain exposure to:

* Technology marketing
* Community building
* Developer relations
* LinkedIn and social media
* Partnerships
* CRM and relationship management
* AI\-assisted research and marketing
* Technology publishing
* Distribution and growth

As the company grows, this role can develop into broader responsibilities across Developer Relations, Community, Developer Programs, Technology Publishing, and Author/Content Acquisition.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a short note explaining why you think you would be good at building relationships with technology professionals.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical exercise involving finding relevant technology professionals for a technical book, explaining why they are relevant, writing an introductory LinkedIn message, and explaining how they would build a relationship with someone who responds.

We care more about how you think and communicate than having the perfect resume.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹440,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Vice President - Data & Analytics, Edelman Intelligence
description:

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise with commercial thinking, innovation, and leadership. Ensure analytical outputs tell a story that resonates with business stakeholders, drives decision\-making, and calls to action — not just report numbers.

Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and reproducibility across the team's work.  



  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration

Work with the Solution team to ensure smooth transitions from analytical outputs to production\-grade deliverables.


Present methodology, findings, and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders and when required clients.

Stay current with developments in AI, data science, and analytics tooling; evaluate and introduce new methods where appropriate.  



  

  

Qualifications


Required


10 or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, predictive analytics, or data science.


5 or more years of experience within media, marketing, or communications environments.


Strong understanding of AI, predictive intelligence, and modern analytics methodologies.


Experience translating analytics into strategic business or client outcomes.


Proficiency in Python and SQL.


Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information for senior internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred

title: Oracle Business Systems & Test Analyst
description:
**Role Purpose**  

  

Support the Future\-Ready Service Ecosystem program by validating Oracle\-based business processes, transactions, integrations and application functionality; coordinating requirements and test feedback between business and technology teams; supporting master data quality; and ensuring release readiness across Oracle E\-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion Cloud and related enterprise applications.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Execute end\-to\-end functional, system integration, regression and user acceptance testing for Oracle applications, enhancements, interfaces and reports.
* Prepare detailed test scenarios, test cases, test data, expected results and evidence; record defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, business impact and supporting documentation.
* Validate Oracle transactions, test Web ADI, workflows, approvals, notifications, scheduled jobs, reports, role\-based access and downstream accounting or operational impacts.
* Perform requirements analysis, process mapping, gap analysis and impact assessment for enhancements, fixes, integrations

and automation initiatives.
  

* Maintain requirements, test status, defect logs, decision logs, action trackers and traceability between business requirements,

configuration, development and test outcomes.
  

* Perform master data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, maintenance and migration support across customer, item, installed

base, branch, territory, contract and service\-related data.
  

* Validate inbound and outbound interfaces, API\-based integrations, data conversions and reconciliation between Oracle and

connected enterprise applications.
  

* Validate role\-based access, permissions, and security profiles across EBS user roles.
* Participate in solution walkthroughs, sprint or release reviews, test\-readiness reviews and defect\-triage discussions;

communicate risks, dependencies and unresolved issues promptly.
  

* Support cutover planning, smoke testing, go\-live validation, hypercare tracking and post\-implementation issue analysis.
* Create and maintain user guides, SOPs, quick references, FAQs, release notes, and KT materials.
* Follow applicable information\-security, data\-privacy, access\-control, documentation and change\-governance requirements.

Systems \& Domain Exposure
  

* Strong working knowledge of Oracle E\-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud applications is preferred.
* Exposure to Oracle modules and processes related to order management, inventory, purchasing, installed base, service

contracts, field service, receivables, billing or finance is desirable.
  

* Understanding of Oracle workflows, concurrent programs or scheduled processes, interfaces, APIs, reports, master data and

role\-based access is preferred.
  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams; SQL or data\-querying exposure is an

advantage.
  

* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM or similar defect and test\-management tools is desirable; OATS or

equivalent testing\-tool experience is preferred.
  

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

* Complete the assigned SIT, regression and UAT cycles on time with full evidence and accurate defect tracking.
* Requirement\-to\-test traceability with minimal gaps between approved business needs and delivered Oracle functionality.
* Accurate transaction, integration and report validation, including documented reconciliation and exception resolution.
* Accurate and timely master data validation and updates with documented approvals and issue closure.
* Timely escalation of blockers, quality risks, dependencies and release\-readiness concerns
* Current and version\-controlled process, testing and knowledge documents before release or handover.

  

**Job Description**  

  

**Skills \& Competencies**  

* Strong Oracle functional testing, data analysis and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand end\-to\-end ERP processes and translate requirements into detailed, practical test scenarios.
* Strong defect\-analysis, root\-cause coordination, reconciliation and documentation discipline.
* Good written and verbal communication with the ability to work effectively with business users, developers, functional

consultants and program stakeholders.
  

* High attention to detail, ownership, follow\-through and ability to work across multiple test cycles and priorities.
**Education \& Experience**  

* Graduate in engineering, computer applications, information technology, computer science, commerce, finance, business, operations or a related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of experience in Oracle functional support, ERP/application testing, business analysis, master data management or implementation programs is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience preparing test cases, executing SIT/UAT, managing defects and validating Oracle transactions or integrations is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with IT development teams, Oracle functional or technical consultants, business stakeholders and thirdparty partners is desirable.
**Work Conditions \& Compliance**  

  

* Fixed\-term contract for 12 months, subject to applicable company terms and conditions.
* May require coordination across functions, locations and time zones based on program needs.
* May occasionally be required to work additional hours or outside standard working hours to support critical testing, releases,

go\-live or business requirements, subject to prior alignment and applicable company policy and local law.
  

* Must maintain confidentiality of business, customer, employee and system information and comply with applicable security

and privacy requirements

title: Data Analyst - Lead
description:
Lead analyst would be working with global stakeholders on analysis of vertical performance \& other ad\-hoc analysis for strategic customers of FedEx.  

Expected to provide expert thought leadership at the enterprise level related to designs and implements advanced processes and analytics associated with a wide variety of data sets used for data/text mining, analysis, and prediction to enable informed business decisions. Gains insight into key business problems and deliverables by applying highly technical analysis techniques to examine structured and unstructured data from multiple disparate sources.
  

Should possess and demonstrate understanding of core Business and Commercial concepts including financial metrics, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes.  

Communicates results to a broad range of audiences. Effectively uses current and emerging technologies to evaluate trends and develop actionable insights and recommendations to management, via understanding of the business model and the information available for analysis.

 **Grade :T7**

**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**

  

As a **Lead Measurement Analyst**, you will be the strategic architect, operational manager, and subject matter expert (SME) driving our commercial performance measurement framework. Operating within the Commercial Analytics and Performance division, you will lead the end\-to\-end design, execution, delivery, and project management of sophisticated analytics that track FedEx global vertical performance.


You will translate complex database queries and advanced statistical models into high\-level business justifications and executive\-level narratives. Serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will synthesize past, present, and future commercial trends to guide marketing, forecasting, and commercial business strategies. Additionally, you will champion analytical standards, distribute work tasks, manage delivery timelines, clear operational roadblocks, and mentor team members to foster a high\-performing culture of data\-driven decision\-making.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Vertical Performance**

* Own the end\-to\-end measurement framework for tracking global performance across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Lead deep\-dive analyses into critical revenue drivers, isolating trends in volume, pricing, and yield—specifically monitoring and developing strategies to address yield compression and regional performance variations.
* Design and champion the architecture of advanced Power BI dashboards and executive scorecards, establishing data modelling and reporting standards across the team.
* Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence partners to optimize enterprise data structures, ensuring consistent data pipelines and high\-integrity reporting environments.

**Executive Consultation \& Narrative Delivery**

* Author and present high\-impact, narrative\-driven business reviews and strategic performance updates directly to executive leadership (e.g., CEO updates, senior staff briefings, and quarterly reviews).
* Translate complex statistical anomalies and commercial trends into clear, executive\-ready "so\-what" insights, detailing the *past* drivers, *present* status, and *future* outlook.
* Formulate data\-driven business cases and pricing/revenue simulations to support strategic adjustments in vertical targeting and market positioning.

**Advanced Statistics, AI, \& Cohort Modelling**

* Direct the implementation of advanced statistical methodologies (such as cohort analysis, regression, and pattern recognition) to identify and explain hidden trends in transactional datasets.
* Drive the business application of AI/Machine Learning models, leveraging clustering algorithms and predictive frameworks to refine customer cohorts, automate industry vertical tracking, and capture emerging micro\-trends.
* Partner with forecasting, marketing, and finance leaders to align historical performance models with forward\-looking growth forecasts and strategic demand plans.

**Team Leadership, Project Delivery, \& Governance**

* **Task Distribution \& Backlog Management:** Manage the intake of analytical requests, prioritize competing demands, and strategically distribute work packages across team members to align with individual strengths and project requirements.
* **Timeline Tracking \& Progress Reporting:** Track delivery milestones for major reporting cycles and ad\-hoc analytics projects, ensuring consistent execution and providing progress and bandwidth updates to department leadership.
* **Roadblock Resolution:** Act as a proactive buffer for the sub\-team, stepping in to resolve technical hurdles, cross\-functional data dependency bottlenecks, or query limitations by collaborating with IT, Data Engineering, and product groups.

* **Mentorship \& Quality Control:** Establish and govern analytical standards, documentation, and query\-optimization practices, providing peer reviews and technical mentoring to mid\- and junior\-level analysts.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience \& Background**

* **7\+ years of progressive experience** in business intelligence, commercial analytics, revenue management, or financial measurement.
* Proven experience in a "Lead", Project Lead, or senior consulting capacity, showcasing the ability to manage project pipelines, track timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional resources.
* Extensive experience querying large\-scale enterprise relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, BigQuery) and building advanced visualization frameworks.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating the successful translation of complex analytical findings into executive level presentations and business cases.

**Core Competencies**

* **Operational \& Delivery Leadership:** Excellent capacity to organize project plans, delegate tasks, track delivery timelines, and maintain team output while actively mitigating risks and clearing technical roadblocks.
* **Strategic Influence \& Executive Storytelling:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, multi\-layered data into clear, persuasive, and action\-oriented narratives for senior executives.
* **Analytical Leadership \& Rigor:** High\-level problem\-solving capability; a track record of formulating robust business hypotheses and establishing rigorous standards for data integrity and statistical validity.
* **Consultative Stakeholder Management:** Ability to collaborate seamlessly with senior directors and cross\-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Pricing, and Marketing) across global time zones.
* **Innovation \& Change Champion:** Proactive approach to adopting new technologies (such as GenAI, machine learning, and automation tools) to optimize legacy reporting systems.

**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**

* **Analytics \& Data Modelling:** Expert proficiency in **SQL** (required) paired with strong data architecture and modelling skills.
* **Advanced Applied Statistics:** Mastery of statistical concepts (e.g., sampling, significance, correlation, predictive modelling) applied directly to commercial cohorts and behavioural segmentations.
* **Business AI \& Machine Learning:** Practical experience leveraging machine learning concepts (e.g., clustering algorithms, decision trees, NLP/text analytics) to drive customer segmentation, automate tracking, and isolate performance anomalies.
* **Data Visualization:** Advanced development skills in **Power BI** or similar enterprise\-grade visualization suites.
* **Programming \& Automation:** Strong proficiency in **Python** or **R** to build reproducible data models, script automation pipelines, and execute advanced analytics.
* **Productivity \& Presentation:** Expert command of MS Excel (advanced modelling) and PowerPoint (drafting highly polished, visually compelling slides for leadership reviews).

**Certifications** ***(nice to have)***

* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), Agile/Scrum certification, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent.

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Global Analytics \& Insights (GAI) team is seeking a Data \& Analytics Engineering Manager to lead our team in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and analytics infrastructure. As a Data \& Analytics Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in empowering a team of engineers to build and enhance analytics applications and a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool), Python, Terraform, and Airflow. You will become an expert in Avalara's financial, marketing, sales, and operations data — including the quantitative models that explain how marketing and sales activity converts into pipeline and revenue. The ideal candidate will have deep SQL experience, an understanding of modern data stacks and technology, demonstrated leadership and mentoring experience, and an ability to drive innovation and manage complex projects. This position will report to Director.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Mentor a team of data engineers, providing guidance and support to ensure a high level of quality and career growth
* Lead a team of data engineers in the development and maintenance of data pipelines, data modelling, code reviews and data products
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions
* Drive innovation and continuous improvements within the data engineering team
* Build maintainable and scalable processes and playbooks to ensure consistent delivery and quality across projects
* Drive adoption of best practices in data engineering and data modelling
* Be the visible lead of the team — coordinate communication, releases, and status to various stakeholders
* Design, build, and maintain advanced marketing attribution models — including Markov Chain models with time\-decay weighting — to quantify multi\-touch channel contribution across the SaaS marketing and sales funnel (Traffic → Inquiry → MQL → Pipeline → Revenue), informing channel investment and budget\-allocation decisions
* Champion the team's adoption of AI\-assisted engineering and knowledge tools (e.g., Claude/Claude Code, Cursor, Glean) to accelerate development, code review, and enterprise data/knowledge discovery


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

* 2\+ years management experience, including direct technical reports

* 4\+ years of working with Git, and demonstrated experience using these tools to facilitate growth of engineers
* 4\+ years working with Snowflake
* 3\+ years working with dbt (dbt core preferred)
* Working knowledge of probabilistic/statistical multi\-touch attribution modeling (e.g., Markov Chain attribution with time decay) applied to a SaaS marketing funnel, and the ability to translate that modeling into production data pipelines and reporting


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Snowflake, Dbt, AWS Certified
* 3\+ years working with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* 2\+ years working with CI / CD, and demonstrated ability to build and operate pipelines
* Experience and understanding of Snowflake administration and security principles Demonstrated experience with Airflow


**Why Join Us?**
* Be part of a data\-driven organization that values innovation and efficiency.
* Opportunity to work on impactful BI projects that drive business success.
* Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

 If you are a passionate BI professional looking to take on a leadership role and make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you!

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

**Role Name And Description**
 Senior, MG\-ALFA/Integrate user, tester or modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

 Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
   

  

 Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry
   

  

 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering MG\-ALFA/Integrate user level, testing and modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
   

  

 You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* As a Senior within the Life MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands\-on valuation or modeling experience in a senior capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
The AIM Fraud Operations Analytics team is seeking an experienced, innovative, and people\-oriented Vice President to lead our Fraud GenAI team. As a senior leader and subject matter expert in data science and generative AI, you will be responsible for building and leading a high\-performing team of data scientists while driving the design, development, and deployment of cutting\-edge data science and GenAI\-based solutions. This role focuses on transforming fraud operations processes through advanced AI while fostering team growth, cross\-functional collaboration, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Leadership \& People Management**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.
* Provide technical and career guidance, conduct performance reviews, and support talent development and succession planning.
* Build and scale a high\-performing Fraud Analytics GenAI team, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.


**Project \& Delivery Leadership**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and implementation of generative AI use cases, from ideation to production.
* Oversee the building and tuning of LLM\-based applications using platforms such as Vertex, GPT, Hugging Face, etc.
* Drive robust prompt engineering strategies and the creation of reusable prompt templates.
* Integrate generative AI with enterprise applications using APIs, knowledge graphs, vector databases (e.g., PG Vector, Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma), and orchestration tools.
* Collaborate with Technology, Business, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Manage end\-to\-end project delivery, ensuring on\-time, high\-quality outcomes within regulatory and risk frameworks.


**Technical \& Domain Expertise**
* Responsible for model development, validation, and testing of fraud detection models, including statistical analysis, data validation, and model performance evaluation.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, MRM (Model Risk Management) standards, and industry best practices in fraud detection and GenAI.
* Document model development artifacts for MRM approvals and governance purposes
* Stay current with GenAI trends, research, and advancements in fraud prevention.
* Apply relevant innovations to fraud and risk domain projects (specialization in fraud or risk domain preferred).


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner effectively with senior business leaders, technology teams, risk, compliance, and other stakeholders.
* Present complex technical concepts and project updates to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Influence decision\-making and secure buy\-in for GenAI and data science initiatives across the organization.


**Qualifications:**
* 9\+ years of hands\-on experience in data science or AI/ML roles, with at least 3\+ years in a people leadership or team lead capacity.
* Proven track record of designing and developing data science / GenAI\-based solutions in production environments.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for a Data Analyst to revolutionize how we measure and scale our Partner Ecosystem \& Services Business.. In this role, you won't just build dashboards; you will build intelligent systems. You will sit at the intersection of Channel Operations and Data Science, using Snowflake, SQL, and Python to turn raw data into a competitive advantage.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* AI\-Driven Visualization: Develop high\-impact dashboards (Tableau, CRMA, or Preset) that incorporate AI\-generated narratives and automated trend detection.
* Ecosystem Intelligence: Design and maintain a "Single Source of Truth" in Snowflake for all data (Rebates, Co\-sell, MDF, and Training).
* Workflow Automation: Use AI tools to automate the generation of SQL queries, Python scripts, and dashboard documentation to increase team velocity.
* The ideal candidate is an AI enthusiast who leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate dashboarding workflows, generate natural language insights, and predict partner performance.


**What will you bring?**
* SQL Mastery: Expert\-level ability to write complex, performant queries in Snowflake.
* Modern BI Tools: Mastery of at least one major visualization tool (Tableau, CRMA, Sigma) with a preference for those who have built Streamlit apps or CRMA
* Python Proficiency: Experience using Python for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and integrating with AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) or Snowflake Cortex.
* AI Integration: Proven experience using LLMs to enhance the data lifecycle (e.g., text\-to\-SQL, automated data cleaning, or predictive analytics).
* Domain Expertise: Previous experience with Channel/Partner/Services (GLS/GPS/TAM) is highly preferred.


**Soft Skills**
* Collaborative Architect: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to understand the "why" behind the data.
* The "AI\-First" Mindset: You naturally look for ways to automate the boring parts of data analysis.
* Strategic Storytelling: You can translate a complex "Partner Co\-sell" matrix into a clear story for the Sales Executives.


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to lead the transition from reactive reporting to predictive ecosystem intelligence.
* Budget and support for modern AI tools and experimentation.

title: Functional AI Tester - GenAI
description:
Functional AI Tester \- GenAI
\- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \- \-


We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer focused on testing Generative AI (GenAI) applications with a strong emphasis on Python\-based test automation, GenAI evaluation, and ETL/data quality validation. You will design and execute end\-to\-end test strategies that ensure our AI solutions are accurate, reliable, safe, and compliant.

 **About the Role**


You will be involved in QA for GenAI features including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), conversational AI and Agentic evaluations. The role centers on:

* Systematic GenAI evaluation (qualitative and quantitative metrics)
* ETL and data quality testing for the data flows that feed AI systems
* Python\-driven automated testing


This position is hands\-on and collaborative, partnering with AI engineers, data engineers, and product teams to define measurable acceptance criteria and ship high\-quality AI features.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Test strategy and planning


	+ Define risk\-based test strategies and detailed test plans for GenAI features.
	+ Establish clear acceptance criteria with stakeholders for functional, safety, and data quality aspects.
* Python test automation


	+ Build and maintain automated test suites using Python (e.g., PyTest, requests).
	+ Implement reusable utilities for prompt/response validation, dataset management, and result scoring.
	+ Create regression baselines and golden test sets to detect quality drift.
* GenAI evaluation


	+ Develop evaluation harnesses covering factuality, coherence, helpfulness, safety, bias, and toxicity etc.
	+ Design prompt suites, scenario\-based tests, and golden datasets for reproducible measurements.
	+ Implement guardrail tests including prompt\-injection resilience, unsafe content detection, and PII redaction checks.
	+ Track quality metrics over time.
* RAG and semantic retrieval testing


	+ Verify alignment between retrieved sources and generated answers.
	+ Verify adversarial tests.
	+ Measure retrieval relevance, precision/recall, grounding quality, and hallucination reduction.
* API and application testing


	+ Test REST endpoints supporting GenAI features (request/response contracts, error handling, timeouts).
* ETL and data quality validation


	+ Test ingestion and transformation logic; validate schema, constraints, and field\-level rules.
	+ Implement data profiling, reconciliation between sources and targets, and lineage checks.
	+ Verify data privacy controls, masking, and retention policies across pipelines.
* Non\-functional testing


	+ Performance and load testing focused on latency, throughput, concurrency, and rate limits for LLM calls.
	+ Cost\-aware testing (token usage, caching effectiveness) and timeout/retry behavior validation.
	+ Reliability and resilience checks including error recovery and fallback behavior.
* Share results and insights; recommend remediation and preventive actions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience


	+ 5\+ years in software QA, including test strategy, automation, and defect management.
	+ 2\+ years testing AI/ML or GenAI features, with hands\-on evaluation design.
	+ 4\+ years testing ETL/data pipelines and data quality.
* Technical skills


	+ Python: Strong proficiency building automated tests and tooling (PyTest, requests, pydantic or similar).
	+ API testing: REST contract testing, schema validation, negative testing.
	+ GenAI evaluation: crafting prompt suites, golden datasets, rubric\-based scoring, and automated evaluation pipelines.
	+ RAG testing: retrieval relevance, grounding validation, chunking/indexing verification, and embedding checks.
	+ ETL/data quality: schema and constraint validation, reconciliation, lineage awareness, data profiling.
* Quality and governance


	+ Understanding of LLM limitations and methods to detect/reduce hallucinations.
	+ Safety and compliance testing including PII handling and prompt\-injection resilience.
	+ Strong analytical and debugging skills across services and data flows.
* Soft skills


	+ Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to translate quality goals into measurable criteria.
	+ Collaboration with AI engineers, data engineers, and product stakeholders.
	+ Organized, detail\-oriented, and outcomes\-focused.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with evaluation frameworks or tooling for LLMs and RAG quality measurement.


Experience creating synthetic datasets to stress specific behaviors.

description:
Moonstruck Appliances is hiring an Amazon \& Marketplace Manager to own the growth and profitability of our home\-appliances categories, with Amazon as the primary platform and Flipkart and other marketplaces as additional channels.
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on category specialist who understands appliance products, can lead an ecommerce team, and can turn sales plans into consistent execution across listings, advertising, pricing and inventory.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 • Amazon marketplace and category performance: manage Seller Central, build SKU\-level growth plans, identify assortment gaps and competition, and plan launches for fans and other home appliances.

 • Marketplace operations: monitor account health, catalogue suppression, order issues, returns and customer feedback; coordinate timely resolution with the relevant teams.
 



 • Reporting: maintain clear daily and weekly dashboards covering sales, conversion, advertising efficiency, contribution margin, stock availability and returns, with actions and owners.

 • Direct experience managing Amazon Seller Central and marketplace sales, with strong knowledge of home appliances, fans, consumer durables or closely related product categories.
 



 • Practical capability across Amazon advertising, catalogue optimisation, pricing, inventory and marketplace account health.
 



 • Experience leading an ecommerce team, setting targets and following through on execution.
 



 • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to explain business performance using numbers.

 Profitable marketplace growth, stronger listing conversion, improved advertising efficiency, dependable stock availability and a team that delivers against clear targets.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a brief summary of the categories and marketplaces you have managed, your team\-leadership experience, and measurable results you have delivered.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

title: Sr Data Product Manager , Global SAP Analytics
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) leads the strategy, design, and delivery of trusted, high\-value data products for McCormick’s SAP Analytics. This role is accountable for the end\-to\-end lifecycle, quality, and adoption of SAP Analytics data products that enable measurable business outcomes — including strategic decision\-making, performance transparency, and operational excellence across McCormick.
   

  

 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) is accountable for the definition, championing, and most importantly, delivery of trusted, high\-value data products. The role works as one with McCormick’s Transformation \& Technology (including Data \& Analytics, Data Governance, Information Security and Technology teams) and Global Business Solutions (including Automation and Data Science \& Engineering teams) functions to connect people, platforms, and processes — establishing a trusted, intelligent, and connected SAP Analytics data foundation that supports McCormick’s global growth and enterprise value creation.
   

  

**Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Product Strategy \& Vision: Defines the strategy and roadmap for SAP Analytics data products that enable functional priorities and deliver measurable business value in alignment with McCormick’s enterprise data strategies—both at the functional level, as established by the Data Owner, and at the enterprise level as established by the Chief Data \& Analytics Officer (CDAO). Partners with stakeholders and Transformation \& Technology Business Relationship Managers (BRMs) to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, ROI potential, and readiness for advanced analytics and AI applications. Directs the design and delivery of data products that generate tangible business outcomes while ensuring scalability, interoperability, and long‑term sustainability. Establishes and maintains strong cross‑functional alignment to effectively prioritize initiatives, communicate progress, and advance McCormick’s data‑driven transformation.
* Data Product Lifecycle Ownership: Directs the planning, prioritization, and delivery of SAP Analytic data products through an agile, iterative approach that ensures responsiveness to evolving business needs. Manages the data product backlog—translating functional requirements into clear, actionable user stories—and directs Data Engineers, Data Architects (who are part of the AI and analytics product teams), and Data Stewards to deliver high\-quality, secure, and accessible data solutions. Oversees release planning and approval in alignment with governance and quality standards.
* Data Quality, Trust \& Compliance: Drives adherence to enterprise and functional standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, and compliance across SAP Analytic data products. Partners with key stakeholders to embed governance and regulatory requirements into data product design and delivery. Monitors data quality and trust metrics, driving continuous improvement to ensure data products remain reliable, reusable, and fit for analytical and AI\-driven use cases.
* Data Enablement \& Workforce Readiness: Enables relevant stakeholders to easily find, understand, and use trusted data by ensuring data products are well\-documented, cataloged, and supported with clear usage guidance. Partners with key stakeholders to maintain accurate catalog entries, metadata, and reference materials that promote consistent and compliant data use. Leads initiatives to strengthen engagement with data products and activate a culture where data is valued, trusted, and responsibly used as “ground truth”.
* Data Product Performance \& Value Realization: Defines and tracks performance metrics to measure the adoption, quality, and business impact of SAP Analytic data products. Establishes feedback loops that leverage usage insights and stakeholder input to drive continuous improvement and optimization. Partners with the Data Owner to quantify and communicate data product value, demonstrating significant advancement McCormick’s digital and AI transformation.


**Required Qualifications**
 Level of Education and Discipline
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or other applicable field
* Candidates with strong SAP Analytics qualifications and a demonstrated track record of data literacy may also be considered in lieu of the above degree requirements


 Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in data product management, data strategy, or data governance within a complex or global organization
* 12\+ years of experience in SAP Analytics within the CPG, food, or manufacturing industries
* Proven ability to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of data products, from vision and roadmap through delivery and adoption
* Strong understanding of data architecture, quality, metadata, and governance, with the ability to connect technical design to business value and apply modern data product concepts (e.g. data mesh)
* Demonstrated success working in Agile environments, collaborating with cross\-functional teams including Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders
* Solid business acumen and communication skills, with experience quantifying data product value and driving data adoption across functions


 Interpersonal Skills \- leadership, interactions, communication, influence
   

  

 Strategic thinking skills are essential to develop data products that create business value and support key business objectives and strategies. By connecting business context with technical execution, the role balances competing needs, prioritizes product backlogs, and ensures successful delivery of data products that achieve business objectives while driving accountability for data quality, governance, and adoption within an Agile, iterative environment.
   

  

 Influencing and collaboration skills are critical to align diverse stakeholders and advance McCormick’s enterprise data and governance strategy. The Data Product Owner builds trusted relationships across multiple functions including RDQR, Transformation \& Technology, and Global Business Solutions, leading through influence and collaboration to deliver data products that meet evolving business needs.
   

  

 Communication skills are required to articulate data product vision, value, and progress in a clear and compelling way. The role tailors messages to different audiences, ensuring complex ideas are conveyed with clarity and purpose. Active listening, transparency, and structured communication are used to align expectations, secure engagement, and reinforce accountability for trusted, high‑value data products.
   

  

 At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.

  

The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to help turn that commitment into trusted, reusable data products across publishing, sales, marketing, finance, and operations. This senior hands\-on role combines analytics engineering, business partnership, and responsible use of AI to deliver governed data models, consistent metrics, and scalable self\-service analytics.
  
What You Will Do
  
* Build trusted data products. Develop scalable transformation pipelines, dimensional models, curated data marts, and reusable datasets for reporting, forecasting, experimentation and AI\-enabled use cases.
* Create consistent metrics. Partner with business leaders to define critical measures and encode consistent business logic so teams work from shared definitions across dashboards, analyses, applications, and AI experiences.
* Engineer for trust. Apply automated testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, code review, and data\-quality controls; resolve issues at their root cause.
* Enable responsible AI. Use approved AI tools to accelerate delivery, prepare governed data for AI applications, and validate generated outputs for accuracy, explainability and business fit.
* Automate manual processes. Partner with business and operations teams to replace repetitive, data\-intensive workflows with reliable, monitored automation that improves speed, accuracy, control, and employee capacity.
* Modernize analytics. Transition fragmented or legacy reporting into governed data products and self\-service experiences while maintaining business continuity and controlling platform cost.
* Lead through influence. Translate ambiguous questions into practical solutions, communicate recommendations clearly, mentor colleagues, and raise team engineering standards.
* Partner across the enterprise. Work with stakeholders in publishing, sales, marketing, finance, operations, supply chain, and technology, including globally distributed colleagues.
* Drive adoption. Document solutions, explain data products in business language, and coach users to confidently interpret and apply data


What You Bring
  
* 5\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI engineering, or a related data role.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional modeling, and experience with structured and semi\-structured data.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data platform and transformation framework, such as Snowflake and dbt or comparable technologies.
* Practical Python skills and experience with Git, modular design, testing, code review, CI/CD, and production support.

* Strong business partnership, communication, and problem\-solving, with sound judgment around sensitive data and AI\-assisted tools.
* Experience mentoring colleagues and improving team practices through feedback and shared standards.


Preferred
  
* Experience with semantic layers, observability, metadata, lineage, or data contracts.
* Experience with commercial, supply chain, and marketing analytics
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting and enabling governed self\-service analytics.
* Familiarity with generative AI, or AI\-product evaluation.
* Publishing, media, retail, or consumer\-products experience
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


Will Be Measured
  
* Business teams trust and adopt shared data products and metric definitions.
* Critical pipelines and models are reliable, observable, documented, and cost\-efficient.
* Decision cycles become faster, with less manual reconciliation and duplicate reporting logic.
* Manual processes are reduced through reliable automation with measurable improvements in cycle time, accuracy, controls, and employee capacity.
* AI\-enabled analytics are grounded in governed data and produce explainable, validated results.
* Team engineering standards improve through your technical leadership and mentoring.
