**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
   

  

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:**
 We are seeking a Principal Analyst to serve as a dual expert in Tableau dashboarding and commercial analytics within Takeda's GCC Commercial Insights \& Analytics (I\&A) organization in India. This senior individual\-contributor role designs, builds, and scales enterprise\-grade reporting and dashboards with deep, specialized Tableau expertise, while independently leading complex commercial analytics workstreams that directly inform global brand strategy. The Principal Analyst sets both the visualization and the analytical standard for the team and acts as a technical authority and mentor for the broader analyst community.
   

  

* Own the design and delivery of Takeda's most complex, high\-visibility reporting and dashboard products, and serve as the recognized Tableau subject\-matter expert (SME) setting the visual analytics standard across global brand teams.
* Independently lead high\-complexity commercial analytics workstreams — patient journey analyses, HCP segmentation, performance deep\-dives, and competitive assessments — that provide actionable recommendations to global I\&A brand leads and commercial partners.
* Act as a technical thought leader and mentor, elevating the reporting, visualization, and analytical capabilities of Analysts and Senior Analysts across the GCC team.


**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Reporting \& Dashboarding Excellence — Tableau:**
* Architect, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade Tableau dashboards that communicate brand performance, patient journey dynamics, HCP engagement and field force activity to global stakeholders.
* Define, implement and enforce UI/visualization best practices and design standards (layout, color, accessibility, interactivity, storytelling) and build self\-service reporting frameworks and templates that reduce ad hoc requests.
* Establish, standardize, and govern KPIs and metrics — brand performance, patient shares, new starts, duration of therapy (DoT), adherence, source of business, campaign effectiveness etc. — across global markets, regions and channels.
* Optimize data models, data extracts and refresh pipelines feeding dashboards to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance at scale.


**Commercial Analytics \& Insight Generation:**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of the most complex performance analytics workstreams that track brand KPIs across global, regional, and country levels, setting the quality bar for the team.
* Integrate and analyze diverse commercial data sources across markets — real\-world data (claims, EMR/EHR, lab data), specialty pharmacy, sales, and channel data — to generate comprehensive patient and HCP insights that support brand strategy and launch readiness.
* Drive advanced, self\-directed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and opportunity prospecting — moving beyond basic pulls (counts, topline, segmentation, time trends) to surface non\-obvious commercial opportunities and hypotheses that shape brand strategy.
* Own the most complex custom reporting and ad hoc requests with independent hypothesis formulation, rigorous methodology, and well\-documented, insight\-rich outputs, and guide others in doing the same.


**Cohort Development and Segmentation:**
* Set the standard for patient and HCP cohorts built on deterministic logic and lead advanced cohort and segmentation approaches — including cluster and probabilistic models — for sophisticated targeting, prioritization, and micro\-segmentation.
* Perform ETL, design and orchestrate reproducible data pipelines feeding reporting products, and automate recurring workflows using SQL, Python or R, API programming, and GenAI tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a coding partner.


**Stakeholder Leadership \& Mentorship:**
* Partner with GCC Managers and global I\&A brand leads to clarify requirements, align on scope, and synthesize findings into decision\-oriented visual stories with clear “so what” recommendations.
* Formally mentor Analysts and Senior Analysts on Tableau, visualization design, and analytical methods, and lead team knowledge management (design patterns, reusable templates and query libraries).


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field; Master's degree or MBA strongly preferred.


**Experience:**
* 5–6 years of progressive quantitative analytical experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare analytics, with a significant portion focused on both commercial analytics and reporting, BI, and data visualization.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on Tableau experience (Tableau Desktop and Server/Cloud) building and governing enterprise\-scale dashboards is required; Tableau certification is a strong plus. Working knowledge of Power BI is a plus.
* Deep working knowledge of pharma commercial datasets across markets patient\-level claims (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health), specialty pharmacy, EMR, and sales data is required.
* Hands\-on experience with data beyond claims is strongly preferred — lab data, EMR/EHR, medical and regulatory coding systems (e.g., ICD, procedure/reimbursement codes), public datasets, and research literature (Citeline, PubMed).
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, SAS, R, or Python for data manipulation and workflow automation; advanced Excel required. Familiarity with API programming and GenAI (e.g., Claude Code) as a coding partner; working knowledge of Databricks or cloud platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting global or regional brand teams or cross\-functional analytics programs is strongly preferred.


**Skills \& Competencies:**
* **Tableau Mastery \& Reporting Architecture —:** 
 Expert Tableau design, development, performance optimization, and Server/Cloud governance; sets visualization and self\-service reporting standards.
* **Data Visualization \& Storytelling —:** 
 Applies advanced visualization and storytelling principles — layout, color, accessibility, and interactivity — to build intuitive, decision\-ready products.
* **Advanced Commercial Data Analysis —:** 
 Independently designs, executes, and leads the most complex analyses on multi\-source, multi\-market pharma datasets; interprets results with deep domain context and sets analytical direction.
* **Cohort Development \& Segmentation —:** 
 Leads deterministic, business\-rule\-based cohorts and advanced probabilistic and cluster\-model approaches for patient/HCP targeting.
* **Stakeholder Communication \& Mentorship —:** 
 Communicates persuasively to global I\&A leads; coaches analysts on Tableau and analytical best practices as a technical authority.


**Intangible Skills:**
* Curiosity

* Reflective

* High command of written and spoken English fluency.


**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:**

 Contribute positively to GCC and global team workflows and cross\-functional collaboration.
* **Drive Accountability —:** 
 Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* **Embrace Learning —:** 
 Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities and share expertise across the team.


**BENEFITS:**

 The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in GHG Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 accounting, GRI\-based sustainability reporting, and ESG assessments such as EcoVadis and CDP. The candidate should be comfortable working with multiple internal stakeholders, analyzing data, preparing disclosures, and translating ESG requirements into actionable initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Manage and support Scope 1, Scope 2 \& Scope 3 GHG accounting in line with the GHG Protocol.
* Support preparation of GRI\-aligned Sustainability Reports and ESG disclosures.
* Manage EcoVadis assessments including data/evidence collection and improvement action plans.
* Support CDP disclosures and other ESG/customer assessments.
* Experience in setting and implementing near\-term and long\-term SBTi targets, including initiatives to reduce emissions and progress toward net\-zero goals.
* Support ISO 14001 Environmental Management System.
* Collect, validate and analyze ESG data and maintain supporting documentation.
* Support carbon reduction and other sustainability initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and assurance providers on ESG requirements.
* Track ESG KPIs and support ESG audits, assurance and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Conduct Org wide campaigns/ activities to create environmental consciousness.
* Drive Supplier sustainability practice, supplier assessments, conduct training sessions, capacity building sessions for internal teams \& suppliers.



  





**Must\-Have** 




  




* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in ESG / Sustainability.
* Strong understanding of GHG Protocol – Scope 1, 2 \& 3\.
* Experience in GRI\-based sustainability reporting.
* Decarbonization Strategy \& SBTi
* Hands\-on experience with EcoVadis and CDP.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills. Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI)



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Exposure to GHG assurance, ESG ratings, carbon reduction plans and other global ESG frameworks.
* ESG/Sustainability\-related certification.
* Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science/Engineering, Engineering, ESG or a related field.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Payer)
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**Role: Senior Business Analyst \- Payer**
**Experience Level: 4 to 7 years**
**Work location: Bangalore**
**What You’ll Do**
 As a Senior Business Analyst (Payer) in HCLS, you'll be the bridge between complex healthcare payer needs and innovative technology solutions. You'll lead requirements gathering, process mapping, and data analysis for payer\-focused projects (e.g., claims processing, provider networks, member engagement). Your expertise in payer operations, regulatory compliance (HIPAA, CMS), and value\-based care models will drive the design and implementation of impactful solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering measurable value to our clients. You'll mentor junior analysts and champion best practices within the team.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Business Analyst specializing in the Healthcare \& Life Sciences (HCLS) domain, with a focus on Payer operations, you will play a pivotal role in understanding, analyzing, and translating complex business needs into actionable technology solutions. You will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project management, ensuring successful delivery of initiatives that enhance efficiency, compliance, and member/provider experience within the payer landscape.
   

  

**Requirements Elicitation \& Analysis**
* Lead and facilitate workshops, interviews, and brainstorming sessions with diverse stakeholders (e.g., claims, enrollment, provider relations, finance, compliance) to elicit, document, and prioritize detailed business requirements.
* Analyze current state processes, identify pain points, and propose future state solutions, leveraging deep understanding of payer operations (e.g., claims adjudication, benefit configuration, premium billing, member services, provider contracting).
* Translate high\-level business needs into clear, concise, and unambiguous functional and non\-functional requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows (BPMN).


**Solution Design \& Strategy**
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and product owners to design and validate technical solutions that meet business requirements and align with organizational strategy and industry best practices.
* Evaluate potential solutions, including commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) products and custom development, performing gap analyses and recommending optimal approaches.
* Contribute to the development of business cases, ROI analyses, and project roadmaps.


**Payer Domain Expertise \& Compliance**
* Apply in\-depth knowledge of healthcare payer regulations (e.g., HIPAA, ACA, CMS guidelines, state mandates) to ensure all solutions are compliant and mitigate risks.
* Understand and articulate the impact of industry trends such as value\-based care, interoperability (FHIR), digital transformation, and consumerism on payer operations.
* Provide subject matter expertise on various payer lines of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange).


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, managing expectations, resolving conflicts, and ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and business implications to technical teams effectively.
* Prepare and deliver presentations, reports, and documentation to various levels of management and project teams.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance Support**
* Define acceptance criteria and support the creation of test plans and test cases.
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and defect triage, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.


**Documentation \& Artifacts**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process maps, data flow diagrams, and user manuals.


**Must Have Skills**
* Requirements Expertise: Elicitation, documentation, prioritization (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
* Process Modeling: Current/future state, optimization (BPMN, Visio).
* Data Analysis: Advanced SQL, Data Visualization (Tableau, Power BI).
* Payer Domain Knowledge: Claims, enrollment, provider networks, benefits.
* Regulatory Compliance: HIPAA, ACA, CMS, X12 EDI, FHIR.
* Technical Acumen: API concepts, system integration, database fundamentals.
* Testing Support: Acceptance criteria, UAT.
* Documentation: Comprehensive project artifacts.


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

title: Biostatistician Manager
description:

**Be Part of One Team, One Purpose.**
 At
 **Emmes Group** 
 , we’re shaping the future of clinical research—
 **where human intelligence meets cutting\-edge technology** 
 to drive meaningful advancements in healthcare. With over
 **47 years of scientific excellence** 
 , we’ve led groundbreaking research in
 **cell and gene therapy, vaccines, infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.**

 **Emmes, a full\-service CRO** 
 , and

 Our culture is built on
 **integrity, collaboration, and innovation**

 Oversees statistical activities and deliverables across a project or platform of related clinical research studies, leads a team of Statisticians and SAS Programmers and ensures that statistical deliverables are completed in a timely manner and with high quality. Serves as a lead statistician on multiple clinical research studies, from the initial design stage all the way to final report writing and manuscript preparation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborates with clinical investigators to determine study design.
* Writes sections of protocols that require statistical input; Applies novel, quantitative decision making techniques to improve study design, analytical approach.
* Reviews protocols and case report forms to ensure that protocol objectives are met, and standards are maintained.
* Generates treatment allocations in randomized clinical research studies and ensures proper implementation.
* Leads the project team’s development of statistical analysis plans and programs to perform analyses and display study data.
* Performs statistical analyses, writes and validates application programs.
* Implements data and safety monitoring reports to ensure participants safety.
* Develops metrics and generates quality control reports to optimize the performance of clinical sites and the coordinating center.
* Generates study reports to be distributed to internal and external monitoring committees and regulatory bodies.
* Develop and follow SOPs for validation of statistical analysis programs. Maintain high quality of the outputs.
* Develop macros and functions for repetitive statistical analysis programs etc.


 Provide input to clinical study report / manuscript through statistical Interpretation of study results during interim, final reporting of the study. Support in results presentation to the DSMB, study teams etc.
   

  

* Participates in professional development activities both within and outside the company.
* Ensure timely and effective communication to all stakeholders. Coordinate with internal/external stakeholders/vendors and other functions (Medical Monitor, Data Managers, SAS programmers) within study team for smooth deliverables of study related documents.
* Maintains awareness of current statistical literature and researches new techniques.
* Contributes to departmental strategies and initiatives (India and Global).
* May contribute at governance board meetings (e.g. DSMB/SMC)
* Provides input on responses to audit/inspection questions and assists in completing CAPAs within agreed timelines.
* Uses networking skills to collaborate with peers or other functional groups (e.g. clinical, DM, IT, medical writing etc.)
* Supports recruitment activities
* May take line management activities


**Qualifications**
* Requires a master’s or PhD degree in Statistics with minimum of 8 years of clinical research experience.
* Strong understanding of design of experiments; Demonstrated proficiency with statistical methods and applications in clinical research.
* Demonstrates good understanding of biostatistics processes.
* Competent in SAS programming language and/or R.
* Expertise in state\-of\-the\-art data manipulation and statistical methodology.
* Experience with clinical database technologies, data models and statistical programming.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks.
* Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment.
* Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts, both written and oral.
* Demonstrated ability in enterprise thinking (e.g. analytical thinking and solutions beyond study level).
* Ability to communicates technical and complex approaches to peers and non\-technical colleagues.

 Most internships have you fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. This is not one of them. At Joveo, the Strategic Initiatives team operates like a startup within a scale\-up. We research, build, and scale new global supply channels and revenue streams from zero. We are looking for a Growth \& Strategy Intern to work directly with leadership to solve complex business problems, optimize go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies, and drive real revenue impact.
 



  





 If you are a first\-principle thinker who is relentlessly curious, highly analytical, and communicates exceptionally well, this is the place to accelerate your career.

1. Market Intelligence \& GTM: Conduct deep\-dive research into new markets, HR tech trends, and competitor landscapes to identify white\-space opportunities for Joveo.

 You can take a complex, 10\-page concept and distill it into a punchy, 3\-bullet Slack message. You are comfortable speaking up in a room full of senior leaders.

 You don't wait to be told what to do. If you see a problem, you research it, propose a solution, and ask for permission to execute.
4. **Tech Fluency:** 
 You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentation tools, and quickly learning new SaaS platforms. (Bonus points if you know your way around basic data visualization).



  





**What’s In It For You:** 



1. **Direct Mentorship** 
 : Work directly under the Chief Strategic Initiatives Officer and learn how to scale businesses from $0 to multi\-million dollar ARR.
2. **Real Impact:** 
 Your work will directly influence Joveo’s global expansion and bottom line.
3. **Fast\-Tracked Learning:** 
 Get a crash course in B2B SaaS, Ad\-Tech, strategic partnerships, and global supply chains.

title: Global Head of Procurement
description:
Saviynt's AI\-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non\-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.  

Saviynt is seeking an experienced, strategic, and transformative Global Head of Procurement to build and scale a high\-performance procurement and travel function within the SaaS industry. This leadership role will own the end\-to\-end procurement process, global sourcing strategy, and vendor management, with a strong focus on software solutions, IT procurement, supply chain optimization, cost efficiency, and governance.


***This role is structured as a Head\-of function, open to a Senior Director or Vice President level depending on the depth of experience and scope of leadership.***



The Global Head of Procurement will play a key role in shaping Saviynt’s global procurement strategy, modernizing our procurement tech stack (including tools such as Tipalti and NetSuite), and completely reimagining our global travel and expense ecosystem to support a rapidly scaling workforce. This position partners cross\-functionally with Finance, IT, Operations, Legal, Security, and executive leadership to align procurement with business goals and drive operational excellence.

### **What will you be doing**

* **Strategic Leadership:** Lead the development and execution of global procurement strategies tailored for a high\-growth SaaS environment, ensuring cost\-effectiveness, risk management, and alignment with Saviynt’s growth objectives across software, IT tools, professional services, and business\-critical categories.
* **Global Procurement Leadership:** Build and execute a global procurement operating model across geographies, ensuring consistent sourcing practices, governance, supplier standards, and commercial outcomes while accounting for regional requirements and market dynamics.
* **AI\-First Procurement:** Apply an AI\-first mindset to procurement and vendor\-risk frameworks to ensure global compliance, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.
* **Vendor \& Software Management:** Manage and optimize strategic relationships with key suppliers and software vendors. Lead supplier evaluation, strategic sourcing, contract negotiations, renewals, and vendor performance management.
* **Software Implementation \& Integration:** Oversee the implementation and optimization of procurement software solutions and their seamless integration with existing systems (such as NetSuite and Tipalti).
* **Global T\&E Transformation:** Lead the end\-to\-end transformation of the Travel \& Expense (T\&E) function, including global policy governance, corporate card programs, and software solutions to increase transparency.
* **End\-to\-End Procurement Lifecycle Management:** Manage the complete procurement lifecycle from requisition approval and sourcing through vendor selection, contract negotiation, purchasing, implementation, renewals, and ongoing supplier management.
* **Process Optimization \& Governance:** Establish and refine global procurement policies, controls, and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes, utilizing automation where possible to drive efficiency, compliance, and transparency.
* **Cost Control \& Financial Partnership:** Partner with Finance and the executive team to create and manage procurement budgets, track spend and savings, translate business strategy into operational savings, and identify cost\-reduction opportunities.
* **Compliance \& Risk Management:** Ensure all procurement activities, SaaS contracts, software licensing, and supplier engagements comply with legal, financial, regulatory, and internal standards while mitigating contractual risks.
* **Performance Reporting \& Analytics:** Develop procurement KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to evaluate strategy effectiveness, monitor supplier performance, track cycle times, and guide data\-driven business decisions.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate closely with Finance, IT, Operations, Legal, Security, and business leaders to support scalable growth and align procurement initiatives with enterprise goals.

### **What You Bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field. An MBA or relevant certifications (such as CPM or CPSM) is a plus.
* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive procurement leadership experience (commensurate with Senior Director or Vice President tracks), including at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role within SaaS or technology companies.
* **Global Sourcing Expertise:** Proven track record of managing global procurement strategy, sourcing, supplier relationships, contract negotiations, and spend across multiple countries or regions.
* **SaaS \& Scaling Expertise:** Demonstrated success driving organizations toward IPO and/or SOX readiness in high\-growth SaaS environments.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep understanding of procurement technology and spend\-management systems, including experience with platforms such as Tipalti and NetSuite.
* **Global Travel Management:** Extensive experience implementing and managing global Travel \& Expense programs and corporate card ecosystem transformations.
* **Executive Influence \& Stakeholder Management:** Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills with a proven history of aligning cross\-functional leaders and executives.

**The role**


As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of business analysis, data analysis and financial analysis. You will turn data from CRM and other business systems into trusted models, commercial insight and practical actions for Sales \& Marketing.


Most of the role is hands\-on analytical delivery: SQL, Power BI, semantic modelling, validation, automation and controlled AI workflows. A smaller part supports core sales operations, including pipeline hygiene, performance checks and forecasting discipline.

 **Requirements** **Skills \& attributes for success**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related field preferred
* Strong SQL skills and practical experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query and advanced Excel.
* Solid understanding of data modelling concepts, including facts, dimensions, grain, keys and table relationships.
* Proven ability to build reliable reporting datasets, reusable KPI logic and reconciliations across multiple data layers.
* Commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to understand performance drivers, forecasts, variances and business trade\-offs.
* Strong business analysis skills: structure ambiguous problems, define requirements and connect business needs to technical solutions.
* Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with a disciplined approach to validation, debugging and documentation.

* A global company well recognized within the energy space for its high levels of competence and independence.
* A diverse, dynamic and international highly skilled working environment
* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Being part of a quickly expanding global business with new development opportunities

title: Engineer II - Robotics MLOps
description:

* **Systematic Release Governance:** The authority is held to define and enforce quality gates, ensuring that only verified, performance\-tuned robotics code is promoted to mission\-critical deployment branches

The software release and deployment lifecycle is architected by the Engineer II \- Robotics MLOps. A critical bridge is maintained between validated R\&D algorithms and field\-ready deployment. This role ensures the stability of the branching strategy, manages the gated promotion of code from Staging to Development and Release, and provides the architecture for MLOps and DevOps pipelines. This position is designed for an engineer, by whom it is understood that ML in robotics is not just about the model \- it is about the hardware constraints, real\-time performance, and the rigour of the release process**Key Responsibilities*** **Release Lifecycle Management:** Manage the gated promotion of software across repositories; coordinate the movement of code from Staging to Development and eventually to Release branches, aligning with flight\-test verification and QA standards
* **ML Deployment \& Optimization:** Optimize machine learning models and robotics algorithms for embedded deployment by applying advanced techniques such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. Profile and tune models for hardware acceleration using CUDA, TensorRT, and other NVIDIA platform primitives
* **CI/CD \& MLOps Infrastructure:** Design and maintain the MLOps toolchain, including automated training, model versioning, and deployment pipelines that are validated against flight\-test data
* **Release Readiness:** Act as the technical lead for release candidate preparation. Coordinate with Senior Systems Engineers to ensure all logs, telemetry, and performance reports are compiled for final stakeholder approval
* **Observability \& Diagnostics:** Implement logging and health monitoring infrastructure to ensure flight\-test data is structured, accessible, and actionable for the R\&D team
* **Infrastructure \& Pipeline Reliability:** Maintain development environments, containers, and deployment toolchains, serving as a secondary point of contact for R\&D, Embedded, and DevOps workflows

**Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics
* **3\+ years (Bachelor’s)** or **1\+ years (Master’s)** of industrial experience in ML and/or robotics software deployment
* **ML Production Skills:** Deep proficiency in Neural Networks and hardware\-specific model optimization (TensorRT, CUDA)
* **Software Rigour:** Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python with a focus on system performance, memory management, and multi\-threading in Linux\-based robotics environments
* **Testing Standards:** Demonstrated experience in Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and the use of automated testing frameworks (e.g., GTest, PyTest)
* **CI/CD Expertise:** Proven experience with build automation, artefact versioning, and complex branching strategies (BitBucket/Git)
* **Profiling \& Debugging:** Experience in profiling and debugging embedded software using tools like Nsight, GDB, or Valgrind
* **Deployment Tooling:** Experience with Docker, Kubernetes (K3S), or similar containerization tools in embedded environments

**Preferred Qualifications*** **Domain Expertise:** Familiarity with SLAM, NeuRF and Gaussian Splatting, Sensor Fusion, or Computer Vision pipelines for navigation
* **Safety Standards:** Experience with safety\-critical software development standards (e.g., MISRA C\+\+)
* **Hardware Platforms:** Hands\-on experience with specific NVIDIA edge platforms (Jetson Orin/Xavier)

So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. * **Collaborative Culture:** Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.

### **Who’s a Great FinBoxer:**


At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking \& financial services world, keep reading!

**Creative Thinkers:** If your brain is always bubbling with out\-of\-the\-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.

**Customer Heroes:** Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.

**Team Players:** We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.

### **About the Role**


We are looking for a **Lead Data Engineer** with **7–10 years** of experience to design and scale our data platform. You will own data architecture across **ingestion, streaming, storage, processing, analytics, security, and reliability** in a high\-growth fintech environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and scale **end\-to\-end data platforms** supporting batch and real\-time workloads.
* Build scalable **ETL/ELT and CDC pipelines** using Kafka, Debezium, Spark/Flink, and Airflow.
* Architect **data lakes/lakehouses** using S3, Parquet, Iceberg/Delta Lake.
* Design and optimise **ClickHouse/Redshift/BigQuery** architectures, including schema design, aggregation, sharding, and replication.
* Build **multi\-tenant data architectures** with strong isolation, security, and compliance.
* Drive **data observability, lineage, quality, and disaster recovery** across critical pipelines.
* Define infrastructure using **Terraform** and drive compute/storage and cost optimisation.
* Partner with platform and security teams on **AWS, VPC, IAM, encryption, and data security**.
* Mentor engineers and establish **data architecture standards and best practices**.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **7–10 years** of strong hands\-on Data Engineering experience with architectural ownership.
* Strong expertise in **distributed systems** — Spark, Flink, and Kafka.
* Hands\-on experience with **AWS data services** — S3, Glue, RDS, MSK, Redshift, DMS, and Athena.
* Strong experience with **ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake**.
* Expertise in **data modelling** — Star Schema, Data Vault 2\.0, and OBT.
* Strong experience with **streaming, CDC, dbt, Python, SQL, and Airflow**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Terraform/CloudFormation**.
* Strong understanding of **IAM, encryption, VPC, multi\-tenancy, and data security**.
* Experience building data platforms **from the ground up and at significant scale**.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.
We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
### **What you will do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 1\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

You will translate strategic product visions into high\-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning \& Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI\-driven automation.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap Leadership:** Define the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Growth \& Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome\-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:** Build data\-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:** Partner closely with the Growth \& Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well\-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade\-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional \& Technical Alignment:** Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade\-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long\-term scalability.
* **AI \& Talent Automation Strategy:** Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise\-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Drive cross\-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US\-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

### **What You Bring to Okta**


* 8\+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:** In\-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case \& ROI Sizing:** Proven ability to translate long\-term business goals into multi\-year product strategies, build data\-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency \& Cross\-Functional Translation:** Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade\-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI \& Automation Acumen:** Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human\-in\-the\-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:** Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, compliance standards (SOX, SOC2, GDPR), and sensitive employee data handling.

title: Branch Manager
description:
Job Title

**Branch Manager**

Industry

**NBFC / Financial Services**

Job Location

Branch Location

Reporting To

Regional Manager / Cluster Manager / Area Manager

Job Summary

The Branch Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the branch, including business development, customer acquisition, team management, loan operations, collections, compliance, and achievement of branch targets. The role requires strong leadership, sales, operational, and customer relationship management skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Business Development \& Sales**

* Achieve branch\-wise monthly and annual business targets.
* Drive loan disbursement, gold loan, investment/NCD, insurance, and other assigned financial products.
* Generate new business through customer visits, referrals, local marketing, and business development activities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Monitor daily business performance and take corrective action to achieve targets.
* Identify new business opportunities within the branch's market area.

**2\. Branch Operations**

* Ensure smooth and efficient day\-to\-day branch operations.
* Monitor cash, gold, documents, registers, systems, and other branch assets.
* Ensure proper completion and verification of KYC and loan documentation.
* Maintain branch records and ensure timely submission of reports to the Regional/Head Office.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and operational guidelines.

**3\. Gold Loan Operations** *(where applicable)*

* Ensure proper gold appraisal, documentation, custody, and release procedures.
* Monitor gold loan outstanding, renewals, closures, auctions, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure compliance with prescribed gold\-loan procedures and security standards.
* Immediately report any discrepancy, suspected fraud, or spurious\-gold\-related issue to the concerned authority.

**4\. Team Management**

* Lead, motivate, and monitor branch staff to achieve business and operational targets.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual employee performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Support recruitment, induction, training, and development of branch employees.
* Address employee performance and disciplinary issues in coordination with HR/Regional Management.

**5\. Customer Service**

* Maintain high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction.
* Handle customer complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers and improve customer retention.
* Ensure transparent communication of product terms, charges, interest rates, and applicable procedures.

**6\. Collections \& Recovery**

* Monitor overdue accounts and ensure timely follow\-up with customers.
* Coordinate with collection/recovery teams for overdue and NPA accounts.
* Conduct customer visits where required for recovery and business follow\-up.
* Ensure recovery activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.

**7\. Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure strict compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, KYC/AML requirements, and applicable laws.
* Maintain proper branch records and documentation.
* Ensure audit observations are addressed within the prescribed timeline.
* Prevent operational lapses, fraud, and financial irregularities.
* Cooperate with internal, statutory, and regulatory audits and inspections.

**8\. Reporting \& Review**

* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including business growth, collections, customer acquisition, overdue/NPA, and staff productivity.
* Participate in review meetings with Cluster/Regional/Head Office teams.
* Take immediate corrective action when branch performance is below expectations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Branch business achievement
* Loan disbursement and outstanding growth
* Gold loan business and portfolio quality
* Customer acquisition and retention
* Collection and recovery performance
* Reduction of overdue/NPA accounts
* Staff productivity and target achievement
* Audit and compliance performance
* Customer service and complaint resolution
* Branch profitability and operational efficiency

Required Qualifications

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or related field will be an advantage.
* Experience in NBFC, banking, gold loan, microfinance, lending, or financial services preferred.

Required Experience

**3–7 years of relevant experience**, preferably with experience in branch management, sales, lending, collections, and team handling.

Key Skills

* Branch Operations Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Team Leadership
* Customer Relationship Management
* Loan \& Gold Loan Operations
* Collection \& Recovery
* KYC/AML \& Compliance
* Problem Solving
* Communication \& Negotiation
* MIS \& Reporting
* Local Market Development

Personal Attributes

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Target\-oriented approach
* Customer\-focused attitude
* High level of integrity and accountability
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Willingness to travel locally for business and customer visits

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  

  
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

* 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Experience developing and managing product roadmaps across complex, cross\-functional organizations.
* Experience developing products for global or regional markets and translating locally relevant customer needs into scalable solutions.
* Experience with mobile\-first consumer or merchant product experiences.
* FinTech, payments, banking, or regional product\-management experience is preferred.
* Strong product decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance customer needs, business context, data and strategic priorities.
* Experience with experimentation and product optimization, including A/B testing and performance measurement.
* Strong understanding of product growth, monetization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Strong product and visual\-design sensibility with attention to customer experience and detail.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment, navigate ambiguity and bring clarity to complex product decisions.

**Additional Responsibilities**


* Own and drive the product roadmap for an assigned domain, translating market\-specific customer needs into scalable product solutions.
* Develop and launch mobile\-first experiences for consumers and merchants across global markets.
* Evaluate growth opportunities across existing products, target audiences and customer journeys to inform roadmap priorities.
* Manage product request intake, feature definition, prioritization and scoping.
* Assess and articulate trade\-offs across customer value, business requirements, legal and compliance considerations, growth and monetization.
* Define product hypotheses and experiments and use results to refine product experiences and roadmap priorities.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators to measure product outcomes and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Assess PayPal’s strategic and competitive position within relevant markets to identify opportunities for differentiated product solutions.
* Partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Design, Program Management and Launch teams to bring capabilities from concept through market launch.

### **Job Summary**



This role functions as a mid\-level engineering position. Under general supervision, the engineer performs analytical and technical duties related to the monitoring and diagnostics of operating power‑generation and industrial assets. The position is designed to deepen expertise within the primary discipline while providing opportunities to broaden knowledge across adjacent engineering and functional areas.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The selected professional will support the delivery of Black \& Veatch’s Monitoring \& Diagnostic (M\&D) services.



M\&D services is enabled by Asset360® software which is a data‑analytics‑driven software and services platform that enables owners and operators of conventional generation, renewable generation, power distribution systems, water treatment facilities, industrial assets and similar infrastructure to monitor and enhance asset performance, reliability and health. The platform helps diagnose equipment reliability and performance issues, optimize operations, and support integrated planning and forecasting.



Given the complexity of the issues addressed through this service, prior experience in the operation, monitoring, or maintenance of one or more of the following is required:


* Gas turbines
* Combined cycle plants
* Gas‑fired thermal units
* Coal‑fired units
* Renewable generation assets


**Performance \& Technical Services**


* Conduct plant performance assessments and identify improvement opportunities.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment and performance deviations.
* Recognize operational and performance patterns and trends using historical and real‑time data.
* Support long shutdown planning and execution, including equipment isolation, line‑up, start‑up, and shutdown procedures.
* Evaluate and optimize equipment performance where applicable.
* Support technical services related to reliability, asset health, and operational readiness.


**Remote Monitoring \& Diagnostics**


* Analyze operational data to detect anomalies, diagnose issues, and recommend corrective actions.

* Interpret thermodynamic and reliability‑related KPIs to support client decision‑making.


**Client Relationship Management**


* Engage with clients to understand operational challenges and communicate findings clearly.
* Provide technical guidance on performance optimization and reliability improvements.
* Support adoption and effective use of Asset360® tools and workflows.


**Plant Performance Audits \& Testing**

\#LI\-PG1

Individual Contributor

Financial acumen with budget management and cost optimization experience
  
Multilingual capabilities (English, Hindi, Marathi preferred)
  
Experience with emerging technologies including cloud assets, IoT devices, and mobile device management

As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

You'll drive automation, AI, and data analytics\-led SOX control testing across Ford's global process landscape — spanning multiple business units, geographies, and process areas — leveraging modern data analytics, automation enablement, and Generative AI tools to streamline "Smart Review" execution, eliminate manual testing effort, and enhance audit coverage. This role suits an experienced, forward\-thinking professional looking to bridge the gap between risk compliance and digital modernization. Beyond core compliance testing, you'll need an agile mindset — flexibly adapting to ad hoc management initiatives, pilot projects, and cross\-functional problem solving as business needs evolve.

* **SOX Control Testing:** Independently execute SOX\-mandated control testing across Ford's global process landscape, ensuring strict adherence to compliance timelines and quality benchmarks, applying sound professional judgment built from prior audit experience.
* **Smart Reviews:** Conduct data\-driven "Smart Reviews"—leveraging data analytics and AI\-assisted pattern and anomaly detection where applicable—to proactively identify control gaps, process bottlenecks, and operational inefficiencies.
* **Data Analytics \& Automation Translation:** Analyze manual control test steps, apply data analytics techniques to identify testing patterns and exceptions, and translate manual steps into automated workflows in partnership with transformation teams.
* **Critical Evaluation \& Root Cause Analysis:** Apply critical thinking to challenge surface\-level explanations, evaluate control design effectiveness, and drive investigations to true root cause — including professionally challenging initial explanations to validate the actual root cause.
* **Insightful Communication:** Articulate complex control gaps, system workarounds, and root causes clearly to global process owners and senior stakeholders, including defending testing conclusions when challenged.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with local management, process owners, and global IC teams across time zones to design and implement sustainable remediation plans.
* **Agile Governance:** Maintain and update Risk Control Matrices (RCMs) and process documentation, leveraging GRC platforms such as AuditBoard / Optro or similar GRC platforms.
* **Mentorship \& Quality Oversight:** Provide guidance and quality review support to junior team members, drawing on depth of prior audit/IC experience.

**Dynamic Project Support:** Maintain flexibility to support emerging management priorities, special project support, and executive reporting.

* Chartered Accountant (CA) / Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) / Certified Management Accountant (CMA) / equivalent professional qualification, with 3–4 years of relevant experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, or related risk/compliance functions.
* Demonstrated working experience using AI\-enabled tools in an audit, controls, or compliance context.
* Prior hands\-on experience with AuditBoard/ Optro (preferable)

title: FS-RC-Actuarial-MG-ALFA-Integrate deployment-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Senior, MG\-ALFA/Integrate user, tester or modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

 Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
   

  

 Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry
   

  

 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering MG\-ALFA/Integrate user level, testing and modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
   

  

 You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* As a Senior within the Life MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands\-on valuation or modeling experience in a senior capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about building a thriving partner ecosystem that helps customers unlock the full potential of their data? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Data Partner Development Specialist (PDS) to join our India Amazon Partner Organization (APO) team. In this role, you will be the partner\-facing authority on AWS Data and Analytics services — including Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon MSK and Amazon S3 Vectors — driving partner capability development, co\-sell execution, and go\-to\-market (GTM) scale across the India market.  

  

As a Data PDS, you will work directly with consulting, technology, and ISV partners to build differentiated data practices and offerings on AWS. You will enable partners to solve complex customer data challenges — from petabyte\-scale data lakes and real\-time streaming pipelines to enterprise data warehouse modernization — and drive measurable customer outcomes through partner\-led and partner\-attached motions. You will collaborate with AWS account teams, specialist SAs, services leadership, and partner programs to accelerate partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline, increase partner attach rates, and shape the future of the AWS data partner ecosystem in India.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary partner development lead for AWS Data and Analytics services across consulting, technology, and ISV partners in India.
* Identify, recruit, and develop partners with strong data capabilities, enabling them to build scalable practices around AWS data lake, data warehouse, streaming, and analytics services.
* Drive partner\-sourced and partner\-attached pipeline by co\-developing GTM plans, joint value propositions, and co\-sell motions with priority partners.
* Enable partners through technical readiness programs — including workshops, bootcamps, proof\-of\-concept (PoC) frameworks, and certification drives — to deepen their AWS data competencies.
* Collaborate with AWS Specialist SAs, account teams, and services teams to identify customer opportunities where partner engagement accelerates time\-to\-launch and improves outcomes especially with the AI team.
* Develop and execute joint business plans with strategic data partners, tracking key metrics such as partner attach rate, launched ARR, and customer impact.
* Work with AWS Partner Programs (e.g., competency programs, funding mechanisms, AWS Marketplace) to help partners access the right development and GTM support levers.
* Provide partner and field feedback to AWS product teams to influence service roadmaps and drive feature adoption relevant to the India partner ecosystem.
* Support competitive positioning by equipping partners with differentiation narratives against on\-premises and third\-party analytics platforms.
* Deliver thought leadership through partner summits, blog posts, case studies, and community engagement to elevate the AWS data partner brand in India.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of Go\-To\-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* 10\+ years of experience in partner development, business development, alliance management, or channel sales in the technology/cloud industry.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling partner practices or GTM motions in the data, analytics, or AI/ML domain.
* Strong understanding of data architectures — data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, and analytics platforms. Good understanding of how data is the foundation to an Agentic AI paradigm.
* Experience managing joint business plans, partner pipeline, and co\-sell execution with measurable revenue outcomes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
* Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

title: Senior Cloud HPC Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Opportunity: Can You Build and Command a Cloud Supercomputer?
  

Want to run one of the largest high\-performance computing grids in the financial industry? Are you driven by the challenge of orchestrating trillions of calculations across thousands of cloud cores to price the firm's entire trading book in minutes, not ours? Do you want to build the massive\-scale "valuation engine" that powers Citi's next\-generation risk platform?
  

Citi is seeking a visionary Cloud HPC Engineer to lead the development and operation of our global pricing grid. This is the engine room of our risk system. You will be responsible for deploying, scaling, and optimizing the computational factory that runs our most complex pricing models at an unprecedented scale on public cloud platforms like AWS and GCP.
  

  

Your Role and Impact:
  

As the lead for the Pricing Engine, you are the master of massive\-scale computation. You will take the sophisticated pricing models developed by our top quants and operationalize them on a colossal grid. Your primary mission is to ensure that millions of trades can be re\-valued against thousands of historical market scenarios with extreme speed, efficiency, and rock\-solid stability.
  

Your impact is at the core of our risk valuation capability. You will architect the system that answers the most fundamental question in risk: "What is it worth, right now, under this scenario?" The performance and reliability of the platform you build will directly determine the firm's ability to manage risk and meet its most critical regulatory obligations.
  

  

Key Responsibilities:
  

* **Architect, build, and manage** a massive\-scale, distributed compute grid on **public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)** for running financial pricing models.
* Design and implement the orchestration layer responsible for distributing millions of pricing tasks efficiently across hundreds of thousands of **CPU/GPU cores**.
* Deploy, manage, and version control a **diverse library of quantitative pricing models**, ensuring they run optimally in a distributed environment.
* Obsessively monitor and optimize the performance, cost, and resource utilization of the cloud grid, driving continuous efficiency improvements.
* Collaborate with quantitative development teams to seamlessly integrate new and updated pricing models into the production grid.
* Engineer the data logistics to ensure that the **correct market data, trade data, and model configurations** are available for every calculation at runtime.
* Ensure the pricing engine is highly available, resilient, and capable of meeting stringent recovery time objectives.
  

  

What We're Looking For:
  

* **8\+ years of professional experience** with a proven track record of designing, building, and running applications on massive\-scale compute grids.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud provider (**AWS or GCP**), including their batch processing, container, and serverless offerings.
* Deep expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies (**Docker, Kubernetes**).
* Strong programming skills in languages common to high\-performance computing, such as **C\+\+ and Python**.
* Prior experience in a similar role within the financial industry (e.g., running large\-scale Monte Carlo simulations, VaR calculations, or XVA pricing grids) is highly desirable.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* A strong background in distributed systems, performance tuning, and **infrastructure\-as\-code principles.**
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues in a high\-pressure, large\-scale environment.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with quantitative research, trading, and risk management teams.

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
