The Role
  
Simon \& Schuster is investing in Data \& Decision Intelligence to build a decision ecosystem where data, tools, and automation are embedded in everyday work, enabling faster and better\-informed decisions. The Director, Data Platform \& Engineering will turn that commitment into a secure, scalable, and AI\-ready enterprise data platform. This leader will own the platform and engineering roadmap, build the team and operating model, and partner across Technology and the business to modernize fragmented data and manual processes without disrupting critical operations.
  
What You Will Do
  
* Own the enterprise data platform. Define and execute the architecture and roadmap for ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, serving, metadata, lineage, and data quality across global data domains.
* Build the engineering organization. Hire, lead, and develop a globally distributed team; clarify roles, capacity, delivery practices, and career paths while raising technical and leadership standards.
* Modernize with continuity. Rationalize legacy pipelines, reporting dependencies, and disconnected workflows; establish migration plans that protect daily business operations and reduce technical debt.
* Create trusted foundations. Partner with data governance, business, and technology leaders to establish documented systems of record, shared data definitions, ownership, and reusable data products.
* Set engineering standards. Establish practical standards for architecture, modeling, testing, documentation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, privacy, observability, incident response, and disaster recovery.
* Enable strategic data products. Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Science, Product, and business teams to support enterprise forecasting, production and warehouse planning, author and title discovery, backlist optimization, marketing effectiveness, and finance.
* Advance automation and responsible AI. Replace repetitive, data\-intensive processes with reliable automation and ensure governed, well\-documented data is available for AI\-enabled applications, with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Operate for reliability and value. Define service expectations and measures for availability, freshness, quality, delivery speed, adoption, and cost; continuously improve platform performance and business outcomes.
* Lead investment and partnerships. Shape budgets, capacity plans, vendor strategy, and consulting engagements; communicate tradeoffs and recommendations clearly.


What You Bring
  
* Leadership experience. 10\+ years in data engineering, platform engineering, or related roles, including 4\+ years leading engineering teams and senior technical talent; experience managing managers is preferred.
* Enterprise platform ownership. A record of defining and delivering cloud data\-platform strategy, architecture, modernization roadmaps, and operating models across multiple functions or data domains.
* Technical credibility. Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, data modeling, distributed data systems, cloud warehouses or lakehouses, transformation frameworks, ingestion and orchestration patterns, APIs, and software\-engineering practices.
* Modern delivery discipline. Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data observability, metadata and lineage, security, privacy, and production support.
* Transformation leadership. Demonstrated success migrating legacy data ecosystems while managing dependencies, change, service continuity, and stakeholder expectations.
* Business and executive partnership. Ability to translate enterprise priorities into a sequenced roadmap, make sound build\-versus\-buy decisions, and communicate architecture, risk, cost, and value in clear business terms.
* Financial and vendor management. Experience managing platform spend, capacity, vendors, contracts, and consulting partners with a focus on measurable value and sustainable total cost.
* People leadership. A record of attracting, developing, and retaining diverse talent and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and continuous improvement.


Preferred
  
* Relevant platforms. Experience with Snowflake and/or BigQuery, dbt, modern ingestion tools, semantic layers, data catalogs, and BI or analytics platforms.
* AI\-ready data. Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI or decision\-support products using governed enterprise data.
* Industry context. Publishing, media, retail, consumer products, forecasting, or supply\-chain experience; bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.


How Success Will Be Measured
  
* A clear enterprise roadmap. The target architecture, investment plan, ownership model, and delivery sequence are understood and supported across Data, Technology, and the business.
* A dependable, governed platform. Core data products meet defined expectations for quality, freshness, availability, lineage, security, and cost.

title: Analyst Senior, Testing
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
Are you curious, motivated, and forward\-thinking?


At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.

**About the Team**
------------------


The QA Automation team owns UI, API, and functional test automation across Account Servicing, Dispute \& Fraud, and Digital Servicing (MUON) product lines, working directly with US\-based internal customers. We build and maintain Selenium/Java and Cypress \& Playwright\-based frameworks, run regression on incremental releases and integrate quality gates into Jenkins CI/CD. The team is actively exploring AI\-assisted automation — failure triage, root\-cause analysis and test generation to shorten regression cycles and reduce maintenance overhead.

**What You Will Be Doing**
--------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts within the enterprise framework (Selenium \+ Java, REST Assured, BDD), Cypress/Playwright (either of the two).
* Execute manual and automated regression on incremental product releases; analyze failures and coordinate with technical and business teams to drive defects to closure.
* Analyze business and technical requirements to formulate test plans per enterprise methodology; apply risk\-based test design to meet delivery timelines.
* Integrate suites into Jenkins pipelines; manage framework dependencies and artifacts via Nexus.
* Track test cases, defects, and execution in Jira; produce coverage and results reports with actionable insights.
* Review peers' automation code; reduce maintenance overhead and keep automated tests relevant over time.
* Cordinate and collaborate with team members with no/less supervision across multiple projects.
* Manage US internal\-customer expectations from a delivery standpoint.
* Contribute to evaluation of JS\-based tooling (Playwright/Cypress) and AI\-assisted testing initiatives.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5\+ years professional experience, 3\+ years building automation scripts; bank card / payments domain preferred.
* Strong Selenium WebDriver with Java — Page Object Model, TestNG/JUnit, Maven, file and exception handling, database connectivity, result reporting, Good To have JS with either Cypress or Playwright.
* API automation with REST Assured; BDD framework development (Cucumber).
* Data\-driven testing using external databases or data sources.
* Working knowledge of Jenkins, Nexus, and Git; solid grounding in SDLC/STLC and Agile/Scrum.
* Strong manual test\-case design and execution across positive, negative, and regression techniques.
* BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate business needs into technical solutions and explain technical solutions to business users.
* Adaptable, team\-oriented, and results\-driven, with strong time skills.


Added bonus if you have:

* Jira (workflows, dashboards, test management); exposure to SoapUI.
* Java certification.
* JavaScript/TypeScript with Cypress or Playwright.
* Cross\-browser / cloud\-grid execution, Docker.
* Interest in applying AI/LLM tools to test generation, triage, or root\-cause analysis.


What we offer you :


A range of benefits designed to help support your lifestyle and wellbeing


A multi\-faceted job with a broad spectrum of responsibilities


A modern international work environment and a dedicated and innovative team


A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities – FIS is your final career step!

**Privacy Statement**


FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**


Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: VP and Branch Head- Jalandhar
description:
**Description**

 **Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Personal Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

* The jobholder is entrusted with the responsibility to direct and manage the growth of the Bank's business in one of the HSBC branches in the country. The branch being situated in a prime location of the city, has immense business potential for the WPB business.
* In view of the range of services, current size of the portfolio as well as the potential the location offers, the Branch is expected to be one of the leading branches of HSBC in INM (India Management.)
* The principal objective is therefore to continue to grow this Branch to maximise contribution to area profitability in line with the Strategic and Area Operating Plans.
* This is to be incorporated by growing the deposit base for the bank and by focussing on growth of the Wealth Management business with a sharper focus on increasing the Bank's market share and HNI (High Net Worth Individual(s) customer base in the catchment.
* The jobholder is required to coordinate marketing efforts, exceed customer expectations, actively manage attrition in the face of the stiff competition and closely monitor branch operations to ensure a high level of service delivery.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

* Ensure the growth of IWPB business for the branch in line with INM Strategic Plan / AOP (Annual Operating Planning) projections
* Contributes to area/ branch profitability
* Monitors and implements best practices across the region
* Enhance Bank's market share in it’s area of operation
* Deliver service and support for non\-RBWM business that is directed through branch and support cross\-business collaboration..
* Where there is CMB (Commercial Banking ) functions, manage interaction effectively.
* Ensure a consistently high level of product and service delivery across the branch
* Develop and maintain good customer relations
* Coach the team to achieve business goals and effectively meet customer needs.
* Ensure effective customer contact management is in place
* Contributes to enhancing the Bank’s image and visibility in the market place
* Ensure all customer complaints are handled sensitively and efficiently within SLA’s applying the TCF and Bank values
* Contribute to subordinate development and boosting branch morale at all times
 **Qualifications \- External**

* Post Graduate
* 5\-10 years of work experience in Branch Banking

  

Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

title: Data Scientist II-3
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Data Scientist II\-3
Job Description Summary  

We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.  

  

Mastercard has over 2 billion payment cards issued by 25,000\+ banks across 190\+ countries and territories, amassing over 10 petabytes of data. Millions of transactions are flowing to Mastercard in real\-time providing an ideal environment to apply and leverage AI at scale. The AI team is responsible for building and deploying innovative AI solutions for all divisions within Mastercard securing a competitive advantage. Our objectives include achieving operational efficiency, improving customer experience, and ensuring robust value propositions of our core products (Credit, Debit, Prepaid) and services (recommendation engine, anti\-money laundering, fraud risk management, cybersecurity)  

  

Role:
  

* Gather relevant information to define the business problem
* Creative thinker capable of linking AI methodologies to identified business challenges
* Develop AI/ML applications leveraging the latest industry and academic advancements
* Ability to work cross\-functionally, and across borders drawing on a broader team of colleagues to effectively execute the AI agenda

  

All About You:  

:• Demonstrated passion for AI competing in sponsored challenges such as Kaggle  

* Previous experience with or exposure to:
* Deep Learning algorithm techniques, open source tools and technologies, statistical tools, and programming environments such as Python, R, and SQL


• •Big Data platforms such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, GPU Clusters for deep learning  

* Classical Machine Learning Algorithms like Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Clustering (K\-means,


•Hierarchical and Self\-organizing Maps), TSNE, PCA, Bayesian models, Time Series ARIMA/ARMA, •Recommender Systems \- Collaborative Filtering, FPMC, FISM, Fossil
  

•Deep Learning algorithm techniques like Random Forest, GBM, KNN, SVM, Bayesian, Text Mining techniques, Multilayer Perceptron, Neural Networks – Feedforward, CNN, LSTM’s GRU’s is a plus. •Optimization techniques – Activity regularization (L1 and L2\), Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta concepts; Cost •Functions in Neural Nets – Contrastive Loss, Hinge Loss, Binary Cross entropy, Categorical Cross entropy; developed applications in KRR, NLP, Speech and Image processing  

* Deep Learning frameworks for Production Systems like Tensorflow, Keras (for RPD and neural net architecture evaluation), PyTorch and Xgboost, Caffe, and Theono is a plus
* Concentration in Computer Science

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Finance & Accounts Executive
description:
**About Us**

  

At Eclat, we believe that technology can make a big difference to a world dependent on access to knowledge. In our current avatar, we are solving for eContent discovery and access challenges that the research community and students face while pursuing their research and education. Using technology we also help institutions drive user engagement and take informed decisions. We are present in 60\+ countries and work with 2000\+ institutes including Fortune 500 companies; premier academic and research institutes like AIIMs, ISB, IIMs, IITs, NTU Singapore and institutions in Japan, S.E. Asia, Middle East, Africa and Latin America.

 **About The Role**

  

As a Finance \& Accounts Executive, you will be responsible for accurate and timely execution of Eclat's day\-to\-day finance operations across accounting, AP, AR, invoicing, reconciliations, payroll coordination, documentation and Zoho based finance processes.  

You will progressively take ownership of finance processes, month\-end close, controls, MIS support, cash/working\-capital visibility and process automation, working closely with the finance/vCFO team and Eclat leadership.  

The role is designed to develop you into a FinOps Manager within 12–18 months, based on demonstrated capability and performance.

 **You Will Closely Work With**

  

* vCFO Finance team
* Internal and Statutory auditors
* Functional and Business heads
* Customer Success team
* Leadership team
* Mentor

 **What Describes You Best**

  

* M.Com / MBA (Finance) / equivalent
* 2–4 years of relevant finance \& accounting experience
* SaaS / technology / IT services experience preferred
* Experience working with internal and statutory Auditors

 **What Will You Own**

  

As a Finance \& Accounts Executive, you will own the hands\-on execution of full\-cycle accounting in Zoho Books \- managing AP/AR, payroll, reconciliations and audit\-readiness.  

Progressively, you will expand your scope to drive month\-end closes, workflow automation, SOP implementation.

 **How Will You Spend Your Time at Eclat**

 *Core Accounting \& Finance Operations*

  

* Ledger \& Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, audit\-ready records in Zoho Books, managing schedules for accruals, prepayments, and fixed assets. Perform regular bank, vendor and customer reconciliations.
* AP/AR Operations: Execute end\-to\-end processing. Prepare customer invoices, manage AR ageing, and coordinate collections. On the AP side, validate vendor invoices, match POs, and process employee expense claims.
* Payroll Coordination: Validate monthly payroll inputs, coordinate with HR for Zoho Payroll processing, and reconcile payroll with accounting records.
* Month\-End Close: Progressively take ownership of the operational close checklist.

 *Revenue, Cash \& Reporting*

  

* SaaS \& Revenue Integrity: Ensure underlying transaction data accurately supports CRM\-to\-billing reconciliations, deferred\-revenue schedules and critical SaaS metrics like ARR/MRR, collections, revenue realization etc.
* Cash \& Export Operations: Monitor bank balances, provide cash\-position visibility and support FIRC/e\-BRC tracking for export\-revenue reconciliation.
* MIS Support: Provide reliable, timely data to support the preparation of monthly P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and working\-capital reports.

 *Systems, Controls \& Compliance*

  

* ZohoOne ERP: Act as a strong operational user of Zoho Books, building strong working knowledge of data flows between CRM, Books, Payroll, Expense, People and Analytics.
* Governance: Enforce Eclat's maker\-checker framework and implementation of approved SOPs without bypassing financial controls.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain accurate data and documentation and challans to support GST/TDS filings, statutory audits, and compliance reviews.

 *AI, Automation \& Process Excellence*

  

* Identify repetitive/manual finance processes suitable for automation.
* Use AI tools to improve finance analysis, documentation and productivity.
* Support workflow automation and system integrations.
* Improve accuracy, turnaround time and reduce manual intervention.

 **Key Success Metrics**

  

* Accuracy and timeliness of accounting, AP/AR and reconciliations
* Month\-end close readiness and quality of supporting schedules
* Zoho adoption, data quality and process automation
* Audit/compliance readiness with minimal control exceptions
* Timely and reliable MIS/finance data
* Process improvements and automation initiatives implemented
### **Benefits**

  

* Be part of Eclat's growth story as we expand across international markets
* Build a career in modern Finance Operations, beyond traditional accounting
* Build hands\-on expertise in Zoho, AI and finance automation
* Learn and grow under the mentorship of experienced finance professionals
* Healthy work/life balance with wellbeing initiatives, parental leave, career development assistance and required work infrastructure support

  

M.Com or MBA in Finance (2\-4 years experience; SaaS/tech industry and prior audit experience preferred)

title: Learning and Change Transformation - Manager - Arabic Proficiency
description:
Location: Kochi

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1741592
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Role \- Manager, Learning Transformation \& Change**

  


**Experience :** 11–15 years, including substantial consulting experience

  


**Capability mix :** Learning consulting with strong organisational change management capability

  


**Travel** : 25%–50% across KSA, UAE and Qatar, engagement\-dependent

  


**THE OPPORTUNITY**

  



The Manager is a core leadership hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change portfolio. The role leads client engagements end to end, shapes commercially viable solutions, supports high\-priority pursuits and helps build the assets, talent and operating discipline required for a scalable practice.

  



The role combines learning transformation, organisational change management, business development and AI\-enabled learning. The successful candidate will work with MENA partners and account teams across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  


**Client delivery and engagement leadership**


* Lead concurrent learning and change engagements across scope, solution, quality, financials, resourcing, risk and client satisfaction.
* Own solution architecture across capability models, learning strategy, learning journeys, curriculum, change and adoption, technology enablement, measurement and sustainment.
* Manage engagement economics including effort, margin, realisation, change control and revenue recognition against plan.
* Lead stakeholder interviews, executive workshops, design sessions, steering reviews and client presentations.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and address delivery risks and escalations promptly.

  


**Learning transformation and change strategy**


* Lead learning needs analysis, capability diagnostics, skills mapping and workforce upskilling roadmaps.
* Design learning operating models, academies, curriculum architectures, blended journeys and outcome measurement frameworks.
* Design change and adoption strategies for digital, operating model, regulatory and workforce transformations.
* Integrate stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, capability building, reinforcement and benefits realisation into learning solutions.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development solutions, including assessment administration and interpretation through suitably accredited practitioners.

  


**Pursuits, proposals and market development**


* Lead L\&D and change pursuits from qualification through win themes, solution design, delivery model, workplan, staffing, assumptions, pricing inputs and oral presentations.
* Translate RFP and client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially sound solutions under tight timelines.
* Develop capability showcases, credentials, case studies, proposal content and reusable response assets.
* Partner with MENA account teams, subject\-matter specialists, finance and delivery leaders to improve proposal quality and conversion.
* Identify account extensions and cross\-portfolio opportunities with OCM, HRT, OWT and Design Theatre capabilities.

  


**AI\-enabled learning and innovation**


* Apply Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools to research, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Shape AI\-enabled learning solutions, including a learning content generation accelerator, personalised learning journeys and learning analytics use cases.
* Define appropriate human review, quality, privacy, intellectual property and risk controls for AI\-assisted deliverables.
* Contribute to at least one client\-facing AI\-enabled learning accelerator or innovation use case.

  


**Practice and people leadership**


* Coach Senior and Staff consultants, review client deliverables and build consulting, learning, change and AI capability across the team.
* Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, deployment, utilisation planning and certification pathways.
* Build and maintain the capability repository, proposal repository and case\-study repository.
* Develop reusable methodologies, accelerators, estimation models, service descriptions and delivery playbooks.

  


**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS**

  


* **Commercial and consulting judgement:** Structures ambiguous problems, builds credible solutions and manages engagement economics.
* **Learning and change integration:** Applies learning strategy and change management together to deliver measurable business outcomes.
* **Pursuit leadership:** Creates clear win themes, compelling proposal narratives and realistic delivery approaches.
* **Executive communication and facilitation:** Leads workshops and presents recommendations with clarity and confidence.
* **AI fluency:** Uses AI responsibly to improve speed and quality and can shape AI\-enabled learning solutions.
* **Builder mindset**: Is comfortable creating repeatable capability while delivering client work in a lean, growth\-stage team.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

  


**Essential**

  


* 11–15 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management, including substantial client\-facing consulting experience.
* Proven end\-to\-end engagement leadership with responsibility for quality, team, financials and client outcomes.
* Demonstrable experience leading pursuits, developing proposals and shaping learning or change solutions.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Working knowledge of change impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on, responsible use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals and learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency in reading, writing and speaking, sufficient to review proposal content, participate in stakeholder discussions and support workshops. Proficiency will be assessed through a role\-relevant practical evaluation.

  


**Preferred**

  


* GCC or MENA market experience, particularly in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating model design, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed or similar, and digital adoption tools such as WalkMe or SAP Enable Now.
* Experience with learning design and content tools such as Articulate 360, Vyond, Camtasia or comparable platforms.

  


**CERTIFICATIONS**

  


**Required at joining or within the agreed development plan**


* PROSCI or equivalent recognised change certification
* Design thinking / human\-centred design
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential
* Agile or Scrum awareness/certification

  


**Preferred / differentiating**


* CPTD / APTD or equivalent learning credential
* CCMP
* Kirkpatrick evaluation credential
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry accreditation
* Learning analytics or platform certification

  


**WAYS OF WORKING**

  


* Initial ramp\-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
* Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.

  


**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**

  


**Delivery**


* Engagements delivered to agreed scope, quality, financial and client\-satisfaction targets.
* Project plans, financial reports, quality reviews and client feedback.

  


**Pursuits**


* Support at least 15 strategic pursuits and lead solution development for at least 5 major proposals, subject to pipeline volume.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.

  


**Commercial contribution**

* Demonstrable contribution to portfolio revenue through billable delivery, wins or account extension.Individual target to be calibrated to the approved portfolio plan
* Revenue, pipeline and account records.

  


**Stakeholders**

* Build effective working relationships with up to 5 priority MENA sponsors or account leaders.
* Stakeholder plan and opportunity activity.

  


**Capability assets**


* Create or materially improve at least 5 reusable credentials, case studies, methods, estimates or proposal assets.
* Controlled repository and reuse log.

  


**AI and innovation**


* Help develop one client\-facing AI\-enabled learning accelerator or use case and evidence responsible AI adoption in pursuits and delivery.
* Demo, use\-case record or client deliverable.

  


**People**


* Coach 3–5 junior consultants and maintain documented development and certification plans.
* Counselling records and development plans.

  


**Utilisation and operating model**

* Meet the approved utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with exceptions re\-based when staffing materially changes.
* Utilisation and resource reports.

  


**WHAT EY OFFERS**

  


* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role that combines client delivery, solution shaping, capability building and market development.
* Opportunities to develop dual capability across learning consulting and organisational change.
* Hands\-on experience with modern learning technology, AI\-enabled content and analytics.
* The opportunity to help shape a growing Learning \& Change portfolio rather than inherit a fixed model.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts**

Job Description

Company: Abhinaya Cinemas

Department: Business Finance \& Accounts

Location: Head Office, Changanacherry, Kerala

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full\-time, on\-site

Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹28,000 per month, based on qualification, skills and assessment

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Abhinaya Cinemas is looking for an Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts to join our head office finance team.

This is an entry\-level role built for someone at the start of their career who wants to learn how money actually

moves through a business — daily box office collections, food \& beverage sales, vendor payments, distributor

settlements, payroll and statutory filings — across a multi\-location cinema operation with a multi\-decade legacy.

The role is deliberately designed for a candidate who is as comfortable with software as with a ledger. A large part

of our finance work is being rebuilt around automation: dashboards instead of manual MIS, system\-to\-system data

flows instead of re\-keying, and validated templates instead of ad\-hoc spreadsheets. We want an Associate who will

not simply run the process as it exists, but will look at a recurring task and ask whether it needs to be done by hand at all.

You will be trained on the accounting fundamentals. What you bring is accuracy, curiosity, and an instinct for using technology to do the job better.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Daily Accounting \& Bookkeeping

* Record day\-to\-day transactions in the accounting system — sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries and bank transactions.
* Maintain accurate ledgers, vouchers and supporting documentation, filed and retrievable.
* Process vendor bills and payments, track advances, and maintain the payables schedule.
* Handle petty cash accounting and expense claims across cinema locations.

Revenue \& Reconciliation

* Reconcile daily box office collections against the ticketing system, online aggregator reports and bank credits.
* Reconcile food \& beverage / Cafe Abhinaya POS sales, stock movement and cash–card–UPI settlements.
* Perform bank reconciliations and follow up on unmatched or delayed settlements.
* Support distributor and film\-hire settlement workings and share calculations.

Statutory \& Compliance Support

* Prepare working files for GST returns, TDS and other statutory filings; assist with timely submission.
* Support monthly payroll inputs in coordination with HR — attendance, deductions, PF and ESI schedules.
* Assist with audits by preparing schedules, ledger extracts and supporting documents.
* Maintain compliance calendars and flag due dates before they arrive.

Automation \& Systems Improvement

* Build and maintain Excel / Google Sheets models with formulas, validation and pivot\-based reporting that replace manual re\-keying.
* **Identify repetitive finance tasks and propose ways to automate or simplify them.**
* Help migrate and clean data as we move processes onto better tools; test new workflows and document them.
* **Write and maintain simple SOPs so that every recurring process is repeatable by anyone in the team.**
* Reporting \& Analysis
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS — collections, occupancy\-linked revenue, F\&B performance, expense
* summaries.
* **Assist with budget versus actual tracking and highlight variances with a plain\-English explanation.**
* Support the Finance Manager with ad\-hoc analysis for management decisions.
* QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE

 technical audiences.

title: Vice President - Data & Analytics, Edelman Intelligence
description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
   

  

 At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic and forward\-thinking Head of Data \& Analytics to lead the analytical engine behind Edelman Intelligence. This role will oversee analytics strategy, predictive intelligence initiatives, AI\-enabled insights, and measurement capabilities that help deliver smarter, more impactful, and client\-centric solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise with commercial thinking, innovation, and leadership. They should understand the communications and media industry well enough to challenge briefs, shape analytical approaches, and translate technical output into language that clients and strategists can act on. They should be passionate about how data, predictive analytics, and emerging AI technologies can enhance decision\-making, uncover opportunities, and create measurable business value for clients.
   

  

 This role will partner closely with the Intelligence leadership, senior consultants, and technology teams to build an advanced data solutions team with the goal of building innovative solutions that transform data into actionable insights, compelling narratives, and measurable business outcomes for industry\-leading clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Leadership \& People Management
   

  

 Recruit, lead, mentor, and grow a team of Data Scientists, Research and Data Engineers.
   

  

 Set clear expectations for technical quality, delivery rigor, and professional development across the team.
   

  

 Manage resourcing and capacity across concurrent engagements.
   

  

 Ensure the team leverages AI to accelerate their work across the analytical workflow.
   

  

 Modelling, Analytics \& Insight
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end analytical workflow: scoping, data exploration, modeling, validation, and delivery of client\-ready outputs.
   

  

 Oversee predictive modeling, media mix modeling, segmentation, forecasting, and attribution methodologies.
   

  

 Ensure analytical outputs tell a story that resonates with business stakeholders, drives decision\-making, and calls to action — not just report numbers.
   

  

 Ensure the business fit and quality of report generation across the Data Science team.
   

  

 Analytical Data Layer \& Quality
   

  

 Direct the team's Data Engineers in building and maintaining the analytical data layer: profiling, staging, exploratory pipelines, and data preparation for modeling and business intelligence.
   

  

 Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and reproducibility across the team's work.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 Partner with the rest of the Intelligence teams to translate business questions into analytical requirements and findings into client\-ready narratives.
   

  

 Work with the Solution team to ensure smooth transitions from analytical outputs to production\-grade deliverables.
   

  

 Present methodology, findings, and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders and when required clients.
   

  

 Technical Standards \& Team Development
   

  

 Define and enforce best practices for modeling, code quality, version control, and peer review within the Data team.
   

  

 Stay current with developments in AI, data science, and analytics tooling; evaluate and introduce new methods where appropriate.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

 10 or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, predictive analytics, or data science.
   

  

 5 or more years of experience within media, marketing, or communications environments.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI, predictive intelligence, and modern analytics methodologies.
   

  

 Experience translating analytics into strategic business or client outcomes.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and SQL.
   

  

 Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex information for senior internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience building and leading teams and driving cross\-functional initiatives.
   

  

**Preferred**
 Experience at an advisory or consulting firm focused on the intersection of communications, advanced analytics, and AI is highly preferred.
   

  

 Experience working in a global agency network
   

  

 Having worked in a matrix organization
   

  

 Expertise with generative AI solutions.
   

  

 Experience in Tableau/Power BI, or similar BI platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with cloud data environments and modern data architecture.
   

  

 Advanced degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or related field
   

  

 We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

description:

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Experience:** 
 3–6 Years
 



**Function:** 
 Lending / Business Operations / Growth
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Business Leadership
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 


 About Credflow
 
 Credflow is building the
 **Cashflow Management OS for Indian SMEs** 
 , combining technology, financial services, and commerce to help SMEs manage cash flow and access working capital.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Program Manager – Lending Growth \& Funnel** 
 to own and improve the lending growth engine across
 **Data, Sales, Credit, Operations, and Business** 
 .
 


 About the Role
 
 The core mandate is simple:
 



**Find where the lending funnel is leaking, understand why, and work with the business to fix it.** 




 You will analyse the complete lending funnel:
 



**Lead → Contact → Qualified → Login → Credit → Sanction → Disbursal** 




 You will identify bottlenecks, quantify opportunities, drive corrective actions, and execute initiatives that improve conversions and lending growth.
 



**This is not a reporting role.** 
 You will be expected to identify problems, build solutions, execute them, and drive measurable business outcomes.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Own the Lending Funnel
 * Track conversion across every stage of the lending funnel.
* Identify leakage, bottlenecks, and lead ageing.
* Analyse performance by salesperson, geography, product, lender, segment, and lead source.
* Identify lead and sales capacity requirements.


 2\. Identify \& Solve Business Gaps
 * Diagnose gaps impacting lending targets.
* Identify issues across
 **lead quality, sales productivity, credit, operations, and lender performance** 
 .
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and quantify business impact.
* Drive corrective actions with relevant teams.


 3\. Data \& Analytics
 * Build dashboards and analysis for lending performance.
* Monitor
 **contact, qualification, login, approval, sanction, disbursal, TAT, and conversion rates** 
 .
* Identify trends and growth opportunities from large datasets.
* Use
 **Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, BI tools** 
 , or similar analytics tools.


 4\. Sales Performance \& Productivity
 * Work closely with Sales Managers and sales teams.
* Identify salesperson\-level productivity gaps.
* Set targets and create action plans.
* Improve lead utilisation, conversion, and sales productivity.
* Establish daily and weekly performance reviews.


 5\. Lead Requirement Planning
 
 Build a bottoms\-up model connecting:
 



**Business Target → Disbursal → Sanction → Login → Qualified Leads → Raw Leads** 



* Forecast lead requirements based on conversion rates, sales capacity, lender appetite, product mix, and seasonality.
* Ensure the sales team has adequate quality leads to achieve lending targets.


 6\. Growth Programs
 * Identify and own initiatives to improve funnel performance.
* Run experiments around
 **lead allocation, contactability, reactivation, qualification, lender allocation, and sales processes** 
 .
* Measure the impact of interventions and scale successful initiatives.


 7\. Business Reviews \& Operating Cadence
 * Drive daily funnel monitoring and weekly business reviews.
* Conduct funnel deep\-dives and root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain action trackers and ensure timely execution.
* Build a data\-driven and predictable lending operating model.


 Requirements
 * **3–6 years of experience** 
 in Program Management, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, Growth, Lending Operations, Business Analytics, or Consulting.
* **Prior experience in FinTech, NBFC, Lending, Banking, Consumer Finance, or Financial Services is strongly preferred.**
* Candidates with experience managing
 **high\-volume lending/sales funnels** 
 will be preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent command of
 **Excel/Google Sheets** 
 ; SQL and BI tools preferred.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels, metrics, conversion analysis, and business performance.
* Ability to work closely with Sales, Credit, Operations, Data, and Business teams.
* Strong commercial mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Highly execution\-oriented and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.


 Preferred Industry Background
 
 Candidates with experience in:
 


* **FinTech**
* **NBFC**
* **Lending / Digital Lending**
* **Banking / Financial Services**
* **Consumer Finance**
* **SME / Business Loans**
* **B2B Lending**
* **High\-volume Lead Generation \& Sales Operations**



 will be strongly preferred.
 


 Key Success Metrics
 * Improvement in overall funnel conversion.
* Increase in lead utilisation.
* Improvement in login, sanction, and disbursal rates.
* Sales productivity improvement.
* Reduction in funnel leakage and lead ageing.
* Accuracy of lead requirement forecasting.
* Incremental lending business generated through growth initiatives.

title: Specialist Manager - OT Solution Integrator
description:
### **Job Summary**



Black \& Veatch allows you to lend your talent and perspective to humanity’s biggest challenges in a flexible environment where you are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities.



Our hybrid environment allows you to balance your work and personal life. At Black \& Veatch, you own your career with purpose and meaning. You are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities at every step of your career journey. Bring your big ideas while knowing you are safe to be who you are and speak up with concerns or questions and put your diverse talents and perspectives to use.



Black \& Veatch is seeking an exceptional and experienced professional to join our Infrastructure Advisory organization as a Manager – Consulting to provide expertise around OT Systems implementation and other related utility OT projects in an Integration Architecture capacity. The world is changing at an unprecedented rate and that change increases the demand for innovation and efficiency to deliver solutions and services across the world’s utility infrastructure. Join Black \& Veatch’s growing Infrastructure Advisory business and use your talents and expertise to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our clients, with the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your professional network, and shape a rewarding career path aligned with your aspirations.



The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early\-to\-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. Peers are engaged in a wide range of technical projects and encouraged to sharpen their skills to provide clients superior consulting services and continue to advance in a specialized career track. You will work with professionals in the Consulting and Digital Delivery Teams who represent a dynamic and cross\-functional group of experts in strategy, data, technology, and asset management systems. Together, they deliver innovative, data\-driven solutions that help clients navigate complex infrastructure challenges across diverse industries.



We partner with clients to align their people, processes, technologies, and data in response to rapid industry transformation. Our work enables organizations to modernize infrastructure, optimize asset performance, enhance resilience, and achieve long\-term sustainability goals. By joining this team, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and client success. You’ll contribute to mission\-critical projects that make a meaningful impact on communities and industries around the world.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The Solution Integrator is responsible for designing, orchestrating, and validating complex technology solutions across operational technology (OT) and enterprise IT environments. This role ensures that systems such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, and associated platforms function cohesively as an integrated operational ecosystem. The Solution Integrator provides technical leadership across solution architecture, integration design, cybersecurity alignment, and end\-to\-end system validation within large\-scale utility transformation programs.


* **Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Develop and document end\-to\-end solution architecture across OT and IT systems, including ADMS, EMS, SCADA, GIS, and enterprise platforms
* Define logical and technical architectures, including system boundaries, data flows, and interface patterns
* Lead architecture workshops and design sessions to align stakeholders on solution approach
* **System Integration Design \& Oversight**
* Design and oversee integration architecture across multiple systems, vendors, and technologies
* Define integration patterns, interface specifications, and data exchange requirements across IT/OT boundaries
* Ensure interoperability and end\-to\-end functionality across integrated workflows
* **IT/OT Integration \& Operational Alignment**
* Lead the design and implementation of IT/OT integration strategies, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and control system requirements
* Coordinate across OT systems (ADMS, EMS, DERMS, SCADA) and enterprise IT systems (CIS, ERP, GIS)
* Ensure solutions support real\-time operations, reliability, and operational decision\-making
* **Cybersecurity \& Compliance Alignment**
* Integrate cybersecurity principles into solution and integration design, including access control, data protection, and secure communication patterns
* Align system architecture with enterprise cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards
* Support risk identification, mitigation, and validation activities for OT and IT environments
* **System Validation, Testing \& Readiness Support**
* Support end\-to\-end system validation by ensuring integration design aligns with test scenarios and operational requirements
* Collaborate with testing teams to validate system behavior, data flows, and integration performance
* Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of integration\-related issues
* **Integration Governance \& Vendor Coordination**
* Provide technical oversight and governance across vendors, internal teams, and system implementers
* Lead integration design reviews, ensure adherence to architecture standards, and manage technical risks
* Serve as the technical point of integration accountability across the project lifecycle


**Key Competencies**


* Systems thinking with the ability to connect complex technical components into a cohesive solution
* Strong stakeholder communication and facilitation across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive alignment across multiple vendors and workstreams
* Risk\-aware mindset with focus on reliability, security, and operational performance


\#LI\-PG1


### **Management Responsibilities**



Individual Contributor


### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Master’s degree in instrumentation, Information Technology or Engineering
* 10 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* 2\+ years of experience with electric utility control systems operations or maintenance
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects through the complete lifecycle including requirements development, design, systems integration \& implementation and testing
* Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC, IEEE) and utility regulatory environments
* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) and enterprise architecture frameworks
* Background in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related technical discipline
* Knowledge of or direct experience with Grid Management \& Modernization Solutions Deployment (e.g. Grid Modernization Technologies, Advanced Distribution Management System, Distributed Energy Resource Management System, Automated Metering Infrastructure) and/or Utility IT Transformation (Enterprise Asset Management, Work Management, Customer Information Systems, ERP)

### **Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, instrumentation or computer engineering, Information Systems, or similar Technical domain
* 7 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* Extensive Knowledge of Electric utilities operations functions and associated processes
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects with technical domain experience
* Hands\-on experience in utility OT platforms such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, DERMS, or related systems
* Deep understanding of system integration concepts including APIs, middleware, data models, and real\-time data exchange
* Proven experience designing IT/OT integration architectures in complex, multi\-vendor environments
* Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for critical infrastructure systems (e.g., identity management, network segmentation, secure integration patterns)
* Experience working across full system lifecycle including design, integration, testing, and go\-live

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js and Node.js)
description:
**About PaperLite**

PaperLite is an enterprise\-software / SaaS startup based in Pune, founded in 2023, focused on workflow automation and enterprise collaboration solutions. We help organizations streamline notifications, task management, document tracking, secure file sharing, communication, data security \& encryption, access control, client management, and more.

As a growing team, we’re building scalable infrastructure and systems to support our platform (for ourselves and our customers), and we are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can help make everything robust, automated, secure, and efficient.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full Stack Developer** with a **minimum of 5 years** **of hands\-on experience in React.js, Node.js, and the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)**. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable web applications, implementing new features, mentoring junior engineers, and ensuring the overall quality and performance of our software solutions. You should also be well versed in using AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop robust, scalable, and user\-friendly web applications using the MERN stack.
* Collaborate with the team to define project requirements, create technical specifications, and determine the best approach for implementation.
* Build reusable and modular code components to ensure code efficiency, maintainability, and scalability.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js and Express.js to support frontend functionalities.
* Implement responsive and mobile\-friendly UIs to deliver seamless user experiences across different devices and screen sizes.
* Work closely with designers and UX/UI experts to translate wireframes and design mockups into fully functional web applications.
* Optimize application performance by implementing best practices, code reviews, and performance tuning techniques.
* Conduct unit testing and debugging to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the quality and stability of the software.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to deliver projects on time and according to specifications.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in web development to continuously enhance your skills and contribute to the team's growth.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and contribute to code reviews and engineering best practices.
* Make effective use of AI\-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) to speed up coding, code reviews, debugging, and documentation, while ensuring output quality and security.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 5\+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer, with a strong focus on the MERN stack.
* Proficiency in React.js and Redux (or other state management libraries) to develop dynamic and responsive user interfaces.
* Expertise in building and deploying scalable backend applications using Node.js and NestJS, including modules, controllers, services, and database integration.
* Hands\-on experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Strong understanding of PostgreSQL database, including database design, schema creation, and query optimization.
* Knowledge of any cloud technology such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Knowledge of React Native would be an added advantage.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including how AI models are trained and how they function.
* Well versed in using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) as part of the daily development workflow to write, review, debug, and document code faster and more reliably.
* Experience with version control systems like Git and collaborative development using platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
* Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as modern front\-end frameworks and libraries.
* Familiarity with build tools such as Webpack, Babel, and task runners like Gulp or Grunt.
* Experience with testing frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Jest, Enzyme) for unit testing and ensuring code quality.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and debug complex issues.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team, mentor junior developers, and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

**What We Value in You**

* Strong problem\-solving \& troubleshooting instincts
* Great communication skills. Able to explain technical designs/questions to stakeholders, developers, security, etc.
* Comfort working with AI\-assisted tools and workflows to boost productivity and code quality.
* Ownership mindset. You care about platform reliability and user experience
* Willingness to learn and adopt new tooling / best practices

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to be an early/hands\-on member of a startup building enterprise SaaS infrastructure
* Exposure to end\-to\-end systems: cloud, security, performance, scalability
* A collaborative engineering culture with learning \& growth
* Flexible / hybrid environment (if applicable)
* Competitive compensation \& benefits

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates, please send your updated CV to **recruitment@findingpi.com** with subject line: Application: Senior Full Stack Developer, PaperLite

Pay: From ₹800,000\.00 per year

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About TaskUs:** 
 TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next\-generation customer experience to fast\-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud\-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest\-growing sectors, including social media, e\-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride\-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
   

  

 The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty\-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
   

  

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 As a Senior Data Engineer, you are the engine room of our data strategy. You don't just "move data"; you build resilient, self\-healing systems that transform raw, into high\-fidelity data products. You will take the Architect's blueprints and turn them into production\-grade code, ensuring there is clean and reliable data.
   

  

**Work mode : Remote**
**What The Senior Data Engineer Will Own**
* Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain high\-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from various sources into our Lakehouse.
* Code Quality \& Tooling: Drive the adoption of dbt for transformation and PySpark for heavy lifting. You will be responsible for writing modular, reusable code that follows strict CI/CD practices.
* Observability \& Reliability: Implement "Data SLAs." You will build the monitoring and alerting systems that notify the team of data drift or pipeline failures before the business notices.
* Data Productization: Work closely with the BI team and Data Scientists to prepare "feature\-ready" datasets.
* Performance Tuning: Deep\-dive into SQL and Spark query plans to optimize slow\-running jobs, reducing cost and latency.
* Local Development Advocacy: Implementing a workflow where engineers can develop and test complex SQL transformations locally using DuckDB, drastically reducing "waiting\-for\-cluster" time and lowering development costs.
* Cost\-Efficient Micro\-Pipelines: Building specialized pipelines for specific client reporting or data\-quality checks that run on single\-node containers (e.g., Lambda or small ECS tasks) using DuckDB, avoiding the minimum billing cycles of larger warehouses.
* Embedded Analytics: Exploring ways to use DuckDB as an embedded engine for internal tools or "edge" processing within the BPO's local site offices where bandwidth to the cloud might be a constraint.


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ Years in Data Engineering: You've lived through the "on\-call" life and know how to build systems that don't break at 3 AM.
* The Power Trio: Expert\-level proficiency in Python , SQL , and PySpark .
* Modern Lakehouse Stack: Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake) or Snowflake . You understand the nuances of the Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
* Transformation \& Modeling: Advanced experience with dbt (Data Build Tool) . You treat data models like software, including version control, testing, and documentation.
* Orchestration: Experience with Apache Airflow or Prefect, specifically building complex, idempotent DAGs.
* Streaming Experience: Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or Spark Streaming is a huge plus\-our BPO operations move in real\-time.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Comfort with Terraform or CloudFormation to manage your own data infrastructure.
* In\-Process Analytics (DuckDB): Proven experience using DuckDB for high\-speed local development, unit testing data transformations, or as a query engine for "small\-to\-medium" datasets (up to 100GB) without the overhead of a distributed cluster.
* Hybrid Execution Patterns: Ability to identify when to use heavyweight compute (PySpark/Databricks) versus lightweight compute (DuckDB/Python) to minimize cloud costs and reduce job latency.
* Parquet/Iceberg Interaction: Experience using DuckDB to directly query data stored in S3/Azure Blob (via Parquet or Iceberg files) for rapid ad\-hoc analysis or local dashboarding.
* Orchestration: Kubernetes (K8s) . Deep understanding of Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets management.


****How We Partner To Protect You:****
 TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
   

  

****DEI:****
 In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
   

  

 We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
 **https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
 TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: Software Quality Assurance Tester
description:
QA / Test Engineer (Manual and Automation)
 



 Wualt and Nexus
 



 Full\-time · Chennai, India (Hybrid)
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



 We are hiring a hands\-on QA / Test Engineer to own quality across both of our products. Wualt is a personal\-safety platform: a smart ring and app, a live response centre, and a real\-time emergency flow. Nexus is our enterprise platform for apparel manufacturing operations.
 



  





 This is a generalist quality role. You will do both manual and automated testing, from writing and running test plans by hand to building the automation and CI checks that catch regressions before they reach users. Because Wualt is a safety product, correctness and reliability are not negotiable.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • Test strategy and coverage across both products: the mobile apps, the web consoles, the back\-end APIs, and the real\-time flows.
 



 • The real\-time, safety\-critical flows, tested carefully: live location and audio, and the alerts that ride on them.
 



 • Clear test plans and test cases written from product requirements, plus exploratory, functional, and regression testing done by hand.
 



 • Automated tests that you build and maintain: API and end\-to\-end suites, mobile automation, and web automation, all wired into CI so they run on every change.
 



 • Device integration flows: Bluetooth ring pairing and on\-device behavior.
 



 • The bug lifecycle end to end: reproduce, isolate, report with clear steps and evidence, prioritize with the team, and verify the fix.
 



 • Release QA: build sign\-off, regression cycles, and quality tracking across releases.
 



 • Data\-privacy and security checks, including that personal data is handled in line with the DPDPA, with correct consent, access, and deletion behavior.
 



 • A close partnership with the architect and developers to build quality in rather than bolt it on.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Solid QA experience across both manual and automated testing of real, shipped software.
 



 • Mobile app testing experience, ideally with React Native apps, and web application testing.
 



 • API testing, for example with Postman or a REST client, and a working understanding of how the back end fits together.
 



 • Hands\-on with at least one automation stack, for example Appium or Detox for mobile, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for web, and pytest or a similar framework.
 



 • Comfort in CI/CD, for example GitHub Actions, and with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira or Linear.
 



 • Strong attention to detail, and the discipline to test methodically and document clearly.
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Testing real\-time or streaming systems, and performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter or k6\.
 



 • Security or privacy testing experience, and familiarity with the DPDPA or comparable regimes.
 



 • Experience testing IoT, BLE, or wearable\-connected products, or enterprise and ERP systems.
 



 • Some scripting or programming ability in Python or JavaScript beyond test frameworks.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 • First 30 days: you know both products, have a documented test plan for the critical flows, and are already finding and filing real issues.
 



 • By 60 days: a working automated regression suite running in CI for the highest\-risk areas, including the emergency flow.
 



 • By 90 days: releases go out with your sign\-off, regressions are caught before users see them, and quality is trending up on both systems.
 



  





 LOCATION AND TYPE
 



 Full\-time, based in Chennai, hybrid with regular on\-site collaboration.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Apply through this LinkedIn posting, and email your resume to sunil@armortrixtech.com. A short note on a tricky bug you caught, how you found it, and how you would have automated the catch is welcome.

title: Technical Specialist Analyst, Microsoft Dynamics 365
description:
Join us as a Technical Specialist Analyst
   

  

* This is a rewarding opportunity for a passionate and driven analyst to join our business
* We’ll look to you to apply your specialist skill and knowledge to solve business problems and produce working solutions that will make a difference to our customers and the bank
* Hone your technical expertise in a collaborative, agile and forward thinking team environment
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Technical Specialist Analyst, you'll be working across the solutions lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design, through to coding, testing, deployment and operation. Working in the feature team, you'll be developing your expertise to help solve business problems presented to make sure our customers are getting the best experience possible.
   

  

 By applying Agile methods, you'll be developing and producing solutions continually and rapidly that meet current non\-functional requirements and are flexible to cope with future functional and non\-functional needs.
   

  

**You'll Also Be**
* Producing innovative ideas and confirming these through experimenting and prototyping
* Designing and developing solutions with a focus on the automation of build, test and deployment activities using executable patterns
* Evaluating and analysing metrics to continually improve performance
* Using, and contributing to the development of standard patterns
* Liaising with principal engineers and domain architects to build an understanding of the wider platform and how it supports business objectives


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 You'll need at least 12 years of technical experience across engineering disciplines such as analysis, design, testing and deployment. You’ll have a background in solving complex analytical and numerical problems, and will be able to rapidly and effectively understand and translate product and business requirements into technical solutions.
   

  

 We'll also look to you to demonstrate a clear understanding of how your technical specialism supports our customers by producing high availability, low cost solutions.
   

  

**You'll Also Demonstrate**
* Strong business analysis expertise in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, with the ability to understand and translate business requirements into effective CRM solutions
* Experience in requirements gathering, business process mapping, and documenting functional specifications
* Ability to engage stakeholders, facilitate workshops, and translate business needs into clearly defined requirements
* Proficiency in writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting successful solution delivery

description:

 Full time
