 Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
   

  

**IST Switch Tester for Bangalore \& Chennai**
 At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you’re ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question\~ Are you FIS?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a QA Test Lead, you’ll test and perfect the fintech products that will change the way people around the world pay, bank and invest. This critical role involves establishing compliance processes with your team and implementing a quality maturity roadmap for each IT functional area.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Reporting into the Quality Assurance Director you will be leading the team of QA Test Analysts in a large program of work
* Preparing Test deliverables such as Test Plans, Test Execution Status Reports/Metrics, Team Status Reports, Test Summary/Completion Reports
* Schedule weekly meeting with the client, capture the pain points, take minutes, address the pain points and track them to closure
* Using your Payments Testing knowledge, be onsite at Client site when required, working alongside and guiding them through the System Integration, User Acceptance, Schemes Cert Test Phases etc
* Reviewing functional and design specifications to ensure full understanding of individual deliverables
* Work closely with the project team to guarantee quality of delivery and ensure all outputs are aligned with key project success metrics
* Effectively communicates testing activities and findings in oral and written forms
* Able to co\-ordinate and work with onshore and offshore teams
* Assist in the release process and with improving and automating the process
* Hold and facilitate test plan/case reviews with cross\-functional team members
* Identify any potential quality issues per defined process and escalate potential quality issues immediately to management
* Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements and creating a Requirements Traceability Matrix as required
* Track and monitor defects in JIRA, schedule defects triage with development team and Clients as required
* Comply with all FIS policies and procedures
* Other related duties assigned as needed


**What You Will Need**
* Min. 8\+ years’ experience in a Software testing role and must have experience in any of the FIS products ( Connex, IST CLR\&MAS, DN)
* A background with financial services industry practices, regulations and processes
* Transaction switching or Payments Testing experience (eftpos, card schemes MCard/Visa etc.)
* Experience in testing using stubs and simulators
* Experience in Schemes Certification testing
* Experience in leading test teams through System Integration Testing test phases
* Leadership experience to mentor and guide QA Analysts
* Proficiency in quality management methods, tools and technologies
* A bachelor’s in computer science, information systems, business administration or other related discipline, or the equivalent experience
* Ability to demonstrate interpersonal and teambuilding skills working with technical and non\-technical individuals
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
* Team skills, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships both internally and externally
* Organizational and time management skills
* To be a self\-starter with proven ability to work independently


**Added Bonus If You Have**
* Experience in the following Applications\~ IST/Merchant Account \& Settlement (MAS), IST/Clearing (CLR), Data Navigator, Connex \&/or Webpay/Digipay
* Experience in the following Tools/Sims\~ Test Rail, Jira, FINsim
* ISTQB Foundation Software Testing certification
* Knowledge of network message standards \- AS2805 or ISO standards


**What We Offer You**
* An exciting opportunity be a part of Worlds Leading FinTech Product MNC
* To be a part of vibrant team and to build up a career on core banking/payments domain
* A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities FIS is your final career step!

title: Principal GIS Analyst
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. Stantec is a leader in global infrastructure, water resource development, Buildings, Mining, Oil and Gas providing engineering design and remediation, construction, procurement, program management, and technology solutions for the environmental, water, wastewater, energy and power markets of the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific region.


Stantec is looking for Principal GIS to join our growing Geospatial team. This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with a broad spectrum of domain expertise in GIS, strong project management capabilities, and hands\-on experience with ESRI software. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering high\-quality geospatial solutions, mentoring team members, and driving strategic growth initiatives.


The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage teams, collaborate across disciplines, and build relationships with global stakeholders. A strong sense of ownership, adaptability, and learnability is essential, along with a proactive approach to contributing to project billability and identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement.


This role also involves strategic thinking to expand the team’s capabilities, foster international collaborations, and enhance Stantec’s global geospatial presence. A commitment to Stantec’s core values—Health, Safety, Security \& Environment (HSSE) and Inclusion \& Diversity—is fundamental.


Key Accountabilities:


* Act as the technical escalation point for complex GIS workflows, data issues, automation challenges, and delivery risks.

* Define and maintain technical standards, reusable templates, QA/QC processes, and best\-practice workflows.
* Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level GIS staff through technical reviews, coaching, training, and knowledge sharing.

 Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real\-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a
 **series B round of $17\.5M backed by leading global investors including Vertex Ventures SE Asia \& India, Fundamentum, and Elevation Capital.**
**Why Join Us?**
**Exciting Problem**
 The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews \- which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.
   

  

**Immense Scale**
 In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
 **900k users daily** 
 to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.
   

  

**Stellar Team**
 Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!
   

  

**Growth Opportunity**
 We have grown remarkably in the last 4 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300\+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H\&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.
   

  

 Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator\-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer\-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Associate Program Manager \- Customer Experience to own the CX charter for our creator platform. This role is for someone who thrives on picking up ambiguous problem statements, going deep into data and user feedback, and driving them to closure \- across product, tech, and support.
   

  

 You'll sit at the intersection of platform experience, creator sentiment (NPS/trust), and support\-led product improvements, and you'll be the one setting up the early\-warning systems (alerts) that help the org catch problems before they escalate.
   

  

**What would you be doing?**
* Platform CX (Service \& Journey)\- own and improve the end\-to\-end experience across critical creator journeys \- creator payouts, social login, and brand reconciliation, etc. Identify friction points in these flows and work with product/tech to resolve them.
* Own Creator NPS, Trust \& Effort\- run structured programs to gather creator insights (through quarterly NPS/Creator Pulse, 1:1 interviews, etc), and use these to identify gaps. Break these down into individual, ownable problem statements and drive them to resolution.
* Product Enhancements (Support\-Led)\- mine support tickets and escalations for recurring/systemic issues and convert them into product enhancement requests \- closing the loop between "what support hears" and "what product builds”
* Alerts \& Monitoring\- work closely with tech and product to set up proactive alerting across the platform \- for issues like sign\-up drop\-offs, engagement dips, and cohort\-level behavioral shifts \- so problems are caught early rather than reactively.


**What are we looking for?**
* Bachelor's degree from a Tier\-1 college/ prior experience at a Tier\-1 consumer tech company
* Prior experience as a generalist / founder's office/ strategy ops/ program manager/ product analytics role at a startup \- someone who has owned individual problem statements and worked on 0→ 1 or 1→ 10 initiatives
* Strong data orientation and structured problem\-solving \- must be comfortable moving from raw data to insight to action independently (must have)
* Strong cross\-functional operator \- comfortable working across product, tech, business, and support teams to get things done (must have)
* Familiarity with app usage metrics, product analytics tooling, and mapping customer journeys (good to have)


**Interview Process**
* R0\- detailed screening call by HR
* R1\- Data interpretation \& problem\-solving
* R2\- Problem\-solving (deeper dive)
* R3\- Cross\-functional and culture fit


**Perks And Benefits**
 We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
   

  

* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning \& Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget
* Company sponsored newsletters and books
* AI tools Subscription
* Regular Team Outings
* Discounted Health Plans \& Gym Memberships
* Industry insights on growing your social media if you are a (aspiring) creator

title: Interior Design Project Manager
description:
HONK is looking for a
 **Project Manager who can make design happen.** 




  





 We work on brands, retail spaces, environments, experiences and physical brand expressions. This role sits between
 **design, client, vendors and execution** 
 — taking projects from an approved idea through drawings, production, site execution and final handover.
 



 We’re looking for someone who is highly organised, commercially aware and comfortable being on the ground when things get complicated.
 


**What you’ll do** 
* Own projects from
 **design development through execution and handover**
* Build and manage project timelines, milestones and execution plans
* Coordinate between
 **designers, architects, AutoCAD/3D teams, clients, vendors, contractors and production teams**
* Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, materials and execution details
* Translate design intent into something that can actually be
 **built, fabricated and installed**
* Manage contractors, fabricators, carpenters, electricians, installers and other site teams
* Conduct regular site visits and monitor progress, quality and workmanship
* Identify problems early and find practical solutions before they become delays
* Track materials, procurement, production and deliveries
* Manage project budgets, estimates, quotations, variations and costs
* Keep clients informed about progress, decisions, approvals and changes
* Coordinate design changes and ensure the latest drawings reach the people executing them
* Maintain project documentation, schedules, site reports and progress updates
* Ensure projects are delivered
 **on time, within budget and to the intended design quality**


**The kind of projects** 

 Our projects can include:
 


* Retail stores and brand spaces
* Commercial and workplace interiors
* Exhibitions and installations
* Brand experience spaces
* Pop\-ups and temporary environments
* Hospitality and experiential spaces
* Other physical brand and spatial projects


**What we’re looking for** 
* **4–8 years of experience** 
 in interior design, architecture, retail design, fit\-out, spatial design or project execution
* Experience managing projects from
 **design → drawings → production → site → handover**
* Strong understanding of construction, materials, finishes and fabrication
* Ability to read and understand architectural/interior drawings
* Experience coordinating contractors, vendors and site teams
* Strong project planning and timeline management
* Good understanding of BOQs, estimates, quotations and project costs
* Strong communication and client\-handling skills
* Comfortable working on multiple projects and solving problems under pressure
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and project management tools
* AutoCAD knowledge is a plus


**Most importantly** 

 You should be the person who walks into a messy situation and thinks:
 



**“Okay. What needs to happen next?”** 




 You don’t have to be the designer.
 



 But you need to understand
 **design well enough to protect the idea while making sure it gets built properly.** 



**About HONK** 

 HONK is a brand and design consultancy working across
 **strategy, brand thinking, design and experience** 
 .
 


* We believe good ideas aren’t finished when they look good on a screen. They’re finished when they work in the real world.

Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us.  Culture is our competitive advantage. We believe in experimentation everywhere. We build, test and learn.  We’ve pioneered one of the world’s largest agentic workforces, with 30,000\+ agents, that are designed for specific tasks and automate complex workflows seamlessly.  The Position
   

  

**Patient Journey Partner\- Hematology**
**Location: Delhi**

 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**
* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public \& private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co\-creation of solutions for key accounts


**Who You Are**
* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4\+ years in Oncology or Hematology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:

 WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

****Job Description****
**Purpose**
* Lead delivery of actuarial transformation initiatives leveraging the Unify platform.
* Act as the primary Business \& Functional SME bridging actuarial stakeholders and workflow development teams.
* Drive process automation, workflow standardisation, governance and business adoption across actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Define and execute the future\-state operating model for actuarial production and transformation.


****Work Experience****
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Life Insurance actuarial functions.
* Minimum 4\+ years in leadership and stakeholder management roles.
* Significant experience across actuarial reporting, valuation, capital modelling, Prophet production, IFRS17 and/or Solvency II processes.
* Experience leading actuarial transformation and automation initiatives.
* Experience working directly with UK Life Insurance clients and stakeholders.


****People Responsibilities****
* Lead and develop a team of actuarial SMEs, business analysts and transformation specialists.
* Mentor team members on actuarial process design, workflow automation and business analysis techniques.
* Drive capability development in Unify, Python, actuarial production processes and governance frameworks.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment and resource allocation.
* Conduct performance reviews and development discussions.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and automation.


****Process Responsibilities \- Business SME Leadership****
* Provide actuarial production expertise and business domain leadership across Unify initiatives.
* Translate actuarial business requirements into detailed functional specifications for workflow developers.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, actuarial teams and development teams.
* Drive solution design decisions ensuring alignment with actuarial processes, controls and governance requirements.
* Provide oversight and challenge throughout the development lifecycle.


****Process Responsibilities \- Unify Transformation \& Workflow Automation****
* Lead design and implementation of Unify workflows supporting actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Drive automation of basis production, model execution, result extraction and reporting activities.
* Support migration of legacy Excel/VBA processes into governed Unify and Python\-based solutions.
* Define reusable workflow frameworks, templates and development standards.
* Support multi\-basis, multi\-risk and multi\-scenario actuarial production solutions.
* Identify automation opportunities and deliver measurable efficiency improvements.


****Process Responsibilities \- Requirements \& Solution Design****
* Lead workshops to gather, document and validate business requirements.
* Develop business process maps, functional specifications and user stories.
* Analyse existing actuarial processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and automation opportunities.
* Design scalable and sustainable future\-state solutions.
* Ensure traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Testing \& Business Readiness****
* Define and execute SIT, UAT and business readiness strategies.
* Coordinate testing activities across actuarial and development teams.
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, controls and timetable expectations.
* Manage defect prioritisation and resolution activities.
* Support operational readiness and transition into production.


****Process Responsibilities \- Governance \& Controls****
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for Unify solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls covering input validation, access management, auditability, version control and result validation.
* Lead governance forums and Go/No\-Go decision processes.
* Maintain solution documentation, audit trails and operational procedures.
* Support internal audit, regulatory and control reviews.


****Process Responsibilities \- Actuarial Domain Expertise****
* Strong understanding of actuarial production processes including valuation, IFRS17, Solvency II, capital modelling and reporting.
* Experience supporting Prophet model execution and downstream reporting processes.
* Understand data flows, assumptions, basis management and results analysis.
* Provide guidance on actuarial process optimisation and target operating models.
* Support strategic transformation programmes involving actuarial and finance functions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Automation \& Innovation****
* Drive adoption of modern technologies including Python, cloud platforms and workflow automation tools.
* Promote standardisation and reusability across actuarial processes.
* Develop dashboards and operational monitoring solutions.
* Support continuous improvement and process modernization initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and automation capabilities.


**Project Leadership**
* Lead large\-scale actuarial transformation and Unify implementation programmes.
* Manage project plans, milestones, risks and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate with actuarial, finance, risk, technology and operations teams.
* Support operating model design and roadmap development.
* Drive successful delivery within agreed timelines and quality standards.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.
* Progressing towards or qualified Fellow of IFoA, SOA, IAI or equivalent actuarial body.
* Fully Qualified Actuary preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong actuarial transformation experience.


****Technical Skills****
* Strong understanding of Life Insurance actuarial processes and reporting frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet ecosystems and actuarial production environments.
* Strong business analysis and process re\-engineering capability.
* Python, SQL and automation expertise.
* Understanding of cloud\-based data and workflow platforms.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.


****Preferred Systems \& Platforms****
* Unify Platform
* Prophet Professional / Prophet Enterprise
* Python Frameworks
* SQL Databases
* Snowflake
* Azure Platform
* Power BI
* Git / Azure DevOps (desirable)


****Soft Skills****
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong facilitation and requirement\-gathering capability.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
* Strong project management and planning skills.
* Strategic thinking and transformation mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Ownership and accountability.
* Strong customer focus.
* Attention to detail and governance mindset.
* Collaborative leadership style.
* Continuous improvement orientation.
* Adaptability and resilience.


****Communication Skills****
* Ability to engage effectively with senior actuarial, finance and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language.
* Strong workshop facilitation and business analysis skills.
* Ability to build consensus and drive decisions across multiple teams.


****Qualifications****
* Graduation/ Masters in Actuarial Science

 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design\-for\-manufacturability and cost‑efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands\-on involvement in complex sheet‑metal product development.

**\- Team leadership and people management** 




 \- Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high\-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters).

**\- Technical ownership and hands\-on design** 




 \- Provide hands\-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‑metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.
 



 \- Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.
 



 \- Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.
 



  





 \-
 **Product development lifecycle \& project leadership** 




 \- Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full\-scale production.
 



 \- Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).
 



 \- Lead cross\-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade\-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders.
 



  





**\- Manufacturability, cost optimization \& supplier engineering** 




 \- Own DFMA for sheet‑metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection.
 



 \- Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead\-time management.
 



 \- Drive cost\-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume\-based sourcing strategies.
 



  





**\- Quality, compliance \& reliability** 




 \- Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements.
 



 \- Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective \& preventive actions.
 



 \- Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.
 



  





**\- Process improvement \& systems** 




 \- Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.
 



 \- Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model\-based definition (MBD) where applicable.
 



 \- Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
 



  





**\- Stakeholder management \& reporting** 




 \- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.
 



 \- Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.
 



 \- Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.
 



  





**Deliverables \& success metrics** 




**\- Deliverables** 




 \- Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.
 



 \- DFMEA, tolerance stack\-ups, verification \& validation plans, prototype test reports.
 



 \- Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials.
 



  





**Required qualifications \& experience (expanded)** 




**\- Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M.Tech/M.S. preferred.
 



**\- Experience:** 
 Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‑metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity.
 



**\- CAD skills** 
 : Expert\-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‑metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent.
 



**\- Manufacturing knowledge:** 
 Thorough understanding of sheet‑metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes.
 



**\- Systems:** 
 Hands\-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions.
 



**\- Process skills** 
 : DFMA, GD\&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development.
 



 \-
 **Leadership:** 
 Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience.
 



 \-
 **Communication** 
 : Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \-
 **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required).
 



  





**Preferred / differentiating skills** 




 \-
 **Certifications:** 
 CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent.
 



 \-
 **Domain experience** 
 : Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense.
 



 \-
 **Simulation:** 
 Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization.
 



 \-
 **Tooling \& fixtures:** 
 Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies.
 



 \-
 **Software:** 
 Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar.
 



 \-
 **Manufacturing exposure:** 
 Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.

title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Deal Value Creation Services
description:
**About Company** 




  





 BDO India LLP is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting, tax \& regulatory advisory and assistance for both domestic and international organisations across a range of industries. We are led by more than 300 Partners \& Directors with a team of over 8500 professionals operating across 12 cities – Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Coimbatore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Goa, Kochi, Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi\-Gurugram and Pune. We take pride in our service portfolio on the backing of a rich blend of experience and expertise, bringing to fore a work culture that is both client\-centric and knowledge driven. Our focus on delivering exceptional client service is backed by a partner driven approach to offer tailor\-made solutions ensuring quality excellence \& time efficiencies.
 



  





**About Deal Value Creation:** 




  





 Mergers and Acquisitions (M\&A) are vital strategic levers to enhance the value of a business—whether to generate growth, enhance capabilities or reduce operational costs. It is also a chance for business transformation, adopting new business models, workflows and workplace cultures.
 



 Increased disruptions, industry convergence, technological changes and the dramatic shift to new business models to stay competitive means that value creation in deals has never been more critical. With the bar getting higher and deals becoming more complex and expensive, creating deal value in M\&A is more challenging than ever.
 



 The DVCS practice advises clients on HR, organisation, and workforce\-related matters across acquisitions, divestitures, carve\-outs, mergers, and large\-scale transformation initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to lead complex engagements involving HR Due Diligence, Post\-Merger Integration (PMI), workforce analytics, and organisational change management.
 



  





**Details:** 




 Position Title \-Senior Associate/ Assistant Manager
 



 Location \-Gurgaon
 



 Department \-Deal Value Creation
 



 Reporting Manager \-Partner/ Director
 



 Qualification \- CA/MBA
 



  





  





**Core Deal Value Creation roles \& Responsibility:
 
 \-** 




  





**HR Due Diligence (Buy\-side \& Sell\-side)** 



* Lead end\-to\-end HR Due Diligence engagements for M\&A, PE, carve\-out, and demerger transactions.
* Assess workforce composition, employee costs, compensation structures, benefits, ESOPs, and HR\-related liabilities.
* Review labour law compliance, employee litigation, talent dependencies, attrition risks, and retention concerns.
* Evaluate HR operating models, governance frameworks, HRIS/HRMS, and shared service structures.
* Prepare diligence reports, red flag summaries, management presentations, and deal structuring recommendations.
* Participate in management discussions and diligence meetings.



  





**Post\-Merger Integration (PMI)** 



* Lead HR integration workstreams and Day\-1/Day\-100 readiness planning.
* Develop integration roadmaps covering organisation design, policy harmonisation, compensation \& benefits alignment, HR systems integration, and workforce restructuring.
* Support Target Operating Model (TOM) design and synergy realisation.
* Track integration milestones, risks, and PMO reporting.



  





**Carve\-Out \& Separation Support** 



* Support HR separation, divestiture, and demerger projects.
* Assess HR dependencies, standalone operating model requirements, and TSA design.
* Manage employee transition, communication, and compliance activities.
* Evaluate standalone HR costs and separation impacts.



  





**Workforce Analytics \& Financial Modelling** 



* Build workforce models, headcount bridges, attrition analyses, cost waterfalls, and synergy models.
* Conduct employee cost analysis, restructuring assessments, and HR benchmarking exercises.
* Translate workforce insights into executive and board\-level presentations.



  





**Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement** 




  




* Develop change management, communication, and employee engagement strategies.
* Advise CHROs, HR leaders, and C\-suite stakeholders throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Collaborate with legal, financial, tax, IT, and other advisory workstreams.
* Support proposals, client pitches, thought leadership, and practice development initiatives.

title: E-COMMERCE & MARKETPLACE EXECUTIVE
description:
WE’RE HIRING: E\-COMMERCE \& MARKETPLACE EXECUTIVE
 
 📍 Gota, Ahmedabad \| Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 💼 Experience: 1–3 years
 


 About Gracia Marcom
 
 Gracia Marcom is a purpose\-driven advertising, marketing and business\-growth company helping brands launch, manage and scale across Indian and international markets.
 



 We are building a disciplined, ambitious and people\-centred team where individuals receive the autonomy to take ownership, the challenges to develop competence and the support to grow professionally and personally.
 


 Why Are We Hiring for This Position?
 
 We are looking for an E\-commerce \& Marketplace Executive – Domestic and International who can manage and grow brands across online marketplaces and their own e\-commerce websites.
 



 This is not merely a product\-uploading or order\-processing position. You will be responsible for improving product visibility, customer experience, sales, operational accuracy and profitability across multiple digital commerce channels.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage day\-to\-day operations across marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Walmart, eBay, Etsy and other relevant Indian and international platforms.
* Manage brand\-owned e\-commerce websites built on Shopify, WooCommerce or similar platforms.
* Create, update and optimize product listings, categories, collections, attributes, variations, pricing and inventory.
* Coordinate product descriptions, images, videos, enhanced content, landing pages and marketplace\-specific brand content.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize listings and website content for better search visibility and conversion.
* Manage marketplace advertising and coordinate paid campaigns for e\-commerce websites.
* Monitor sales, traffic, conversion rates, average order value, advertising performance, return rates and profitability.
* Coordinate inventory availability, stock planning, order fulfilment and replenishment.
* Manage marketplace fulfilment models such as FBA and coordinate with warehouses, courier companies and logistics partners.
* Monitor website functionality, product pages, payment gateways, checkout flow, discount codes and customer experience.
* Identify and resolve listing, catalogue, order, payment, inventory and account\-health issues.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams and technology partners to resolve operational problems.
* Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns, offers and international market expansion.
* Study competitors, pricing, keywords, customer reviews and category trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Coordinate with content, design, advertising, inventory, finance, customer\-support and logistics teams.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights, action points and measurable outcomes.
* Recommend ways to increase sales, visibility, conversion, customer retention and profitability.


 What Does the Right Person Look Like?
 
 You may be a strong fit if you:
 


* Have 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in e\-commerce or marketplace management.
* Have worked with platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, WooCommerce, Walmart, eBay, Etsy or similar channels.
* Understand product listings, cataloguing, variants, pricing, inventory and order management.
* Have practical knowledge of marketplace advertising or e\-commerce performance marketing.
* Understand website merchandising, landing pages, checkout experience and conversion optimization.
* Can work comfortably with sales data, dashboards and performance reports.
* Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Can investigate operational problems and follow them through until they are resolved.
* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
* Can coordinate effectively with multiple internal teams and external partners.
* Think beyond completing tasks and actively identify opportunities for commercial growth.



 Experience with international marketplaces, cross\-border e\-commerce, D2C websites or international fulfilment will be preferred.
 


 Our Value SystemDisciplined Execution
 
 You turn plans into reliable action, respect timelines and close tasks without requiring repeated follow\-ups.
 


 Empowered Autonomy
 
 You are given the freedom to make decisions—and are expected to take responsibility for their outcomes.
 


 Growth Through Challenge
 
 You are willing to learn new platforms, solve unfamiliar problems and build competence through responsibility.
 


 Purposeful Alignment
 
 You understand that e\-commerce growth must create sustainable value for the client, the organisation and your own professional journey.
 


 Co\-creation of an Ecosystem for Deeper Interests
 
 We encourage you to contribute ideas, explore your strengths and develop expertise beyond the limits of a narrowly defined role.
 



 We also believe in open conversations, empathetic leadership, psychological safety and employee wellbeing. High standards and a supportive workplace can—and should—coexist.
 


 Where Can This Position Lead?
 
 A strong performer can grow into roles such as:
 


* Senior E\-commerce Executive
* Marketplace Manager
* D2C E\-commerce Manager
* International E\-commerce Manager
* E\-commerce Growth Strategist
* Head of E\-commerce



 Your growth will depend on the ownership you demonstrate, the systems you build and the measurable commercial results you create.
 


 Company Size \& Vibe Check
 
 We are a growing, hands\-on team—not a large company where responsibilities disappear between departments.
 



 You will work closely with decision\-makers, receive meaningful responsibility and see the direct impact of your work. Our environment is fast\-moving, ambitious, collaborative and execution\-focused. We take our commitments seriously while maintaining open communication and space for people to grow.
 


 Please Do Not Apply If
 * Your experience is limited to uploading products or processing orders.
* You have only theoretical knowledge and no hands\-on e\-commerce experience.
* You require continuous follow\-ups to complete routine responsibilities.
* You avoid accountability when a listing, campaign, order or website issue occurs.
* You only execute instructions and do not examine sales, conversion or profitability.
* You are uncomfortable working with data, reports or performance targets.
* You repeatedly escalate problems without first investigating possible solutions.
* You are unwilling to learn new marketplaces, tools or e\-commerce platforms.
* You are not comfortable working full\-time from our Gota, Ahmedabad office.
* You are looking only for a job title rather than an opportunity to take ownership and grow.


 Work Arrangement
 
 This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office position at Gota, Ahmedabad. We see working from the office as an opportunity to collaborate closely, learn faster and build stronger systems together.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Send your updated résumé along with brief answers to the following questions:
 


1. Which marketplaces and e\-commerce platforms have you personally managed?
2. Have you managed a Shopify, WooCommerce or another e\-commerce website?
3. What approximate monthly sales or advertising budget did you handle?
4. Describe one marketplace or website\-related problem you solved independently.
5. What measurable improvement did you achieve in sales, conversion, advertising performance or profitability?
6. What are your current CTC, expected CTC and earliest joining date?



 Please apply only if you are serious about building multi\-channel e\-commerce expertise and taking end\-to\-end ownership of performance.

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

 :
 
**Junior Professional Inventory Controller** 




**Junior Professional Inventory Controller:** 

 The Inventory Controller is responsible for overseeing all inventory control activities to minimize stockholding costs while maximizing component availability and data accuracy. The successful candidate will manage inbound raw materials (e.g., metals, plastics, pins), work\-in\-progress (WIP) elements, and finished connector assemblies, ensuring seamless synchronization between physical stock and the ERP system.
 




  





**MAIN DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**










 ·      
 
**Stock Auditing \& Reconciliation:** 

 Conduct routine physical stock counts, cyclical audits, and perpetual inventory checks. Reconcile physical warehouse findings against the ERP system (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or customized MRP software).
 




  






 ·      
 
**Variance Investigation:** 

 Identify, report, and troubleshoot any discrepancies, stock shortages, surpluses, damaged, or slow\-moving items.
 




  






 ·      
 
**Material issue control to shopfloor based on the production order** 

 or work order requirement and ensure workorder reconciliation.
 




  






 ·      
 
**Material Flow Control:** 

 Monitor logistics processes including inbound vendor shipments, raw material issuance to the production floor, inter\-branch transfers, and finished good dispatch.
 




  






 ·      
 
**Optimizing Reorder Points:** 

 Collaborate with procurement and planning teams to establish optimum minimum/maximum stock levels and reorder thresholds, preventing material bottlenecks or costly overstocking.
 




  






 ·      
 
**Obsolete Stock Management:** 

 Identify and flag redundant, slow\-moving, or obsolete electronic parts to clear up working capital and physical space.
 




  






 ·      
 
**Reporting:** 

 Generate detailed analytics on inventory health, warehouse space utilization, order patterns, turn rates, and financial asset reporting for the Operations Manager.
 




  






 ·      Review of material Planning accuracy based on the production plan/forecast released by the planning team.
 




  






 ·      Total Spend review of Freight charges for the Import and Export other than EXW.
 




  





  





**Required Qualifications**

title: Director Principal SRE
description:
**Principle SRE (Site Reliability Engineering)**
**Role Overview**
 The Principal Site Reliability Engineer will be a senior technical expert responsible for driving
 **end\-to\-end resilience, reliability, and scalability** 
 across our mission\-critical payments platform. This role focuses on
 **front\-to\-back payment flows** 
 , ensuring systems are designed for
 **fault tolerance, observability, and operational excellence** 
 .
   

  

 You will perform deep technical reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and define patterns for
 **resiliency by design** 
 . As a hands\-on engineer, you will collaborate with development and production support teams, advocate
 **chaos engineering** 
 , and build a culture of
 **designing for failure** 
 . This position requires strong technical breadth across
 **infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, and integrations** 
 , combined with expertise in modern reliability engineering practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Reliability Engineering Leadership:
+ Drive strategies to improve reliability, maintainability, and scalability across payment flows and platform components.

* Architecture \& Design Reviews:
+ Conduct deep technical assessments of system architectures, identifying risks and recommending improvements for fault tolerance and disaster recovery.

* Incident Management \& Root Cause Analysis:
+ Act as a senior escalation point for production incidents, lead RCA, and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.

* Resiliency by Design:
+ Define and enforce reliability patterns, frameworks, and best practices; ensure adoption across engineering teams.

* Chaos Engineering \& Failure Testing:
+ Advocate and implement chaos engineering principles to validate system resilience under real\-world failure scenarios.

* Observability \& Monitoring:
+ Design and implement full\-stack observability solutions, including metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting.

* Automation \& Tooling:
+ Develop automation for failover, capacity management, and self\-healing mechanisms to reduce operational risk.

* Collaboration:
+ Partner with development, infrastructure, and production support teams to embed reliability into the SDLC.

* Continuous Improvement:
+ Analyze service risk assessments and production incidents to identify systemic issues and drive long\-term improvements.

* Culture Building:
+ Promote operational excellence and a mindset of designing for failure across all engineering teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Technical Expertise:
+ 12\+ years in software engineering or infrastructure roles, with at least 5 years focused on reliability engineering or SRE.
+ Proven experience building and operating fault\-tolerant, highly available systems at scale.

* Architecture \& Design:
+ Strong knowledge of distributed systems, resiliency patterns (circuit breakers, retries, failover), and disaster recovery strategies.

* Technical Breadth:
+ Expertise across infrastructure (compute, storage, networking), application architecture, databases, and integration patterns.

* Problem\-Solving:
+ Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed systems and perform deep root cause analysis.

* Collaboration \& Influence:
+ Skilled at working with development, operations, and architecture teams to embed reliability into design and delivery.


**Purpose of the role**
 To drive technical excellence and innovation by leading the design and implementation of robust software solutions, providing mentorship to engineering teams, fostering cross\-functional collaboration, and contributing to strategic planning to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions aligned with business objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of guidance and expertise to engineering teams to ensure alignment with best practices and foster a culture of technical excellence.
* Contribution to strategic planning by aligning technical decisions with business goals, anticipating future technology trends, and providing insights to optimize product roadmaps.
* Design and implementation of complex, scalable, and maintainable software solutions, considering long\-term viability and business objectives.
* Mentoring and coaching to junior and mid\-level engineers to foster professional growth and knowledge sharing, elevating the overall skillset and capabilities of the organization.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Innovation within the organization by identifying and incorporating new technologies, methodologies, and industry practices into the engineering process.


**Director Expectations**
* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub\-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub\-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up\-to\-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.


 All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Lead Devops Engineer
description:

 Pune, India

 60% hands\-on engineering \| 40% team leadership

* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are** 
  

  

 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a hands\-on Lead DevOps Engineer to lead the design, delivery, and operation of secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 This role combines approximately 60% individual contribution with 40% team leadership and management. You will remain actively involved in architecture, automation, implementation, troubleshooting, and operational support while mentoring engineers, setting technical standards, and coordinating the team's delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has deep, practical expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and working knowledge of other major cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure and GCP
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands\-on Engineering \- 60%**
* Design and implement secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available cloud and hybrid environments, primarily on AWS.
* Own and evolve AWS architecture across networking, compute, storage, identity, security, containers, and managed services.
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, Argo CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
* Implement GitOps practices and automate application deployment, configuration, testing, and release processes.

* Develop automation and operational tooling using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Implement comprehensive observability using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, centralised logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and service\-level indicators.

* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, performance, and production reliability issues.
* Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous service improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, developer productivity, performance, and cloud cost efficiency.


**Leadership and Management \- 40%**

* Establish and maintain engineering standards for cloud architecture, automation, CI/CD, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Plan and prioritise the team's work in partnership with engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical direction while balancing delivery timelines, operational risk, scalability, security, and cost.
* Review architectural proposals, infrastructure code, automation, and operational processes.
* Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, documentation, continuous improvement, and blameless learning.
* Coordinate incident response and ensure corrective actions are documented, prioritised, and completed.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, career development, and capability planning.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Champion DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering, and cloud governance practices across the organisation.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**

* Strong experience with CI/CD platforms, preferably GitLab CI, plus familiarity with Argo CD, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Strong practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS in production environments.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, DNS, load balancing, identity and access management, secrets management, and security controls.
* Experience designing highly available systems and implementing backup, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity strategies.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001 and PCI DSS compliance audits, with hands\-on expertise in implementing CIS Benchmarks and supporting penetration testing and remediation activities.

**Desired**

title: Principal SDET
description:
We're looking for a
 **Principal SDET Engineer** 
 to join our Development team in Noida.
 



  





 Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting\-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize continuous professional growth through workshops, certifications, and hands\-on learning opportunities. You will serve as a technical authority within our engineering organization, driving quality strategy, automation excellence, and engineering best practices. This is a principal\-level individual contributor role that combines hands\-on technical expertise with leadership through influence, mentorship, and collaboration.
 



 You will partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to ensure quality is built into every stage of the software development lifecycle. Success in this role means enabling teams to deliver reliable, scalable, high\-performing products that consistently earn customer trust.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Drive Quality Engineering Strategy
 


* Own and drive the end\-to\-end test automation strategy across Web, API, and Mobile platforms.
* Establish and champion a clear quality vision across products and engineering teams.
* Proactively identify functional risks, integration gaps, performance bottlenecks, and automation coverage gaps.



 Design \& Build Scalable Automation Frameworks
 


* Design, build, and maintain robust automation frameworks using Playwright and modern automation practices.
* Establish automation standards for test architecture, reusability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Define best practices for test design patterns, data management, environment readiness, and execution strategies.



 Automate Web, API \& Mobile Testing
 


* Build and maintain comprehensive automation suites covering Web, API, and Mobile applications.
* Implement API contract, integration, and end\-to\-end testing strategies.
* Develop mobile automation solutions using Appium across real devices and emulators/simulators.



 Performance \& Reliability Engineering
 


* Design and execute performance, load, stress, and scalability testing using tools such as k6 and JMeter.
* Analyze performance trends and identify system bottlenecks before they impact customers.
* Ensure applications meet reliability, scalability, and availability standards.



 CI/CD \& Release Quality
 


* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Define and maintain quality gates, deployment validation processes, and release readiness criteria.
* Build automated reporting mechanisms that provide actionable quality insights.



 Lead Through Influence \& Mentorship
 


* Champion a shift\-left quality culture across engineering teams.
* Mentor developers and engineers on testing principles, testability, automation best practices, and observability.
* Influence product and technical design decisions by advocating for quality, reliability, and scalability from the earliest stages of development.



 Drive AI\-Powered Testing Innovation
 


* Evaluate and adopt AI\-assisted testing tools and workflows.
* Leverage AI to accelerate test creation, maintenance, failure analysis, and automation coverage.
* Drive innovation initiatives that improve testing efficiency and product quality.



 Quality Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Establish and monitor quality KPIs including coverage, defect escape rates, flakiness, pipeline reliability, and release quality.
* Use data\-driven insights to continuously improve testing effectiveness and engineering processes.
* Provide strategic recommendations to improve product quality and delivery speed.



  





**Your Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's (B.E./B.Tech.) or Master's (MCA) degree in Computer Science or a related field.



  





**Skill Sets / Experience We Require** 



* 8–11 years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, or Quality Engineering roles.
* Proven experience as a senior or principal\-level individual contributor driving automation and quality strategy.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript (TypeScript is a plus).
* Deep hands\-on expertise with Playwright as a primary automation framework.
* Extensive experience in Web, API, and Mobile automation testing.
* Strong experience designing and building scalable automation frameworks from scratch.
* Mobile automation expertise using Appium across real devices and emulators/simulators.
* Hands\-on experience with performance testing tools such as k6 or JMeter.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD implementation using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Experience working with Docker, containerized environments, and DevOps practices.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience leveraging AI\-driven testing tools and automation solutions.
* Strong understanding of test architecture, parallel execution, reporting, quality gates, and automation scalability.
* Exceptional debugging, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Strong systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to identify quality, performance, and reliability risks.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.
* Experience working within Agile development environments and cross\-functional teams.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud\-native testing environments.
* Knowledge of security testing tools and best practices.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms.
* Familiarity with contract testing and service virtualization.
* Contributions to quality engineering communities, open\-source projects, or technical publications.



  





**What You'll Get in Return** 




 Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic and innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops, certifications, and leadership opportunities while enjoying a flexible work\-life balance.
 



 Our collaborative culture encourages creativity, ownership, and continuous learning. You'll work on impactful projects across diverse industries while helping shape the future of quality engineering at Taazaa. We offer clear career advancement opportunities, comprehensive health benefits, and engaging team\-building initiatives.
 



  





**Who We Are** 




 Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.
 



 Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity.

title: Data & Records Business Partner AVP
description:
Step into the role of Data \& Records Business Partner AVP at Barclays, where you'll provide first\-class support by conducting in\-depth due diligence, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and safeguarding our clients and organization with expertise and care.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
   

  

  

* Maintain compliance with Group Data \& Record Management Standards (GDMS) by setting the agenda and driving the BU/Fn Data Council effectively as per the GDMS, covering various aspect of Data \& Record Management.
* Drive the Critical Data Element (CDE) Identification owing to functional changes in the concerned system applications and database, addition of new In Scope report, downstream request or any other self identified event.
* Build \& Maintain Data Lineages reflecting end to end data flow right from the data originating source system till Output report while capturing in between data stores, applications, EUDAs and any Manual Hands In accordingly.
* Drive the DQ Control identification \& mapping for respective CDEs for ensuring Completeness, Accuracy \& Timeliness of the data.
* DQ Issue management through Active tracking and remediation of data quality issues, DQ metrics etc.
* Drive domain’s authoritative data sources, lineage, metadata, scope validation, record management and attestation activities on behalf of Data Domain owner.
* Ensuring Compliance for MI Reporting as per the Risk Reporting Standard (RRS) and Non Financial Regulatory Reporting Standard (NFRR) where applicable.
* Support delivery of tactical and strategic solution in collaboration with Technology Transformation team, Technology and Controls Business Partner teams.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and identify automation opportunities.
* Driving a consistent approach for Reporting and management of Data \& Records across the business in BaU and due to any impacts arising from changes to RRS / GDMS relevant policies and standards.
* Lead engagement with Chief Data Office and Tech partners.


**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**
* Experience in Data Management, Data Governance including records management. Ability to review business processes from data lens and identify critical upstream and downstream components especially in financial services organisation.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality \& Controls, Data Lineage and Reference Data/Metadata Management including relevant policies and frameworks.
* Ability to analyse, interpret and work robustly with stakeholders to to identify data quality issues and develop proposed solutions.
* Excellent problem solving skill sets, think strategically and convey an understanding of big picture to senior management.
* A clear understanding of the elements of an effective control environment, enterprise risk management framework, operational risk or other principal risk frameworks.
* Experience of managing stakeholders directly \& indirectly and across geographies \& cultures.
* Strong understanding and practical exposure to application of BCBS 239 principles and related frameworks.
* Commercially astute, demonstrates a consultative, yet pragmatic approach with integrity to solving issues, focusing on areas of significance and value to the business.
* A strong understanding of Risk and Control environment/control frameworks/op risk, including understanding of second and third line functions and impact across people, process and technology.


**Some Other Desired Skills Include**
* Graduate in any discipline.
* Effective communication and presentation skills.
* Experience in Data Management/ Data Governance/ Data Quality Controls, Governance, Reporting and Risk Management preferably in a financial services organisation.
* Proficient in MS Office – PPT, Excel, Word \& Visio.
* Comprehensive understanding of Risk, Governance and Control Frameworks and Processes.
* Understanding of Data Management Principles and Data Governance including BCBS 239\.
* Ability to analyse, interpret and work robustly with others to identify issues and develop proposed solutions.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Noida.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To enable effective data governance, risk management, and compliance within the bank, acting as a liaison between business units and the Data \& Records Management (DRM) function, translating business needs into actionable strategies and ensuring efficient implementation of DRM.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Partnership with the local business unit to ensure successful implementation of data \& records governance frameworks as appropriate to the needs of the business unit.
* Provision of guidance and support on records classification, retention, storage, retrieval and disposal to business units.
* Monitoring local data quality and records metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Identification of opportunities for data improvement and optimisation.
* Partnership with the relevant business unit to support their data priorities and ensure appropriate decisions related to data \& records are embedded in their BAU decision making and change programs.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior IT Security Analyst
description:
About the Role:
   

  

 As a Senior IT Security Analyst, you will engage in advanced cybersecurity tasks with a high level of autonomy. Your contributions will be crucial for maintaining a secure IT environment and anticipating potential threats. You'll exercise thorough security measures and guide less experienced team members.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support vulnerability management activities across cloud, infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, and application environments.
* Review and analyze findings from security tools such as CSPM, vulnerability scanners, container security tools, and application security platforms.
* Work with infrastructure, cloud, application, and DevOps teams to drive remediation of identified security issues.
* Support cloud security posture management across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Manage EDR and XDR platforms: Deploy, configure, and optimize security tools to monitor endpoints, integrate cross\-layered telemetry (cloud, network, and email), and eliminate security silos.
* Detect and respond to threats: Analyze advanced multi\-vector alerts, hunt for hidden attackers, and orchestrate automated playbooks to rapidly isolate compromised systems and minimize response times.
* Review cloud misconfigurations, exposed resources, identity risks, network security gaps, and compliance issues.
* Assist in container and Kubernetes security reviews, including image vulnerabilities, runtime exposure, cluster configuration, and workload security.
* Support vulnerability prioritization based on severity, exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Help maintain dashboards, reports, trackers, and metrics for vulnerability remediation and security posture.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive security tasks, reporting, data enrichment, and remediation workflows.
* Support basic application security and shift\-left activities, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency risks, and secure development awareness.
* Assist with basic forensic analysis, incident triage, log review, and evidence collection when required.
* Contribute to emerging AI security initiatives, including understanding risks around AI agents, connectors, cloud\-hosted AI workloads, data exposure, and infrastructure security.
* Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to track remediation progress, exceptions, risk acceptance, and closure.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 5–6 years of experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, cloud security, infrastructure security, or related domains.
* Good understanding of cloud security concepts across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Hands\-on or working knowledge of CSPM tools such as Orca, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Defender for Cloud, Lacework, or similar.
* Understanding of vulnerability management processes, including detection, prioritization, remediation tracking, SLA monitoring, and reporting.
* Familiarity with vulnerability scanners such as Rapid7, Qualys, Tenable, or similar.
* Good understanding of infrastructure security, including servers, operating systems, patching, network exposure, identity, and access controls.
* Basic understanding of containers and Kubernetes security, including container images, registries, clusters, namespaces, workloads, secrets, and runtime risks.
* Basic understanding of application security and shift\-left practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, CI/CD security, and secure coding concepts.
* Understanding of AI security concepts such as AI agents, connectors, data access, prompt injection, excessive permissions, and secure integration with enterprise tools.
* Ability to analyze security findings and translate them into clear remediation actions.
* Experience working with dashboards, Excel, Power BI, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar reporting and tracking tools.
* Basic scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, KQL, SQL, or APIs.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with cloud, infrastructure, application, DevOps, and leadership teams.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Exposure to Kubernetes security tools, container scanning, runtime security, or CNAPP platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Jira, Power BI, Snowflake, or similar enterprise reporting platforms.

* Experience with automation of vulnerability reporting, data cleanup, ticket enrichment, or remediation workflows.
* Exposure to AI security, GenAI governance, MCP/connectors, agentic workflows, or AI infrastructure security.
