title: Senior Principal SRE Engineering
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

About the technology organization
  
  

Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission\-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high\-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non\-negotiable.
  
Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability\-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise.
  
  

About the Team
  
  

Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
  
The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world\-class technology capabilities and platforms.
  
Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
  
The Reliability Engineering team is the engineering\-first function that owns the stability, observability, and operational quality of a multi\-application production estate. It operates in close partnership with the engineering team that builds the agentic automation platform, and is in active transition from human\-executed operations to engineering\-led, agent\-assisted reliability.
  
  

Role summary
  
  

As the Senior Principal SRE Engineering Lead, you are the senior\-most engineering authority for the reliability of the supported production estate. You own the bar for what reliable means in this organization: service\-level objectives, error\-budget governance, observability standards, and the engineering practices that protect both production and the team's engineering time.
  
This role is the judgment layer between an agent's recommendation and a production change. You combine engineering rigor with operational pragmatism, and you decide which patterns surfaced from production warrant durable engineering investment. You hold the SRE engineering bar within the function — the cross\-pillar reference architecture is owned by the Senior Architect, but the practice, standards, and engineering judgment of reliability at this site are yours.
  
You are a senior individual contributor. You do not manage people. You partner with the Reliability Leader, the Senior Principal Tech Shift Lead in the same pillar, the Senior Architect, and the senior engineering principals in the agentic automation team. Success is measured by organizational impact, sustained reliability outcomes, and the ability to scale reliability through systems and people, not heroics.
  
  

What you'll be doing
  
  

1\) Reliability strategy and SLO governance
  
  

* Define service\-level objectives and indicators across the supported production estate, tiered by application risk and business impact.
* Govern error\-budget burn: when to slow change, when to invest in durable fixes, when to accept the budget.
* Drive the adoption of reliability reporting and the disciplined operating cadence that makes SLOs real, not decorative.
* Hold the SLO and error\-budget conversation with product and application owners — including the conversation about what their service needs to change to meet the bar.


2\) Engineering standards, observability, and self\-healing
  
  

* Establish observability and instrumentation standards as the contract every supported application must meet — and hold the line on them.
* Set the bar for infrastructure\-as\-code, continuous\-delivery hardening, and deployment safety across the supported estate.
* Define the engineering work that flows from incidents and root\-cause analyses into durable production change, and the architectural patterns (self\-healing runbooks, graceful degradation, circuit breakers) that reduce repeat failure.


3\) Incident learning, durable fixes, and partnership with agentic automation
  
  

* Drive blameless postmortem culture; ensure root\-cause analyses produce engineering work, not just narrative.
* Govern which patterns from production warrant durable engineering investment, against the error\-budget regime.
* Partner with the production operations team in the same pillar on which patterns from the field warrant engineering attention; partner with the agentic automation engineering team on which fixes become safe agent\-assisted remediations, and on the confidence thresholds, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that make those remediations safe in production.
* Lead high\-severity incident response as incident commander when escalation reaches this seat, and coach the team to handle the rest.


4\) Compliance, security, and regulated\-environment readiness
  
  

* Ensure reliability practices comply with Lilly standards and applicable regulatory requirements, and engineer them so that audit evidence falls out of normal operation.
* Promote secure operational practices, auditability, and validated\-environment\-friendly engineering as part of the standards the team holds.
* Act as a trusted technical leader in regulated and validated environments.


5\) Technical leadership and talent development
  
  

* Set the engineering bar through standards, expectations, and role modeling.
* Mentor senior reliability engineers in the pillar; build the bench for sustained team growth and develop the next layer of principal engineers.
* Influence engineering, product, and platform leaders through credibility and outcomes rather than authority.
* Contribute to the evolution of enterprise\-wide reliability practices in partnership with the Senior Architect and peer technical leaders.


How you will succeed
  
  

At the senior\-most engineering individual\-contributor level for reliability, success is defined by breadth of impact and sustained outcomes:
  
  

* Be recognized as the senior reliability authority for your area.
* Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements such as: reduced major incidents, fewer recurring failures, improved time\-to\-recovery, and a credible error\-budget regime.
* Influence decisions across multiple teams and leaders through expertise and trust.
* Scale reliability through systems, standards, and people, not heroics.


What you should bring
  
  

Required
  
  

* 14\+ years of progressive engineering experience, with at least 6 years as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, or equivalent, including a tour as the senior\-most reliability engineer for a multi\-application production estate — not a single product.
* Production reliability experience in a regulated or audited environment (GxP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent), including familiarity with change\-control discipline, audit evidence, and validated\-system constraints.
* Hands\-on ownership of an SLO/SLI framework and error\-budget policy across a multi\-application estate, including defining SLIs, negotiating SLOs with product owners, and operationalizing burn\-rate alerting and error\-budget governance.
* Deep, hands\-on fluency across the SRE technical stack: observability and OpenTelemetry (Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, or Grafana/Prometheus); infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); CI/CD pipeline hardening and progressive delivery; Kubernetes and container platforms; and at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Track record of leading high\-severity incident response as incident commander, running blameless postmortems, and converting findings into durable engineering work — measured by reduced recurrence rather than narrative quality.
* Demonstrated technical leadership at scale: mentoring senior ICs, influencing engineering and product leaders without org\-chart authority, and writing the standards and engineering documents that set the bar for a discipline.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering field.


Preferred
  
  

* Hands\-on experience designing self\-healing automation and running chaos engineering or resilience\-testing programs (AWS Fault Injection Service, Gremlin, LitmusChaos, or equivalent) tied to measurable reliability gains.
* Deep AWS fluency across reliability\-relevant services (EKS, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, X\-Ray, Systems Manager, Route 53\), and familiarity with AWS Well\-Architected Reliability Pillar.
* Experience with AIOps or agent\-assisted operations, including designing the guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that make automated remediation safe in production.
* Track record of saying no to a deploy because the error budget was burned, and making the call stick.
* Prior experience building a reliability practice from a small founding team.
* Experience operating in pharma, healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.


Leadership expectations
  
  

* Acts as the judgment layer between aspiration and engineering reality.
* Combines engineering rigor with operational pragmatism, and knows when each is the right answer.
* Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org\-chart authority.
* Comfortable telling a product owner that their application does not meet the reliability bar yet, and showing them how to get there.
* Treats mentorship of senior reliability engineers as a first\-class outcome of the role.


Additional information
  
  

Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non\-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non\-standard hours where applicable.
  
This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.
  
  

At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.
  
  

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  

Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

You work within the standards the Senior Principal SRE Engineer sets — SLOs, error budgets, observability — and you're the one who encodes them into working automation and documented procedure.
  
This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role focused on execution and codification rather than cross\-estate reliability strategy. You decide, in partnership with the Senior Principal SRE Engineer, which recurring patterns warrant a self\-healing investment versus a documented manual runbook, and you build whichever is right.
  
You are an individual contributor. You do not manage people. You partner daily with the Senior Principal SRE Engineer, the agentic automation engineering team, and Operations on validating outcomes. Success is measured by self\-healing coverage, runbooks authored and adopted, reduced recurrence of known failure modes, and the safety record of every automation you sign off.
  
  

What you'll be doing
  
  

1\) Self\-healing automation \& resilience patterns
  
  

* Design and build self\-healing automation — circuit breakers, graceful degradation, automated remediation — for the failure modes that recur most across the estate.
* Run resilience or chaos testing to validate that self\-healing patterns behave correctly before they're trusted in production.
* Continuously expand self\-healing coverage as new failure modes are identified and proven safe to automate.
* Partner with the Senior Principal SRE Engineer on which failure modes justify self\-healing investment versus a documented manual runbook.


2\) Runbook authorship \& validation
  
  

* Author and validate the remediation runbooks for the production estate: safe execution order, rollback steps, and exception handling for every documented fix.
* Keep the runbook library current as systems, dependencies, and failure modes evolve, retiring runbooks that no longer apply.
* Define and apply the graduation criteria that let a runbook move from human\-executed to agent\-assisted to autonomous.


3\) RCA to durable fix
  
  

* Lead or contribute to root\-cause analysis for significant incidents, and drive the blameless postmortem process to a durable engineering fix — not just a narrative.
* Convert recurring incident patterns into codified runbooks and, where appropriate, self\-healing automation.
* Track fix effectiveness against recurrence, and escalate to the Senior Principal SRE Engineer when a fix needs broader engineering investment.
* Participate in high\-severity incident response, including acting as incident commander for escalations within your area.


4\) Partnership with agentic automation \& operations
  
  

* Partner with the Agentic Automation Engineering team on which fixes are safe to hand off as agent\-assisted remediations, and on the confidence thresholds and human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that keep them safe.
* Sign off on agent graduation criteria (accuracy over volume, zero P1/P2 caused) before an automation moves to a higher autonomy tier.
* Partner with Operations on outcome validation, feeding what's learned back into the runbook library and self\-healing patterns.


5\) Incident response \& regulated\-environment practice
  
  

* Ensure runbooks and self\-healing automation meet Lilly's change\-control, audit, and validated\-environment standards.
* Document procedures so that audit evidence falls out of normal operation, not a special exercise.
* Mentor other reliability and automation engineers on runbook quality and self\-healing design.
* Contribute proven patterns back to the broader reliability practice, in partnership with the Senior Principal SRE Engineer and Senior Architect.


How you will succeed
  
  

At the principal engineering level for reliability, success is defined by the durability and safety of what you build:
  
  

* Be recognized as the engineer who turns incidents into durable fixes, not repeat pages.
* Demonstrate measurable growth in self\-healing coverage and runbook adoption, with falling recurrence of known failure modes.
* Maintain a clean safety record: automations you sign off don't cause P1/P2 incidents.
* Build runbooks and automation that make good practice the default, not a personal habit.


What you should bring
  
  

Required
  
  

* 10\+ years of progressive engineering experience, with meaningful time as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, or equivalent, including hands\-on ownership of self\-healing automation or runbook\-driven remediation for a multi\-application production estate.
* Production reliability experience in a regulated or audited environment (GxP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent), including familiarity with change\-control discipline, audit evidence, and validated\-system constraints.
* Hands\-on experience authoring and validating runbooks: safe execution order, rollback steps, and exception handling for real remediation procedures.
* Deep, hands\-on fluency across the SRE technical stack: observability (Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, or Grafana/Prometheus); infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); CI/CD pipeline hardening; Kubernetes and container platforms; and at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Practical experience designing self\-healing patterns (circuit breakers, graceful degradation, automated remediation) and validating them before they're trusted in production.
* Track record of contributing meaningfully to root\-cause analysis and blameless postmortems, converting findings into durable engineering fixes measured by reduced recurrence rather than narrative quality.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering field.


Preferred
  
  

* Hands\-on experience designing self\-healing automation and running chaos engineering or resilience\-testing programs (AWS Fault Injection Service, Gremlin, LitmusChaos, or equivalent) tied to measurable reliability gains.
* Deep AWS fluency across reliability\-relevant services (EKS, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, X\-Ray, Systems Manager, Route 53\), and familiarity with AWS Well\-Architected Reliability Pillar.
* Experience with AIOps or agent\-assisted operations, including designing the guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that make automated remediation safe in production.
* Experience defining or signing off on autonomy/graduation criteria for automation moving toward self\-sufficiency.
* Prior experience building or scaling a runbook library across multiple applications or teams.
* Experience operating in pharma, healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.


Leadership expectations
  
  

* Treats every RCA as unfinished until it produces a durable fix, not just a narrative.
* Combines engineering rigor with operational pragmatism in deciding what gets automated and what stays manual.
* Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org\-chart authority.
* Comfortable telling a team that a fix isn't ready for autonomy yet, and showing them what's missing.
* Treats runbook quality and knowledge\-sharing as a first\-class outcome, not an afterthought.


Additional information
  
  

Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non\-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non\-standard hours where applicable.
  
This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.
  
  

At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. **Key Responsibility**




 As a Program Manager, you will be a key member of a newly formed team, responsible for

* **Performance Monitoring** 
 : Tracking project performance in real time, analyzing key metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams. metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams.
* **Continuous Improvement** 
 : Implementing best practices and lessons learned to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of project delivery and advancing operational prowess through collaboration with Services leadership.
* **Customer Success**

**Qualifications**

* You have a strong understanding of AI technologies, particularly in deploying conversational AI and automation solutions for large enterprises.

* You have a deep understanding of consumer customer service best practices and strategies.

* You have proven experience building project delivery methodologies and processes.

**What Success Looks Like in 3–6 Months**




  

  

 Within your first 3\-6 months, you will have successfully demonstrated your impact by:
   

  





  

  




* **Becoming an Expert** 
 : You’ll be proficient with TheLoops’s platform and will have a deep understanding of the common challenges our customers face.
* **Leading Implementations** 
 : You will have autonomously managed and completed at least one high\-stakes customer implementation from start to finish. This includes leading discovery, architecting the solution, configuring the platform, and successfully migrating data.
* **Driving Customer Value** 
 : You will have received positive feedback from customers, validating that you’ve not only met their technical requirements but have also empowered their teams and improved their operational efficiency.
* **Strengthening Team Collaboration** 
 : You will have established strong working relationships with the sales, engineering, and product teams, providing valuable feedback from the field to help improve our product and processes.



 Why Join Us
   

  




* Work on cutting\-edge AI solutions that have real business impact
* Be part of a fast\-growing team shaping how enterprises deploy AI at scale

Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Asst Project Manager
description:

  Savira Systek
 



**Location:** 
  Pune, Maharashtra

  Projects / Engineering
 



**Position:** 
  Project Manager
 



**Reporting To:** 
  Director / Head of Projects

  8–15 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-Time
 


 1\. About Savira Systek
 
 Savira Systek is a provider of 
 **industrial safety solutions, material handling systems, robotics, automation, cranes, AGVs/AMRs, and engineered industrial solutions** 
 . We deliver end\-to\-end solutions covering engineering, supply, installation, commissioning, integration, and customer support.
 


 2\. Job Purpose
 
 The Project Manager will be responsible for 
 **end\-to\-end execution of industrial projects** 
 , ensuring timely delivery, technical compliance, cost control, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
 



 The role requires strong coordination between 
 **customers, sales, engineering, suppliers, manufacturing partners, installation teams, and service teams** 
  to successfully execute projects from order receipt through commissioning and handover.
 


 3\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning \& Execution
 * Take complete ownership of assigned projects from 
 **PO/order receipt to successful commissioning and handover** 
 .
* Prepare detailed project execution plans, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.
* Define project deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, and critical path activities.
* Monitor project progress against agreed schedules and take corrective action when required.
* Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, installation, commissioning, and documentation activities.

 **time, cost, quality, and scope** 
 .


 B. Customer Coordination
 * Act as the primary project contact for customers during project execution.
* Conduct project kick\-off meetings and regular progress\-review meetings.

* Coordinate site surveys, technical discussions, inspections, installation, trials, and final acceptance.
* Prepare and submit project progress reports to customers.
* Manage customer expectations and resolve project\-related issues professionally.


 C. Engineering \& Technical Coordination
 * Coordinate with engineering teams for 
 **GA drawings, layouts, electrical drawings, mechanical designs, control architecture, safety systems, and technical documentation** 
 .
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure compliance with approved specifications.
* Coordinate design changes and obtain necessary customer approvals.
* Identify technical risks, interface issues, and potential execution challenges at an early stage.
* Support engineering teams in developing practical and cost\-effective solutions.


 D. Procurement \& Vendor Management

* Track purchase orders, manufacturing status, inspections, dispatches, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor supplier performance and address delays or quality issues.
* Coordinate with international partners, OEMs, and technology suppliers wherever required.
* Ensure materials and equipment received are as per approved specifications.


 E. Site Installation \& Commissioning
 * Plan and coordinate site installation, erection, integration, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Mobilize appropriate manpower, tools, equipment, and subcontractors.
* Ensure installation activities are carried out according to approved drawings and safety procedures.
* Coordinate FAT, SAT, trial runs, performance testing, and customer acceptance.
* Ensure all punch points are closed before project handover.


 F. Project Cost \& Commercial Control
 * Monitor project costs against approved budgets.
* Track project profitability, additional costs, variations, and scope changes.
* Identify potential cost overruns and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with the commercial/accounts team for 
 **billing milestones, payment follow\-up, retention, and final settlement** 
 .
* Ensure additional customer requirements are properly documented and commercially evaluated before execution.


 G. Quality, Safety \& Compliance
 * Ensure project execution complies with applicable 
 **industrial safety standards, customer specifications, statutory requirements, and OEM guidelines** 
 .
* Coordinate quality inspections and documentation.
* Ensure proper installation and commissioning records are maintained.
* Promote safe working practices at customer sites.
* Ensure project teams and subcontractors follow required EHS procedures.


 H. Documentation \& Handover
 * Ensure timely preparation and submission of:
* Project execution documents
* GA/layout drawings
* Electrical/control documentation
* Test reports
* Inspection reports
* FAT/SAT documents
* Operation \& maintenance manuals
* Warranty documents
* Training records
* As\-built drawings
* Final project handover documents
* Obtain customer sign\-off and formally close projects.


 4\. Project Scope
 
 The candidate may be responsible for projects involving:
 


* Industrial automation and robotics
* AGVs / AMRs and automated material handling
* Automated storage and retrieval systems
* EOT cranes and special\-purpose cranes
* Material handling equipment
* Industrial safety barriers and pedestrian protection
* Forklift and MHE safety systems
* Dock safety and vehicle safety systems
* Blind\-spot detection and traffic management systems
* Smart wheel chock and vehicle restraint systems
* Safety lighting and warning systems
* Customized lifting and ergonomic handling solutions
* Industry 4\.0 / IoT\-enabled solutions
* Integration of multiple safety and automation systems


 5\. Project Management Responsibilities
 
 The Project Manager is expected to maintain and regularly update:
 


* Master project schedule
* Project tracker
* Procurement tracker
* Engineering status
* Vendor status
* Site readiness status
* Installation \& commissioning plan
* Risk and issue register
* Project cost tracker
* Customer action\-point tracker
* Punch\-point closure tracker
* Project completion and handover status


 6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * On\-time project completion
* Project gross margin / profitability
* Engineering and procurement schedule adherence
* Installation and commissioning efficiency
* Customer satisfaction
* Reduction in project delays
* Effective management of scope changes
* Timely billing and payment milestones
* Quality and punch\-point closure
* Safety performance during project execution
* Successful project handover with complete documentation


 7\. Required Qualifications
 
**Education:** 



* Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, or related engineering discipline.
* PMP / equivalent project\-management certification will be an advantage.



**Experience:** 



* 8–15 years of relevant experience in industrial project execution.
* Experience in automation, robotics, material handling, cranes, industrial safety, or machine integration is preferred.
* Experience handling multiple projects simultaneously is desirable.


 8\. Technical \& Professional Skills
 * Strong project planning and execution skills
* Good understanding of mechanical and electrical systems
* Knowledge of automation, PLC, VFD, sensors, safety systems, and industrial equipment
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings and layouts
* Vendor and subcontractor management
* Cost and commercial awareness
* Strong documentation skills
* MS Excel and MS Project / Primavera or equivalent
* Good communication and negotiation skills
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Willingness to travel extensively to customer sites across India


 9\. Personal Attributes
 * Ownership\-oriented and accountable
* Customer\-focused
* Proactive and solution\-oriented
* Strong coordination and leadership skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities
* Strong follow\-up and execution discipline
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently as well as lead cross\-functional teams

**“To ensure every Savira Systek project is executed safely, professionally, profitably, and on time—delivering the promised technical solution and a high\-quality customer experience from order to successful handover.”**

**Company Description** 
 Namdeo Umaji Agritech (India) Pvt. Ltd., established in 1885, is India’s oldest vegetable seeds company and a longstanding contributor to national agriculture. Operating under the “Pyramid Seeds” brand, the company offers hybrid, open\-pollinated, flower, and herb seeds known for their high quality and healthy yields. All seeds undergo rigorous quality checks, with streamlined production and processing that support its position as a leading manufacturer and exporter of premium seeds. The organization is committed to supporting farmers’ productivity and success across India. Guided by the ethos “Seeding with trust, harvesting with smile,” the company focuses on reliability, quality, and long\-term partnerships in agriculture.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Strawberry Project Manager will oversee end\-to\-end management of strawberry cultivation and related projects, ensuring timely planning, execution, and delivery in alignment with company quality standards. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Haveli and involves coordinating with farmers, internal agronomy teams, and external partners to manage sowing schedules, input supply, field operations, and harvest planning. The individual will monitor project progress, track timelines, manage risks, and ensure that inspection, quality control, and logistical activities are efficiently handled. Daily responsibilities include supervising expediting activities for seeds and materials, overseeing field inspections, managing logistics for distribution, and maintaining accurate documentation and reporting. The role also involves continuous process improvement, stakeholder communication, and alignment of project outcomes with business and customer requirements.

* Logistics Management skills to plan and manage transportation, storage, and distribution activities for strawberry projects.
* Experience in agriculture or horticulture, ideally in fruit or vegetable crop management, is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in reporting.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate with farmers, technical teams, and management.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Agriculture, Horticulture, Agribusiness, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred.

title: Program Manager, Fellowship Program
description:
**About the Organization** 




  





 ProblemSolvers Lab (PSL) began with a simple idea: a
 **ll students can engage in deep, higher\-order thinking when they have the right environment and the right kind of mathematical experiences.** 




  





 Across many classrooms in India, students rarely get opportunities to think aloud, explore structure, make conjectures, work with peers, or experience the satisfaction of figuring something out. PSL was created to bring these opportunities into everyday instruction.
 



  





 Our work is grounded in a few design principles:
 


* **Low\-floor, high\-ceiling tasks** 
 that allow every student to enter and stretch
* **Productive struggle** 
 , where students test ideas, revise, and persist
* Seeing students as
 **visualizers, experimenters, and problem\-solvers** 
 , not passive recipients



  





 Everything we do, with teachers and with students, rests on this approach.
 



  





**About the Fellowship Program** 




  





 We partner with Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) schools like Akanksha and affordable private schools to build teacher skills in conducting effective problem\-solving sessions. This year, our fellowship includes
 **120 teachers who collectively reach about 3,500 students** 
 in Grades 3–9\.
 



  





 We work closely with math education professors and practitioners from institutions like NYU, Azim Premji University, and others to strengthen our curriculum and pedagogy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Program Manager to lead the implementation of ProblemSolvers Lab’s teacher fellowship programs across partner organizations. This role focuses on translating our curriculum and pedagogy into strong classroom practice through effective
 **training, coaching, and project management** 
 , while working closely with fellows, partners, and the internal PSL team.
 



  





 You will gain deep exposure to teacher development, instructional leadership, and program
 



 design, while contributing to high\-quality, scalable problem\-solving experiences for students
 



 and teachers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Program design and implementation** 
 : Lead the planning and execution of teacher fellowship programs across partner organizations; contextualize ProblemSolvers Lab curriculum and pedagogy to partner needs, grade levels, and classroom realities; ensure high\-quality, consistent implementation across sites.



  




* **Training and coaching** 
 : Design and facilitate training experiences that build fellows’ capacity in learner\-centric pedagogy and problem\-solving facilitation; provide ongoing, individualized coaching through observations, reflections, and feedback conversations; support fellows in planning, executing, and reflecting on classroom practice.



  




* **Partnership and collaboration** 
 : Serve as the primary point of contact for partner organizations, ensuring clear communication and smooth program delivery; collaborate closely with curriculum, facilitation, and leadership teams to align goals and execution; gather inputs from fellows and partners to continuously improve the program.



  




* **Monitoring, reflection, and learning** 
 : Track fellow participation, engagement, and deliverables; review reflections, classroom artifacts, and student work to identify patterns and areas for improvement; document program learnings to inform curriculum refinement and future scaling.

title: Senior Administrator, Financial Systems & Automationv
description:
**Our Mission**
 You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
   

  

 We’re here to give power to the patient.
   

  

 For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace \- helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
   

  

 Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
 *seeking* 
 to
 *getting* 
 . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
   

  

 Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
   

  

**Your Impact on our mission**
 Healthcare is too hard. At Zocdoc, we work every day to make it easier for patients to get the care they need.
   

  

 As Senior Administrator, Financial Systems \& Automation, you’ll help ensure that the systems supporting Zocdoc’s financial operations are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to use. You’ll own the Finance Applications service experience from intake through resolution, serve as a hands\-on NetSuite expert, and help improve the connected tools and processes that Finance and Accounting rely on every day.
   

  

 This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical systems problems, improving how work gets done, and taking ownership from the first request through the final outcome.
   

  

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are**
* Energised by owning a system, service queue, or project from beginning to end
* Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities change
* Motivated by turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps
* Someone stakeholders trust for NetSuite guidance, issue resolution, and process improvement
* Structured and consistent in your approach to SLAs, documentation, testing, and follow\-through
* Curious about automation and responsible uses of AI
* Comfortable balancing speed, user experience, data integrity, security, and financial controls


**Your day\-to\-day is**
**Own Finance Applications service delivery**
* Manage the Finance Applications Jira queue from intake and triage through prioritization, communication, escalation, resolution, validation, and closure
* Track backlog, aging, blocked work, SLA risk, reopen rates, and recurring issues, taking action before commitments are missed
* Clarify incomplete requests, set realistic expectations, provide proactive updates, and close the loop with requesters
* Improve Jira Service Management workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake quality, knowledge articles, and escalation practices


**Administer and improve NetSuite**

* Translate Finance and Accounting requirements into practical solutions that improve accuracy, control, scalability, and user experience
* Investigate transaction, reporting, access, workflow, and integration issues and determine the appropriate resolution path
* Coordinate sandbox validation, regression testing, release readiness, production deployment, and post\-change verification
* Maintain documentation for configurations, dependencies, operating procedures, and support guidance


**Lead projects and continuous improvement**
* Manage financial\-systems projects from discovery and requirements through planning, testing, implementation, rollout, and follow\-up
* Define outcomes, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, decisions, and next steps
* Coordinate contributors across Finance, Accounting, FP\&A, IT, Engineering, and external vendors
* Identify blockers early, recommend practical paths forward, and escalate with context and a proposed decision
* Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, data quality, user experience, or control effectiveness


**Strengthen automation, controls, and documentation**
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error\-prone processes that can be improved through configuration, automation, controls, or clearer documentation
* Investigate data mismatches, integration failures, and process breaks using reports, logs, testing, and root\-cause analysis
* Build or improve dashboards and operational reporting for service delivery, system health, project progress, and process performance
* Follow change\-management, access\-management, segregation\-of\-duties, and audit\-readiness practices
* Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, process documentation, testing evidence, and handoff materials


**You’ll be successful in this role if you have**
* 5\+years of experience in financial systems, ERP administration, finance operations technology, or a related field
* Strong hands\-on NetSuite administration and configuration experience, including workflows, approvals, roles and permissions, saved searches, reporting, forms, and troubleshooting
* Experience owning a service queue, ticketing process, or internal systems\-support function against defined SLAs
* Experience with Jira or Jira Service Management, including queues, workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake, escalation, or automation
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver results with limited day\-to\-day supervision
* Strong analytical and root\-cause problem\-solving skills across systems, data, and business processes
* Experience managing external vendor support cases with clear documentation, urgency, and follow\-through
* Experience with system testing, release management, change control, production validation, and operational documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and decisions to non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of ownership, sound judgment, proactive risk escalation, and strong internal customer service
* A bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NetSuite Administrator certification
* Experience with connected finance platforms such as Coupa, Planful, ADP, Salesforce, or banking systems
* Experience translating business needs into requirements, action plans, decisions, and validation plans
* Experience influencing without authority across Finance, Accounting, IT, Engineering, vendors, and distributed teams
* Experience using automation or AI tools to improve finance operations, documentation, reporting, or user support


**What Success Looks Like**
* Finance Applications requests are visible, actively managed, and resolved against agreed service commitments
* Requesters receive timely communication, clear expectations, and complete resolution documentation
* NetSuite configurations and workflows are reliable, well governed, well documented, and aligned to business needs
* Financial\-systems projects move forward with clear ownership, decisions, milestones, and measurable outcomes
* Recurring issues and manual work decrease through root\-cause fixes, automation, and process improvements
* Stakeholders trust you to make progress, navigate ambiguity, and escalate risks early


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-

We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

description:

 As part of our EY GRC Tech team you’ll contribute technically to IT Risk and Assurance client engagements and as part of Transformation projects. title: Engineer L1
description:
**About Us**
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
   

  

 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
   

  

 We are looking for an Oracle IT Analyst with hands\-on functional experience beyond end\-user activities, who is motivated to build and grow a long\-term career working with Oracle E\-Business Suite.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver stable, scalable, and business\-aligned Oracle solutions that enable efficient Procure\-to\-Pay and Order to Cash operations and continuous process improvement.
   

  

 This job is based in Pune\- Maharashtra \- India.
   

  

 We provide a flexible working schedule with the option of working hybrid.
   

  

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be**
 Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional specifications for Oracle E\-Business Suite.
   

  

 Design, configure, and support Oracle R12 SCM /Distribution modules, including Purchasing, Order Management, iProcurement, Inventory, and iSupplier, Shipping , WMS , Pricing ensuring correct setup of profile options, flexfields, and business rules.
   

  

 Map existing (“as\-is”) business processes, perform gap analysis, and design optimized (“to\-be”) processes aligned with Oracle EBS capabilities.
   

  

 Create and maintain functional documentation, including scope documents, functional design documents, use cases, process flows, and user training materials.
   

  

 Develop and execute functional test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
   

  

 Provide end\-user training and ongoing functional and technical support, including issue resolution and management of Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
   

  

 Act as a key liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and successful delivery of IT solutions.
   

  

 Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process efficiencies and system enhancement opportunities.
   

  

**For This Role You Will Need**
 University degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
   

  

 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12, with strong functional expertise in Distribution (Procurement/Order Management) modules.
   

  

 Solid understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)/ Order to Cash(O2C) lifecycle and related supply chain business processes.
   

  

 Experience with at least one end\-to\-end Oracle implementation or multiple Oracle Procurement support projects.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
   

  

 Experience creating functional documentation and process maps.
   

  

 Working knowledge of SQL for querying tables and reading packages.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**
 Functional knowledge of ASCP AND Manufacturing modules.
   

  

 Experience working in a global or cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
   

  

 Proactive, pragmatic, and results\-oriented mindset.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Our People**
 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
   

  

 Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

 Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging**
 At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. title: Freight Operations Supervisor
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Title\- Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations
 



 Location: Pune, Magarpatta
 



  





 Position Overview: The Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, covering both FCL and LCL shipments. The role will involve shipment planning and execution, booking and scheduling, coordination with shipping lines and freight forwarders, documentation, shipment tracking, exception management, and timely delivery follow\-up. The role will also be responsible for ensuring operational accuracy, compliance with applicable shipping and trade requirements, effective stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of ocean freight processes. The position will provide operational guidance and support to team members while ensuring smooth and efficient handling of increasing shipment volumes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* End\-to\-End Ocean Freight Operations:
* Manage the complete lifecycle of FCL and LCL ocean shipments, from shipment planning and booking through documentation, vessel movement, tracking, and final delivery.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, warehouses, and other logistics partners for smooth shipment execution.
* Handle shipment bookings, vessel schedules, cut\-off timelines, cargo readiness, container planning, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor shipment milestones and proactively follow up on delays, rollovers, schedule changes, container\-related issues, and other operational exceptions.
* Ensure timely coordination for cargo pickup, stuffing, container movement, port processes, vessel departure, transshipment, arrival, and delivery.
* Ensure shipments are executed within agreed timelines and operational requirements.
* Handle day\-to\-day operational queries and resolve shipment\-related issues through effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.



**FCL \& LCL Shipment Management:** 



* Manage FCL export and import shipments, including container booking, equipment availability, shipping line coordination, cut\-off management, and shipment tracking.
* Manage LCL shipments, including coordination with freight forwarders/consolidators, cargo readiness, consolidation schedules, documentation, and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with relevant parties to ensure timely cargo movement and avoid unnecessary delays, demurrage, detention, storage, and other additional costs.
* Monitor container and cargo movement and ensure timely escalation of operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with warehouses, suppliers, freight forwarders, and transporters to ensure cargo is available and moved as per the planned sailing schedule.



**Documentation \& Trade Compliance:** 



* Ensure accurate and timely preparation, verification, and submission of ocean shipping documentation.
* Handle and review documents such as Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Shipping Instructions, and other applicable shipping and trade documents.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve documentation discrepancies.
* Ensure shipping documentation is complete and accurate within defined timelines.
* Handle preferential and non\-preferential Certificates of Origin and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for issuance and submission.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international trade, customs, shipping, and documentation requirements.
* Maintain proper operational records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.



  





**Shipping Line \& Freight Forwarder Coordination:** 



* Coordinate with shipping lines and freight forwarders for bookings, schedules, rates, equipment availability, documentation, and shipment execution.
* Follow up on vessel schedules, rollovers, delays, transshipments, port congestion, and other operational issues.
* Monitor service levels and operational performance of logistics service providers.
* Escalate recurring service issues and coordinate corrective actions with service providers.
* Support negotiations and discussions related to operational requirements, service quality, and freight\-related issues.



  





**Stakeholder Management:** 



* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding ocean freight shipments and operational matters.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, Finance, Warehouse, Supply Chain, Customs, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Provide timely shipment status updates and highlight potential delays or risks.
* Ensure alignment between shipment requirements, cargo readiness, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Handle operational escalations and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.



  





**Team Coordination \& Support:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day operational guidance and support to team members handling ocean freight activities.
* Support the team in managing FCL and LCL shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Review operational activities for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined processes.
* Train and guide junior team members on ocean freight processes, documentation, systems, and operational procedures.
* Support the team in resolving complex shipment\-related issues and exceptions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and prioritization of operational activities within the team.



  





**Cost Control \& Process Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve ocean freight processes, shipment planning, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Monitor and minimize avoidable costs such as demurrage, detention, storage, documentation charges, and other operational expenses.
* Support freight and logistics cost optimization through effective shipment planning and coordination.
* Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of SOPs, process controls, and operational best practices.
* Monitor key operational performance indicators and support continuous improvement initiatives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Commerce, or a
 



 related field.
 



  





**Experience** 




 • 7–9 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight Operations.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in managing both FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Experience in end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, shipment coordination, documentation, and
 



 carrier/freight forwarder management.
 



 • Prior experience in handling or coordinating a team will be preferred.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient.  \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

 We are seeking a performance testing professional to lead non\-functional testing (NFT) strategy and execution across complex Telecom technology landscapes, including Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. This role plays a critical part in shaping the QA vision, driving automation, ensuring delivery efficiency, and collaborating closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers and multi\-vendor partners to deliver high\-quality, scalable and resilient solutions.

* Execute and manage performance tests, analyse results, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Define and track testing metrics, processes, tools and reporting mechanisms to ensure effective delivery governance

**Who You Are**

 Network Engineer – AWS \& Cisco Migration
   

  

**Requirements**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies and AWS cloud networking to lead and execute the migration of on‑premises and Cisco‑based network infrastructure into AWS. This role will be responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating hybrid and cloud‑native network architectures while modernizing legacy Cisco environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience with Cisco firewalls, routing/switching, VPNs, and BGP, combined with strong practical knowledge of AWS VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and cloud security controls.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of professional experience as a Network Engineer, with strong Cisco networking background.
* 3\+ years of hands‑on experience designing and supporting AWS networking.
* Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF.
* Strong experience with Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and VPN technologies.
* Solid understanding of AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Elastic Load Balancing.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues in production environments.
* Experience migrating large‑scale enterprise networks from Cisco to AWS.
* Hands‑on experience with Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation.
* Familiarity with container networking (EKS, Kubernetes CNI).
* AWS and/or Cisco certifications such as: – AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty – CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security


 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Cisco to AWS Migration**
* Lead network migration initiatives from Cisco on‑premises and datacenter environments to AWS.
* Assess existing Cisco architectures (ASA/FTD, routers, switches) and define migration strategies to AWS‑native or virtualized equivalents (ASAv/FTDv, Transit Gateway, AWS Network Firewall).
* Migrate and validate ACLs, NAT rules, VPNs (Site‑to‑Site and Client VPN), and routing policies in AWS.


**AWS Networking \& Hybrid Connectivity**
* Design and implement AWS VPC architectures, including CIDR planning, subnets, routing tables, gateways (IGW/NAT), and security boundaries.

* Implement Transit Gateway architectures for large‑scale, multi‑account environments.


**Network Security \& Compliance**

* Implement network security best practices using security groups, NACLs, and logging (VPC Flow Logs).
* Support compliance initiatives (SOC, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) through secure network design and documentation.


**Automation, Operations \& Troubleshooting**
* Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation) to standardize and automate network deployments.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across Layer 3–7 in hybrid and cloud environments.

* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational documentation.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 IT Helpdesk Technician / VMware Operations \& Support Engineer
   





**Location:** 
 Bhartiya City, Bangalore
   





**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid / Work from Office
   





**Compensation:** 
 As per industry standard market rates
   





**Position Overview** 
  





 We are seeking an experienced IT Engineer to manage the day\-to\-day administration, support, maintenance, and optimization of our enterprise virtualization platforms. This role ensures the high availability, performance, security, and compliance of core VMware infrastructure, supporting mission\-critical business applications across production, DR, and UAT environments.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements

* **VMware \& VCF Operations:** 
 Administer VMware vSphere, ESXi (7\.x/8\.x), vCenter, HA, DRS, vMotion, and Storage vMotion. Operate VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments, including SDDC Manager, Management Domains, and Workload Domains. Perform lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, and routine health checks.

 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise VMware infrastructure operations (preferably in financial services or enterprise\-scale environments).

 Expertise in VMware ESXi 7\.x/8\.x, vCenter Server, vSphere, VMware HCX Migration, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF).

 Deep understanding of ITIL\-based operational frameworks, change management, and incident management.

* Experience with VMware NSX\-T/NSX, VMware Aria Operations, VMware SRM, or Dell PowerFlex.
* Familiarity with enterprise storage, networking concepts, and ticketing platforms like ServiceNow.

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.

* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

description:
**Meet the Team**
 CX is a team of outstanding technical guides whose \#1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience. We help take on the toughest business challenges with network\-centric solutions that accelerate customer and partner success and dedication. Our success is validated through outstanding financial results, growing customer happiness metrics, industry recognition, and employee happiness scores.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Lead \& drive software design, optimization/implementation, execution, for projects/accounts to accelerate customer outcomes.
* Support presales activities and translate business requirements into solution design.
* Participate in Statement of Work scoping, review, and creation, kick\-off meetings
* Provide/assist customers with development, integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance for Cisco technologies.

* Support solution implementation and strategy plans.

* Create and deliver trainings for new and junior technical resources within the team.
* Provides guidance and mentoring to other engineers. Mentor / develop others.


**Minimum Qualifications**

* Proficiency in programming using Python, adept in efficient usage of AI coding tools.
* Expertise in Data Structures \& Algorithms, Database management (MySQL/PostgreSQL/noSQL) finetuning and optimization , API design (RESTful services), parsing and REGEX, Kafka and Golang

* Experience in all phases of software development lifecycle with good working exposure to agile development methodologies, software automation/workflow orchestration, microservices, containers/K8s, cloud, databases, open source etc

title: Integration Project Administrator
description:
**Overview**  

**Purpose:**  

  

The Platform Operations, Support, and Onboarding teams ensure the reliability, stability, and seamless functioning of CitrusAd's production systems and offerings, operating as a centre of excellence for service delivery across the integration lifecycle.
  

  

The Integration Project Administrator, based in Epsilon India, provides administrative and coordination support to Integration Project Managers across the APJ, EMEA, and AMER portfolios. The role keeps integration projects on track, ensures administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time, and contributes to the standardisation of integration delivery globally. The position extends 24/5 coverage of integration delivery by adding an India working\-day footprint to the existing AU, US and UK presence.
  

**Core Objectives**  

* Project Coordination
* Operational Practices
* Stakeholder Engagement
* System Reliability
* Product Knowledge
* Team Membership
* Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification
* Personal Capability Building

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Project Coordination**
  

* Assist in planning, organising, and coordinating integration projects, including scheduling meetings, updating project tasks, maintaining project calendars, and ensuring goals and deadlines are met.
* Create, organise, and maintain project documentation, including project plans, scope documents, reports, and meeting minutes in ServiceNow and SharePoint.
* Track resource availability and utilisation across project team members; flag conflicts to the Director and Integration Project Managers.
* Serve as a central point of contact for project\-related communication across India, AU, UK, and US time zones; distribute information, schedule cross\-region meetings, and keep partners informed.
* Prepare and present reports on project progress, RAID logs, and onboarding Retun on Investment data.
* Assist Integration Project Managers in managing budget, scope, and delivery.
* Identify project risks and impacts to timelines; coordinate mitigation activities with the Integration Project Manager.
* Support the service transition into Platform Operations for technical support of clients post\-launch.
* Uphold processes and procedures for the best change management across production platforms.

  

**Operational Practices**
  

* Uphold operational practices for software implementation and project management.
* Support proactive incident and problem detection during integration and hypercare phases.
* Support the operational integrity of all production environments.
* Work as a team to ensure SLAs and practices are well defined, documented, and consistently applied.
* Uphold the IT Service and Support workflow, with a particular focus on best\-in\-class customer experience.

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Client Integration Engineering, Product, Release Management, Platform Operations, and Global Support.
* Maintain strong relationships with retailers and partners, ensuring their needs are met while protecting the business needs of CitrusAd and Epsilon.
* Act as a regional point of contact for India\-based retailers and India\-based engineering and account teams.

  

**System Reliability**
  

* Work with Engineering, Product, Delivery, and Security teams to ensure appropriate attention is given to production and system reliability for customers.
* Uphold operational practices in conjunction with Product and Engineering teams, including understanding how integrations and configurations may affect reliability, performance, and cost.

  

**Product Knowledge**
  

* Keep up to date with Epsilon Retail Media product suite features, improvements, and roadmap.
* Stay abreast of industry trends in retail media, ad\-tech, and advertising in India and globally.
* Understand the different facets of the CitrusAd system, including Reporting, Ad Serving, API Integration, Product Catalog, and Ad Placements.
* Maintain a solid level of knowledge of the technical integration and functionality of Epsilon and CitrusAd Onsite and Offsite core platforms, supporting products, toolsets, and partner systems.

  

**Team Membership**
  

* Act in the best interest of the Customer and the Team at all times.
* Drive cohesion between team members across India, AU, UK, and US; build strong relationships across the Platform Operations and Support group.
* Collaborate with internal delivery teams to ensure a high\-quality customer experience for case resolution and support.

  

**Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification**
  

* Ensure all processes and procedures are documented for continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement process improvement and simplification with leadership and partner teams.
* Proactively identify new opportunities to improve and simplify integration delivery, tooling, and governance.

  

**Personal Capability Building**
  

* Develop own capabilities through assessment, development planning, and formal and informal training and coaching.
* Gain or maintain external professional accreditation where relevant.
* Maintain an in\-depth understanding of project management methodologies, technology, external regulation, and industry standard.

**Behavioural Competencies**  

* **Manages complexity.** Detail oriented, strong communication and negotiation skills, works well under pressure, prioritises effectively, and handles multiple inquiries concurrently. Makes sense of complex, high\-volume, sometimes contradictory information.
* **Ensures accountability.** Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments; tracks performance and helps the team learn from success, failure, and feedback.
* **Balances partners.** Anticipates and balances the needs of multiple collaborators across regions; maintains a professional attitude under pressure.
* **Collaborates.** Builds partnerships and works collaboratively to meet shared objectives; shares credit and invites candid views.
* **Instills trust.** Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* **Courage.** Steps up to address difficult issues; raises tough issues with leadership early.
* **Influences.** Uses compelling arguments to gain support and commitment; deftly explains impacts to internal teams.
* **Contributes to effective team behaviours.** Applies diverse skills to achieve common goals; leverages strengths and addresses weaknesses.

  

**Qualifications**  

**Essential**
  

* 2\+ years' experience as a project administrator or project coordinator in a technical or software implementation environment.
* Strong technical competence and ability to understand complex software systems.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to work upward to senior leadership and across a wide range of audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, globally distributed environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills; able to dive deep while keeping perspective on big\-picture goals.
* Ability to engage and coordinate teams within tight timeframes and manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Self\-directed, motivated, and able to multitask in a fast\-paced ad\-technology environment.
* Ability to work flexible hours to overlap with AU and UK or US time zones as needed.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Proficiency in ServiceNow, particularly Project Portfolio Management or Strategic Portfolio Management modules.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Teams in a global delivery context.
* Experience working with retail media, ad\-tech, or e\-commerce platforms.
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as the DPDP Act 2023 (India) and GDPR.

**Education**  

  

**Essential**
  

* An undergraduate degree in Project Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or equivalent industry experience.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Professional Project Management accreditation, Agile or PMI or similar, and/or demonstrated work experience as a project coordinator or administrator.
* ITIL Foundation certified.

  

**Additional Information**  

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  

  

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400\+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real\-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry\-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.  

  

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.  

* **People centricity:** We focus on employee well\-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* **Growth:** There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting\-edge solutions and forward\-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

  

These pillars and values are our foundation\-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.  

  

**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
  

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.
