title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About WeRize**




 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintechplatform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
 



  





 This customer segmentis not served by privatesector banks, Insurersand Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans,savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support.These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
 



  





 Our social distribution platform supported by financially literatefreelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-fieldteams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That resultsin very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousandsof freelancers in 5000\+ citiesonly through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.
 



  





 To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 We are looking for a Director of Engineering with a strong focus on execution and delivery. This role is ideal for a hands\-on leader who excels in managing engineering teams, driving timely execution, and ensuring high\-quality software delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with product, design, and business teams to translate business goals into robust technology solutions.

 Engineering Execution \& Delivery:
 


* Own the end\-to\-end execution of engineering projects, ensuring on\-time delivery with high quality.
* Drive agile development processes, ensuring efficient sprint planning, backlog grooming, and milestone tracking.
* Optimize release cycles, code quality, and system performance while minimizing technical debt. Lead and unblock teams by identifying bottlenecks, mitigating risks, and ensuring continuous progress



 Team Leadership \& Management:
 


* Manage, mentor, and scale high\-performing engineering teams.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability within the team for successful execution.
* Provide hands\-on technical guidance where needed, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with the hiring team to attract and retain top engineering talent.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
 


* Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and other engineering leaders to align technology execution with company goals.
* Ensure seamless coordination between backend, frontend, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical roadmaps and execution plans.



 System Scalability \& Stability:
 


* Ensure the stability, security, and scalability of existing systems while enabling new feature development.
* Optimize performance and system reliability while ensuring cost\-efficient infrastructure.
* Ensure strong DevOps and CI/CD practices to support smooth and frequent deployments.



  





 Attributes we are looking for:
 


* 8\-12 years of experience in software development and engineering leadership.
* Proven experience in driving execution in fast\-paced environments, preferably in fintech or consumer tech.
* Hands\-on experience with backend (Java) and frontend (React) technologies.

 Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on.

 We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.
 



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience.
 



 This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI\-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost\-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low\-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self\-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI\-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise\-grade decision\-making.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long\-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.
* Define specific systems programs and create a plan of action for realizing those programs. Such programs could be around capacity planning, migration efforts, high availability, network architecture, performance optimization, reliability improvements and more.
* Use your technical understanding of Atlassian and related systems to partner with and influence engineers and architects in making progress on these problems.
* Responsible for taking a systematic approach to engineering problems. This includes: prioritizing tasks, scoping out the project, defining objectives, and making consistent progress against each of these.
* Be accountable for the success of these technical programs by managing the entire lifecycle from initiation to forecasting, budgeting, scheduling, etc.
* Manage complex dependencies and projects with a broad scope across the company


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience on software teams as Development Manager or TPM
* Strategic thinking and ability to understand business objectives to translate them into technical problems and programs.
* Technical understanding of systems involved. Willingness to develop domain expertise in the area they operate \- storage, networking, authentication, capacity management, service deployments, etc.
+ TPMs are not expected to write or read code, but are expected to understand system flows, block architectures, APIs and such.

* Experience defining and running end\-to\-end complex technical programs
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Company Introduction** 




 We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
 



  





 We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
 



  





 Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next\-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.
 



  





 As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business\-critical outcomes.
 



  





 This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.
 



  





 The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large\-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead strategic, organization\-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
* Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
* Drive large\-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
* Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
* Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
* Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision\-making, and resource allocation.
* Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
* Drive executive\-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.



  





**Basic Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
* Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed systems environments.
* Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
* Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.



  





**Type of work model** 




  





 Hybrid /Onsite / Remote working

Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.



  





**Details to consider**

Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R\&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all\-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook\-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. In your first year, you’ll be expected to independently run a portfolio of programs from scoping through delivery and retrospectives, and to improve how R\&D programs operate by contributing to and evolving Technical Program Management best practices.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.
* Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.
* Own end\-to\-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.
* Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.
* Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.
* Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision\-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.
* Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.
* Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R\&D programs run across GitLab.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.
* Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.
* Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation\-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.
* Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.
* Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.


**About The Team**
 You’ll join the R\&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross\-functional team that leads high\-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook\-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and partners in other functions to improve how programs are planned, executed, and communicated, helping evolve shared practices, templates, and tooling for program governance across R\&D.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. **Engineering Program Manager** 




**\[IC role]** 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an experienced Engineering Program Manager to drive planning, execution, and continuous improvement across our Engineering organization. You'll act as the execution orchestrator across Engineering — turning roadmap priorities into executable plans, keeping cross\-team delivery on track, and making sure customer\-impacting issues, releases, and demos move smoothly from commitment to completion.
 




  






 You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and Sales Engineers (SEs), and you'll need to influence outcomes without direct authority — bringing structure to ambiguous problems and surfacing risks early.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Roadmap \& Sprint Execution** 





 Translate roadmap objectives into milestones, deliverables, and timelines across Engineering teams.
 





 Own planning and tracking for sprints and projects: define dependencies, track scope changes and blockers, and flag delivery risk before it becomes slippage.
 





 Sequence work across teams based on business priority, capacity, and dependencies; facilitate trade\-off discussions when priorities conflict.
 





 Maintain program dashboards as the single source of truth for delivery status.
 




  





**2\. Cross\-Functional \& Customer Issue Coordination** 





 Serve as the coordination point between Engineering, Product, Customer Supoort, CSMs, and SEs on customer\-reported issues.
 





 Track issues from investigation through release and customer validation; drive aging or high\-impact issues to resolution.
 





 Ensure decisions, owners, and timelines are documented and communicated; escalate critical issues with clear context and recommended action.
 




  





**3\. Release \& Demo Coordination** 





 Coordinate releases across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps; own release timelines and readiness reviews.
 





 Organize feature/sprint demos for CSMs, SEs, and Product; ensure feedback and action items get routed to the right owners.
 





 Support post\-release validation and retrospectives for major releases.
 




  





**4\. Quality, RCA \& Continuous Improvement** 





 Drive completion of Root Cause Analyses for significant customer\-impacting bugs and recurring defects, with clear owners and target dates.
 





 Analyze issue data to spot systemic patterns; partner with Customer Support, Engineering and Product on permanent fixes, not workarounds.
 





 Facilitate retrospectives and ensure findings feed back into planning.
 




  





**5\. Process Improvement** 





 Identify bottlenecks, gaps, and manual effort in existing workflows; design and standardize processes that improve predictability.
 





 Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tracking and reporting.
 





 Establish metrics to confirm process changes are actually working.
 





 Tracking \& Improving Customer Support SLAs.
 




  





**6\. Stakeholder Communication** 





 Run a predictable communication cadence covering progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.
 





 Tailor updates for Engineering, Product, customer\-facing teams, and leadership.
 





 Proactively surface deviations from plan — don't wait for escalation.
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 





 5\+ years in Program Management, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Project Management in a software/technology company.
 





 Proven experience driving execution across multiple Engineering teams with interdependent deliverables, in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 





 Track record coordinating cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, Customer Support, Sales/SE).
 





 Strong stakeholder management — able to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
 





 Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and delivery/reporting tools.
 





 Experience with release management, RCA/defect trend analysis, or engineering dashboards.
 




  





**Good to Have** 





 Technical background or experience working closely with engineers.
 





 B2B SaaS / enterprise software experience.
 





 Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or application architecture.
 





 Experience with distributed/geographically diverse teams.
 





 PMP, SAFe, or Scrum Master certification.
 





 Strong analytical skills and comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities.
 




  





**Success in This Role** 





 Roadmap and sprint delivery become measurably more predictable.
 





 Customer\-impacting issues resolve faster, with clear ownership and tracking.
 





 Recurring defects decline through consistent RCA follow\-through.
 





 Engineering, Customer Support, Product, CSM, and SE teams report better visibility and alignment.

**Job Title: Delivery Lead**
 The Senior Process Consultant / Delivery Lead is responsible for leading a Sub Value Stream portfolio / Global Programme and driving end\-to\-end process re\-engineering and transformation initiatives to deliver agreed transformation objectives.
   

  

 The purpose of the Operation Transformation Process Consultant is to support the end\-to\-end process re\-engineering / transformation activities that will deliver transformation goals.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in customer\-centric, data\-driven process improvement and transformation, covering 4Cs: Customer, Colleague, Cost, Control, and Scalability. The Delivery Lead drives strategic planning and supports Operating Models, governance, tooling, and delivery execution to ensure sustainable business outcomes.
   

  

 The role also acts as a change catalyst, partnering with Global Business Lines across geographies (primarily home and priority markets) and supporting multiple internal engagements to drive measurable performance improvement.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Operate at a Programme delivery level, working for global business and regions and helping the Operations Transformation, business transformation to focus on end customers.
* To deliver the Global Ops transformation programs delivering P\&L targets by focusing on the globally directed projects and initiatives by identifying strategic opportunities, designing, implementing, and embedding the change to the operations processes.
* Responsible for leading transformation of different complexities focusing on end\-to\-end digital journeys with a lens on scalable and reusable solutions and leading other Delivery Leads \& Senior Process consultant’s in managing a large transformation program to deliver an agreed set of business objectives.
* Facilitate program governance, RAID management, Fortnightly / Monthly governance packs for Accounts Business Services. Position ID validation with Finance, Anaplan Governance Oversight, Change Request (CRs) Management, JIRA Ticket Housekeeping, Forecast Confidence analysis with Operations Leads by providing a forward view.
* The role requires to oversee and mentor Delivery Leads and Senior process consultants in a program/project environment guiding them to deliver program/project objectives
* For specific functional areas, deliver step change in operational performance (cost, service levels, and customer satisfaction) through identification and successful initiation of new process improvement initiatives aligned with local/regional transformation goals.
* Act as a strategic transformation delivery lead focusing on operational excellence \& working closing with stakeholders to identify key projects. Provide detail input to ensure commercially viable decisions are taken on prioritizing and optimizing the project portfolio.
* Work closely with different transformation programme and providing on ground support from DBS Operations transformation perspective with Revisit projects post deployment on regular basis to validate whether the objectives are met and sustainable
* Be knowledgeable of key business drivers – WFM data, process maps, process insights, data intelligence etc. Also Organize \& lead process reviews, walkthrough, bootcamp sessions.
* Mobilize right support for reengineering projects and ensuring designs are translated into implementation\- including Tech funding ask, Business case creation, supporting Jira work for demand intake process.
* Anticipate issues and risks and address them quickly, with an understanding of the critical path. Contemplate contingencies and develop strategies to manage risks and collaborate with other enablers \& teams i.e. Automation, Technology, Operation Transformation Program Office to drive Global and local re\-engineering initiatives


**Leadership \& Teamwork**
**Value Creation:**
* Own value creation planning, ensuring benefits, scope, schedule, and costs are clearly defined, tracked, and realized.
* Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, customer experience, control effectiveness, and scalability.
* Use data\-driven insights to assess performance, validate outcomes post\-deployment, and drive continuous improvement.
* Balance speed, risk, and value to ensure sustainable delivery outcomes.


**Operational Performance**
* Provide hands\-on delivery oversight, ensuring projects meet milestones, quality standards, and financial commitments.
* Review and challenge delivery plans, resourcing models, and execution approaches to maximize effectiveness.
* Drive standardization through use of approved templates, tools, and delivery methodologies.
* Ensure post\-implementation reviews are conducted and lessons learned are embedded into future delivery.


**People And Capability Development**
* Identify capability gaps and work with Programme Directors to secure appropriate skills and resources.
* Set clear expectations, roles, and accountability for delivery team members.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance team environment.
* Act as a role model for delivery excellence


**Experience**
**To be successful you will:**
* 10 to 15 years of experience in operations transformation, operations strategy, programme delivery, and change management, ideally within financial services.
* Domain understanding of overall banking and financial/consulting services industry especially Private banking \& Wealth knowledge will be preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-country and multi\-stakeholder programmes.
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.
* Experience working across global operating models and matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success in delivering measurable business outcomes across cost, efficiency, customer experience, and control.
* Be a strong team player and contribute to the success of teamwork, taking up different roles and activities.
* Track\-record of leading Agile multi\-disciplined teams to deliver exceptional customer service and value.
* Preferably Black Belt trained / certified, Agile coach \& scrum master certification
* Strong problem\-solving skills using end to end process reviews and data driven analysis.
* Exposure / experience to Microsoft Power Platform, AI and other automations tools / techniques will be an added
* Understand business case, challenge benefit quantification, and do reality check.
* Strong communications, leadership, project management, influencing, analytical, decision\-making, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of Process Excellence methodology\- proficiency in conducting workshops and working with stakeholders for strategic planning.


**Capabilities**
* Portfolio / Value Stream Definition and Planning
* Programme Management
* Global Mindset
* Customer Empathy
* Practical working knowledge of agile
* Business Commerciality
* Business Analysis and Design
* Resource and Team Management and Leadership
* Problem Solving and Critical Thinking
* Innovation and Idea Management
* Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder matrix
* Understanding of financial aspects of programmes
* Thought leadership
* Experience in resolving conflicts and negotiation


**Skills And Certifications**
* 
+ Understanding of HSBC Change framework.
+ Understanding of Private Banking \& Wealth Services.
+ Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external 'regulators.'
+ To continually re\-access the operational risks inherent in the business, on account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures, management restructuring and the impact of new technology in conjunction with the donor Group companies. Responsible for one’s own performance. Ensuring the service levels are maintained at their optimum level.


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic**
 Our Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level:** 
 Manager or equivalent
   

  

 As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead cross\-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Our Enterprise \& Operations Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market\-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
   

  

 We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team
   

  

* Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.
* Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.
* Drive enterprise\- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.


**The team:**
 Our Commodity Trading \& Risk Management advisory practice solves our clients’ most complex issues and helps drive transformative changes to their supply, trading, and marketing organizations. We support our clients with advice related to physical and financial commodity market challenges through commercial \& risk advisory, quantitative analysis, technology and operational advisory services.
   

  

 Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. These services are organized into three capability areas \- Strategic Services, Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services, and Technology Services:
   

  

* Strategic Services help clients define fit\-for\-purpose operating models for their commodities, define the changes required to realize that vision, and develop a roadmap for execution
* Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services assess the existing compliance, risk, and operational processes of our clients leveraging proprietary tools to yield insights for improvement or optimization
* Technology Services deliver custom and package technology solutions that help our clients manage their commodity business and associated risk \& compliance exposures.
* Managers are responsible for setting goals that align with organizational objectives
* As a manager will focus on the management and delivery of client engagements, as well as sales and practice development.
* Managing multiple project budget, monitoring expenditure and costs as the project progresses.
* Facilitating the appointment of individuals to project teams.
* Provide deep subject matter expertise on CTRM Projects.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
**Functional Requirements –**
* 10 – 15 years of experience in business processes across Trading and Contract management, Physical Commodity Trading and their related financial derivatives, Scheduling, Mark to Market, Vars, Write on/Write offs, Inventory Management, Invoicing and Accounting.
* Familiarity with Pricing tools such as ZEMA
* Understanding of deal pricing and pricing strategies
* Understand End of day and End of Month processes for the month close. Understanding of the RA month close process and sequence of jobs to be run to facilitate month end.
* Familiarity with Right Angle Risk Management module. Understand hedging strategies and managed or supported Hedge/offset deals in Right Angle.
* Understanding of snapshots – intraday, end of day, weekly and monthly processes.


**Technical Requirements –**
* Good skills on SQL and .Net
* Have worked on or previously supported integration of Right Angle with other applications using.net class dll and WCF services.
* Leverage AzureDev Ops or similar deployment workflow for RA development and deployments
* Have worked on or have supported Right Angle version upgrades.
* Familiar with deployment of RightAngle enhancements and customizations.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies
* Worked on RightAngle version 15 or above.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university.
* MBA or related PG preferred


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: 15+ Years - GM, Projects/Development Strategy
description:
**About Maia Estates**
 At MAIA, we believe real estate goes beyond construction — it is about building trust, shaping aspirations and creating meaningful ways of living. Established in 2016 by Mayank Ruia in partnership with the Manipal Group, MAIA Estates is redefining India’s real estate landscape through thoughtful design, meticulous planning, and conscious development.
   

  

 In just a decade, MAIA has earned recognition from leading global institutions including the International Property Awards, Asia Pacific Property Awards, and Luxury Lifestyle Awards. Yet, what truly defines us is our unwavering commitment to quality, transparency, customer\-centric thinking, and the belief that design has the power to create lasting impact.
   

  

 Today, MAIA has emerged as one of Bengaluru’s most respected names in premium residential and commercial real estate, with a portfolio that reflects both innovation and integrity. Every development is guided by a philosophy rooted in purpose, precision, sustainability, and enduring value.
   

  

 Our Founder and CEO, Mayank Ruia, brings over two decades of global experience across finance and real estate. His professional journey includes tenures at Goldman Sachs, UBS, and Everstone Capital, alongside a track record of planning and developing over 15 million square feet of residential and commercial real estate across Bengaluru and other cities, including landmark developments such as 27 Summit, Pelican Grove, Kessaku, and One Bangalore West. His leadership is driven by long\-term thinking, operational excellence, and a deep understanding of evolving customer aspirations.
   

  

 Joining MAIA means becoming part of a culture that values clarity of thought, attention to detail, collaboration, and meaningful innovation. We are not driven by trends or excess, but by the ambition to create spaces and experiences that stand the test of time.
   

  

 If you are looking to be part of an organisation where purpose, performance, and passion come together, MAIA offers the opportunity to build not just developments, but a meaningful future.
   

  

 Website: https://www.maiaestates.in/
   

  

 OUR FLAGSHIP PROJECTS
   

  

**27 Summit** 
 – MAIA’s flagship residential development off Richmond Road, Central Bangalore (https://27summit.com/)
   

  

**The Beacon** 
 – MAIA’s first commercial development on the banks of Nagavara Lake, North Bangalore
   

  

**Casa Sia** 
 – MAIA’s entry into Chennai at Parathasarathy Garden, off Poes Garden, Central Chennai (https://maiacasasia.com)
   

  

**Pelican Grove** 
 – MAIA’s debut residential development on the banks of Jakkur Lake, North Bangalore (https://maiapelicangrove.com/)
   

  

**Pelican Gardens** 
 – MAIA’s next chapter on the banks of Jakkur Lake, North Bangalore (https://maiapelicangardens.com/)
   

  

**The Seven** 
 – MAIA’s foray into South Bangalore, nestled in historic Basavanagudi’s cultural core
   

  

 CORPORATE OFFICE LOCATION
   

  

 Ulsoor Road, Central Bangalore
   

  

 OUR PEOPLE FIRST STRATEGY
   

  

 A sense of autonomy
   

  

 A greater purpose
   

  

 Accelerated career growth for top performers
   

  

 Competitive total rewards package
   

  

 YOUR IMPACT AREA
   

  

 We are looking for someone to lead Total project delivery across design, statutory approvals budgeting, contracting, execution tracking, risk management and innovation by driving standardized processes, financial discipline, timely delivery, and capability building, while embedding the MAIA Way across teams and partners.
   

  

 As
 **General Manager – Projects** 
 , you will be the strategic and operational leader responsible for orchestrating seamless project execution from conceptualization to handover. You will act as the central point of accountability for all development functions, ensuring alignment between design intent, budget controls, statutory compliance, vendor management, quality standards, and schedule adherence across MAIA's portfolio of premium projects.
   

  

 MINIMUM QUALIFICATION
   

  

 Degree/Postgraduate in Architecture/ Engineering /Construction Management from a recognized institution
   

  

 18\+ years' experience in real estate development projects, specifically in high\-rise premium residential developments (G\+20 and above)
   

  

 Should have successfully completed at least two premium projects (₹ 400 Cr\+ each) from conceptualization to handover
   

  

 Proven track record of managing projects with carpet areas exceeding 4 lakh sq ft
   

  

 Strong leadership, financial acumen, contractual negotiation, and governance expertise
   

  

 In\-depth statutory approval process experience from inception to Occupancy Certificate (OC) and post\-OC compliances
   

  

 Experience working with Tier\-1 consultants, international architects, and premium contractors
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional teams of 20\+ professionals
   

  

 Exposure to large\-scale budgets (₹300 Cr\+ construction budgets) and P\&L management
   

  

 Familiarity with project management tools (Procore, MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Process \& Governance
* Drive end\-to\-end process flow standardization across all development functions including design, statutory, procurement, execution, and handover.
* Establish and enforce SOPs, governance frameworks, and decision matrices aligned with MAIA standards.
* Ensure staffing readiness and timeliness aligned to project milestones and phase\-wise requirements.
* Implement robust documentation, reporting, and audit trail systems for all project activities.
* Lead monthly/quarterly project review meetings with senior leadership and present strategic updates.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and embed lessons learned from past projects.
* Ensure compliance with ISO, IGBC, and other relevant quality and sustainability certifications.
* Establish KPI dashboards and performance metrics for all development teams.
* Design Development
* Focus on Constructability of design to mitigate future execution challenges and reduce RFIs.
* Ensure 100% schematic design completion and obtain project budget approval before DD stage.
* Oversee statutory compliance, approvals (plan sanction, BBMP, BDA, CMDA, environmental clearances), and design change management across all projects.
* Coordinate with architects, structural, MEP, façade, and landscape consultants to ensure design integration.
* Conduct rigorous design reviews at each stage (SD, DD, CD) to ensure alignment with project vision, budget, and timeline.
* Champion value engineering initiatives that optimize costs without compromising quality or aesthetics.
* Ensure all designs meet RERA compliance requirements and customer expectations.
* Manage design iterations and ensure timely approvals from internal stakeholders and authorities.
* Drive BIM adoption and digital twin creation for enhanced project visualization and coordination.
* Establish design freeze protocols and manage post\-freeze change requests with financial impact analysis.
* Budget \& Financial Control
* Manage P1 (initial budget) vs P2 (revised budget) variance and ensure cashflow accuracy with monthly reconciliations.
* Drive timely financial and budgetary approvals across all project stages (land, design, construction, marketing, handover).
* Responsible for managing entire cost\-to\-completion budget, including construction, consultancy, statutory, contingencies, and handing over process.
* Implement robust cost control mechanisms and flag budget overruns with mitigation plans.
* Conduct monthly financial reviews and provide variance analysis reports to CFO and CEO.
* Ensure accurate forecasting of project costs, commitments, and cash outflows on a rolling 12\-month basis.
* Drive procurement savings through strategic sourcing, bulk buying, and vendor negotiations (target: 10–15% savings).
* Manage VO (Variation Order) approvals and ensure financial discipline in design changes.
* Monitor ROI on all project investments and provide financial insights for future projects.
* Establish financial dashboards with real\-time budget tracking and burn rate analytics.
* Contract \& Vendor Management
* Standardize RFPs, RFQs, and tender documents for consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Ensure contractor selection timelines are met and manage vendor empanelment systems with performance ratings.
* Negotiate contracts, terms, payment schedules, LDs, and performance bonds with strategic vendors.
* Establish vendor performance evaluation frameworks and conduct quarterly vendor reviews.
* Build a robust vendor ecosystem with at least 3–4 empaneled vendors in each category (civil, MEP, façade, etc.).
* Manage claims, disputes, and arbitration processes with contractors and consultants.
* Drive strategic partnerships with international brands for premium finishes, fixtures, and systems.
* Ensure vendor compliance with HSE norms, labor laws, and contractual obligations.
* Implement digital vendor management platforms for PO tracking, invoice processing, and payment approvals.
* Maintain vendor relationship management and conduct quarterly vendor meets for alignment.
* Execution \& Project Management
* Provide leadership oversight on team performance, schedule adherence, construction quality, logistics, and HSE compliance.
* Drive on\-site execution excellence with daily, weekly, and monthly progress tracking against approved schedules.
* Ensure zero\-defect construction through rigorous quality audits, mock\-ups, and third\-party inspections.
* Manage project schedules using CPM (Critical Path Method) and ensure milestone adherence with buffer management.
* Coordinate with all project stakeholders including PMC, contractors, consultants, RERA, and authorities.
* Implement site logistics planning for material procurement, storage, labor management, and equipment deployment.
* Drive HSE culture with zero\-accident goals, safety training, and compliance with local regulations.
* Ensure timely resolution of site issues, technical queries (RFIs), and design clarifications.
* Conduct regular site visits, client walkthroughs, and investor updates.
* Manage handover process including snagging, OC documentation, NOCs, and customer possession timelines.
* Training \& Capability Building
* Close skill gaps within the Development Strategy team through structured training programs.
* Enable external training exposure (NICMAR, RICS, PMI, LEED GA/AP) and certifications for team members.
* Foster dual\-role capability across team members to ensure business continuity and succession planning.
* Conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions on best practices, new technologies, and industry trends.
* Establish mentorship programs for junior team members and groom future project leaders.
* Drive talent retention through career development plans and performance\-linked rewards.
* Collaborate with HR to build competency frameworks and job role clarity for all project roles.
* Encourage participation in industry forums, conferences, and professional networks (CII, CREDAI, IGBC).
* Innovation \& Technology
* Drive SaaS adoption for project management, BIM, cost estimation, and collaboration tools (Procore, BIM 360, Cost X, etc.).
* Champion pilots of new materials, construction technologies (prefab, modular, 3D printing), and OPEX efficiency proposals.
* Establish innovation labs or pilot zones within projects to test new construction methods and materials.
* Leverage AI/ML for predictive analytics on schedule delays, cost overruns, and quality risks.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives including drone surveys, IoT sensors, and real\-time project monitoring.
* Collaborate with PropTech startups and industry bodies to stay ahead of innovation curves.
* Implement sustainability initiatives including green building certifications, energy\-efficient systems, and waste management.
* Establish a culture of continuous innovation with quarterly innovation showcases and awards.
* Stakeholder Management \& Reporting
* Provide strategic project updates to Board, Investors, and Senior Leadership on a monthly/quarterly basis.
* Manage relationships with key external stakeholders including GBA/BBMP, BDA, CMDA, Fire Department, RERA, and other statutory authorities.
* Coordinate with Sales \& Marketing teams to ensure project readiness aligns with sales launches and customer promises.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all project\-related escalations and issue resolution.
* Ensure seamless communication between design, execution, finance, legal, and customer\-facing teams.
* Manage customer expectations during construction and handover phases with regular updates and site visits.

title: CTRM - RightAngle | Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic**
 Our Regulatory, Risk \& Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level:** 
 Manager or equivalent
   

  

 As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead cross\-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Our Enterprise \& Operations Risk professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market\-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
   

  

 We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team
   

  

* Enable profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations.
* Leverage deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility, and remediation.
* Drive enterprise\- wide impact across strategy, operations, performance, and reputation.


**The team:**
 Our Commodity Trading \& Risk Management advisory practice solves our clients’ most complex issues and helps drive transformative changes to their supply, trading, and marketing organizations. We support our clients with advice related to physical and financial commodity market challenges through commercial \& risk advisory, quantitative analysis, technology and operational advisory services.
   

  

 Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. These services are organized into three capability areas \- Strategic Services, Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services, and Technology Services:
   

  

* Strategic Services help clients define fit\-for\-purpose operating models for their commodities, define the changes required to realize that vision, and develop a roadmap for execution
* Compliance, Risk \& Operational Services assess the existing compliance, risk, and operational processes of our clients leveraging proprietary tools to yield insights for improvement or optimization
* Technology Services deliver custom and package technology solutions that help our clients manage their commodity business and associated risk \& compliance exposures.
* Managers are responsible for setting goals that align with organizational objectives
* As a manager will focus on the management and delivery of client engagements, as well as sales and practice development.
* Managing multiple project budget, monitoring expenditure and costs as the project progresses.
* Facilitating the appointment of individuals to project teams.
* Provide deep subject matter expertise on CTRM Projects.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
**Functional Requirements –**
* 10 – 15 years of experience in business processes across Trading and Contract management, Physical Commodity Trading and their related financial derivatives, Scheduling, Mark to Market, Vars, Write on/Write offs, Inventory Management, Invoicing and Accounting.
* Familiarity with Pricing tools such as ZEMA
* Understanding of deal pricing and pricing strategies
* Understand End of day and End of Month processes for the month close. Understanding of the RA month close process and sequence of jobs to be run to facilitate month end.
* Familiarity with Right Angle Risk Management module. Understand hedging strategies and managed or supported Hedge/offset deals in Right Angle.
* Understanding of snapshots – intraday, end of day, weekly and monthly processes.


**Technical Requirements –**
* Good skills on SQL and .Net
* Have worked on or previously supported integration of Right Angle with other applications using.net class dll and WCF services.
* Leverage AzureDev Ops or similar deployment workflow for RA development and deployments
* Have worked on or have supported Right Angle version upgrades.
* Familiar with deployment of RightAngle enhancements and customizations.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies
* Worked on RightAngle version 15 or above.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university.
* MBA or related PG preferred


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Supplier Assurance Project Manager
description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Assurance Manager – Pacific (Australia and New Zealand)**
 ISS connects people and places to make the world work better. Are you ready to connect to a place where you belong? At our corporate facilities or at client sites – together, we make places while transforming businesses into having even more positive impact on societies, the environment, and our people.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Guindy, Chennai, India
   

  

**Language:** 
 English
   

  

**Main purpose of the position:**
 ISS is looking for dynamic individuals in the supply chain, risk and assurance function to drive CUSTOMER VALUE by securing assurance of subcontractors that provide compliance services to ISS.
   

  

 We’re delighted to be recruiting for a new Supply Chain Assurance Manager to join the ISS Procurement Excellence team. This role will be predominantly working with our Australia and New Zeeland team and Group Supply chain assurance team. Working with suppliers and subcontractors who are aligned with ISS and its customers’ values is critically important to us; the Supply Chain Assurance team drive supply chain compliance with ISS standards and policies on our key customer accounts. You will be responsible for supplier relationship management. Reporting to the Assistant General Manager of Supply Chain Assurance, you will play a key role in adding value to our customer accounts in the Australia and New Zealand, minimising risk exposure via the implementation, delivery, and reinforcement of supplier management processes.
   

  

 You will work cross\-functionally to ensure effective supplier management and strong relationships with both ISS functions and countries (Australia and New Zealand).
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Supplier Relationship Management: Ensure focus with material supplier(s), that delivery is consistent, aligned to scope and quality assured.
* Ensure supplier performance is monitored at defined intervals, and corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.
* Creation of supplier contracts with flow\-down terms and conditions for our material suppliers in Australia and New Zeeland providing services to Key Accounts \- liaising with the supplier, Country Legal, the ISS customer account management team and Country Procurement category teams where appropriate. Negotiate terms, pricing and set KPIs and manage the contracts through to signing.
* Work in collaboration with the Vetting team and group assurance team to ensure compliance for suppliers in the assurance programme
* Manage ‘material’ suppliers to complete any client specific requirements
* Conduct audit support activity – introduction meeting including presentation, pre\-audit documentation, collaborate with supplier to close gap closure items and submit relevant documentation for closure
* Management of action plans for our key customer accounts, to incorporate defined standards of compliance with the Group Supply Chain \& Procurement supplier assurance programme
* Managing and reporting on performance by all parties per supplier assurance activity
* Routinely re\-communicating the supplier assurance programme parameters and its importance to all stakeholders and securing their continued buy\-in
* Support as required for wider supplier assurance activities, Procurement Excellence projects, and Supply Chain \& Procurement objectives


**Ideal Candidate**
* Previous employment in Supply Chain Management, Supplier Assurance or Procurement (typically 5\+ years), or strong corporate background in other professional services within a large organisation
* Degree level education or professional qualification (e.g., CIPS) is highly desirable
* Demonstrable experience in stakeholder/relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen, with negotiation skills (experience of working with contracts is highly desirable)
* Organised, thorough, and diligent work ethic; a desire to take ownership of tasks and deadlines, executing activities without micromanagement


**Who you’ll work with:**
* Key Account Director / Key Operation Directors – ensure in first instance Compliance Services are managed effectively.
* Critical and Strategic Suppliers (Key contacts)
* Interact with senior ISS stakeholders in establishing a fact base for implementing and driving performance management of suppliers and subcontractors
* Interact with our customers to define, deliver, and update on the assurance progress and enable a risk
* Drive results through working with country procurement, operations organizations and subcontractor.


**Personal skills you excel:**
* On a personal level, you are structured and demonstrates energy, persistence, and determination in the implementation of projects and initiatives.
* You are diplomatic and persuasive and demonstrates good understanding of the general business principles.
* Moreover, you have great interpersonal skills in building relationship and networking with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Technical Services


**Why ISS**
 Since our founding in 1901, ISS has been a people\-first company. We recognize the power of diversity and celebrate the differences that make us unique. When everyone is free to be themselves, everyone benefits. Our people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves, allowing them to seize opportunities and reach their full potential. We take seriously our obligation to improve lives, make a difference in our communities, and protect our planet — because when we get things right, the world works better. And that is what drives us.
   

  

**ISS is a Place to Be You.**
 Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
   

  

 Become more.
 **Become ISS.**
**How You’ll Apply**
 Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.
   

  

**ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.**

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
   

  

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
