title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
About Lumibella Fashion

Lumibella Fashion has been serving customers with quality imitation and fashion jewellery since 2005\. We're looking for a hands\-on E\-commerce Manager to drive sales through our website and grow the brand's visibility across digital channels.

About the Role

We're hiring an **E\-commerce Manager** to take ownership of **lumibellafashion.co.in** from driving traffic to the site, to converting that traffic into sales, to keeping customers coming back. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can look at a website that isn't converting the way it should, figure out why, and fix it, while also running the day\-to\-day marketing that brings the right visitors in the door.

You'll work closely with the founder and have real input into the website experience, promotions, content, and marketing spend.

Core ResponsibilitiesWebsite Sales \& Conversion

* **Own website sales performance** — track daily/weekly numbers and be accountable for revenue generated through the site
* **Manage and improve the website** — homepage, product pages, cart, and checkout — to reduce drop\-off and improve the shopping experience
* **Improve conversion rate (CVR)** through better product photography, descriptions, pricing display, customer reviews, and a smoother checkout flow
* **Run A/B tests** on pricing, page layout, banners, and offers
* **Optimize for mobile**, since most jewellery shoppers browse and buy from their phones
* **Manage on\-site merchandising** — featured products, bundles, cross\-sells, and upsells
* **Set up and manage abandoned cart recovery, email/SMS flows, and retargeting** to recapture lost sales

Visibility \& Traffic Growth

* **Drive traffic to the website** through SEO, paid ads (Meta/Google/Instagram), influencer collaborations, and content
* **Manage performance marketing campaigns** — plan and run ad budgets across Meta, Google Shopping, and Instagram/Facebook
* **Grow organic visibility** — improve SEO (product titles, descriptions, blog content) and grow presence on Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest in ways that funnel followers to the website
* **Coordinate influencer and partnership collaborations** to reach new customers
* **Manage marketplace listings** (Amazon, Myntra, Meesho, etc., if relevant) as an additional channel alongside the website

Reporting \& Retention

* **Track and report on performance** — traffic, conversion rate, average order value, and repeat purchase rate — using Google Analytics and website/ad platform dashboards
* **Run email/SMS marketing and loyalty offers** to increase repeat purchases
* **Coordinate with operations/fulfillment** to make sure growing demand doesn't create delivery or stock issues

What We're Looking For

* 2–4 years in e\-commerce, digital marketing, or online sales roles — ideally for a D2C, fashion, jewellery, or lifestyle brand
* Hands\-on experience managing a website/online store (Shopify or similar) and driving sales through it
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, basic SEO, and email/SMS marketing tools (e.g., Klaviyo, Mailchimp)
* Comfortable reading data and reports to guide day\-to\-day decisions
* Organized and self\-driven — able to manage multiple channels and priorities at once
* Good communication skills; able to work closely with the founder

Nice to Have

* Experience specifically in jewellery, accessories, or fashion e\-commerce
* Familiarity with the Indian D2C market and platforms like Shopify, Myntra, Meesho, or Amazon India
* Experience with influencer or affiliate marketing
* Basic design sense (Canva/Figma) for ad creative and website banners

Why Join Lumibella

* Direct access to and collaboration with the founder
* Room to grow into a larger leadership role as the business scales

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in seo ?
* Are you currently located in Chennai?

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Direct Payments
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations**
 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.
   

  

 We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions.
* Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi\-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
* Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
* Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
* Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of the scheme integration.


**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**
* Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
+ 8\+ years in the workforce with ideally 5\+ years in product management or product\-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3\+ years in a senior product manager role

* A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
* Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
* Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
* A strong track record shipping customer\-facing products end\-to\-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade\-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with payment scheme integrations
* Experience in fintech or a high\-growth tech company.
* The ability to write SQL
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Procurement Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.
   

  

 Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
* Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross\-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
* Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
* Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
* Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
* Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
* Manage cross\-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
* Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision\-making.
* Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
* Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional team environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
* Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

 What You Bring to the Team

* Strong hands\-on experience with EAM / ERP systems (SAP PM preferred; Maximo a plus)

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree with 3\-6 years of relevant experience in clinical research, study operations, or clinical trial management

* Proficiency in MS Office applications including Project, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel

title: Director of Product
description:
**Director of Product** 




 AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform
 



**Reports to** 
 Chief Product Officer
 



**Location** 
 Mumbai
 



**Function** 
 Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)
 



  





**Why this role, why now?** 




 Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.
 



 Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co\-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two\-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign\-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go\-to\-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.
 



 You will move between whiteboarding high\-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.
 



  





**What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap** 




 • Co\-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign\-off end to end.
 



 • Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post\-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day\-0 and Day\-1 user journey.
 



 • Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.
 



  





**Team and craft** 




 • Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.
 



 • Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.
 



 • Coach high\-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.
 



**Enterprise commercials and offtake** 




 • Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.
 



 • Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.
 



 • Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.
 



**Platform economics** 




 • Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.
 



 • Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first\-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.
 



  





**What you bring?** 




 • Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands\-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large\-scale cloud or general\-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.
 



 • A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.
 



 • Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.
 



 • Working command of multi\-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air\-gapped clusters and customer\-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.
 



 • Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.
 



  





**How you work?** 




 • You zoom out to market positioning and a two\-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.
 



 • You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.
 



 • You are a low\-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.
 



 • You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.
 



  





**Your first 90 days** 




 • Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.
 



 • Land the near\-term Velocis milestones with clean telemetry on adoption and stability.
 



 • Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go\-to\-market that delivers predictably.
 



  





**Success in the first 6 to 12 months** 




 • Roadmap predictability and release velocity, with the Velocis milestones shipped and instrumented for adoption and reliability.
 



 • Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.
 



 • Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.
 



 • Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.
 



 • A high\-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Senior Manager \- Technical Diligence \& Project Controls \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



  





 Read a site badly at diligence and the error is baked into the underwriting for the life of the asset. Read it well and the deal either improves or dies early, the cheapest outcome available. The same scepticism, pointed at a contractor's programme, tells you whether the date on it is real. Pointed at a running bill, it tells you whether we are paying for work that exists.
 



  





 Vantrock currently buys all of that judgement from consultants, one assignment at a time, with nobody inside who can mark their work. The pipeline is 10 million sq ft and ground breaks on the first 2 million in January 2027\. From that point the platform is running acquisitions and construction at once, and whoever can walk a site in the morning and take apart a Primavera file in the afternoon becomes the most useful person in the room.
 



  





 This is the technical seat in the Enterprise Programme Management Office. The other two seats hold the portfolio and the governance. You hold the ground truth underneath both, and you hold it across the whole life of an asset rather than at one gate.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




  





 Before we buy
 



 \- Technical pre\-diligence on every site under consideration. Ground, levels and cut\-fill, approach and access, power availability and distance to source, water, drainage and outfall, existing structures, and every physical constraint that changes what can be built there. Your output goes into the underwriting as a technical view with the assumptions stated.
 



 \- The buildability and cost\-shape read. Not a BOQ, a judgement: what makes this site expensive and where the foundation cost goes. Early, rough and honest beats late and precise.
 



 \- Development potential against the authority's rules. What MIDC, HSIIDC, KIADB or the local DCR actually permit on this parcel, and what that does to the yield the model assumes.
 



  





**While we design and build** 




 \- Design and specification review. Read what the architect and the consultants propose against what actually builds, and against the Vantrock specification, before it becomes a tender.
 



 \- Tender and rate scrutiny. Rate analysis, comparative statements and the technical read on a bid. You can look at a rate and say whether it is real.
 



 \- Programme review and claims. Take apart the contractor's and the PMC's programmes on critical path, float, sequencing and resource loading, and report what is real. Assess extension\-of\-time claims on their technical merits. A programme that has never been challenged is a wish.
 



 \- Technical validation on site. Running bills, measurement, quality and progress against the drawings. What you certify is technical. The money is finance's, and the two of you reconcile weekly.
 



  





**Through handover and after** 




 \- The technical close\-out. Snagging, defect liability, warranties and the as\-built record, so the asset arrives at operations in a state somebody can run.
 



 \- The occupier's technical requirements. Floor loading, flatness, power, fire and insurer conditions, read against what the building gives, so leasing and the tenant's fit\-out are not negotiating against a surprise.
 



 \- The physical record. Site visits captured properly and put into Vantrock Intelligence, so the platform's memory of a site does not live in one person's phone.
 



  





**Across all of it** 




 \- Command of technical partners. Geotechnical agencies, surveyors, TDD firms, third\-party inspection and PMCs. You brief them, hold them to a standard and mark their output. You never take a report on trust because it arrived on letterhead.
 



  





 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 



  





 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into technical due diligence, lender's independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



  





 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted writes a view that nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



  





 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which sites, what your scope was, what the ground turned out to be and what it cost to deal with.
 



  





 QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \- A full\-time B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. This one is not negotiable and no other discipline substitutes.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification is a strong plus rather than a requirement: NICMAR (ACM, APM or the QSCM diploma), RICS School of Built Environment, an IIT or NIT M.Tech in structural, geotechnical or construction engineering, and the NMIMS MBA (Tech.) in Civil Engineering with Operations Management. An MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage. Chartered or professional standing \- MRICS, Institution of Engineers (India), a valuer's registration, IGBC or LEED \- is read as evidence that you write to a standard someone else audits.
 



  





 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 



  





 This is the part of the seat that cannot be learned on the job here, so we will test it directly, on a real drawing set and a real soil report.
 



  





 \- Ground and land form. Borelogs, SPT data, safe bearing capacity, settlement, water table, ground\-improvement options and what each one costs. Contours, cut and fill, approach gradients, and survey output read rather than taken on trust. You know what to specify to a geotechnical agency before they mobilise.
 



 \- Codes and authorities. IS 456, 800, 875 and 1893, the National Building Code, and the development control and industrial authority rules that bind a site.
 



 \- Warehousing and industrial specifics. Pre\-engineered buildings, portal frames, purlins and bracing, crane gantries, floor loading and flatness to the occupier's standard, fire strategy and sprinkler implications on the layout, and what an insurer's engineering requirements do to a design.
 



 \- Services and enabling. HT power, sanctioned load, distance to substation and what the discom will and will not do. Water source, sewage treatment, storm water outfall and where it legally goes.
 



 \- Cost. BOQ, rate analysis, running account bills, variation orders, escalation, retention and defect liability.
 



 \- Programme. Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project at critical\-path, float and resource\-loading level, with extension\-of\-time claims assessed on merit. Essential in this seat specifically, because reading a programme against physical reality is the job.
 



 \- Drawings. GFC review, structural and services coordination, and BIM clash detection at a level where you know what the model is hiding.
 



 \- Writing. A technical report a lender's credit committee or an investment committee can act on: findings, assumptions, quantified impact and a recommendation you will stand behind. Plus advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 \- Platforms. Microsoft Project at working level, plus a background working in SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online. We will ask which one, what you did in it and what it could not do.
 



  





 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \- 8 to 12 years, the majority of it on or around sites rather than in a design office.
 



 \- At least three years on technical due diligence, independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring work. Not delivery with a diligence assignment attached once.
 



 \- Sites assessed across greenfield land and built assets both. Assessing only completed buildings is half the seat.
 



 \- A report a lender, an investment committee or a buyer relied on to price or to walk away, and which held up afterwards.
 



 \- One constraint you found that nobody else had, and what it changed. This is the question the whole interview turns on.
 



 \- Specialist agencies instructed and marked, not merely coordinated.
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 \- Not delivery or EPC, and not design. Execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled. You review what is proposed, you do not draw it and you do not build to it.
 



 \- Not the deal, and not portfolio governance. Investments owns underwriting and the register sits with the EPMO Lead. You supply the technical view into both, and you are expected to supply it even when it kills the deal.
 



 \- Not project accounting. Budget, forecast and variance sit with finance.
 



  





 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



  





 Deliberately small, no departments. Survey, soil investigation, third\-party inspection and measurement all go to specialist agencies. What stays inside is the judgement about whether their work is any good and what it means for the money. Expect to be on site most weeks, and expect your written view to be read by the founder, the investment committee and, in time, by lenders.
 



  





 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 



  





 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive it, route it and report on it. You walk the site yourself, brief the geotechnical agency yourself, take the drone output apart yourself and write the report in your own hand. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.

title: Clinical Trial Manager - SCP
description:
**Description**
 Clinical Trial Manager \- SCP
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
   

  

 Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
* 7\+ years of onsite clinical monitoring experience
* Good experience of Site selection, site initiation, and site activation
* Client Office based opportunity in Mumbai
* Should be able to act as the primary point of contact for sites
* Strong oncology experience is mandatory
* Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close\-out visits (performed on\-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH\-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiologic Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site\-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes, conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records, verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete, applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines, utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture, verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
* May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
* For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site\-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
* May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project\-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs Chart Abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff.


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 Roles within the Clinical Trial Management job family are responsible for overseeing the development, coordination, and implementation of Phase 1 clinical research studies at the organization's facilities. Individuals in these roles collaborate closely with the principal investigator, serve as liaisons between research subjects, client teams, investigators, and clinic operations teams, and meticulously plan logistics and resource usage. These roles require tracking study progress in alignment with project milestones, client deliverables, and budget, while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations globally and by region. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Individual contributor with developing subject matter expertise and responsibility for processes. In\-depth knowledge and skills within a professional discipline, understanding the impact of work on related areas. May be responsible for entire projects or processes within area of responsibility.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Client** 




 Our client is a global leading, end\-to\-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not\-for\-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.
 



  





**About Teamified** 




 Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-
 



 scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and
 



 accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high
 



 performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,
 



 designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 We're looking for a mid\-level Product Manager to join us in working directly
 



 with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer\-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform\-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs



  





**What you bring** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade\-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data\-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback



  





**Why this role matters** 




 This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.
 



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity

title: Business Architect
description:
**Business Architect** 




**Location:** 
 Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India
 



**Work Arrangement:** 
 On\-site
 



**Contract:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About GCRS Group** 




 GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy working across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.
 



 As GCRS continues to expand across international markets and strengthen its technology, digital products and operational capabilities, we are seeking a
 **Business Architect** 
 to help shape the way the organization operates and grows.
 



 This position sits at the intersection of business strategy, operations and technology. The successful candidate will examine how different functions work together, identify opportunities for improvement and help create practical structures that support the company's long\-term objectives.
 



 This role offers an opportunity to work on genuine business challenges, influence decision\-making and contribute to the development of processes and systems that can support GCRS as it scales.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The Business Architect will work with management and teams across regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product functions to understand business priorities and translate them into workable solutions.
 



 You will examine existing processes, systems and operating models, challenge areas that are no longer effective and help design better ways of working.
 



 Some projects may involve technology implementation or digital transformation, while others may focus on organisational structure, workflow design, process improvement or business planning. The ability to understand the wider business context while paying attention to operational details will be important.
 



 This is a practical role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems and can move confidently between strategic conversations and detailed process discussions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Review existing business processes and workflows to understand what is working well and where teams may be facing unnecessary delays, duplication or inefficiencies.
 



 • Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives and turn those objectives into clear, realistic and actionable requirements.
 



 • Help develop business architecture frameworks and operating models that support the company's current needs while allowing room for future growth.
 



 • Look for practical ways to improve productivity, reduce manual work and make business processes easier to manage and scale.
 



 • Map key business functions, processes, capabilities and information flows to create a clear picture of how different areas of the organisation connect.
 



 • Work with management to convert broader business strategies into structured initiatives, priorities and implementation plans.
 



 • Identify gaps between the way a process works today and what the business will need in the future as GCRS expands.
 



 • Prepare clear business requirements for software, digital transformation and technology\-related projects.
 



 • Work closely with software developers, AI engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure that technology solutions address genuine business requirements.
 



 • Contribute to the development and improvement of digital products and technology\-enabled services offered by GCRS.
 



 • Assess existing processes and systems and recommend where technology could make operations more efficient or improve the client experience.
 



 • Explore opportunities to introduce automation and AI where they can deliver meaningful improvements rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
 



 • Create process maps, workflows, business models and functional requirements that can be easily understood by both business and technical teams.
 



 • Understand how changes to one business function or system may affect other departments, processes, data or client\-facing activities.
 



 • Support teams in designing and introducing new processes that are practical, clearly documented and easy for employees to adopt.
 



 • Help GCRS build scalable operating structures that can support increasing clients, services, markets and internal teams.
 



 • Review business performance and operational information to identify areas where processes, resources or systems could be improved.
 



 • Prepare business cases, recommendations and supporting analysis for new projects, systems and strategic initiatives.
 



 • Help management assess and prioritise business and technology projects based on their potential value, urgency, complexity and business impact.
 



 • Bring relevant stakeholders together to clarify project objectives, define scope and ensure that expectations are aligned before implementation begins.
 



 • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams, helping both sides understand requirements, limitations and expected outcomes.
 



 • Identify operational risks, process gaps and areas where the current way of working may create challenges as the business grows.
 



 • Support the implementation of new processes and help teams adapt to changes in systems, technology and ways of working.
 



 • Maintain clear documentation covering business processes, requirements, workflows, operating models and key business decisions.
 



 • Review the results of implemented solutions and recommend further improvements where the expected business outcomes have not been fully achieved.
 



 • Keep up to date with developments in AI, automation, digital transformation and modern business architecture practices that could be relevant to GCRS.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in understanding how businesses function and how they can operate more effectively.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable asking challenging questions, examining information from different sources and developing a clear view of a problem before recommending a solution.
 



 The position requires someone who can understand the priorities of senior management while remaining close enough to day\-to\-day operations to recognise practical issues that may otherwise be overlooked.
 



 Commercial awareness, sound judgement and the ability to communicate clearly will matter as much as technical knowledge.
 



 We are looking for a person who can connect
 **business strategy, operational requirements and technology** 
 without losing sight of the people who ultimately use the processes and systems.
 



  





**Essential Experience and Skills** 




 • A degree or professional background in business architecture, business analysis, consulting, strategy, operations, information systems or a related discipline.
 



 • Strong knowledge of business processes, organisational structures and operating models, with the ability to assess how they function in practice.
 



 • Proven capability in gathering requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, meetings and process reviews.
 



 • A structured approach to analysing complex problems and breaking them into manageable areas for action.
 



 • Confidence in documenting business processes and explaining them clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
 



 • Practical knowledge of workflow design, process mapping and requirements documentation.
 



 • An understanding of how technology systems support business activities and how changes in one area can affect others.
 



 • The ability to collaborate effectively with people from different departments, levels of seniority and professional backgrounds.
 



 • Skill in converting business needs into clear functional requirements that development or implementation teams can act upon.
 



 • Familiarity with digital transformation concepts and the role technology can play in changing established business models.
 



 • Working knowledge of project delivery and organisational change, particularly where new systems or processes are being introduced.
 



 • A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to recognise inefficiencies and propose realistic improvements.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
 



 • Strong organisational skills for managing multiple initiatives, stakeholder discussions and competing priorities.
 



 • Commercial understanding of how operational decisions affect cost, efficiency, customer experience and business growth.
 



  





**Desirable Experience** 




 • Exposure to management consulting, strategic advisory or business transformation projects can provide useful experience for this position.
 



 • Familiarity with AI and automation initiatives will help when assessing opportunities to modernise existing workflows.
 



 • Knowledge of business process management platforms can assist with analysing and redesigning complex operational activities.
 



 • Experience with CRM, ERP or other enterprise business systems.
 



 • Participation in digital transformation programmes and knowledge of enterprise architecture.
 



 • Familiarity with BPMN or another recognised process\-modelling methodology
 



 • Experience preparing transformation roadmaps or investment proposals.
 



 • Exposure to data, reporting and analytics projects.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 GCRS is entering an exciting phase of growth, with increasing international activity alongside investment in technology, AI and digital capabilities.
 



 The Business Architect will have the opportunity to work across multiple areas of the organisation rather than being restricted to a single department or system.
 



 The candidate will gain direct exposure to management and collaborate with regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product teams. The role is particularly suited to someone who wants to build something rather than simply maintain an existing structure. As the company's technology and operating capabilities develop, there will be scope to take on greater responsibility across business transformation, strategy and technology.
 



  





**Important** 




 This is a
 **fully on\-site role** 
 based at the GCRS office in
 **Hapur, Uttar Pradesh.** 
 Candidates must be willing to work from the Hapur office
 **five days a week** 
 .

title: Program Manager, Customer Experience
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 The Program Manager, Customer Experience will build and scale the programs that make Sprinto's customer journey more predictable, efficient, and valuable, by identifying friction across handoffs, onboarding, implementation, adoption, support, renewal, and expansion, and turning these into cross\-functional programs with clear owners, operating cadence, metrics, and measurable business impact. In parallel, you will directly own deployments for some of our largest enterprise customers, acting as the project lead to drive successful onboarding and time\-to\-value, while using these engagements as a ground\-level lens into customer challenges to inform scalable systems, playbooks, and improvements. This is a high\-ownership IC role for someone who combines strong stakeholder management, structured execution, data fluency, and customer empathy, and can move seamlessly between delivering outcomes for individual customers and improving the overall customer experience at scale.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Identify friction across the customer journey — using both data and firsthand experience from enterprise deployments — and translate it into scoped, measurable CX programs.
* Own end\-to\-end project management for deployments of key enterprise customers, driving onboarding, implementation, and time\-to\-value.
* Build and run program structures: plans, governance cadences, risk tracking, decision frameworks, and launch readiness
* Align Sales, Solutions, CS, Support, Product, Engineering, and Ops on ownership, tooling, and execution.
* Define and track program success through dashboards, business reviews, and KPI frameworks tied to customer outcomes.
* Convert repeat customer scenarios into standardized playbooks, documentation, and enablement assets.
* Prioritise improvements using customer feedback, onboarding data, support signals, and deployment learnings.
* Drive adoption of new processes and systems through strong change management.
* Provide leadership with clear updates, trade\-offs, and visibility into progress, risks, and blockers.


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 2\-5 years in Program Management, Customer Success Operations, Service Delivery, Implementations, Business Operations, or a similar cross\-functional role in B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience leading complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong operator mindset: able to move from ambiguous problem statement to charter, milestones, owners, metrics, and launch plan.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and working teams alike.
* Data fluency with Excel / Google Sheets and strong comfort with dashboards, KPI design, and operational analysis; SQL / BI skills are a plus.
* Experience improving customer lifecycle motions such as onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, handoffs, or enablement.
* High ownership and change\-management capability: can influence without formal authority and drive adoption across teams.


**Good to Have :**
* Experience in Customer Experience, Customer Success, RevOps, or post\-sales functions of a high\-growth SaaS company.
* Exposure to CRM / CX / support / project systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, Gainsight / Totango / Planhat, Jira / Asana, Zendesk / Freshdesk, and BI tools.
* Background in security, compliance, IT operations, or another domain with structured workflows and heavy cross\-functional coordination.
* Formal program or project management training/certifications are good to have, but not required.


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Applied Value Engineer -CPGR / CMT - NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a Lead Applied Value Engineer, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)—an industry expert who can bridge the gap between technical process mining and strategic business outcomes. You will act as an architect for critical work\-streams within a major CPG account, translating complex operational data into clear value drivers.
   

  

 As a Lead Value Engineer, you are a go\-to execution expert within our CPG go\-to\-market organization. You will move beyond standard process optimization to link Celonis capabilities to key outcomes specific to fast\-moving consumer goods operations.
   

  

 You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end\-to\-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor, helping them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform.
   

  

 In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set and strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest\-growing tech companies worldwide.
   

  

**The work you’ll do:**
**Identify \& Frame Value**
* Translate Strategy to Operations: Analyze the client’s strategic priorities (e.g., Omnichannel Growth, Margin Protection, Supply Chain Agility, and Sustainability) and map them to high\-impact Celonis use cases.
* Target High\-Impact Areas: Architect solutions that connect data across the value chain—moving beyond simple task automation to optimizing complex ecosystems like Demand Planning, Trade Promotions Management (TPM), Logistics, and Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) fulfillment.
* Build the Business Case: Construct robust, data\-backed business cases that articulate the financial and operational impact of Process Intelligence (e.g., reducing Cost of Goods Sold, optimizing working capital, or improving On\-Time In\-Full \[OTIF] delivery) to senior management.
* Win Expansion: Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new expansion opportunities.
* Assess Value: Undertake Value Assessments or Proof\-of\-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C\-Level executives.


**Realize Value**
* Drive Engagement Success: Lead the value workstream for pilots and implementations, ensuring the digital twin strategy effectively monitors process health in fast\-paced, high\-volume retail and consumer environments.
* Orchestrate Improvement: Guide customers on how to use Celonis to provide context to their AI agents, coordinating hand\-offs between systems and teams in Order\-to\-Cash, Source\-to\-Pay, and Plan\-to\-Produce.
* Solve Systemic Challenges: Work cross\-functionally to tackle difficult implementation hurdles, helping customers define standards for Retailer Compliance, master data governance, or supply network visibility.
* Facilitate Workshops: Run business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement.
* Initiate Change: Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise\-wide change initiatives.
* Present Results: Present results and realized value to senior management and C\-level executives.


**Scale Value**
* Codify Best Practices: Turn our solutions into reusable assets and use cases for the broader Value Engineering team.
* Mentor \& Enable: Act as a senior resource for the team, helping junior engineers understand CPG terminology, seasonality nuances, and retail stakeholder management.
* Product Feedback: Serve as a bridge between the customer and our Product teams, providing specific feedback on how to enhance our platform for the CPG vertical (e.g., specific requirements for Trade Spend visibility or SKU Rationalization).
* Manage the Journey: Responsible for the end\-to\-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption, and renewing.
* Build Roadmaps: Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization.
* Drive Innovation: Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases.


**The qualifications you need:**
* Deep Industry Experience: 8\+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Supply Chain, or Operations, ideally combining time at a CPG/FMCG company with Management Consulting or Sales Engineering.
* Domain Expertise: You possess granular knowledge of the CPG value chain, specifically in areas such as Demand \& Supply Planning, Logistics, Trade Promotions, or Consumer/Retail Operations.
* Growth Mindset: Proven track record of managing the full customer lifecycle, with a demonstrated ability to land new accounts, expand footprint through strategic upselling, and drive long\-term value to ensure high retention and organic advocacy.
* Value Realization Skills: You have a track record of identifying operational inefficiencies and driving them to resolution. You understand how to impact the P\&L through process improvement and technology deployment.
* Technical Fluency: Good knowledge of Business Software/SaaS applications (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP IBP), and experience with data visualization, SQL, or Python is a strong plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Experience presenting to and working with senior stakeholders. You can navigate complex internal structures and clearly communicate value to non\-technical audiences.
* Builder Mentality: You are comfortable working with ambiguity and setting your own direction within an account team to achieve the best results.
* Degree: Degree in Industrial/Business Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Informatics, Mathematics, or similar.


**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70\-20\-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well\-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion \& Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value\-Driven Impact: Join a mission\-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. description:

 Space Technology
 



  





**About Catalyx Space:** 




 Catalyx Space is building the world's best reentry systems. Our reusable ReX vehicles return payloads from orbit at unprecedented scale, up to 12 tons and 60m³ of cargo, while operating the full mission lifecycle from launch to recovery. Our core innovation is a Origami\-inspired deployable heat shield that combines the scalability of an inflatable system with the robustness of a rigid structure.  You will establish and run the program cadence that keeps approximately 40 engineers aligned toward common vehicle milestones and serve as the source of truth for engineering program status, schedule, risks, dependencies, and forecast dates.
 



 This is a hands\-on program leadership role requiring a strong understanding of complex hardware development and the ability to drive cross\-functional execution from design through build, integration, testing, and flight readiness.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Build and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule across engineering subsystems, with clearly defined dependencies and critical paths to major milestones

* Run the weekly engineering program review covering commitments, progress, blockers, actions, risks, and escalations
* Maintain the program risk register with clear owners, mitigation plans, and closure criteria
* Manage change control across subsystems so engineering changes are reflected in schedules, dependencies, and program risks
* Track milestone status and provide forecast dates, assumptions, dependencies, and risks to leadership
* Establish and maintain lightweight program\-management tools, workflows, and reporting systems that engineering teams actively use
* Work closely with subsystem leads and engineering leadership to drive actions to closure and maintain alignment against vehicle\-level milestones



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline
* 8–12 years of experience in hardware engineering or engineering program management
* At least 5 years of experience managing an integrated hardware\-development program involving multiple engineering subsystem owners
* Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, re\-entry systems, UAVs, defense systems, automotive new\-product development, or similarly complex electromechanical hardware
* Demonstrated ability to build an integrated engineering schedule from first principles
* Experience managing dependencies across design, procurement, manufacturing, integration, and test
* Experience tracking long\-lead procurement, vendor deliveries, and test campaigns against hardware milestones
* Experience running structured engineering reviews and driving actions to closure
* Experience maintaining and managing technical or program risk registers
* Strong understanding of hardware\-development lifecycles and cross\-functional engineering dependencies
* Strong written and verbal communication skills



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Experience at ISRO, DRDO, HAL, a defense prime, new\-space company, or similar hardware organization
* Experience taking hardware through a complete design\-build\-test\-flight or design\-build\-test\-delivery cycle
* Familiarity with systems\-engineering practices including requirements management, interface control, verification, and validation
* Experience with Asana, Jira, MS Project, or comparable project/program\-management tools
* Experience working directly with senior engineers and technical leads to track commitments and escalate schedule or technical risks when required
