title: SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.

With a strong client base, Vimson Derma works with over 200 companies across India.
 



  





**The Role:**

The Production Head will be responsible for production planning, manpower management, process optimization, capacity utilization, and achieving production targets through effective leadership of Production Supervisors and cross\-functional coordination.

title: EBDG - Power Sales & Trading- Senior Manager
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Team Lead \- Sales, Billing and Licence**


**Tender Analysis and Participation:**



Analyze monthly tender data from state\-wise utilities to understand requirements and plan for participation.



Assess available capacity based on quarterly and yearly Operations and Maintainence (O\&M) projections.



Review tender terms and conditions, identify risk factors, and highlight them for management review.



Float approval notes to the management for tender participation as per the Delegation of Authority (DOA).



Manage one\-time registration for new plants on online portals and handle payments for participation.



Address clarifications from utilities and update management on critical points via email.



Coordinate with the Company Secretary for board resolutions required for tender participation.



Oversee the technical and financial bid qualification process, including support for Ernest Money Deposit (EMD) and Bank Guarantee (BG) submissions.



Monitor reverse auction proceedings, perform competitor analysis, and make strategic decisions based on market intelligence.



Prepare and submit Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) drafted by team members for accuracy and compliance.



Communicate effectively with utilities regarding any clarifications and maintain meticulous records of these communications.


**Open Access Management:**



Manage short\-term open access contracts, ensuring compliance with buyer agreements and utility requirements.



Coordinate with utilities to determine the mode of power take\-off, whether under General Network Access (GNA) or Temporary General Network Access (TGNA).



Conduct continuous contract monitoring from the start of the power supply, ensuring customer power off\-take aligns with contract.



General Network Access (GNA) Contracts



Verify delivery points and create contracts based on the receiving substations' requirements.



Create and approve contracts on the Web\-Based Scheduling (WBS) platform and ensure RLDC approval for power flow commencement.



Temeporary General Network Access (TGNA) Contracts



Apply for power flow applications through the National Open Access Registry (NOAR).



Ensure applications are submitted within the stipulated timelines and that Regional Load Dispatch Center (RLDC) approvals are diligently pursued and received.


**Contract Monitoring:**



Monitor daily power off\-take by buyers and record data accurately in the system.



Notify buyers promptly if off\-take falls below the contracted 85% threshold.



Ensure uniformity in off\-take patterns and manage communication with buyers accordingly.



Request power requirements from buyers two days before execution and coordinate accordingly.


**Collective Transactions:**



Manage daily bidding activities on Indian Energy Exchange for collective transactions.



Coordinate availability confirmation from plants on Day\-2 and Day\-1\.



Optimize trading strategies based on market dynamics and trade analysis reports from ELECOR.



Facilitate direct negotiations with buyers to secure premium rates and ensure timely trade execution.



Supervise Real\-Time Market (RTM), Day Ahead Market (DAM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM) activities as per market conditions.


**Long Duration Contracts:**



Facilitate the submission and management of long\-duration contracts on exchanges, ensuring compliance with timelines and commitments.



Participate in reverse auctions, monitor competing bids, and strategize to secure optimal rates.



Coordinate with buyers for prompt confirmation post\-auction and manage power flow commencement timelines.


**MIS Management:**



Generate and circulate MIS reports to CEO and senior management, detailing power sales, revenue generated, and plant\-wise performance.



Compile monthly trading analytics and sales reports across bilateral, term ahead, day ahead, and real\-time markets.



Provide insights for future planning and decision\-making based on exchange market performance.


**Energy Trading (Power Sales to other Adani Group Companies):**



Facilitate the purchase of power from wind and solar generators, acting as an intermediary to supply power to other Adani Group companies such as AEML, consumer products, ports, and Ambuja Cement.



Negotiate terms and conditions to establish contracts that meet the needs of both the power generators (sellers) and the end clients (buyers).



Benchmark industry rates to inform pricing decisions and finalize contracts based on competitive market analysis.



Customize standardized contracts to accommodate deviations on a case\-by\-case basis, ensuring all parties' interests are addressed.



Oversee the uploading of contracts onto the system for digital signing by the power generators.



Manage applications on State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) portals for each power agreement, coordinating agreements by substations as needed.



Evaluate tender terms and conditions, identify potential risks, and seek necessary amendments or clarifications to ensure compliance and favorable contract terms.



Lead the bidding process on buyer\-floated tenders, assessing the viability and risks involved.



Secure bank guarantees (BG) and board resolutions through the finance team, and manage the payment of fees to the Power Finance Corporation (PFC).



Monitor reverse auction proceedings and make strategic decisions based on competitor analysis and market intelligence.



Coordinate with utilities for the issuance of Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) for accuracy and compliance.



Act as a liaison between the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) , power generators, and buyers, resolving any queries that arise during contract formation.



Circulate the No Objection Certificate (NOC) provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to all parties, ensuring clear communication and agreement on contract terms.



Manage financial transactions between the generator and the buyer, including the issuance of invoices and the processing of payments, while ensuring margins are accounted for.



Handle the credit notes provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to the respective generator based on the power generation amount.



Raise invoices to the buyer based on consumption units as per the group credit note (GCN) and manage the payment process, deducting AEL's margins before paying the generator.


**Energy Trading (Power Sales of other Adani Group Companies):**



Manage daily forecasting for power generation from other Adani Companies such as Adani Green and execute contracts based on agreed terms and conditions, ensuring a smooth contractual process.



Sign power agreements digitally on a daily basis under a blanket contract with defined trading margins, and make informed decisions regarding the inclusion of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) in sales.



Oversee and facilitate the power flow from green energy sources to final buyers, handling invoice processes and transaction settlements accordingly.



Analyze market trends for Day Ahead Market (DAM) and Green DAM, deciding on the most favorable strategy for selling Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).



Prepare comprehensive monthly trading reports detailing all green energy transactions and perform ongoing registration tasks for buyers and generators on national exchanges.


**Exchange Bidding and Monitoring:**



Monitor residual power for daily bidding in the Indian Energy Exchange across various markets: Day Ahead Market (DAM), Real\-Time Market (RTM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM).



Analyze the best times to sell energy for premium rates and coordinate with buyers for one\-to\-one trades.



Observe market dynamics to capitalize on opportunities for obtaining premium rates.



Manage contingency trading in the RTM and ensure bids are placed within capacity limits.



Track bid validity, contract acceptance, and power flow commencement for long\-duration contracts on the exchange.



Supervise long\-duration contract applications, assess buyer confirmations, and monitor completion of reverse auctions for price setting.



Engage in Real\-Time Market trading as required to manage any unfavorable circumstances which necessitate the buy or sale of power at short notice.



Create detailed sales analytics and allocation reports to aid in future planning and inform the strategic division of power sales channels across bilateral contracts and exchange markets.



Ensure timely completion of all contract performance guarantees and manage follow\-ups for power supply commencement.



Manage the distribution of MIS reports to the management, detailing revenue generated, power sold, contract participation, and power availability insights.


**Digitization and Automation:**



Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimise operational efficiency



Implement automation solutions to support overall organisational goals / strategy


**People and Team Management:**



Foster a constructive team environment, managing team performance, and driving initiatives for continuous development and departmental excellence.



Ensure that all team members are aligned with the business strategy, promoting a culture of innovation and response to changes.



Manage team performance, driving initiatives for continuous development, and ensuring departmental excellence in line with business strategy.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**



Adani Green, AEML, Cement, Wilmur, Ports



Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) Team



Finance Team



Legal Team



Technical ServicesTeam



Fuel Management Team


**Key Stakeholders \- External**



State and Regional Utilities



SLDC



RLDC



Energy Exchange Platforms



Direct Consumers of Energy


### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**



B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, related field), Additional Degrees or Cetifications (Energy management, Business Administration, related field) preferred


**Work Experience (Range of years):**



Minimum 6 years of experience in power trading negotiations, contract management, or related role.


**Preferred Industry:**



Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power trading mechanisms, policy landscapes and renewable energy trading.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job title: Monitoring \& Management Product Manager**
**Job summary:**
 The Monitoring \& Management Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption and operational success of a global portfolio of vendor software platforms used to remotely monitor and manage audio visual (AV) and workplace technology devices. The role ensures these platforms provide reliable telemetry, actionable alerts, remote support capabilities and useful operational insights that improve service quality and the technology\-based office experience.
   

  

 The Product Manager will work with Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Service Management, other product teams and technology vendors to translate business and operational needs into product capabilities. The role will guide platform selection and lifecycle decisions, establish support and governance models, drive integrations and automation, and measure the business value delivered by the portfolio.
   

  

**Key responsibilities (analytical/decision making/supervisory):**
* Own the global product strategy and multi\-year roadmap for AV telemetry, monitoring and remote management platforms.
* Lead proofs of concept and pilots; define success criteria, evaluate results and make evidence\-based recommendations for production adoption.
* Gather and prioritize requirements from Operations, Engineering, product teams and other stakeholders, balancing service value, effort, risk and cost.
* Manage the product lifecycle for assigned platforms, including evaluation, selection, onboarding, enhancement, integration, adoption, operational transition and retirement.
* Define platform standards for device onboarding, data consistency, health states, alerts, notifications, remote actions, and role\-based access.
* Drive integration with enterprise service management, event management, asset data, analytics and reporting capabilities to create and support automated workflows and improve leadership decision making.
* Establish service definitions for in\-scope platforms, ensure operational readiness requirements are met, integrate new platforms into PCD runbooks and Operations SOPs.
* Develop product KPIs and report on platform coverage, reliability, alert quality, adoption, automation, operational outcomes, cost and realized value.
* Ensure adequacy of on\-premise platform infrastructure, including server capacity, back\-up procedures, etc.
* Analyze telemetry and operational data to identify recurring issues, false positives, monitoring gaps and opportunities for proactive remediation or continuous improvement; collaborate with Operations to raise ITIL problems as appropriate.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, licensing and service reviews; communicate EY requirements and influence vendor roadmaps.
* Prepare business cases, financial forecasts, investment recommendations and leadership updates for the product portfolio.
* Provide direction to internal teams, external suppliers and project resources delivering roadmap initiatives; the role may hold the “Sponsor’s Representative” role or coordinate work across teams without direct line\-management responsibility.
* Ensure platform decisions and changes are properly governed and align with EY security, privacy, compliance, architecture and operational resilience requirements.


**Knowledge, skills and experience requirements:**
 To be successful in this role, candidates should exhibit the following core knowledge and skills:
   

  

* Strong product management experience in a global enterprise technology environment, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, lifecycle management and value realization.
* Experience managing software platforms for monitoring, observing and managing IoT endpoints, including unified communications, workplace technology or AV devices.
* Understanding of telemetry, events, device health, alerting, incident workflows, dashboards, APIs, data integration and management automation concepts.
* Ability to translate operational and technical requirements into clear product capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Experience developing on\-boarding and support processes and operational transition plans for enterprise platforms.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including business\-case development, cost\-benefit analysis, forecasting and KPI definition.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships, influence decisions and gain consensus across diverse functions, cultures and geographies.
* Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and concisely to engineering teams, operational stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience managing vendors, licensing, contracts, performance reviews and product evaluations.
* Knowledge of AV, Microsoft Teams Rooms, unified communications, collaboration technology or workplace technology is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal, Utelogy, Cisco Control Hub, Poly Lens, Jabra\+, Neat Pulse, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync, ServiceNow, Netcool or Power BI is beneficial.
* Ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities and lead through ambiguity.
* Fluent written and spoken English; flexibility to participate in periodic early or late meetings with global stakeholders. Travel is expected to be limited.


**Qualifications, certifications and education requirements:**
* Successful candidates will have the specific role experience noted below:
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Typically 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in product management, IT operations, monitoring and management, unified communications, workplace technology or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to the lifecycle of enterprise software products or platforms used by global teams.
* Experience leading platform evaluations, proofs of concept, pilots and production deployments.
* Experience defining and tracking measurable business and operational outcomes for technology products.
* Product Management, ITIL, Agile, Scrum, SAFe or PMP certification is beneficial.
* AVIXA CTS or relevant Microsoft, Cisco or other collaboration technology certification is beneficial.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About the Role:**
 The Global Transition and Transformation function has oversight and end to end delivery accountability for a wide portfolio of transformation programs and projects spanning Operating Model, Process and Enterprise level transformation. Your role therefore is pivotal to front\-ending and delivering the Operating Model transformation road map for Haleon.
   

  

* Transition Scoping and planning:
* Facilitate discovery workshops and document transition scope. Plan follow\-ups where required.
* Facilitate planning workshops; develop and baseline the end\-end transition roadmap / plan.


* Business Case: Closely monitor spend; manage baseline changes through change control.
* Governance:
+ Partner with the Global PMO to ensure toll gate criteria are well defined relative to the transition nature and tollgates are orchestrated in line with the transition plan. Prepare content for tollgates.
+ Prepare status reports on overall transition health for report\-out at weekly governance. Leverage standard tooling and best practices as prescribed by the Global PMO for status updates.

* Detailed Design / Solutioning, Knowledge Transfer (KT) planning:
* Consolidate outcomes of the detailed design for report\-out.
* Facilitate Knowledge Transfer planning workshops covering all aspects of the processes to be transitioned with clear alignment on scope, trainers, timelines, and ways of working.


* Recruitment, Onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT):
+ Participate in recruitment steer cos; ensure HR gets required support from business to hire at pace.
+ Align with IT requirements and raise provisioning requests in line with onboarding timelines.
+ Onboard new joiners and orient / deploy for KT in accordance with the KT plan.
+ Stakeholder Management: Plan stakeholder connects at an agreed cadence to keep them informed of the transition progress. Maintain a stakeholder log evidencing stakeholder engagement (Actions from the meetings, follow up plans etc.)
+ Facilitate Governance \& actions Management
+ Chair and lead the partnership governance
+ Partner with the Enterprise Transformation office and represent HBS in TO governance
+ Collect and Co\-ordinate Actions into the Programme Team
+ Ensure that the Actions Board is being proactively managed
+ Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership

+ Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership


* Change Control Management

+ Manage the Change Board invite based upon scope of Change Items to be presented
+ Action any approved changes, updating the key Programme artefacts
+ Communicating outcomes from the Change Board


**Qualifications \& Skills:**
* 7\+ years demonstrated experience of transitioning processes from local markets to Shared Services Captives, Outsourcing partners etc.
* Transition management experience across multiple functions (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Tech etc.) in a Consumer goods company is a plus, but not mandatory
* Demonstrated proficiency in project, program, portfolio management processes and principles
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects through both Agile and waterfall approach is desirable.
* Demonstrated resilience in navigating through complex and ambiguous change.
* Excellent interpersonal (communication and presentation) and organizational skills
* Hands on experience on PM tools – Example MS Project, MS P4W, Jira, Confluence, Teams
* Good to have Certifications – PMP, Prince 2


 This is a unique opportunity to influence change, interact with global stakeholders on projects and programs that drive a real impact to the Haleon businesses. Your ability to ‘make things happen’ coupled with a ‘positive can\-do attitude’ will set you up for success in this role.

title: Lead. Application Engineer II
description:

 Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.

 Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc.
   

  

 As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities.

You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, and engineering, to ensure alignment and effective Solution development.

* Preparing technical proposals, cost estimates ensuring it meet the customer requirement and provide competitive advantage to JCI.
* Develop solutions specific dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data modeling strategies as part of presales demonstrations, highlighting portfolio‑level insights and operational benefits.
* Provide technical leadership to coordinate, prioritize and deliver proposal, commercials in pre\-sales process.
* Articulate goals, desired outcomes, risks/issues and mitigation plan clearly in pre\-sales process.
* Clearly qualify out of the box solutions and possible customizations needed.
* Provide feedback to product management and development teams regarding customer needs and market demands


**What We Look For**
* 8\-10\+ years’ experience as Presales engineer and delivering proposals, commercials in overall Bid process.
* Expertise in Solutioning, designing and delivering building technology Solutions e.g. BMS, Security, Fire and Lighting.
* Hands\-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred.
* Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have.
* Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols.
* knowledge of HVAC or Industrial Process Control systems, IT\-OT Integrations, API integrations.
* Knowledge of L2 and L3 Networking, Switching, Servers, Virtualization concepts and Clustering.
* knowledge of cloud IoT platforms and services (MS Azure is preferred)
* Familiar with Energy Management, Cloud based Analytics tools, Digital Twin, Digital asset management and BRICK schema concepts.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in an energizing and fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with industry leaders to understand current technology trends and relevancy.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and new product features.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools.
* Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and customer\-oriented mindset.

**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\) Define and own the vehicle vision, customer value proposition, and technical direction for all 3W and 4W platforms.
 



 2\) Lead vehicle architecture, platform strategy, package integration, and technology roadmaps across ICE, EV, and future mobility solutions.
 



 3\) Drive end\-to\-end system integration across all Engineering CoCs, ensuring alignment of vehicle\-level objectives and interfaces.

 9\) Monitor field performance, warranty trends, and customer feedback, driving continuous product and platform improvements.
 



 10\) Build and mentor high\-performing engineering teams, develop technical capabilities, and drive succession planning.
 



 11\) Manage engineering budgets, resource allocation, and capability investments to support business growth.
 



 12\) Act as the primary technical authority for CMB vehicle programs, advising senior leadership on product strategy, risks, and key decisions. 13\) Manage, Achieve and Report all milestone deliverables of NPD towards achieving right design maturity at each NPD process gates 14\) Work with all cross functioal teams across organization to achieve desired reults.
 



**Education** 




 B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics or related engineering discipline. M.E. / M.Tech in Automotive, Systems, Mechanical, Electrical or a related field is preferred. Management or program leadership qualification is an advantage.
 



**Experience** 




 20\+ years of automotive product development experience, including substantial vehicle\-level leadership for 3W, 4W, commercial vehicle, passenger vehicle or adjacent mobility platforms. Demonstrated ownership of at least one complete vehicle program from concept to launch and field stabilisation; experience across EV and/or ICE architectures, multi\-CoC integration, validation and industrialization is preferred.
 



**Key Skills** 




 Professional / Functional Competencies
 



 • Complete vehicle engineering and architecture: expert understanding of vehicle attributes, package, systems interfaces, integration and trade\-off management across 3W and 4W platforms.
 



 • Commercial mobility domain: strong knowledge of duty cycles, payload, total cost of ownership, durability, reliability, serviceability, uptime, fleet/customer needs and regional operating conditions.
 



 • Product development leadership: target setting, requirements management, systems engineering / V\-model, technical gateways, configuration management and change control.
 



 • Cross\-domain depth: working mastery of body, chassis, suspension, steering, brakes, powertrain / EV systems, E/E architecture, embedded software, thermal systems, vehicle dynamics, NVH, CAE and validation.
 



 • Safety and compliance: knowledge of applicable vehicle regulations, homologation, functional safety, cybersecurity, DFMEA / System FMEA, DVP, reliability and quality methods.
 



 • QCD and industrialisation: design\-to\-cost, value engineering, supplier technical management, manufacturing feasibility, launch readiness, root\-cause methods and field\-quality improvement.
 



 • Digital engineering: exposure to MBSE, requirements tools, PLM, simulation\-led development, data\-based decision\-making and connected vehicle diagnostics.
 



  





**Leadership / Behavioural Competencies** 




 • Strategic orientation and customer focus; enterprise\-level systems thinking; decisive technical judgement under ambiguity.
 



 • Influencing without direct authority; strong governance, conflict resolution, communication and executive stakeholder management.
 



 • Builds technical capability, coaches leaders, encourages innovation and creates accountability across distributed teams.
 



 • Integrity, ownership, learning agility, collaboration and disciplined execution.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

title: Ezhomz_Project Manager
description:
**EZHOMZ**

Luxury Residential Automation · Smart Building Integration · Delhi NCR

**We are hiring**

**Project Manager**

Home Automation \& Lighting Control

**Location\- Delhi NCR**

**Experience\- 4\-10 yrs**

**Reports to\- Founder, EZHomz**

**Type\- Full time, on site**

**Read this line first.** This role is for someone who has personally programmed automation systems — KNX, Lutron, Crestron, Control4, RTI or ELAN — and has since moved into managing projects without losing that ability. If you have coordinated automation work but never opened the programming software yourself, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather say so here than at the interview.

**About EZHOMZ**

EZHOMZ designs and delivers automation for luxury residences across Delhi NCR — KNX and DALI lighting control, curtain and comfort systems, and OKAS integration, working with brands including Ekinex, Moorgen and Blacknova. Our clients are homeowners with high expectations and architects and interior designers who hold us to their standard.

We are deliberately building EZHOMZ into a professionally managed company rather than a founder\-dependent one. This seat is a central part of that: it exists so that projects run on their own momentum, with the founder consulted on decisions rather than chased for them.

**The role**

You will own three to six live residences at a time, from the point the BOQ is approved through to client sign\-off and handover into service. You are the person who knows the state of every one of them without being asked, and who never lets one slip because another was loud.

This is not a coordination seat. You will size the programming work honestly, challenge an optimistic estimate, cover a programmer who is unavailable, and hold a technical position in front of an architect or an MEP consultant without escalating it. That is why the programming background matters: a manager who can open the project file is a different animal from one who can only ask about it.

**What you will actually do**

– **Own the delivery plan.** Convert the approved automation BOQ into a sequenced site plan — first fix, conduiting and back\-boxes, panel space, device mounting, commissioning, scene programming, client training, handover.

– **Drive site readiness.** Work ahead of the trades so our team never mobilises to a site that is not ready. Get conduiting and back\-box positions right with the electrician and the interior designer before the ceiling closes, because after that everything costs ten times more.

– **Own the programming plan.** Size the work, supervise or perform the platform programming, and validate the system yourself before it goes anywhere near the client.

– **Run the cadence.** A live schedule, a weekly progress report the client can read, a decision log, and drawing revision control. Escalations arrive with a recommendation attached, or they are not escalations.

– **Protect the commercials.** Defend the BOQ, price variations honestly, verify vendor bills, and raise commercial exposure early rather than at handover.

– **Coordinate the ecosystem.** Architect, interior designer, MEP consultant, electrician, carpenter, site engineer and vendor partners — everyone should know what is needed, by whom, by when, and what it depends on.

– **Carry the client relationship on site.** Set expectations, avoid surprises, and leave every interaction with the client more confident than before it. Never expose internal confusion.

– **Close properly.** Client training at handover, a complete documentation pack, and a clean transition into service and AMC.

**Essential — we will not compromise on these**

– **Hands\-on programming on KNX (ETS) or Lutron.** You have built the topology, addressed the devices, written the scenes and commissioned on site yourself — not stood beside the person who did.

– **Working capability on at least one control platform:** Crestron, Control4, RTI or ELAN. Tell us which, and which software you used.

– **The journey: engineer, then programmer, then project ownership.** At least two years in a programming seat before you moved into managing.

– **4–10 years total experience**, with the ability to run three or more live residences concurrently.

– **Presence.** You can sit with an HNI client, an architect and an interior designer, hold the room, and write to them afterwards in a way that builds confidence.

– **Delhi NCR base**, or a genuine willingness to relocate.

**Desirable, not essential**

– DALI commissioning depth — short addressing, groups and scenes, and what has to happen when a fixture is replaced after handover.

– KNX Partner certification, or a Crestron, Control4, Lutron, RTI or ELAN dealer certification.

– Experience of luxury residential finish standards, and the disruption tolerance that comes with working in an occupied home.

– A scheduling and reporting habit you can show us, not only describe.

– Exposure to OKAS or comparable integration platforms.

**This role is probably not for you if**

– You have managed automation projects without ever programming one. You would spend the first year unable to judge the work your team is doing, and you would not enjoy it.

– You want one flagship project to pour yourself into. This seat runs several at once, and the skill is holding all of them.

– You would rather be at a desk than on site. Much of this job happens standing in a half\-built room with a drawing in your hand.

**What we offer**

– **Complete residences, not fragments.** You own the project from BOQ handover to sign\-off, with real decision authority inside it.

– **An engineered standard to work from.** Our BOQ logic, design standards and technical references already exist, so your time goes into delivery rather than reinvention.

– **Direct access to the founder** and a genuine say in how the delivery function is built, at a moment when it is being built.

– **Continued technical growth.** We will fund platform certification. We would rather you got better at the craft than drifted away from it.

– **Compensation:** Depends on Interview

**How to apply**

Write to **hr@ezhomz.com** with your CV and a short note answering three things:

– Which platforms have you personally programmed, and which software did you use?

– What is the most difficult commissioning problem you have solved yourself — what went wrong, what you tried, and how it ended?

– How many projects were you running at the same time, at peak?

*We read these properly. A specific, honest answer to the second question will get you further than a long CV.*

title: Safety/Security Director - Safety, Security & Emergency Preparedness Branch, 60007 (2026-03472)
description:
**Description**
**APPLICANTS MAY BE EDUCATIONAL OFFICERS, TEACHERS AND OTHER QUALIFIED INDIVIDUALS**
**SPECIAL INTERNAL / EXTERNAL**
****TYPE OF APPOINTMENT ISSUED:****
 This position is excluded from the Educational Officers' Bargaining Unit and will be filled as a clear line appointment.
   

  

**A WRITTEN EXAMINATION/ASSIGNMENT MAY BE ADMINISTERED TO HELP DETERMINE POSSESSION OF THE KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES PORTIONS OF THE MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS.**
**Examples of Duties**
 Under the general supervision of the Assistant Superintendent of the Office of Campus Operations and Support, the Safety, Security and Emergency Preparedness Director:
   

  

* Strategic and Fiscal Administration
* Directs Branch operations and aligns program activities with Department strategic goals, policies, and procedures.
* Establishes program goals, priorities, performance measures, and operational plans for the Branch.
* Evaluates administrative performance and service delivery to identify operational issues, improve program effectiveness, and ensure regulatory compliance.
* Administers the operating budget, allocates fiscal resources, and monitors expenditures to ensure fiscal accountability.
* Prepares internal operational reports, budget proposals, policy recommendations, memoranda, and executive communications for Department leadership and external stakeholders.
* Executive Liaison and External Relations
* Represents the Department on school safety, security, and emergency management initiatives across complex area offices, districts, and state agencies to ensure alignment and coordinated implementation of statewide initiatives.
* Accompanies or represents the OCOS Assistant Superintendent in meetings with the Superintendent, Board of Education, legislative hearings, and civic or community groups as assigned.
* Prepares legislative testimony, executive briefings, and formal responses to inquiries from elected officials, governmental agencies, and the public.
* Builds and maintains collaborative partnerships with federal, state, county, and community agencies to advance Department priorities and strengthen statewide safety and emergency preparedness efforts.
* Personnel and Operations Management
* Provides leadership, supervision, and direction to staff within the Branch; establishes performance expectations, evaluates performance, identifies professional development opportunities, and supports required training.
* Directs workforce planning, recruitment, selection, employee development, succession planning, and personnel actions in accordance with Department policies and collective bargaining agreements.
* Conducts staff meetings and provides guidance regarding the interpretation and implementation of laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and program requirements to promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Emergency Management and Security Coordination
* Serves as the Department's emergency management coordinator and primary liaison with state and county emergency management agencies; coordinates Department preparedness, response, recovery, and continuity of operations for emergencies and disasters affecting schools and Department facilities.
* Oversees the development, implementation, maintenance, and periodic review of the Department’s Emergency Operations Plan, Continuity of Operations Plan, and related emergency management plans.
* Provides timely situational awareness and emergency notifications to Department leadership regarding natural hazards, public safety incidents, and emergencies; coordinates statewide shelter operations and Department\-wide emergency response activities when required.
* Provides statewide leadership for school safety and security initiatives by overseeing safety and security vulnerability assessments, risk analyses, security technology, security personnel training, and the development of standards for physical security, access control, and visitor management.
* Establishes and maintains collaborative partnerships with law enforcement, fire services, emergency management agencies, and other public safety organizations to strengthen school safety, security, emergency preparedness, and coordinated response efforts.
* Evaluates safety and security incidents, identifies emerging threats and trends, and implements risk mitigation strategies.
* Policy, Compliance and Technical Assistance
* Directs the development, interpretation, implementation, and communication of Department policies, procedures, standards, and guidance related to safety, security, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensures schools and Department offices receive timely technical assistance, training, and consultation to support consistent implementation of statewide programs and compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Department requirements.
* Monitors changes in legislation, regulations, and professional best practices and recommends policy or program modifications to improve effectiveness and organizational readiness.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education** 
 : Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree in public policy, law enforcement, emergency or safety management, public or business administration, criminal justice, or related field.
   

  

**Experience** 
 : Nine (9\) years of responsible professional work experience in emergency, safety or security management, education or related field of which five (5\) years shall have been in an education or government program, agency, or system, including two (2\) years supervising professional personnel.
   

  

**Combined Education and Experience** 
 : An equivalent combination of education and experience may be acceptable, as determined by the Department. Substitutions can be considered for the requirement of experience in an education program, agency or system.
   

  

**Knowledge** 
 : Effective communication and leadership principles; change management and organizational behavior; operations and productivity management; basic research methods and statistics; budget development and fiscal management; laws, rules, regulations, and administrative procedures pertinent to the areas of assignment; principles and practices of supervision and management.
   

  

**Desired Knowledge** 
 : Principles and practices of school safety and security; emergency management, operations planning, and continuity of operations; safety management principles and occupational safety requirements; threat assessment and violence prevention; federal and state laws affecting school safety and emergency management; public relations; current literature, trends, methods, and developments in the areas of assignment.
   

  

**Ability to** 
 : Plan, direct, coordinate, and evaluate central staff services; deal effectively with federal, state, county, and departmental officials and others to accomplish program goals and objectives; communicate effectively with others both orally and in writing; operate a computer and other business machines.
   

  

**Desired Ability to** 
 : Lead complex statewide safety and emergency management programs; make sound decisions during emergencies and rapidly changing situations; analyze complex operational, security, and emergency management issues; exercise discretion and sound judgment in a managerial capacity in prioritizing projects and carrying out assignments, organizing projects and completing work within limited time/other constraints; set, model and uphold high ethical behavior and standards for staff; supervise the work of others and/or instruct staff as appropriate; prepare executive reports, policies, and presentations; evaluate effectiveness of programs to recommend direction or priorities to achieve program goals and objectives; improve and implement programs and procedures; assist districts, complexes and schools in the coordination and implementation of the pro grams.
   

  

**Supplemental Information**
**SALARY RANGE:** 
 EOSR\-10, $130,120 to $184,201\.
   

  

 Department of Education certificated employees will be placed on the salary range in accordance with Department regulations.
   

  

 All others will be placed on the first step of $130,120\.
   

  

**NOTE:** 
 Department of Education employees will be placed on the salary range in accordance with Department regulations. All new external applicants will be placed on the initial step of the salary range. However, placement above the initial step of the salary range will be based on special characteristics and critical needs of the position, an applicant's exceptional qualifications, the availability of funds, and other relevant factors. Such appointments require prior approval.
   

  

**WORK YEAR AND BENEFITS:**

title: Technical Delivery Manager - Data Engineering - RDT Pharma Medicines
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The Technical Data Delivery Manager will own the delivery of data solutions across the Pharma Commercial ecosystem — including Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Managed Markets, Patient Services, and Commercial Analytics. This role acts as the critical link between commercial business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely data across the full commercial data lifecycle — from data acquisition and integration through to reporting and insights.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Data Delivery\& Program Management
  
  

* Own delivery of data pipelines, integrations, and platforms supporting Commercial functions: Sales (call activity, targeting, alignments), Marketing (campaign/digital engagement), Market Access (payer/formulary data), and Patient Services (hub/specialty pharmacy data).
* Manage data ingestion from third\-party sources: IQVIA, Symphony Health/Komodo, Veeva, Definitive Healthcare, claims data (medical/pharmacy), specialty pharmacy, and distributor data.
* Lead sprint planning, release cycles, UAT, and production go\-lives in partnership with data engineering, IT, and business teams.
* Manage timelines for recurring commercial data cycles (e.g., monthly/weekly sales data refreshes, incentive compensation cycles, alignment updates)
* Manage key projects and programs


Business\& Technical Liaison
  
  

* Translate requirements from Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Marketing, and Market Access teams into technical specifications.
* Serve as SME on commercial data domains: sales force effectiveness (SFE), CRM (Veeva/Salesforce), MDM (customer/HCP/HCO data), incentive compensation, segmentation\& targeting, and syndicated data.
* Partner with Compliance/Legal/Privacy on data usage governance (HIPAA, state privacy laws, data licensing terms with vendors like IQVIA/Veeva).


Data Quality\& Governance
  
  

* Define and monitor KPIs for data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness across commercial data feeds.
* Establish reconciliation and exception\-handling processes (e.g., HCP/HCO matching, territory alignment discrepancies, sales data anomalies).
* Drive root\-cause analysis for data issues impacting compensation, targeting, or reporting accuracy.


Team\& Vendor Leadership
  
  

* Manage data analysts/engineers and/or third\-party vendors and system integrators.
* Own vendor relationships with commercial data providers (IQVIA, Veeva, Symphony/Komodo, Definitive Healthcare, etc.).


Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes and improve delivery speed/scalability.
* Support data governance initiatives across the commercial data landscape.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (Master's a plus).
* 7\+ years in data management/delivery, with 3\+ years specifically inpharma/biotech/life sciences commercial data.
* Experience with commercial data platforms: Veeva CRM, Salesforce, MDM tools (Reltio, IQVIA OneKey), incentive compensation systems.
* Strong knowledge of pharma commercial data sources: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD), Symphony Health/Komodo, claims data, specialty pharmacy/hub data, HCP/HCO reference data.
* Proficiency in SQL, ETL/data pipeline tools, and cloud data warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift).
* Program/project management experience delivering technical solutions in a regulated, matrixed environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technical functions.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data stack tools (dbt, Airflow, Informatica).
* Familiarity with BI/visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Spotfire).
* Understanding of pharma compliance (Sunshine Act, HIPAA, OIG guidelines) as applied to commercial data use.
* Agile/Scrum or PMP certification.


Key Competencies
  
  

* Broad domain fluency across pharma commercial functions (not siloed to one area)
* Technical depth in data architecture/integration
* Vendor and cross\-functional stakeholder management
* Strong analytical/problem\-solving orientation
* Comfort operating in a highly regulated, compliance\-sensitive environment


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.

 We are actively building the next generation of intelligent product ecosystems. * Python Mastery: Deep expertise in Python, asynchronous programming, and modern frameworks like FastAPI.

* Deep Dive \& System Design: Architecture discussion focused on RAG pipelines, scaling, and past ML projects.
* Final Chat \& Offer: Closing alignment with leadership and official offer rollout.

description:
**We Are**

 YouTrip is the leading and fastest\-growing multi\-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi\-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the \#1 multi\-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually.

YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 
 



 Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024\), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023\), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.
 



 Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast\-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.
   




**Job Description \- IT System Administrator**

 We're looking for a tech\-savvy IT System Administrator to join our team and provide IT system setup and technical support to our employees. The IT Administrator will be responsible for setting up IT system infrastructure, troubleshooting and resolving IT\-related issues, managing our wired and wireless office network infrastructure, and working with vendors and internal teams to ensure our IT systems are up\-to\-date and secure. The ideal candidate should have strong problem\-solving skills and a thorough understanding of information technology, including hardware, software, networking, and information security. 
   




**You Will**
* Install, configure, and maintain both hardware and software systems including variety of SaaS based and internal applications, such as Slack, Google Workspace, AWS WorkSpaces, Github, JIRA, Confluence, VPN
* Troubleshoot, and resolve IT\-related hardware and software issues reported by internal users, and manage the process of support ticketing
* Monitor network and system performance, including network security and security logs
* Be the IT liaison for new hires, assist to create accounts and set up hardware for new hires
* Train users on new hardware and software
* Support audio and video equipment, and printer in office
* Manage the life cycle and purchase forecast of corporate assets to ensure accurate inventory records
* Support working with shared space owner, support the network equipment setup and optimization in the office, troubleshoot issues with the network and ISP vendors
* Work with internal teams or vendors to resolve technical issues
* Support information security audits


**Requirements**
**You Are**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Networking or other related disciplines.
* Good working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, information security, computer systems, hardware, and software
* Experience supporting hardware and software issues on Mac, and Windows, operating systems
* Working knowledge of networking protocols and setup, such as ethernet, wireless network, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN
* Experience with modern SaaS tools and open\-source software is desirable
* Strong written documentation skills (ticket notes, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, user guides)
* Strong ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively with internal and external teams
* Good communication, prioritization, and stakeholder coordination skills
* Basic AWS console/access support exposure will be advantageous
* Familiarity with JQL, Google Apps Script, APIs/webhooks/JSON preferred
* Experience with asset inventory / CMDB tools will be a bonus
* ITIL fundamentals (Incident / Request / Escalation / Problem Management) will be a plus point
